Business & Domain 14 topics

BD-01Role of a data analystBasicMust Know

Analyst ka kaam hai data se business decisions ko support karna. Product, marketing, ops, finance sabke liye questions answer karna.

Simple me samjho

Analyst ek translator hai. Business ke sawal ko data ki language me badalta hai, aur data ke jawab ko wapas business ki language me. Jaise poker room ka manager poochta hai "players kam kyun aa rahe hain?" aur tum numbers se jawab dete ho.

Key points

  • Product analytics: feature usage, funnels, retention. Example: new lobby UI se hands played badha ya nahi.
  • Marketing analytics: campaigns, channels, CAC, ROAS. Kaunsa channel sasta aur quality players laata hai.
  • Ops analytics: support tickets, KYC turnaround, withdrawal time, fraud/bot flags.
  • Finance analytics: revenue (rake), bonus cost, GGR/NGR, forecast vs actual.
  • Analyst vs Scientist vs Engineer: Analyst = questions answer + dashboards + insights. Scientist = models, experiments, prediction. Engineer = pipelines, warehouse, data quality ka infra.
  • Boundaries overlap karti hain: chhoti company me analyst SQL, dashboard, thoda pipeline sab karta hai.
  • Stakeholder expectation 1: correct numbers. Ek galat number se trust toot jata hai.
  • Stakeholder expectation 2: time pe delivery aur clear next step, sirf chart nahi.
  • Stakeholder expectation 3: "so what?" yaani insight plus recommendation.
  • Proactive hona: sawal aane ka wait mat karo, khud anomalies aur opportunities flag karo.

Example

Scenario: Marketing head bolta hai "Deposits gir gaye."

  • Analyst pehle check karta hai: data sahi hai ya pipeline fail hui?
  • Phir segment karta hai: channel, country, device, new vs returning.
  • Finding: Android new users ka payment success rate 92% se 70% hua.
  • Recommendation: payments team ko gateway issue ke liye ping karo.

Yaha analyst ne sirf number nahi, cause aur action diya.

Common mistakes

  • Sirf data nikal ke dena, bina context ya insight ke.
  • Dashboard banana bina poochhe ki decision kya lena hai.
  • Business ki language ke bajaye technical jargon use karna.
  • Apne numbers ki limitation (missing data, assumption) batana bhool jana.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Data analyst aur data scientist me kya farak hai?
    A. Analyst past/present samjhata hai (SQL, BI, insights). Scientist predictive models aur experiments banata hai. Overlap hota hai, focus alag hota hai.
  • Q. Ek achha analyst kya banata hai?
    A. Business samajh, accurate numbers, clear communication, aur data ko action me badalne ki ability.

Yaad rakho

Analyst ka output number nahi, decision hai.

BD-02Understanding the business modelBasicMust Know

Company paisa kaise kamati hai, kharcha kahan hota hai, customer ka journey kya hai, aur kaun kis cheez ka owner hai.

Simple me samjho

Business model matlab "paisa kahan se aata hai aur kahan jata hai". Ye samjhe bina metrics bekaar hain. Poker platform me paisa players ke deposits se aur rake se banta hai, kharcha bonus, marketing, payment fees me hota hai.

Key points

  • Revenue streams (poker): rake from cash games, tournament fees, rakeback ke baad net, sometimes ads/partnerships.
  • Cash game rake: har pot ka chhota percent platform rakhta hai, cap ke saath.
  • Tournament fee: buy-in me se entry fee platform ki hoti hai.
  • Cost drivers: marketing/acquisition, bonuses aur promotions, payment gateway fees, tech/infra, support, compliance/KYC, taxes.
  • Customer journey: Acquire (ad/install) -> Register -> KYC -> First deposit -> First game -> Repeat play -> VIP -> Churn/Reactivation.
  • Key teams: Marketing (acquisition), Product (features), Ops/Support (KYC, withdrawals), Risk/Fraud (collusion, bots), Finance (reporting), Payments, Engineering.
  • Who owns what: har metric ka ek owner hona chahiye. Deposit success = Payments, CAC = Marketing, hands/DAU = Product.
  • Players ko dekho: few high-value players zyada revenue dete hain (Pareto). Segmentation zaroori hai.
  • Unit of business: poker me "hand", "table", "player", "session" basic units hain.

Example

Ek simple revenue flow:

ItemAmount
Total pots (hands)1,000,000
Rake at 5%50,000
Bonus cost12,000
Payment fees3,000
Contribution35,000

Yaha analyst samajhta hai ki rake badhane ka matlab hands ya stakes badhana hai, aur bonus cost control me rakhna hai.

Common mistakes

  • Revenue aur deposit ko same samajhna. Deposit player ka paisa hai, revenue sirf rake hai.
  • Sirf average dekhna aur high-value players ka alag behavior ignore karna.
  • Teams ka ownership na samajhna, aur galat bande se data ya fix maangna.
  • Seasonality aur promos ko business model se alag mana.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Online poker company paisa kaise kamati hai?
    A. Mainly rake aur tournament fees se. Deposits revenue nahi hote, wo player balance hai.
  • Q. Naye company me business samajhne ke liye pehle kya karoge?
    A. Revenue streams, customer journey, top 5 metrics aur unke owners ko map karunga. Phir stakeholders se baat.

Yaad rakho

Pehle paisa ka flow samjho, phir metrics banao.

BD-03KPIs and metricsBasicMust Know

Metric koi bhi measurement hai, KPI wo metric hai jo goal se juda ho. Sahi metrics chunna analyst ki core skill hai.

Simple me samjho

Car me speedometer, fuel, temperature sab metrics hain. Par agar goal "time pe pahunchna" hai to speed KPI hai. Metric = measure. KPI = important metric jo target se linked hai.

Key points

  • Metric vs KPI: Metric = koi bhi number (page views). KPI = goal se linked metric (D7 retention target 25%).
  • Dimension: wo attribute jisse metric ko tod ke dekhte hain: country, device, channel, stake level, date.
  • Leading metric: future ka signal deta hai. Example: first-week hands played, D1 retention.
  • Lagging metric: result batata hai, late. Example: monthly revenue, churn rate.
  • Vanity metric: achha dikhta hai par action nahi banta. Example: total registered users (kabhi girta nahi).
  • Actionable metric: dekh ke decision le sakte ho. Example: new-user D7 retention by channel.
  • North star metric: ek metric jo long-term value capture kare. Poker ke liye "weekly active players with 50+ hands" ya "rake per active player".
  • Metric tree: north star ko chhote drivers me todna. Revenue = Active players x Hands per player x Rake per hand.
  • Guardrail metrics: jo bigad na jaye, jaise withdrawal time ya fraud rate jab bonus badhao.
  • Ratio vs absolute: dono dikhao. Absolute scale batata hai, ratio efficiency.

Example

Metric tree for Rake Revenue:

text
Rake Revenue
 = Active Players
   x Hands per Active Player
   x Avg Rake per Hand
Active Players = New + Returning + Reactivated

Ab agar rake gira, check karo kaunsa branch gira. Is se investigation structured ho jati hai.

Common mistakes

  • Total registrations ko success batana (vanity).
  • Bahut zyada KPIs rakhna. 5-7 se zyada focus khatam kar dete hain.
  • Leading aur lagging me confuse hona aur sirf lagging ke peeche bhagna.
  • Metric ka target ya owner define na karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Vanity metric ka example do.
    A. Total signups. Ye sirf badhta hai, aur retention ya revenue ke bare me kuch nahi batata.
  • Q. North star metric kaise chunoge?
    A. Jo user value aur business value dono capture kare, aur team ke actions se move ho sake.

Yaad rakho

Achha KPI wo hai jise dekh ke tum kuch kar sako.

BD-04Metric definitions and business logicIntermediateMust Know

Metric ka precise definition likhna zaroori hai: kaun count hoga, kab, kis window me. Ambiguity se alag-alag numbers aate hain.

Simple me samjho

"Active user" ka matlab sabke liye alag ho sakta hai: login, hand khela, ya deposit kiya. Jab tak definition fix nahi, meetings me numbers ladte rahenge. Isliye data dictionary me ek hi definition likhte hain.

Key points

  • DAU: ek calendar day (timezone fix) me distinct users jinhone qualifying action kiya (jaise 1 hand khela). MAU = 30 days ya calendar month me distinct users.
  • Churn: us period me users jo pehle active the aur ab active nahi. Poker me usually "N days inactive" rule (jaise 30 days).
  • Retention: cohort ka kitna percent day-N par wapas aaya.
  • ARPU: total revenue / active users. ARPPU: revenue / paying users.
  • LTV: ek user se lifetime me expected revenue (ya margin). CAC: acquisition spend / new customers acquired.
  • Conversion: users jo next stage tak gaye / users jo stage tak aaye. Denominator clear likho.
  • Edge cases: timezone (UTC vs IST), bots/test accounts, refunds, duplicate users, late-arriving data.
  • Data dictionary: har metric ka name, definition, formula, source table, owner, refresh time, known caveats.
  • Single source of truth: ek hi SQL view/semantic layer me metric ki logic rakho.
  • Change log: definition badle to version aur date likho.

Example

sql
-- DAU: players who played at least 1 hand (PostgreSQL)
SELECT DATE(played_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AS day,
       COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS dau
FROM hands_played
WHERE is_test_account = false
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

Yaha definition: "hand khela" + test accounts excluded + IST day. Ye sab dictionary me likha jayega.

Common mistakes

  • DAU ko login se aur kisi aur dashboard me hand se count karna.
  • Timezone ignore karna, jisse raat ke events galat din me jate hain.
  • Churn ke denominator me naye users bhi daal dena.
  • Definition sirf kisi ke dimaag me rakhna, likhna nahi.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Churn ko kaise define karoge?
    A. Period start me active users me se jo period me inactive ho gaye. Window (jaise 30 days) business ke hisab se fix karunga aur document karunga.
  • Q. Do dashboards me DAU alag hai, kya karoge?
    A. Definitions, filters, timezone aur source tables compare karunga, phir ek official definition tay karunga.

Yaad rakho

Jo metric likha nahi gaya, wo metric nahi hai.

BD-05Requirement gatheringIntermediateMust Know

Request ke peeche ka asli business sawal, decision, success criteria aur deadline poochna. Galat sawal ka sahi jawab bekaar hota hai.

Simple me samjho

Doctor ki tarah socho: patient bolta hai "dawai do", doctor pehle poochta hai takleef kya hai. Stakeholder ki request bhi ek symptom hoti hai. Pehle sawal samjho, phir query likho.

Key points

  • Business question: asli sawal kya hai? "Deposit report chahiye" ke peeche shayad "payment failure kyun badhe" hai.
  • Decision: is data se kaunsa decision hoga? Agar koi decision nahi, to report shayad zaroori nahi.
  • Audience: kaun dekhega: CEO, marketing, ops. Detail level unke hisab se.
  • Metric definitions: kaunse metrics, kaunsa time range, kaunse segments, exclusions.
  • Success criteria: "kya dikhe to hum bolenge sawal solve ho gaya?"
  • Deadline aur priority: kab chahiye, one-time ya recurring, kitna accuracy chahiye (quick estimate ya audited).
  • Data availability: data kahan hai, kitna clean hai, history kitni hai.
  • Restate karo: apne words me repeat karo aur confirm karo. Misunderstanding yahin pakdi jati hai.
  • Scope control: naye asks aaye to alag ticket ya timeline update.

Example

Request: "Mujhe VIP players ka report do."

QuestionAnswer mila
VIP kaun?30 din me rake > 5,000
Decision?Kitna rakeback offer karna hai
Time range?Last 90 days
Deadline?Thursday meeting

Ab analyst ke paas clear spec hai, aur 3 baar rework nahi hoga.

Common mistakes

  • Pehli request ko literally le lena aur seedha query likhna.
  • Assumptions likhit me confirm na karna.
  • Ek saath bahut saare questions poochna. 3-5 sharp questions kafi hain.
  • Deadline aur data limitations ko pehle hi na batana.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Stakeholder vague request de to kya karoge?
    A. Decision aur goal poochunga, metrics aur time range clarify karunga, aur summary email se confirm karunga.
  • Q. Aap kaunse 3 questions hamesha poochte ho?
    A. Is data se kaunsa decision hoga? Kab chahiye? Success kaise measure hogi?

Yaad rakho

Pehle "kyun" poochho, phir "kya".

BD-06BRD / dashboard requirement docsIntermediateGood to Have

BRD ek document hai jisme business need, scope, metrics, wireframe aur acceptance criteria likhe hote hain, taki sab ek page par ho.

Simple me samjho

Ghar banane se pehle naksha banta hai. BRD dashboard ka naksha hai. Isse builder (analyst) aur client (stakeholder) dono ek hi cheez dekhte hain.

Key points

  • BRD: Business Requirement Document. "Kya aur kyun" batata hai, "kaise" nahi.
  • Typical sections: objective, background, stakeholders, scope (in/out), KPIs and definitions, filters, data sources, refresh frequency, access.
  • Wireframe: dashboard ka rough layout (paper, Figma, ya slide). Charts ki position aur type.
  • Acceptance criteria: testable conditions. Example: "Total rake number finance report se 0.5% ke andar match kare."
  • Non-functional needs: load time, refresh time, row-level security, mobile view.
  • Sign-off: stakeholder written approval deta hai. Ye scope creep se bachata hai.
  • Reading a BRD: pehle objective aur scope, phir definitions aur acceptance criteria dekho. Ambiguity flag karo.
  • Version control: changes track karo, date aur approver ke saath.
  • Out of scope clearly likho taaki expectations realistic rahein.

Example

Chhota BRD snippet:

text
Objective: Track daily cash-game rake by stake level.
Users: Finance, Product.
KPIs: Rake, Hands, Avg Pot, Active Players.
Filters: Date, Stake, Platform.
Refresh: Daily 6 AM IST.
Acceptance: Rake matches finance ledger within 0.5%.
Out of scope: Tournament data (Phase 2).

Is se build, QA aur sign-off ek clear checklist ban jati hai.

Common mistakes

  • Metrics ki definitions BRD me na likhna.
  • Acceptance criteria vague rakhna ("sahi dikhna chahiye").
  • Sign-off ke bina build shuru karna, phir baad me requirements badalna.
  • Document likh ke bhool jana. Changes ke baad update karo.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. BRD me sabse important cheez kya hai?
    A. Clear objective, metric definitions aur testable acceptance criteria. Isse misunderstanding kam hoti hai.
  • Q. Scope creep kaise handle karte ho?
    A. Original BRD aur sign-off dikhata hu, naye ask ko change request ya next phase me daalta hu.

Yaad rakho

BRD ka matlab hai: likh ke agree karo, phir build karo.

BD-07Funnel thinkingIntermediateMust Know

Funnel user ke steps ka sequence hai. Har step par kitne users bache, kahan gire, aur kitni der me gaye, ye dekhte hain.

Simple me samjho

Funnel ek chhalni jaisa hai: upar se zyada users aate hain, neeche tak kam pahunchte hain. Analyst dekhta hai sabse zyada leakage kahan hai.

Key points

  • Stages define karo: poker example: Install -> Register -> KYC done -> First deposit -> First hand.
  • Order aur window: steps ek sequence me hone chahiye, aur ek time window me (jaise 7 days) ya cohort-based.
  • Drop-off: ek step se agle step tak kitne users nahi gaye. Drop-off % = 1 - step conversion.
  • Step conversion: users at step N+1 / users at step N.
  • Overall conversion: last step / first step.
  • Time between steps: median time registration se first deposit tak. Lambi delay bhi ek problem hai.
  • Where to look first: sabse bada absolute drop ya sabse kharab step conversion, aur jo step fix karna sasta ho.
  • Segment karo: channel, device, country, new vs returning. Aksar drop ek hi segment me hota hai.
  • Strict vs loose funnel: strict me steps order me hone chahiye, loose me koi bhi order.
  • Data quality check: tracking events miss to nahi ho rahe.

Example

sql
-- Users per funnel stage (PostgreSQL)
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER (WHERE event = 'register')      AS registered,
  COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER (WHERE event = 'kyc_done')      AS kyc,
  COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER (WHERE event = 'first_deposit') AS deposited,
  COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER (WHERE event = 'first_hand')    AS played
FROM events
WHERE event_time >= DATE '2026-11-01';

Ye simple counts deta hai. Strict order chahiye to har user ke step times join karke compare karo.

Common mistakes

  • Steps ka order verify na karna aur sirf counts compare karna.
  • Different time windows ke users mix karna.
  • Overall conversion dekh ke step-level problem ignore karna.
  • Segment kiye bina average par conclusion nikalna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Funnel me drop-off bahut hai, kahan se start karoge?
    A. Data tracking verify, phir sabse bada drop wala step, phir segments (device, channel) se cause dhundunga.
  • Q. Step conversion aur overall conversion me kya farak hai?
    A. Step conversion do consecutive steps ka ratio hai. Overall first aur last step ka ratio.

Yaad rakho

Funnel me sabse bada leak dhundo, phir segment se wajah.

BD-08Cohort and retention thinkingIntermediateMust Know

Cohort users ka group hota hai jo same time par start hue. Retention batata hai wo group baad me kitna wapas aaya.

Simple me samjho

Ek class ke students jo same saal admit hue, unka 1st year, 2nd year me kitna percent bacha, ye cohort analysis hai. Poker me: "1 Nov ko register hue users me se D7 par kitne wapas aaye".

Key points

  • Cohort definition: signup date, first deposit date, ya first hand date ke basis par group. Basis clearly likho.
  • Retention rate: cohort me se kitne users day-N par active the / cohort size.
  • Day-N retention: exactly day N par active (D1, D7, D30). Strict hai.
  • Rolling (unbounded) retention: day N ya uske baad kabhi bhi active. Zyada forgiving, number high.
  • Retention curve: x = days since start, y = retention %. Curve ka shape insight deta hai.
  • Decaying curve: curve neeche girti rahe aur zero ke paas pahunche = product users ko rok nahi pa raha.
  • Flat curve: ek point ke baad curve flat ho jaye = loyal core user base hai. Ye healthy sign hai.
  • Smile curve: kuch users wapas aate hain (reactivation, promos).
  • Compare cohorts: Nov cohort vs Oct cohort, channel-wise cohort. Improvement dikhta hai.
  • Immature cohorts: recent cohort ka D30 abhi complete nahi hota. Usse compare mat karo.

Example

sql
-- D7 retention by signup date (PostgreSQL)
WITH c AS (
  SELECT user_id, DATE(created_at) AS cohort_day FROM users
)
SELECT c.cohort_day,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id) AS cohort_size,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_id) AS d7_active,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id), 1) AS d7_pct
FROM c
LEFT JOIN activity a
  ON a.user_id = c.user_id AND a.activity_date = c.cohort_day + 7
GROUP BY c.cohort_day
ORDER BY c.cohort_day;

Har cohort day ka D7 percent milta hai. Rolling retention ke liye activity_date >= c.cohort_day + 7 use karo.

Common mistakes

  • Day-N aur rolling retention ko mix karna.
  • Cohort size me inactive/test accounts rakhna.
  • Naye cohort ke incomplete data ko drop samajh lena.
  • Sirf average retention dekhna, channel/segment cohorts nahi.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Day-N aur rolling retention me farak?
    A. Day-N sirf exactly us din active users gino. Rolling me us din ya uske baad kabhi bhi active users gino, isliye number high hota hai.
  • Q. Flat retention curve ka matlab?
    A. Ek stage ke baad users stable rehte hain, yaani core loyal base hai. Product-market fit ka achha sign.

Yaad rakho

Retention curve ka shape number se zyada batata hai.

BD-09Unit economicsIntermediateGood to Have

Ek customer par company kitna kamati hai aur kitna kharch karti hai. LTV, CAC, payback aur margin isi ke measures hain.

Simple me samjho

Chai ki dukan: ek chai se Rs 5 profit, customer 100 baar aata hai. Ek customer laane ka kharch Rs 100 hai. Profit hai ya nahi, ye unit economics batati hai.

Key points

  • LTV: ek customer se lifetime me expected revenue ya margin. Simple: ARPU x lifetime ya ARPU x margin / churn.
  • CAC: marketing + sales spend / naye customers acquired. Poker me "paying player" ya "first depositor" ko customer maano, aur define karo.
  • LTV:CAC ratio: usually 3:1 ya zyada achha mana jata hai (rule of thumb, har business me alag).
  • Payback period: CAC wapas aane me kitne months lagte hain. Chhota payback = cash safe.
  • Contribution margin: revenue minus variable costs (bonus, payment fees, taxes). Fixed cost (salaries) include nahi.
  • Gross revenue: total before deductions. Net revenue: bonuses, refunds, taxes ke baad.
  • GGR vs NGR (gaming): GGR = wagers minus winnings. NGR = GGR minus bonuses aur taxes/fees. Poker me rake hi mostly revenue hai.
  • Margin se LTV nikalo, revenue se nahi, warna LTV zyada dikhega.
  • Segment-wise: channel ya cohort wise LTV compare karo.

Example

ItemValue
Avg monthly rake/userRs 400
Contribution margin60% = Rs 240/month
CACRs 1,200
Payback1200 / 240 = 5 months
Avg lifetime18 months
LTV (margin)240 x 18 = Rs 4,320
LTV:CAC3.6

Ratio 3.6 hai, payback 5 months. Healthy hai, par lifetime assumption check karni chahiye.

Common mistakes

  • LTV revenue par nikalna aur cost ignore karna.
  • CAC me sirf ad spend lena aur tools/team cost bhool jana.
  • Lifetime ka assumption bina retention data ke lena.
  • Blended CAC use karna jab paid aur organic ka mix change ho raha ho.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. LTV:CAC 3 se kam ho to?
    A. CAC kam karo (better channels), ya LTV badhao (retention, ARPU). Payback aur cohort data se confirm karo.
  • Q. Gross vs net revenue?
    A. Gross total collection hai. Net me refunds, bonuses, discounts, taxes ghat ke bachta hai.

Yaad rakho

LTV margin par nikalo aur CAC se compare karo.

BD-10Domain knowledgeIntermediateMust Know

Apna domain chuno (gaming, fintech, e-commerce, SaaS) aur uski terms, seasonality, regulations aur typical metrics seekho.

Simple me samjho

Same SQL har jagah chalti hai. Par "kya dekhna hai" domain se aata hai. Domain jaante ho to sahi sawal poochte ho aur anomalies jaldi pakadte ho.

Key points

  • Pick a domain: depth ke liye ek domain pakdo. Tumhare case me online gaming/poker.
  • Gaming terms: DAU, ARPU, rake, rakeback, GGR, NGR, buy-in, stakes, cash game vs tournament, lobby, tables, VIP.
  • Gaming metrics: hands played, rake per hand, deposit conversion, D1/D7/D30 retention, withdrawal rate, bonus cost ratio, bot/collusion flags.
  • Seasonality: festivals, weekends, IPL/major tournaments, salary week (month start), big promos. Poker me weekend aur evening traffic high hota hai.
  • Regulations: KYC/AML, age verification, responsible gaming limits, tax rules, state/country restrictions. Ye region ke hisab se badalte rehte hain, latest rules check karo.
  • Fintech: AUM, TPV, take rate, default rate, KYC drop, NPA.
  • E-commerce: GMV, AOV, conversion, return rate, cart abandonment.
  • SaaS: MRR, ARR, churn, NRR, seats, activation.
  • Learn from: company ka public content, industry reports, internal docs, domain experts se baat.

Example

Poker analyst ke liye domain knowledge ka asar:

  • Metric: deposits Friday ko 30% upar.
  • Naive view: campaign kaam kar gaya.
  • Domain view: weekend tournament series start hui, ye normal weekly seasonality hai.

Domain jaan ke analyst false alarm aur false credit dono se bachta hai.

Common mistakes

  • Domain terms ko sirf rata marna, logic na samajhna.
  • Regulation changes ko ignore karna jo metrics ko directly hit karte hain.
  • Seasonality adjust kiye bina week-over-week compare karna.
  • Doosre domain ke benchmarks ko apne domain par blindly apply karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Aap gaming domain me kya metrics track karoge?
    A. DAU/MAU, retention, ARPU/ARPPU, rake, deposit conversion, bonus cost, churn aur fraud rate.
  • Q. Domain knowledge analysis me kaise help karta hai?
    A. Sahi hypotheses banane me, seasonality aur regulatory effects samajhne me, aur stakeholders ki language bolne me.

Yaad rakho

Domain jaano to data bolta hai, warna sirf numbers dikhte hain.

BD-11Finance basics for analystsBasicGood to Have

P&L, GMV vs revenue, margin, budget vs actual, aur YoY/MoM/QoQ ki basic samajh, taki finance team se baat kar sako.

Simple me samjho

Finance ki language numbers ko sahi context deti hai. "Revenue 10% badha" tabhi matter karta hai jab pata ho kis ke against: pichle mahine, pichle saal, ya budget.

Key points

  • P&L (Profit and Loss): Revenue - COGS/variable costs = Gross profit. Gross profit - operating expenses = Operating profit. Phir interest, tax ke baad Net profit.
  • GMV vs Revenue: GMV total transaction value hai (marketplace me). Revenue company ka apna hissa. Poker me deposits GMV jaise hain, rake revenue hai.
  • Margin: profit / revenue. Gross margin, operating margin, net margin alag hain.
  • Budget vs Actual: plan kiya hua number vs real. Variance = Actual - Budget.
  • Forecast vs Actual: forecast badalta rehta hai latest data se. Budget fixed hota hai saal ke start me.
  • YoY: same period pichle saal se compare. Seasonality hatata hai.
  • MoM: pichle mahine se. QoQ: pichle quarter se.
  • Fiscal calendar: kai companies me financial year 1 April se 31 March hota hai (India). Quarters us hisab se (Q1 = Apr-Jun). Company ka calendar confirm karo.
  • Variance %: (Actual - Budget) / Budget x 100.
  • Reconciliation: analytics numbers ko finance ledger se match karna zaroori hai.

Example

MetricBudgetActualVariance
Rake revenue50L46L-4L (-8%)
Bonus cost8L10L+2L (+25%)
Contribution30L25L-5L (-16.7%)

Story: revenue thoda kam, bonus cost zyada, isliye contribution bahut gira. Analyst bonus overspend ki wajah dhundega.

Common mistakes

  • MoM growth ko seasonal month me bina YoY ke interpret karna.
  • GMV ko revenue bol dena.
  • Fiscal quarter aur calendar quarter mix karna.
  • Finance ledger se reconcile kiye bina numbers publish karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. GMV aur revenue me farak?
    A. GMV total value of transactions hai. Revenue us me se company ko milne wala part (commission/rake).
  • Q. YoY kab MoM se behtar hai?
    A. Jab seasonality strong ho, kyunki YoY same season compare karta hai.

Yaad rakho

Number ke saath hamesha "kis ke against" bolo.

BD-12Marketing analytics basicsIntermediateGood to Have

Marketing channels, CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS, attribution aur UTM tracking. Kaunsa paisa kaam kar raha hai ye pata karna.

Simple me samjho

Marketing me paisa kharch hota hai. Analyst batata hai kis channel se kitne aur kaise quality users aaye, aur kitne paise me.

Key points

  • Channels: paid search, social ads, affiliates, influencers, app-store, email/push, referral, organic.
  • Impressions: ad kitni baar dikha. Click: kitni baar click hua.
  • CTR: clicks / impressions.
  • CPC: spend / clicks. CPA: spend / acquisitions (install, signup, first deposit).
  • ROAS: revenue from ads / ad spend. ROAS 3 = Rs 1 par Rs 3 revenue.
  • Attribution: conversion ka credit kis touchpoint ko. Last-click, first-click, multi-touch (linear, time-decay) models.
  • UTM tracking: URL me parameters (utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign) jo batate hain traffic kahan se aaya.
  • Campaign vs organic: paid campaigns se aaya traffic vs bina paid ke (search, word of mouth). Incrementality check zaroori hai.
  • Quality over volume: cheap installs jo deposit nahi karte bekaar hain. CPA ko first-deposit par naapo.
  • Fraud: fake installs aur click spam se bacho.

Example

ChannelSpendInstallsFirst depositorsCPA (deposit)
Social100,0005,0001001,000
Affiliate100,0001,500200500

Cost per install me social sasta (20 vs 67), par cost per depositor me affiliate behtar (500 vs 1000). Isliye CPA business outcome par dekho.

Common mistakes

  • Sirf CPI ya CTR optimize karna, quality ignore karna.
  • UTM naming inconsistent rakhna (Facebook vs facebook).
  • Last-click ko absolute truth maan lena.
  • Organic ke natural growth ko campaign ka credit de dena.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. ROAS aur CAC me kya farak?
    A. ROAS revenue per spend hai. CAC spend per customer hai. Dono ek hi spend ke alag angles hain.
  • Q. Attribution kyun mushkil hai?
    A. User multiple touchpoints se guzarta hai, aur kisi ek ko credit dena model-dependent hota hai.

Yaad rakho

Channel ko installs se nahi, paying users se judge karo.

BD-13Product analytics basicsIntermediateGood to Have

Product analytics me events, sessions, feature adoption, engagement, stickiness aur activation dekhte hain. User product me kya karta hai ye samajhna.

Simple me samjho

Har click, har hand, har deposit ek event hai. Events ko jod ke hum samajhte hain users kya use karte hain aur kya nahi.

Key points

  • Event: user action with timestamp, user_id, properties. Example: hand_played, deposit_success.
  • Event naming: consistent (verb_noun) aur documented tracking plan rakho.
  • Session: ek continuous activity window. Usually 30 min inactivity ke baad naya session (convention, tool ke hisab se alag).
  • Feature adoption: feature use karne wale users / eligible users.
  • Engagement: sessions per user, hands per session, time spent, tables joined.
  • Stickiness (DAU/MAU): kitne monthly users roz aate hain. 20% matlab average user mahine me ~6 din aata hai.
  • Activation: wo "aha moment" jahan user value pa leta hai. Poker me "first 10 hands played in first 3 days" ho sakta hai. Data se validate karo ki kaunsa action retention se correlate karta hai.
  • Power users: top 10% players alag behavior dikhate hain. Unhe alag segment karo.
  • Tracking gaps: client vs server events ka mismatch check karo.

Example

sql
-- Stickiness for November 2026 (PostgreSQL)
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT DATE(event_time) AS d, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS dau
  FROM events WHERE event = 'hand_played'
    AND event_time >= '2026-11-01' AND event_time < '2026-12-01'
  GROUP BY 1
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS mau
  FROM events WHERE event = 'hand_played'
    AND event_time >= '2026-11-01' AND event_time < '2026-12-01'
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * AVG(dau) / MAX(mau), 1) AS stickiness_pct
FROM daily, monthly;

Average DAU / MAU deta hai. Ye batata hai product ki habit kitni strong hai.

Common mistakes

  • Events ka naming inconsistent rakhna.
  • Activation ko guess karna, data se validate na karna.
  • Stickiness compare karte waqt DAU/MAU ki definitions alag use karna.
  • Power users aur casuals ko ek hi average me mix karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Stickiness kya hai?
    A. DAU/MAU ratio. Higher ratio = users zyada frequently wapas aate hain.
  • Q. Activation kaise define karoge?
    A. Early action dhundunga jo long-term retention se strongly correlate kare, jaise first week me 10 hands. Phir usse onboarding ka goal banaunga.

Yaad rakho

Event ko samjho, user ka behavior samjho.

BD-14Hypothesis and root-cause thinkingIntermediateMust Know

Metric kyun hila? Pehle data issues rule out karo, phir decompose aur segment karo, aur last me business causes dhundo.

Simple me samjho

Doctor pehle check karta hai thermometer sahi hai ya nahi, phir bimari ka karan dhundta hai. Metric drop me bhi pehle tracking/pipeline check karo.

Key points

  • Step 1: confirm the drop: sach me hua? Dashboard ka time range, filter, timezone check.
  • Step 2: data issues first: pipeline delay, missing events, duplicate loads, tracking release, schema change.
  • Step 3: decompose: metric ko formula me todo. Revenue = players x hands x rake/hand. Kaunsa part gira?
  • Step 4: segment: device, country, channel, new vs existing, stake, platform. Drop aksar ek segment me hota hai.
  • Step 5: time pattern: achanak (release/outage) ya dheere (trend/seasonality)? Kis din shuru hua?
  • Internal causes: app release, bug, payment gateway issue, promo change, rake change, new rules.
  • External causes: festivals, competitor offer, regulation, payment partner downtime, big sports event.
  • Hypothesis list banao: har hypothesis ke saath ek test (query/chart) likho.
  • Prioritise: jo likely aur sasta check ho, pehle.
  • Communicate: cause, evidence, confidence level aur next action batao.

Example

Problem: DAU 15% gira.

text
1. Data check: events count normal? -> haan, pipeline OK.
2. Decompose: new users same, returning users -15%.
3. Segment: sirf Android v5.2 par drop.
4. Timeline: drop app release ke din se.
5. Hypothesis: v5.2 me login/lobby crash.
6. Action: crash logs check, engineering ko flag.

Evidence chain se root cause tak pahunche.

Common mistakes

  • Seedha business reason bolna bina data check kiye.
  • Sirf ek hypothesis par lock ho jana.
  • Segment kiye bina total number par conclusion.
  • Correlation ko cause maan lena (promo aur drop same din the, par alag reason ho sakta hai).

Interview Q&A

  • Q. DAU gir gaya, tum kya karoge?
    A. Pehle data/tracking verify, phir DAU decompose (new/returning), segment (platform, channel, country), timeline dekhu, aur releases/promos/external events se jodunga.
  • Q. Data issue ko pehle kyun rule out karte hain?
    A. Kyunki galat pipeline par business cause dhundna time waste aur galat action hota hai.

Yaad rakho

Pehle data, phir decompose, phir segment, phir cause.

Excel & Sheets 21 topics

XL-01Navigation and shortcutsBasicMust Know

Keyboard se Excel chalana seekho: jump, select, filter, anchor aur format. Mouse kam, speed zyada.

Simple me samjho

Excel me mouse se kaam karna cycle chalane jaisa hai, shortcuts bike jaisa. Interview me bhi live task me speed dikhti hai. Roz 5-6 shortcuts use karo, 2 hafte me muscle memory ban jaati hai.

Key points

  • Ctrl+Arrow: data block ke edge tak jump karta hai. Ctrl+Down se last row mil jaati hai.
  • Ctrl+Shift+Arrow: jump + select ek saath. Pura column data select karne ka fastest tareeka.
  • Ctrl+Shift+L: filter on/off toggle. Header row pe cursor rakh ke dabao.
  • Alt+=: AutoSum. Neeche ya side ke numbers ka SUM formula auto daal deta hai.
  • F4 anchoring: formula edit karte time F4 dabao, reference cycle hota hai: A1 -> $A$1 -> A$1 -> $A1.
  • Ctrl+T: range ko Table bana deta hai. Auto-expand, filter buttons, structured references milte hain.
  • Fast formatting: Ctrl+1 Format Cells, Ctrl+Shift+% percent, Ctrl+Shift+$ currency, Ctrl+B bold.
  • Ctrl+; (semicolon): aaj ki date static value ke roop me. Ctrl+Shift+; current time deta hai.
  • Extra useful: Ctrl+Space (column select), Shift+Space (row select), Ctrl+D fill down, Ctrl+Home top-left.

Example

text
Task: 50,000 rows ka total column D me nikalna hai.
1. Cell D1 pe jao, Ctrl+Down  -> last data row pe
2. Ek cell neeche jao (Down arrow)
3. Alt+=  -> formula banta hai: =SUM(D2:D50001)
4. Enter
Date stamp chahiye? Cell select karo, Ctrl+;  -> 20-11-2026 (value fixed, TODAY() jaisa change nahi hoga)

Ctrl+; wali date har din badalti nahi, jabki =TODAY() roz update hoti hai.

Common mistakes

  • Ctrl+Arrow blank cell pe ruk jaata hai, to data me gaps ho to galat jagah pahunchte ho. Pehle gaps check karo.
  • F4 bina formula edit mode ke "repeat last action" karta hai. Reference toggle sirf edit mode me hota hai.
  • Laptop pe F-keys media keys ho sakti hain. Fn dabana padega.
  • Filter lagate time header row select na ho to Excel galat range le leta hai.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Dollar sign ($) formula me kyun lagate hain?
    A. Reference ko lock karne ke liye taaki copy karne par row ya column na khiske. F4 se jaldi lagta hai.
  • Q. Table (Ctrl+T) normal range se behtar kyun hai?
    A. Auto-expand hota hai, formulas auto-fill hote hain, aur Sales[Amount] jaise readable references milte hain.

Yaad rakho

Ctrl+Arrow, Ctrl+Shift+L, Alt+=, F4, Ctrl+T: ye paanch yaad ho gaye to 80% speed mil gayi.

XL-02Data types and formatsBasicMust Know

Excel me text, number aur date alag cheezein hain. Format sirf dikhawa badalta hai, value nahi. Locale se dates bigad sakti hain.

Simple me samjho

Cell me jo dikhta hai aur jo andar stored hai, dono alag ho sakte hain. Date andar ek number hota hai. Jab "number" text ban jaata hai, SUM galat aata hai. Yahi sabse common problem hai.

Key points

  • Number: calculation ho sakti hai. Default right-aligned.
  • Text: left-aligned, green triangle aata hai agar number text ban gaya ho. SUM isko ignore karta hai.
  • Date: andar serial number hota hai (1 = 1-Jan-1900). Isliye date ko subtract kar sakte ho.
  • Number formats: Ctrl+1 se. 0.00, #,##0, 0.0%, dd-mmm-yyyy. Sirf display badalta hai.
  • Leading zeros: 00123 chahiye to cell Text format karo ya format 00000 lagao.
  • Text to Columns: Data > Text to Columns. Delimited ya Fixed width. Text-numbers ko number banane ya dates fix karne me kaam aata hai.
  • Paste Special: Ctrl+Alt+V. Values, Formats, Transpose, aur Operations (Multiply). Text-number ko 1 se multiply karke number banate hain.
  • Locale issues: 12/03/2026 US me 3-Dec, India/UK me 12-Mar. Decimal separator . vs , bhi region par depend karta hai.
  • VALUE / DATEVALUE: text ko number/date me badalne ke formulas. Locale par depend karte hain.

Example

text
A2 = "1500" (text, left-aligned)     A3 = 500 (number)
=SUM(A2:A3)        -> 500       (text ignore hua)
=VALUE(A2)+A3      -> 2000
Alternate fix: koi khali cell me 1 copy karo, A2 select karo,
Paste Special > Multiply  -> A2 ab real number 1500

Date check: B2 = 20-Nov-2026
=B2+7              -> 27-Nov-2026
Format "General" lagao -> serial number dikhega (46,000 ke aas paas)

Date + 7 isliye chala kyunki date andar number hai.

Common mistakes

  • CSV khol ke dates dd/mm vs mm/dd me ulat jaati hain. Import me column type set karo ya Power Query use karo.
  • Format badal ke sochna ki value badal gayi. ROUND value badalta hai, format nahi.
  • Leading space wale IDs match nahi hote. TRIM use karo.
  • ID columns (phone, account no.) ko number rehne dena, jis se 0 gayab ho jaata hai.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. SUM zero kyun de raha hai jabki numbers dikh rahe hain?
    A. Numbers text format me hain. Text to Columns, VALUE, ya Paste Special Multiply se fix karo.
  • Q. Excel me date kaise store hoti hai?
    A. Serial number ke roop me, 1-Jan-1900 se din ginti. Time uska decimal part hota hai.

Yaad rakho

Format = chehra, value = asli cheez. Data type pehle check karo, formula baad me.

XL-03Basic formulasBasicMust Know

SUM, AVERAGE, COUNT jaise basic functions aur relative vs absolute reference. Har analysis ki buniyaad.

Simple me samjho

Formula hamesha = se shuru hota hai. Reference ek address hota hai jo copy karne par ya to saath me khisakta hai (relative) ya fixed rehta hai (absolute).

Key points

  • SUM: numbers ka total. =SUM(B2:B10).
  • AVERAGE: mean. Text aur blanks ignore karta hai, zero ko count karta hai.
  • COUNT: sirf numeric cells ginta hai (dates bhi number hain).
  • COUNTA: jo cells blank nahi hain sab ginta hai (text bhi). COUNTBLANK khali cells ginta hai.
  • MIN / MAX: sabse chhota aur bada value.
  • ROUND: =ROUND(x, digits). ROUND(1234.567, 1) = 1234.6, ROUND(1234.567, -2) = 1200. ROUNDUP, ROUNDDOWN bhi hain.
  • Relative reference: A1. Copy karne par row/column saath khisakte hain.
  • Absolute reference: $A$1. Hamesha wahi cell.
  • Mixed: $A1 (column fixed) ya A$1 (row fixed). Do-way tables me kaam aata hai.

Example

text
A: player   B: rake    C: tax%   D: net
Ravi        200        =$F$1     =B2*(1-C2)  
Amit        150
Neha        (blank)
F1 = 0.18  (tax rate)

=SUM(B2:B4)      -> 350
=AVERAGE(B2:B4)  -> 175    (blank ignore, 2 values)
=COUNT(B2:B4)    -> 2
=COUNTA(A2:A4)   -> 3
=ROUND(B2*$F$1,0)-> 36

Tax rate $F$1 anchored hai, to formula neeche copy karne par bhi wahi cell use hoga.

Common mistakes

  • Tax rate jaise constant ko lock na karna. Copy karte hi F2, F3 ban jaate hain aur result galat aata hai.
  • AVERAGE me blank vs zero ka fark na samajhna. Zero average neeche kar deta hai.
  • Formula me numbers hardcode karna (*0.18). Input cell use karo.
  • Round karne ki jagah sirf format se decimals chhupana. Total match nahi karta.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. COUNT aur COUNTA me fark?
    A. COUNT sirf numbers ginta hai, COUNTA kisi bhi non-empty cell ko ginta hai.
  • Q. Absolute aur relative reference kab use karte ho?
    A. Constant (rate, target) ke liye absolute, row-wise calculation ke liye relative.

Yaad rakho

Constant ko lock ($) karo, baaki sab relative chhodo.

XL-04Logical functionsBasicMust Know

IF, IFS, AND, OR, NOT, IFERROR aur SWITCH se condition-based result nikalna. Segment aur flag banane ka base.

Simple me samjho

IF ek traffic signal jaisa hai: condition sahi to ek kaam, galat to doosra. Multiple conditions ho to AND/OR/IFS use karo, nested IF ki jagah.

Key points

  • IF: =IF(test, value_if_true, value_if_false).
  • AND / OR / NOT: AND me sab true chahiye, OR me koi ek, NOT ulta kar deta hai. Aksar IF ke andar use hote hain.
  • Nested IF: IF ke andar IF. Padhna mushkil, 3-4 levels se zyada mat jao.
  • IFS: =IFS(cond1, val1, cond2, val2, ...). Excel 2019 aur 365 me. Koi match na ho to #N/A, isliye last condition TRUE rakho.
  • SWITCH: ek value ko list se match karta hai. =SWITCH(x, "A","Gold", "B","Silver", "Other"). Excel 2019/365.
  • IFERROR: =IFERROR(formula, fallback). Har error chhupata hai. IFNA sirf #N/A pakadta hai.
  • Comparison operators: =, <>, >=, <=.
  • TRUE/FALSE: AND/OR ka output boolean hota hai, -- se 1/0 bana sakte ho.

Example

text
B2 = 12000 (monthly rake of player)
=IF(B2>=10000,"VIP","Regular")                       -> VIP
=IF(AND(B2>=5000, B2<10000),"Mid","Other")           -> Other
=IFS(B2>=10000,"Gold", B2>=5000,"Silver", TRUE,"Bronze")  -> Gold
=SWITCH(C2,"IN","India","US","USA","Unknown")        (C2="IN") -> India
=IFERROR(B2/D2, 0)         (D2=0 ho to #DIV/0! ki jagah 0)

IFS me conditions upar se neeche check hoti hain, isliye bada threshold pehle likho.

Common mistakes

  • IFS me order galat rakhna: >=5000 pehle likh diya to 12000 bhi Silver ban jaata hai.
  • IFERROR se sab errors chhupa dena. Asli bug (galat range) pata hi nahi chalta.
  • Text compare me extra space ya case ka dhyan na rakhna. "VIP " aur "VIP" alag hain.
  • Nested IF me bracket mismatch. Formula bar me alag lines me todke likho.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. IFERROR vs IFNA?
    A. IFNA sirf #N/A pakadta hai, jo lookup miss ke liye sahi hai. IFERROR sab errors chhupata hai, isliye risky hai.
  • Q. Nested IF ki jagah kya use karoge?
    A. IFS, SWITCH ya lookup table (approximate match). Lookup table sabse maintainable hai.

Yaad rakho

Condition ka order dhyan se, aur IFERROR sirf soch ke lagao.

XL-05Text functionsBasicMust Know

Text ko kaatna, saaf karna, jodna aur todna: LEFT/MID/TRIM/SUBSTITUTE/TEXTJOIN/TEXTSPLIT. Messy data cleaning ka core.

Simple me samjho

Text functions saw aur glue ki tarah hain. Kuch kaatte hain (LEFT, MID), kuch saaf karte hain (TRIM), kuch jodte hain (TEXTJOIN).

Key points

  • LEFT / RIGHT / MID: LEFT(text, n), RIGHT(text, n), MID(text, start, n).
  • LEN: characters ki ginti, spaces bhi gine jaate hain.
  • FIND / SEARCH: position batate hain. FIND case-sensitive, SEARCH nahi. MID ke saath use hote hain.
  • TRIM: extra spaces hatata hai (beech me sirf ek space chhodta hai).
  • CLEAN: non-printable characters hatata hai. Web/CSV data me aate hain.
  • UPPER / LOWER / PROPER: casing theek karte hain.
  • SUBSTITUTE: SUBSTITUTE(text, old, new). Non-breaking space ke liye CHAR(160) use karo.
  • CONCAT / TEXTJOIN: CONCAT purane CONCATENATE ka naya version hai. TEXTJOIN(delim, ignore_empty, range) delimiter ke saath range jodta hai. Dono Excel 2019+.
  • TEXTSPLIT: delimiter se text ko columns/rows me todta hai. Sirf Microsoft 365 me.

Example

text
A2 = "  ravi KUMAR  "      B2 = "PLR-4521-IN"
=PROPER(TRIM(A2))                      -> Ravi Kumar
=LEFT(B2,3)                            -> PLR
=MID(B2,5,4)                           -> 4521
=RIGHT(B2,2)                           -> IN
=SUBSTITUTE(B2,"-","")                 -> PLR4521IN
=TEXTJOIN(", ",TRUE,"IN","US","UK")    -> IN, US, UK
=TEXTSPLIT(B2,"-")                     -> PLR | 4521 | IN  (365 only, spill hota hai)
Variable length: =MID(B2,FIND("-",B2)+1,4)   -> 4521

TEXTSPLIT na ho to Text to Columns ya LEFT/MID/FIND combo use karo.

Common mistakes

  • TRIM chalaya phir bhi match nahi hua: CHAR(160) wala non-breaking space hai. SUBSTITUTE(A2,CHAR(160)," ") karo.
  • Fixed positions ke liye MID hardcode karna jabki length badalti hai. FIND se position nikalo.
  • Result text hota hai. Number chahiye to VALUE() ya -- lagao.
  • PROPER McDonald ya USA jaise naamon ko bigaad deta hai.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. "Ravi Kumar" se first name kaise nikaaloge?
    A. =LEFT(A2, FIND(" ",A2)-1).
  • Q. TRIM aur CLEAN me kya fark?
    A. TRIM extra spaces hatata hai, CLEAN non-printable control characters hatata hai.

Yaad rakho

Pehle TRIM/CLEAN, phir cut, phir join. TEXTSPLIT sirf 365 me.

XL-06Date and time functionsBasicMust Know

TODAY, DATEDIF, EOMONTH, NETWORKDAYS, WEEKNUM, TEXT aur YEAR/MONTH/DAY se date calculations aur reporting periods.

Simple me samjho

Date andar number hai, isliye din gin sakte ho, mahine add kar sakte ho, month-end nikal sakte ho. Bas format aur function sahi chunna hai.

Key points

  • TODAY / NOW: aaj ki date / date+time. Dono volatile hain, har recalculation pe badalte hain.
  • YEAR / MONTH / DAY: date ke parts nikalte hain. DATE(y,m,d) se date banate hain.
  • DATEDIF: DATEDIF(start, end, unit). Units "Y", "M", "D", "YM". Ye hidden function hai, formula suggestions me nahi dikhta par chalta hai. "MD" unit buggy hai, avoid karo.
  • EOMONTH: EOMONTH(date, months). Month-end deta hai. months=0 same month, -1 pichla mahina.
  • NETWORKDAYS: working days (Sat-Sun chhod ke), optional holidays range. Custom weekend ke liye NETWORKDAYS.INTL.
  • WEEKNUM: WEEKNUM(date, [type]). Default type 1 me week Sunday se shuru. Type 2 Monday. ISO week ke liye ISOWEEKNUM.
  • TEXT(date, format): date ko text me badalta hai, jaise "mmm-yyyy". Month grouping ke liye useful.
  • Month start: =EOMONTH(A2,-1)+1.

Example

text
A2 = 15-Mar-2024 (signup date)   B2 = 20-Nov-2026 (today)
=DATEDIF(A2,B2,"Y")               -> 2     (poore saal)
=DATEDIF(A2,B2,"YM")              -> 8     (saal hatake bache mahine)
=EOMONTH(A2,0)                    -> 31-Mar-2024
=EOMONTH(A2,-1)+1                 -> 01-Mar-2024
=TEXT(A2,"mmm-yyyy")              -> Mar-2024
=NETWORKDAYS(DATE(2026,1,1),DATE(2026,1,31))  -> 22
=WEEKNUM(DATE(2026,1,5),2)        -> 2
=YEAR(A2)&"-"&MONTH(A2)           -> 2024-3

January 2026 me 31 din me se 9 weekend din hain, isliye 22 working days.

Common mistakes

  • Date text me stored ho to functions kaam nahi karte. Pehle DATEVALUE ya Text to Columns.
  • TEXT(date,"mmm-yyyy") ka result text hai, sort alphabetical hota hai. Sort ke liye real date (month-start) rakho.
  • Cohort me TODAY() use karne se purani reports ka result badal jaata hai. Fixed as-of date cell rakho.
  • TEXT format codes regional language me alag ho sakte hain.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Last day of month kaise nikaaloge?
    A. =EOMONTH(date, 0).
  • Q. Do dates ke beech working days?
    A. NETWORKDAYS(start, end, holidays).

Yaad rakho

Date ko real date rakho, text nahi. Month-start column bana ke group karo.

XL-07Lookup functionsIntermediateMust Know

VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH aur XLOOKUP se doosri table se value laana. Exact vs approximate match samajhna zaroori.

Simple me samjho

Lookup matlab "is ID ka naam/country/tier doosri table se dhundh ke laao". SQL ke JOIN ka spreadsheet version.

Key points

  • VLOOKUP: =VLOOKUP(value, table, col_index, [range_lookup]). Lookup column table ka sabse left column hona chahiye.
  • HLOOKUP: same, par horizontal (row me dhundta hai).
  • Exact match: last argument FALSE (ya 0). ID matching ke liye hamesha yehi.
  • Approximate match: TRUE, sorted ascending data chahiye. Slabs/tiers (jaise VIP level) ke liye.
  • INDEX-MATCH: =INDEX(return_col, MATCH(value, lookup_col, 0)). Left-side lookup bhi chalta hai, column insert se nahi tootta.
  • XLOOKUP: =XLOOKUP(value, lookup_array, return_array, [if_not_found], [match_mode], [search_mode]). Excel 2021 aur 365 me. Default exact match.
  • XLOOKUP match_mode: 0 exact, -1 exact ya next smaller, 1 exact ya next larger, 2 wildcard.
  • #N/A handling: IFNA(formula, "Not found") ya XLOOKUP ka 4th argument.
  • Duplicate keys: lookup hamesha pehla match deta hai.

Example

text
Sheet "Players": A=player_id, B=name, C=country   (A2:C100)
F2 = P102
=VLOOKUP(F2, A2:C100, 3, FALSE)                    -> IN
=INDEX(C2:C100, MATCH(F2, A2:A100, 0))             -> IN
=XLOOKUP(F2, A2:A100, C2:C100, "Not found")        -> IN   (365/2021)
=IFNA(VLOOKUP(F2,A2:C100,3,FALSE),"Not found")

Tier table: 0->Bronze, 5000->Silver, 10000->Gold (sorted)
=VLOOKUP(12000, $H$2:$I$4, 2, TRUE)                -> Gold

Approximate match me 12000 se chhota sabse bada key (10000) pakda jaata hai.

Common mistakes

  • Approximate match galti se chhod dena (4th argument na likhna). Default TRUE hai, galat results aate hain.
  • Col index hardcode karna, column insert hote hi toot jaata hai. INDEX-MATCH/XLOOKUP use karo.
  • Text vs number mismatch ("101" vs 101), isliye #N/A aata hai.
  • Lookup range lock na karna ($A$2:$C$100) aur copy karte hi range khisak jaana.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. VLOOKUP ke limitations?
    A. Sirf right-side lookup, col index fragile, default approximate match, pehla match hi deta hai.
  • Q. XLOOKUP kab nahi chalega?
    A. Excel 2019 aur usse purane versions me. Wahan INDEX-MATCH use karo.

Yaad rakho

Exact match (FALSE/0) default sochkar chalo. Naye Excel me XLOOKUP, purane me INDEX-MATCH.

XL-08Conditional aggregationIntermediateMust Know

SUMIFS, COUNTIFS, AVERAGEIFS, MAXIFS aur SUMPRODUCT se condition ke saath total, count, average nikalna. SQL ke WHERE + GROUP BY jaisa.

Simple me samjho

Pura column sum nahi karna, sirf wahi rows jinki condition match kare. Jaise "sirf India ke cash game ka rake".

Key points

  • SUMIF: SUMIF(range, criteria, [sum_range]). Ek condition.
  • SUMIFS: SUMIFS(sum_range, crit_range1, crit1, crit_range2, crit2, ...). Yaad rakho sum_range pehle aata hai. AND logic hota hai.
  • COUNTIF(S): condition match karne wali rows ginta hai.
  • AVERAGEIF(S): condition wale rows ka average. AVERAGEIFS(avg_range, crit_range, crit).
  • MAXIFS / MINIFS: condition ke saath max/min. Excel 2019 aur 365.
  • Criteria syntax: ">=100", "<>IN", wildcards "A*". Cell ke saath: ">="&F1.
  • Date criteria: ">="&DATE(2026,1,1).
  • SUMPRODUCT: arrays ko multiply karke sum. OR logic ya complex condition ke liye. =SUMPRODUCT((A2:A6="IN")*(B2:B6="Cash")*C2:C6).
  • Ranges ka size same hona chahiye warna #VALUE! aata hai.

Example

text
A: country   B: game       C: rake
IN           Cash          100
IN           Tournament    300
US           Cash          200
IN           Cash          150
US           Tournament    400

=SUMIFS(C2:C6, A2:A6,"IN", B2:B6,"Cash")        -> 250
=COUNTIFS(A2:A6,"IN")                           -> 3
=AVERAGEIFS(C2:C6, B2:B6,"Tournament")          -> 350
=MAXIFS(C2:C6, A2:A6,"US")                      -> 400
=SUMPRODUCT((A2:A6="IN")*C2:C6)                 -> 550
=SUMIFS(C2:C6,A2:A6,"IN")+SUMIFS(C2:C6,A2:A6,"US")  (OR logic)

SUMPRODUCT me (A2:A6="IN") TRUE/FALSE deta hai, multiply karte hi 1/0 ban jaata hai.

Common mistakes

  • SUMIFS me sum_range ko last me likhna (SUMIF ki aadat). Result galat ya error.
  • Operator ko cell se jodna bhool jaana: ">="F1 ki jagah ">="&F1.
  • Whole column ranges SUMPRODUCT me. File dheemi ho jaati hai.
  • COUNTIF me text-numbers aur numbers match nahi hote.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. SUMIF aur SUMIFS me fark?
    A. SUMIFS me multiple conditions (AND) aur sum_range pehla argument hota hai.
  • Q. OR condition kaise karoge?
    A. Do SUMIFS add karo, ya SUMPRODUCT me + use karo.

Yaad rakho

SUMIFS me sum_range pehle. Ek pivot ki jagah formula chahiye to yeh sabse seedha tareeka hai.

XL-09Dynamic array functionsIntermediateGood to Have

FILTER, SORT, UNIQUE, SEQUENCE, LET, LAMBDA: ek formula se poori list nikalna jo cells me spill hoti hai. Naye Excel me.

Simple me samjho

Pehle ek formula ek cell deta tha. Ab ek formula poori list bana ke neeche "spill" kar deta hai, automatic. Ye SQL ke WHERE, ORDER BY, DISTINCT jaisa feel deta hai.

Key points

  • Availability: FILTER, SORT, UNIQUE, SEQUENCE, LET Excel 2021 aur Microsoft 365 me. LAMBDA sirf Microsoft 365 me. Excel 2019 ya purane me nahi.
  • FILTER: FILTER(array, include, [if_empty]). Condition match wali rows deta hai.
  • SORT: SORT(array, [sort_index], [sort_order], [by_col]). Order 1 ascending, -1 descending.
  • UNIQUE: UNIQUE(array, [by_col], [exactly_once]). Duplicate hata ke distinct values.
  • SEQUENCE: SEQUENCE(rows, [cols], [start], [step]). Numbers ya dates ki series.
  • Spill range: result jitne cells me failta hai. Upar-left cell me hi formula hota hai.
  • Spill reference: A2# poori spill range ko point karta hai. =SUM(E2#).
  • #SPILL! error: spill area me kuch aur likha ho to aata hai. Blocking cells saaf karo.
  • LET: LET(name, value, ..., calculation). Intermediate value ko naam deta hai, formula chhota aur fast hota hai.
  • LAMBDA: apna custom function banao, Name Manager me naam do. Phir normal function ki tarah use karo.

Example

text
A: country  B: player   C: rake   (A2:C100)
=UNIQUE(A2:A100)                                  -> IN, US, UK (spill)
=FILTER(A2:C100, C2:C100>1000, "No data")         -> sirf high-rake rows
=SORT(FILTER(A2:C100, A2:A100="IN"), 3, -1)       -> India rows, rake ke hisaab se bada se chhota
=SEQUENCE(5)                                      -> 1,2,3,4,5 (neeche spill)
=LET(r, C2:C100, AVERAGE(r) + STDEV.S(r))         -> ek hi baar range likha
=SUM(FILTER(C2:C100, A2:A100="IN"))               -> India ka total rake
Name Manager me Net: =LAMBDA(x, x*0.82)   phir  =Net(B2)

Spill hone wale formula ko edit karna ho to sirf top-left cell badlo.

Common mistakes

  • Purane Excel me file bhejna, wahan _xlfn ya #NAME? aata hai. Version check karo.
  • Spill range ke neeche data hona, to #SPILL!. Jagah khaali rakho.
  • Table ke andar spill formulas allowed nahi hain.
  • FILTER me include array ki size data se match nahi karti.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. UNIQUE vs Remove Duplicates?
    A. UNIQUE formula hai, source data ko nahi chhedta aur live update hota hai. Remove Duplicates data ko permanently badalta hai.
  • Q. LET kyun use karte hain?
    A. Ek expression baar baar na likhna pade, formula padhne me aasan aur calculation fast.

Yaad rakho

Spill formulas 365/2021 ki cheez hain. Share karne se pehle receiver ka Excel version pooch lo.

XL-10Pivot tablesIntermediateMust Know

Pivot table se bina formula ke data summarise karo: rows, columns, values, dates grouping, slicers aur % calculations.

Simple me samjho

Pivot ek smart summary table hai. Tum fields drag karte ho, Excel group karke sum/count nikal deta hai. SQL ke GROUP BY ka drag-and-drop version.

Key points

  • Create: source ko Table (Ctrl+T) banao, phir Insert > PivotTable.
  • Four areas: Rows (grouping), Columns (cross-tab), Values (sum/count/average), Filters.
  • Value Field Settings: Sum, Count, Average, Max, Distinct Count (data model ke saath).
  • Grouping dates: date par right-click > Group. Months, Quarters, Years combine kar sakte ho.
  • Calculated field: PivotTable Analyze > Fields, Items & Sets > Calculated Field. Jaise Rake / Revenue. Ye fields ke sums par chalta hai, cell references par nahi.
  • Slicers: click-filter buttons. Ek slicer ko kai pivots se jod sakte ho (Report Connections).
  • Timelines: date field ke liye special slicer. Month/Quarter/Year choose karo.
  • Refresh: source badalne par pivot auto-update nahi hota. Alt+F5 ya Data > Refresh All.
  • Show Values As: % of Grand Total, % of Column Total, % of Parent Total, Running Total, Difference From.
  • GETPIVOTDATA: pivot ke cell ko formula se pakadta hai.

Example

text
Source table "Txn": date | country | game | rake
Rows:    country
Columns: game
Values:  Sum of rake

Layout ka result:
country   Cash   Tournament   Grand Total
IN        250    300          550
US        200    400          600

Value Field > Show Values As > % of Grand Total:
IN 21.7%  26.1%   |  US 17.4%  34.8%  (total 100%)
Date ko Rows me daalo, right-click > Group > Months + Years

Show Values As se alag formula likhe bina percentage mix mil jaata hai.

Common mistakes

  • Refresh bhoolna, aur purane numbers report kar dena.
  • Source me blank rows ya headers ke bina columns. Pivot error deta hai.
  • Dates text me hone par Group option disable rehta hai.
  • Calculated field ko average ratio samajhna. Wo sums ka ratio hota hai, row-level ratio nahi.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Pivot ka data update kaise hoga?
    A. Source Table me add karo, phir Refresh. Table se range auto-expand hoti hai.
  • Q. Slicer aur filter me fark?
    A. Slicer visual hai aur multiple pivots control kar sakta hai. Filter ek hi pivot par chalta hai.

Yaad rakho

Table se pivot banao, date group karo, aur har baar Refresh karo.

XL-11Charts in ExcelIntermediateMust Know

Sahi chart chuno (column, line, combo, waterfall), dual axis aur formatting sambhalo, aur dynamic ranges se chart auto-update karo.

Simple me samjho

Chart ka kaam ek baat saaf dikhana hai. Pehle sawaal socho, phir chart chuno. Zyada colors aur 3D effects se message dab jaata hai.

Key points

  • Column / bar: categories compare karne ke liye (country-wise rake).
  • Line: time trend ke liye (daily active users).
  • Combo chart: do alag type, jaise column (revenue) + line (rake %). Insert > Combo.
  • Dual axis: alag units wale series ke liye secondary axis. Dhyan se use karo, scale misleading ho sakta hai.
  • Waterfall: Excel 2016+ ka built-in chart type. Opening se closing balance tak increase/decrease dikhata hai. Totals ko "Set as total" karo.
  • Formatting: clear title, gridlines kam, data labels, axis labels, ek hi colour family, sorted bars.
  • Dynamic chart range: data ko Table bana do to chart auto-expand hota hai.
  • Named range option: Name Manager me formula-based name banao aur chart series me use karo.
  • Pie chart: sirf 2-4 slices ke liye. Baaki me bar chart behtar.

Example

text
Table "Daily": date | dau | rake
Chart 1: Line chart, X = date, Y = dau
Chart 2: Combo -> dau = Clustered Column, rake = Line (Secondary Axis)

Dynamic named range (Name Manager, name: ChartDates):
=Sheet1!$A$2:INDEX(Sheet1!$A:$A, COUNTA(Sheet1!$A:$A))
Series X values me: =Book1.xlsx!ChartDates

Table ya named range use karne se naya row add karte hi chart me aa jaata hai.

Common mistakes

  • Y-axis zero se na shuru karna bar chart me. Chhota farak bada dikhta hai.
  • Dual axis me do alag scale se jhooti correlation dikhana.
  • Dates text hone par line chart ka X axis galat order me aata hai.
  • Sab kuch ek chart me thoons dena. Ek chart, ek message.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Trend dikhana ho to kaunsa chart?
    A. Line chart. Categories compare karne ke liye column/bar.
  • Q. Chart auto-update kaise karoge?
    A. Source ko Table banao, ya dynamic named range chart series me do.

Yaad rakho

Pehle message, phir chart type. Sort karo, saaf rakho, labels do.

XL-12Conditional formattingBasicMust Know

Rules se cells ka colour/icon apne aap badalna: color scales, icon sets, formula rules, duplicates aur thresholds highlight karna.

Simple me samjho

Data ko traffic light bana do. Bure numbers red, achche green, aur duplicates turant dikh jaayein.

Key points

  • Location: Home > Conditional Formatting.
  • Color scales: low se high tak gradient (2 ya 3 colours). Heatmap jaisa.
  • Data bars: cell ke andar chhoti bar.
  • Icon sets: arrows, traffic lights, ticks. Thresholds percent ya number se set karo.
  • Highlight Cells Rules: Greater Than, Between, Text Contains, Duplicate Values.
  • Top/Bottom rules: Top 10, Above Average.
  • Formula-based rules: "Use a formula to determine which cells to format". Formula TRUE ho to format lagta hai.
  • Mixed reference: pehle cell ke relative address ke hisaab se likho. Row highlight ke liye $C2 (column locked).
  • Manage Rules: order, Stop If True, aur applies-to range yahin se.

Example

text
Range select: A2:F100 (active cell A2)
Rule 1 (poori row red agar rake threshold se upar):
  =$C2>10000
Rule 2 (duplicate player id):
  =COUNTIF($A$2:$A$100,$A2)>1
Rule 3 (overdue tasks):
  =AND($D2<TODAY(), $E2<>"Done")
Rule 4: Color Scale on C2:C100, Min=white, Max=green

$C2 ka matlab har row ke column C ko check karo, aur formatting poori row par lage.

Common mistakes

  • Formula rule me galat anchor (C2 ya $C$2). Pura sheet ek hi cell se check hota hai.
  • Rules ka overlap, jis se kaun jeeta samajh nahi aata. Manage Rules me order check karo.
  • Copy-paste se rules bikhar jaate hain aur duplicate ho jaate hain.
  • Colour-blind users ke liye sirf red/green. Icons ya labels bhi do.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Poori row ko value ke hisaab se highlight kaise karoge?
    A. Pura range select karo, formula rule lagao jaise =$C2>10000.
  • Q. Duplicates kaise dhundoge?
    A. Highlight Cells Rules > Duplicate Values, ya COUNTIF($A$2:$A$100,$A2)>1.

Yaad rakho

Formula rule me column lock ($C2), row relative. Thoda aur saaf rakho, har cell rangin mat karo.

XL-13Data validation and dropdownsBasicGood to Have

Cell me kya enter ho sakta hai wo control karo: dropdown lists, dependent dropdowns, custom rules aur input messages.

Simple me samjho

Data validation form ke "choose one" box jaisa hai. Log galat spelling ya galat value daal hi nahi paate.

Key points

  • Location: Data > Data Validation.
  • List: Allow = List. Source IN,US,UK (comma) ya range ya named range.
  • Table-based list: source ke liye Table column ya named range use karo to list auto-grow hoti hai.
  • Dependent dropdown: parent choice ke hisaab se child list badle. Classic tareeka: =INDIRECT($A2) jahan named ranges parent ke naam par hain.
  • 365 tareeka: source me spill reference, jaise =$H$2#, jahan H2 par FILTER/UNIQUE formula hai.
  • Custom rule: formula TRUE hona chahiye. =AND(ISNUMBER(B2),B2>0).
  • Input message: cell select karte hi tip dikhta hai.
  • Error alert: Stop, Warning, Information styles.
  • Circle Invalid Data: pehle se bhare galat data ko dhundta hai.

Example

text
Cell A2 (country dropdown): Allow=List, Source: =$H$2:$H$4
Named ranges: "India" = J2:J4 (cities), "USA" = K2:K4
Cell B2 (city, dependent): Allow=List, Source: =INDIRECT($A2)
Custom unique ID rule on A2:A100:
  =COUNTIF($A$2:$A$100,A2)=1
Amount column B2: Custom: =AND(ISNUMBER(B2), B2>0, B2<=100000)

A2 me "India" chuno to B2 me sirf India ke cities milte hain.

Common mistakes

  • INDIRECT ke liye named range me space hota hai ("New York"). Names me space allowed nahi, underscore use karo.
  • Paste karne par validation hat jaata hai. Paste Special > Values use karo.
  • Error alert off hone se koi bhi value chali jaati hai.
  • List source locked na ho to range khisak jaati hai. $ lagao.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Dependent dropdown kaise banate ho?
    A. Parent list ke har item ke naam ka named range banao, child cell me =INDIRECT(parent_cell).
  • Q. Validation 100% secure hai?
    A. Nahi, paste aur copy se bypass ho sakta hai. Sheet protection saath me rakho.

Yaad rakho

Free-text se spelling bigadti hai, dropdown se data saaf rehta hai.

XL-14Data cleaning in ExcelBasicMust Know

Gande data ko saaf karna: duplicates, Find and Replace, Flash Fill, text to columns, blanks aur casing.

Simple me samjho

Analysis se pehle data ko dhona padta hai. Cleaning me 60-70% time jaata hai, to tools aane chahiye.

Key points

  • Remove Duplicates: Data > Remove Duplicates. Columns choose karo jinse duplicate ginna hai. Ye permanent hai, pehle copy bana lo.
  • Find and Replace: Ctrl+H. Wildcards * aur ?. Literal * dhundna ho to ~*.
  • Flash Fill: Ctrl+E. Ek-do example type karo, Excel pattern seekh leta hai (naam split, ID nikalna).
  • Text to Columns: delimiter se column todna, aur text-numbers/dates fix karna.
  • Blanks: F5 > Special > Blanks se select karo. Fill down ke liye =A2 type karke Ctrl+Enter, phir values paste.
  • Consistent casing: UPPER, LOWER, PROPER. Spaces ke liye TRIM.
  • Standardise values: "IN", "india", "India " ko ek form me lao.
  • Formulas to values: clean column ko Paste Special > Values karke original hata do.
  • Bade data ke liye: Power Query repeatable steps deta hai.

Example

text
A: raw name        B (clean)
" ravi KUMAR "     =PROPER(TRIM(A2))          -> Ravi Kumar
"AMIT sharma"                                 -> Amit Sharma

Flash Fill: C2 me "Ravi" likho, C3 me "A" type karo, Ctrl+E
Blank fill: A2:A100 select > F5 > Special > Blanks
            type =A1 aur Ctrl+Enter, phir Copy > Paste Values
Dedup: Data > Remove Duplicates > sirf player_id tick karo

Dedup me galat column tick karne se asli alag rows bhi hat jaati hain.

Common mistakes

  • Original data par seedha Remove Duplicates chalana, wapas nahi aata. Pehle copy.
  • Flash Fill static hota hai, source badalne par update nahi hota.
  • Blanks ko zero samajhna. Blank aur 0 average me alag behave karte hain.
  • TRIM ke baad bhi match na hona (CHAR(160)). SUBSTITUTE se hatao.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Messy data ko clean karne ka tumhara process?
    A. Raw copy rakho, duplicates, blanks, types, casing, spaces check karo, phir validate counts ke saath.
  • Q. Flash Fill vs formula?
    A. Flash Fill fast hai par static hai. Repeatable kaam ke liye formula ya Power Query.

Yaad rakho

Raw data kabhi mat chhedo. Copy par clean karo, aur har step ke baad row count check karo.

XL-15Power QueryIntermediateMust Know

Power Query se data import, clean, merge aur append karo, ek baar steps record karo aur refresh se baar baar chalao.

Simple me samjho

Power Query ek recorder jaisa hai. Tum cleaning steps ek baar karte ho, agli baar naya file aaye to sirf Refresh dabate ho. Ye ETL ka chhota version hai.

Key points

  • Import: Data > Get Data. Excel, CSV, folder, database, web.
  • Transform: Power Query Editor me types badlo, filter, split, replace, remove columns.
  • Applied Steps: right side ka pane. Har step recorded hota hai, edit ya delete kar sakte ho.
  • Merge queries: do tables ko key par jodta hai (JOIN). Types: Left Outer, Inner, Full Outer, Left Anti, Right Anti. VLOOKUP ka better replacement.
  • Append queries: tables ko upar-neeche jodta hai (UNION ALL). Monthly files combine karne ke liye.
  • Unpivot: columns ko rows me badalta hai. "Unpivot Other Columns" naya column aane par bhi chalta hai.
  • M language basics: har step let ... in block me hota hai. Case-sensitive.
  • Refresh: Data > Refresh All, original file nahi chhedta.
  • Close & Load: result sheet ya Data Model me jaata hai.

Example

text
let
    Source = Excel.CurrentWorkbook(){[Name="Sales"]}[Content],
    Typed = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Source, {{"amount", type number}}),
    Filtered = Table.SelectRows(Typed, each [amount] > 0)
in
    Filtered

Har step pichle step ka naam use karta hai. Editor ke Advanced Editor me ye code dikhta hai. Folder se 12 monthly CSVs combine karo, phir naya month file daalo aur Refresh dabao.

Common mistakes

  • Hardcoded column names. Source me naam badalte hi query toot jaati hai.
  • Merge me key ka type match na hona (text vs number), isliye rows match nahi hoti.
  • Raw data sheet me hi clean karna jab Power Query kar sakta hai.
  • Refresh error ignore karna, ya source file ka path change ho jaana.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Merge aur Append me fark?
    A. Merge columns jodta hai key par (JOIN). Append rows jodta hai (UNION ALL).
  • Q. Power Query kyun use karte ho?
    A. Repeatable, auditable steps. Naya data aane par Refresh se hi saaf ho jaata hai.

Yaad rakho

Ek baar steps banao, baar baar Refresh karo. Manual cleaning se bachne ka best tareeka.

XL-16Power Pivot and DAX basicsAdvancedGood to Have

Power Pivot me data model, relationships aur DAX measures banao. Measures vs calculated columns ka fark aur CALCULATE ki taakat.

Simple me samjho

Pivot ek hi table par chalta hai. Power Pivot me kai tables ko relationship se jod ke ek model banate hain, phir DAX se calculations. Ye mini Power BI Excel ke andar hai.

Key points

  • Data Model: Excel ke andar compress ho kar rakha hua tables ka set. Millions of rows handle karta hai.
  • Relationships: Diagram view me key columns jodo. One-to-many: dimension (one) se fact (many).
  • Star schema: ek fact table (transactions) aur dimension tables (players, dates).
  • Measure: calculation jo filter context me chalti hai, pivot me aggregate hoti hai, memory me value store nahi hoti.
  • Calculated column: har row ke liye banta hai aur stored rehta hai. Row-wise logic ke liye.
  • DAX syntax: Power Pivot window me measure Name := formula.
  • CALCULATE: CALCULATE(expression, filter1, ...). Filter context badal ke expression nikalta hai.
  • Availability: Power Pivot sab Excel editions me nahi hai (Microsoft 365 aur kuch desktop editions me hai).
  • Distinct count: DISTINCTCOUNT data model ka bada fayda hai.

Example

text
Total Rake := SUM(Txn[rake])
Players := DISTINCTCOUNT(Txn[player_id])
India Rake := CALCULATE([Total Rake], Players[country] = "IN")
Rake Share := DIVIDE([India Rake], [Total Rake])

Calculated column (Txn table): 
Net Rake = Txn[rake] * 0.82

CALCULATE pivot ke filter ko override karke sirf India ke liye total nikalta hai.

Common mistakes

  • Hamesha calculated column banana. Size badhta hai, measure zyada efficient hai.
  • Relationship direction ya key type galat hone se totals galat aate hain.
  • Ek flat wide table me sab kuch rakhna aur DAX ki zaroorat hi nahi samajhna.
  • Division me / ki jagah DIVIDE na use karna, zero par error aata hai.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Measure vs calculated column?
    A. Calculated column row-by-row banta hai aur store hota hai. Measure aggregation par chalta hai aur filter ke hisaab se badalta hai.
  • Q. CALCULATE kya karta hai?
    A. Expression ko modified filter context me evaluate karta hai.

Yaad rakho

Aggregation chahiye to measure, row-level value chahiye to calculated column. CALCULATE = filter badalne wala function.

XL-17What-if analysisIntermediateGood to Have

Goal Seek, Scenario Manager aur Data Tables se "agar ye badle to kya hoga" check karo. Sensitivity analysis ka base.

Simple me samjho

Ek input badlo aur dekho output kitna hilta hai. Planning aur forecasting me ye roz kaam aata hai.

Key points

  • Location: Data > What-If Analysis.
  • Goal Seek: ek formula ka target result fix karo, Excel ek input badal ke wo value nikalta hai. Set cell, To value, By changing cell.
  • Goal Seek limits: sirf ek input badalta hai. Set cell me formula hona chahiye.
  • Scenario Manager: best/base/worst jaise named scenarios save karta hai, aur Summary report banata hai.
  • One-variable data table: ek input ki list ke liye output.
  • Two-variable data table: do inputs ka grid (row input cell aur column input cell).
  • Sensitivity analysis: batana ki kaunsa input output ko sabse zyada hilata hai.
  • Calculation: data tables heavy hote hain. "Automatic except data tables" option se control karo.
  • Input cells: assumptions alag cells me rakho, tabhi what-if chalta hai.

Example

text
B1 = players = 1000    B2 = avg rake/player = 50    B3 = cost = 30000
B4 = profit = B1*B2 - B3   -> 20000

Goal Seek: Set cell B4, To value 35000, By changing B1
   -> B1 = 1300

Two-variable data table:
  E1 =B4   (corner cell)
  F1:H1 = 800, 1000, 1200   (players, Row input cell = B1)
  E2:E4 = 40, 50, 60        (rake, Column input cell = B2)
  Select E1:H4 > Data Table

Table me har combination ka profit aa jaata hai. Ye array formula {=TABLE(B1,B2)} ke roop me banta hai.

Common mistakes

  • Goal Seek ke input cell me formula hona. Wo hardcoded value hi change kar sakta hai.
  • Data table ke input cells doosri sheet me rakhna. Same sheet par hone chahiye.
  • Scenario results ko live sample samajhna. Summary static snapshot hota hai.
  • Bahut saare inputs ek saath badalna aur kaunsa asar hai pata na chalna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Goal Seek kab use karte ho?
    A. Jab target output pata ho aur ek input chahiye, jaise break-even players.
  • Q. Data table kya karta hai?
    A. Ek ya do inputs ko range of values deta hai aur har combination ka output ek table me dikhata hai.

Yaad rakho

Assumptions alag cells me rakho. Goal Seek ek target ke liye, Data Table puri sensitivity ke liye.

XL-18Excel dashboardsIntermediateGood to Have

KPI cards, slicers, saaf layout, protected sheets aur printing setup ke saath ek one-page Excel dashboard banao.

Simple me samjho

Dashboard ek car ka speedometer hai: ek nazar me pata chale sab theek hai ya nahi. Data, calculation aur dashboard alag sheets me rakho, dashboard sirf dikhaye.

Key points

  • Structure: 3 sheets: Data (raw table), Calc (pivots/formulas), Dashboard (sirf output).
  • KPI cards: bade font ka number, neeche chhota label aur vs-last-period change. Cell ko formula se link karo.
  • Delta formatting: custom format [Color10]+0.0%;[Red]-0.0%;0.0% se green/red change.
  • Charts: 3-5 se zyada nahi. Har chart ek sawaal ka jawab.
  • Slicers: ek slicer ko kai pivots se jodo (Report Connections), to poora dashboard filter hota hai.
  • Layout: upar KPIs, beech me trend charts, neeche detail table. Gridlines hide karo (View > Gridlines).
  • Protected sheets: Review > Protect Sheet. Slicers/inputs wale cells unlock karo (Format Cells > Protection), baaki lock.
  • Printing: Page Layout me Print Area, Landscape, Fit to 1 page wide, Print Titles.
  • Refresh: Data > Refresh All se pivots aur queries update.

Example

text
Dashboard!B2  (Total Rake)   =Calc!C5
Dashboard!B3  (vs last month) =Calc!C5/Calc!C6-1   format: [Color10]+0.0%;[Red]-0.0%
Dashboard!D2  (Active Players) =Calc!C8

Layout:
Row 1-4   : 4 KPI cards (Rake, DAU, ARPU, Churn %)
Row 6-20  : Line chart (trend) | Column chart (country-wise)
Row 22-35 : Top 10 players table
Left side : Slicers (Country, Month) connected to all pivots
Protect Sheet: password optional, Select unlocked cells only

KPI cards seedha Calc sheet ke cells se linked hain, isliye refresh par apne aap update hote hain.

Common mistakes

  • Dashboard par hi raw data aur pivots rakhna. Saaf dikhna band ho jaata hai.
  • Slicer sirf ek pivot se connected, baaki pivots filter nahi hote.
  • Protect karte waqt slicer interaction allow na karna.
  • Print preview na dekhna, chart do pages me kat jaata hai.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Achha dashboard kaisa hota hai?
    A. Ek audience, kuch KPIs, saaf layout, filters aur har number ka reference (definition aur date).
  • Q. Dashboard ko edit hone se kaise bachaoge?
    A. Sheet protect karo, inputs ke cells unlock karo.

Yaad rakho

Data, calc, dashboard alag sheets. Dashboard par sirf wahi jo decision me kaam aaye.

XL-19Macros and VBA basicsAdvancedBonus

Repetitive kaam ko macro se automate karo: record macro, simple VBA code aur report automation.

Simple me samjho

Macro tumhare Excel steps ka recording hai. Ek button dabao, wahi steps apne aap chal jaate hain. VBA us recording ka code hai, jise tum edit kar sakte ho.

Key points

  • Developer tab: File > Options > Customize Ribbon se on karo.
  • Record Macro: naam do, steps karo, Stop Recording. Excel VBA code likh deta hai.
  • VBA Editor: Alt+F11. Module me Sub ... End Sub ke andar code hota hai.
  • File type: macro wali file .xlsm me save hoti hai, .xlsx me macros nahi rehte.
  • Relative References: recording me on karo, to macro active cell ke hisaab se chalta hai.
  • Objects: Range, Sheets, Workbook. Range("A1").Value = 5.
  • Loop: For Each ya For i = ... Next se rows par repeat.
  • Report automation: refresh, copy, format, save/export ek macro me.
  • Security: unknown macros enable mat karo. Trusted locations use karo.
  • Debug: F8 se line-by-line chalao.

Example

vba
Sub DailyReport()
    ThisWorkbook.RefreshAll
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Dashboard")
    ws.Range("B1").Value = Date
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 2 To 100
        If ws.Cells(i, 3).Value < 0 Then
            ws.Cells(i, 3).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 200, 200)
        End If
    Next i
End Sub

Ye macro data refresh karta hai, date likhta hai aur negative values ko light red karta hai. Button par assign karne ke liye Insert > Shapes, right-click > Assign Macro.

Common mistakes

  • Recorded code me hardcoded cell addresses, jo data badalne par toot jaate hain.
  • Select aur Activate ka zyada use. Seedha object par kaam karo.
  • Macro undo nahi hota. Chalane se pehle file ka backup lo.
  • Cloud/Excel Online me VBA nahi chalta, desktop Excel chahiye.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Macro kab banaoge?
    A. Jab same manual steps hafte me baar baar karne pade, jaise report refresh aur format.
  • Q. Macro aur Power Query me kaise chunoge?
    A. Data cleaning/refresh ke liye Power Query. UI actions aur formatting automation ke liye macro.

Yaad rakho

Record karo, code padho, hardcoding hatao. Macro file hamesha .xlsm.

XL-20Spreadsheet best practicesIntermediateMust Know

Structured tables, no hardcoding, input/calc alag sheets, trace precedents, naming, version history aur performance ke tareeke.

Simple me samjho

Spreadsheet chhota software hai. Agar saaf banaya ho to koi bhi samajh sakta hai aur galti kam hoti hai. Ek ganda file baad me bug aur trust issue ban jaati hai.

Key points

  • Structured tables: Ctrl+T. Formulas me Sales[Amount] jaisa readable reference, auto-expand.
  • No hardcoding: tax rate, targets, dates input cells me rakho. Formula me seedha 0.18 mat likho.
  • Input vs Calc sheets: ek Inputs sheet, ek Calc, ek Output. Alag colours se pehchano (blue = input).
  • Trace Precedents / Dependents: Formulas tab. Shortcut Ctrl+[ se precedent cell par jump.
  • Show Formulas: Ctrl+` se sab formulas dikhte hain. Error check ke liye.
  • Naming: sheets, ranges aur columns ke clear naam. Name Manager me.
  • Version history: OneDrive/SharePoint me File > Info > Version History. Ya file naam me date.
  • Documentation: README sheet jisme data source, definitions, last refresh.
  • File size aur performance: volatile functions (OFFSET, INDIRECT, TODAY) kam, whole-column references kam, unused formatting hatao, .xlsb format try karo, heavy hone par manual calc.
  • Checks: total reconcile cells jaise "sum of parts = total".

Example

text
Bad :  =B2*0.18                       (0.18 ka matlab kya?)
Good:  =B2*Inputs!$C$3                (Inputs!C3 = Tax rate, naam "TaxRate")
Best:  =[@Amount]*TaxRate             (Table ke andar, naam wali range)

Check cell: =IF(ROUND(SUM(Detail[Rake])-Summary!B2,2)=0,"OK","MISMATCH")

Slow: =SUMPRODUCT((A:A="IN")*(C:C))   (poora column)
Fast: =SUMIFS(Tbl[Rake],Tbl[Country],"IN")

Naam wali input cell se formula padhne me aasan aur ek jagah badalne se sab update.

Common mistakes

  • Formula me hardcoded numbers. Kisi ko pata nahi kyun aur kab badalna hai.
  • Bina backup ke original file overwrite karna.
  • Merged cells aur blank rows data table me. Pivot aur filter toot jaate hain.
  • Ek sheet me raw data, calculation aur chart sab mix.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Spreadsheet audit kaise karoge?
    A. Trace Precedents, Show Formulas, reconcile checks, aur inputs vs calcs alag karke.
  • Q. File slow ho to kya karoge?
    A. Volatile functions aur whole-column references hatao, helper columns kam karo, Power Query ya .xlsb try karo.

Yaad rakho

Inputs alag, formulas saaf, checks built-in. Kal ka tum ya koi aur bina poochhe samajh sake.

XL-21Google Sheets specificsBasicGood to Have

Google Sheets ke khaas features: QUERY, IMPORTRANGE, ARRAYFORMULA, GOOGLEFINANCE, sharing permissions aur Apps Script basics.

Simple me samjho

Sheets browser me chalta hai aur team ke saath real-time share hota hai. Kuch functions Excel se alag ya zyada powerful hain. QUERY to SQL jaisa hi lagta hai.

Key points

  • QUERY: QUERY(data, "query string", [headers]). Google Visualization query language: select, where, group by, order by, label.
  • Column naming in QUERY: normal sheet range me column letters (A, B) use hote hain. Array ya IMPORTRANGE result par Col1, Col2 use hota hai.
  • IMPORTRANGE: IMPORTRANGE(spreadsheet_url, "Sheet1!A1:D100"). Doosri file se data. Pehli baar "Allow access" dena padta hai.
  • ARRAYFORMULA: ek formula pure column par apply. =ARRAYFORMULA(B2:B*C2:C).
  • GOOGLEFINANCE: stock/currency data. =GOOGLEFINANCE("CURRENCY:USDINR").
