Simple me samjho

Ye database me saved code hain. Function value return karta hai, procedure kaam karta hai, trigger apne aap chalta hai. Analyst ko inse tab milna padta hai jab numbers kisi hidden logic se bante hain.

Key points

  • Function: Value ya table return karta hai, SELECT ke andar use hota hai. Jaise rake_amount(pot).
  • Stored procedure: Kaam karta hai (insert, update, loop). PostgreSQL 11+ me CALL proc_name(...) se chalta hai.
  • Trigger: Table pe INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE hone par apne aap chalta hai. Jaise updated_at set karna ya audit log.
  • Analyst kab milta hai: Report ka number procedure se aata hai, ya trigger data badal deta hai, to confusion hoti hai.
  • Existing ko padhna: PostgreSQL \df+ aur pg_get_functiondef(oid). MySQL SHOW CREATE PROCEDURE name. SQL Server sp_helptext 'name'.
  • Basic authoring: Chhote functions likho, naam saaf rakho, aur naya function dev me test karo.
  • Hidden side effects: Trigger dikhta nahi, par data badalta hai. Table ke triggers check karo.
  • Language: PostgreSQL me LANGUAGE sql ya plpgsql. SQL Server me T-SQL. MySQL me alag syntax.
  • Version control: Production procedures ko git me rakho.

Example

sql
CREATE FUNCTION rake_amount(pot numeric, pct numeric DEFAULT 0.05)
RETURNS numeric
LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE
AS $$ SELECT ROUND(pot * pct, 2) $$;

SELECT rake_amount(200);   -- 10.00

CREATE FUNCTION set_updated_at() RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
BEGIN
  NEW.updated_at := now();
  RETURN NEW;
END $$;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_users_updated
BEFORE UPDATE ON users
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

Function query me use hota hai. Trigger har UPDATE par updated_at apne aap set karta hai.

Common mistakes

  • Trigger ke hidden logic ko ignore karke data mismatch ka bug dhundhna.
  • Production procedure bina padhe chalana. Ho sakta hai wo data delete kare.
  • Function ke andar heavy query daal ke use har row par chalana. Slow hota hai.
  • Procedure ko git ya docs me track na karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Function aur procedure me fark?
    A. Function value return karta hai aur query me use hota hai. Procedure action karta hai aur CALL se chalta hai.
  • Q. Trigger kya hota hai?
    A. Table event par apne aap chalne wala code, jaise audit log ya timestamp update.

Yaad rakho

Function value deta hai, procedure kaam karta hai, trigger khud chalta hai. Padhne ki aadat rakho.

SQL-33SQL dialect differencesIntermediateGood to Have

Core SQL same hai, par date functions, limit, quotes aur JSON engine ke hisaab se badalte hain.

Simple me samjho

SQL ek bhasha hai jiske alag alag "accent" hain. SELECT, JOIN, GROUP BY har jagah chalta hai. Date, string aur limit jaise functions me farq milta hai.

Key points

  • Limit rows: LIMIT n (PostgreSQL, MySQL, BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift). SQL Server me TOP n ya OFFSET ... FETCH.
  • Date trunc: PostgreSQL/Snowflake DATE_TRUNC('month', d), BigQuery DATE_TRUNC(d, MONTH). MySQL me DATE_FORMAT. SQL Server me DATETRUNC (2022+).
  • Date diff: Syntax alag hai. Table dekho.
  • String concat: || PostgreSQL/Snowflake/BigQuery, CONCAT() MySQL, SQL Server me + ya CONCAT().
  • Quoting: PostgreSQL/Snowflake "col", MySQL/BigQuery backticks, SQL Server [col].
  • Integer division: PostgreSQL aur SQL Server me 5/2 = 2. MySQL me 5/2 = 2.5000. Hamesha 1.0 * cast lagao.
  • Case sensitivity: PostgreSQL strings case-sensitive. MySQL default collation case-insensitive. ILIKE PostgreSQL/Snowflake/Redshift me hai.
  • Redshift: PostgreSQL jaisa dikhta hai, par kai features missing hain aur kuch functions alag hain (jaise DATEDIFF, LISTAGG).
  • Jab sandeh ho: Us engine ke docs dekho aur chhoti test query chalao.

Example

KaamPostgreSQLMySQLSQL ServerBigQuerySnowflake
Aaj ka timenow()NOW()GETDATE()CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
Days differenced2 - d1DATEDIFF(d2, d1)DATEDIFF(day, d1, d2)DATE_DIFF(d2, d1, DAY)DATEDIFF(day, d1, d2)
Top 5 rowsLIMIT 5LIMIT 5TOP 5LIMIT 5LIMIT 5

Same kaam, teen alag syntax. Pehle dialect pehchano, phir query likho.

Common mistakes

  • PostgreSQL query ko seedha SQL Server ya BigQuery me paste karna.
  • DATEDIFF argument order ulta likhna. MySQL aur SQL Server me order alag hai.
  • Integer division bhool jaana aur percentage 0 aana.
  • Case-sensitivity par dhyan na dena. Filter me rows miss ho jaati hain.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Alag dialect me kaam kaise karte ho?
    A. Core logic same rakhta hoon, date/string/limit functions docs se check karke badalta hoon.
  • Q. SQL Server me LIMIT kyun nahi chalta?
    A. Wahan TOP n ya OFFSET ... FETCH use hota hai.

Yaad rakho

Logic same, syntax alag. Date, limit, quote aur division pe nazar rakho.

SQL-34Semi-structured data in SQLIntermediateGood to Have

JSON, arrays aur nested fields ko SQL me nikaalo aur flatten karke rows banao.

Simple me samjho

Game events aksar JSON payload me aate hain. Ek column ke andar poora chhota document hota hai. SQL me hum key nikaalte hain, aur array ko alag rows me todte (flatten) hain.

Key points

  • PostgreSQL JSON: jsonb type. -> JSON deta hai, ->> text deta hai. Number chahiye to cast karo.
  • Nested path: payload->'player'->>'name' ya #>>'{player,name}'.
  • Containment: payload @> '{"game":"holdem"}' (jsonb).
  • Arrays: unnest(array_col) array ko rows me todta hai. PostgreSQL jsonb_array_elements JSON array ke liye.
  • Flattening: Ek row, N array items me badal kar N rows. Row count badhta hai, to sums dhyan se.
  • MySQL: JSON_EXTRACT, ->>, JSON_TABLE.
  • SQL Server: JSON_VALUE, OPENJSON.
  • BigQuery: JSON_VALUE, UNNEST(array), STRUCT me dot notation (player.name).
  • Snowflake: VARIANT type, payload:buy_in::number, LATERAL FLATTEN(input => payload:tags).
  • Performance: Roz ke heavy use ke liye JSON ko normal columns me nikaal lo.

Example

sql
-- events.payload: {"game":"holdem","buy_in":500,"tags":["vip","mobile"]}
SELECT e.id,
       e.payload->>'game'                AS game,
       (e.payload->>'buy_in')::numeric   AS buy_in,
       t.tag
FROM events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(e.payload->'tags') AS t(tag);
text
id | game   | buy_in | tag
1  | holdem | 500    | vip
1  | holdem | 500    | mobile

Ek event ke 2 tags the, to 2 rows bani. Isi liye buy_in ka SUM double ho sakta hai.

Common mistakes

  • ->> se text nikaal ke number ki tarah compare karna bina cast ke.
  • Flatten ke baad SUM karna aur double counting hona.
  • Missing key par NULL aata hai. Use handle na karna.
  • json aur jsonb ko same samajhna. jsonb indexable aur tez hai.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. PostgreSQL me -> aur ->> me fark?
    A. -> JSON object deta hai, ->> text value deta hai.
  • Q. Array flatten kaise karte ho?
    A. PostgreSQL me unnest / jsonb_array_elements, BigQuery me UNNEST, Snowflake me LATERAL FLATTEN.

Yaad rakho

Key nikaalo, cast karo, array ko flatten karo. Flatten ke baad row count badalta hai.

SQL-35SQL readability and reviewBasicMust Know

Saaf formatting, achhe naam, comments aur peer review se query samajhne me aasaan aur safe banti hai.

Simple me samjho

Query ek baar likhi jaati hai par kai baar padhi jaati hai. 6 mahine baad aap khud usse nahi samjhoge agar wo ulajhi ho. Saaf query se bugs jaldi pakde jaate hain.

Key points

  • Formatting: Keywords ek jaise (UPPER ya lower), ek line me ek column, indentation consistent.
  • Naming: snake_case, meaningful aliases (users u, orders o). a, b, t1 se bacho.
  • CTE over nested subquery: Har step ka naam do, upar se neeche padho.
  • Comments: Kya nahi, kyun likho. Jaise "bots exclude kiye kyunki test accounts hain".
  • Header comment: Purpose, owner, date, input tables.
  • Explicit joins: JOIN ... ON use karo, comma join nahi.
  • Style guide: Team ka ek standard follow karo. Tools jaise sqlfluff auto-check karte hain.
  • Saving queries: Git repo ya shared folder me version ke saath rakho. Dashboard ya notebook me chhupa mat rakho.
  • Peer review: Joins, filters, grain, NULL handling aur date range doosre se check karao.
  • Magic numbers: Constants ko CTE ya comment me naam do.

Example

sql
-- Purpose: daily real-money deposits, bots excluded
-- Owner: analytics | Updated: 2024-05-10
WITH real_users AS (
    SELECT user_id
    FROM users
    WHERE is_bot = FALSE          -- test/bot accounts hatao
)
SELECT
    t.created_at::date AS deposit_date,
    COUNT(*)           AS deposit_count,
    SUM(t.amount)      AS deposit_amount
FROM transactions AS t
INNER JOIN real_users AS r ON r.user_id = t.user_id
WHERE t.type = 'deposit'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

Har step ka naam hai, comment me wajah hai, aur header me owner. Reviewer 1 minute me samajh lega.

Common mistakes

  • Ek lambi line me poori query likhna.
  • Alias a, b, c rakhna.
  • Comments na likhna ya purane comments ko update na karna.
  • Review ke bina number business ko bhej dena.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Achhi SQL query ki pehchaan?
    A. Sahi result, saaf formatting, meaningful naam, CTE me steps, aur zaroori jagah comments.
  • Q. Peer review me kya dekhte ho?
    A. Join keys, grain, filters, NULL handling, date range aur duplicate risk.

Yaad rakho

Query doosron ke liye likho, aur future aapke liye. Saaf, naam wali, reviewed.

SQL-36Data validation queriesIntermediateMust Know

Number bhejne se pehle row count, duplicates, nulls aur source totals se reconcile karo.

Simple me samjho

Galat number bhejna sabse bura hota hai. Isliye query chalane ke baad checks chalao. Jaise accountant total match karta hai, waise hum source se match karte hain.

Key points

  • Row counts: Expected date range ke rows ki ginti. Aaj aur kal me bada farak ho to rukho.
  • Duplicates: GROUP BY key HAVING COUNT(*) > 1, ya COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT key).
  • Nulls: COUNT(*) - COUNT(col) ya COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE col IS NULL).
  • Reconcile totals: Apne result ka SUM/COUNT source (raw table ya finance report) se match karo.
  • Sanity checks: Negative amounts, future dates, min/max, impossible values (age 200, chips < 0).
  • Join fan-out: Join ke pehle aur baad ka row count same hona chahiye (ek-se-ek join me).
  • Orphans: LEFT JOIN ... WHERE parent.id IS NULL se bina parent wali rows.
  • Freshness: MAX(created_at) dekho ki data latest hai ya nahi.
  • Trend check: Kal ya pichle hafte se compare karo. Achanak 50% girawat bug ho sakti hai.
  • Save checks: Ye queries ek saved file me rakho, har report ke baad chalao.

Example

sql
SELECT 'row_count' AS check_name, COUNT(*)::text AS result
FROM orders WHERE order_date = '2024-05-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'duplicate_order_id', (COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT order_id))::text
FROM orders
UNION ALL
SELECT 'null_user_id', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE user_id IS NULL)::text
FROM orders
UNION ALL
SELECT 'negative_amount', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE amount < 0)::text
FROM orders;
text
check_name         | result
row_count          | 1240
duplicate_order_id | 0
null_user_id       | 0
negative_amount    | 3

Negative amount 3 rows me hai. Pehle samjho ki refunds hain ya bug, phir number bhejo.

Common mistakes

  • Result "reasonable" lagne par check na karna.
  • Join ke baad row count compare na karna.
  • Source se reconcile kiye bina dashboard ka number mana lena.
  • Checks ko ek baar chala ke bhool jaana.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Report bhejne se pehle kya check karte ho?
    A. Row count, duplicates, nulls, negative/impossible values, aur source se total match.
  • Q. Duplicates SQL me kaise dhoondhte ho?
    A. Key pe GROUP BY karke HAVING COUNT(*) > 1.

Yaad rakho

Count, duplicate, null, reconcile, sanity. Phir hi number bhejo.

SQL-37NoSQL awareness (MongoDB, Redis)IntermediateGood to Have

MongoDB documents store karta hai aur pipeline se aggregate karta hai. Redis fast key-value store hai.

Simple me samjho

SQL me data tables me hota hai. MongoDB me JSON jaise documents hote hain, aur Redis me key se value milti hai. Analyst ko pata hona chahiye ki data kahan se aa raha hai aur kaise nikaalna hai.

Key points

  • Document: Ek JSON-like record (BSON). Collection = table jaisa, document = row jaisa.
  • Flexible schema: Har document me alag fields ho sakte hain. Nested objects aur arrays aam hain.
  • Aggregation pipeline: Stages ek ke baad ek: $match (WHERE), $group (GROUP BY), $sort, $project, $limit.
  • $lookup / $unwind: $lookup join jaisa hai. $unwind array ko flatten karta hai.
  • Key-value store (Redis): key -> value. Memory me hota hai, isliye bahut tez.
  • Redis types: String, Hash, List, Set, Sorted Set (leaderboard ke liye).
  • TTL: EXPIRE / SET ... EX se key apne aap expire hoti hai. Session aur cache me useful.
  • Kab NoSQL fit hai: Flexible schema, high write volume, cache, session, leaderboard, real-time counters.
  • Kab SQL behtar: Complex joins, reporting, transactions aur strict schema.
  • Analytics ke liye: Mongo/Redis data aksar warehouse me export hota hai, phir SQL se analysis.

Example

javascript
// MongoDB: user wise successful deposit total
db.transactions.aggregate([
  { $match: { type: "deposit", status: "success" } },
  { $group: { _id: "$userId", total: { $sum: "$amount" }, cnt: { $sum: 1 } } },
  { $sort: { total: -1 } },
  { $limit: 3 }
])
text
{ _id: 7, total: 5000, cnt: 4 }
{ _id: 3, total: 2500, cnt: 2 }

SQL equivalent: WHERE + GROUP BY user_id + ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 3.

text
SET session:abc123 "user:7" EX 1800
GET session:abc123
INCR rate:user:7
ZINCRBY leaderboard:daily 250 "user:7"
ZRANGE leaderboard:daily 0 2 REV WITHSCORES

Redis me session 30 minute ke TTL ke saath, rate-limit counter, aur sorted-set leaderboard.

Common mistakes

  • NoSQL ko SQL ki tarah joins ke liye use karna.
  • Redis ko permanent database maan lena. Memory data khoya ja sakta hai (persistence config ke bina).
  • Mongo me field type mix hona (kabhi string, kabhi number). Aggregation galat aati hai.
  • Analytics seedha production Mongo/Redis par bhaari query chalana.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Mongo aggregation pipeline kya hai?
    A. Stages ki chain ($match, $group, $sort...) jisme har stage ka output agle ka input banta hai.
  • Q. Redis kab use karte hain?
    A. Cache, sessions, rate limiting, leaderboards, jahan bahut tez read/write chahiye.

Yaad rakho

Mongo = documents + pipeline, Redis = tez key-value + TTL. Analysis ke liye warehouse + SQL.

Python 28 topics

PY-01Python basicsBasicMust Know

Python ke basic building blocks: variables, data types, operators aur input/output. Har script isi pe khada hota hai.

Simple me samjho

Variable ek label hai jo kisi value pe chipka hota hai. Python me type declare nahi karna padta, value se type decide hota hai. Jaise Excel cell me number ya text kuch bhi daal sakte ho, waise hi yahan bhi.

Key points

  • Variables: name = "Aman" se bante hain. Naam case-sensitive hota hai, snake_case use karo (total_bet).
  • Data types: int, float, str, bool, NoneType. type(x) se check karo.
  • Dynamic typing: same variable ko baad me dusri type ki value de sakte ho, lekin readable code ke liye avoid karo.
  • Arithmetic operators: + - * / (hamesha float deta hai), // floor division, % modulo, ** power.
  • Comparison operators: == != < > <= >= result True/False dete hain.
  • Logical operators: and, or, not. Membership: in, not in. Identity: is.
  • Type conversion: int("5"), float("2.5"), str(10). Galat string pe ValueError aata hai.
  • Input: input("prompt") hamesha str return karta hai, number chahiye to convert karo.
  • Output: print(a, b, sep=",", end=""). f-string se formatted output.
  • None: "koi value nahi" ka marker. Check karne ke liye x is None.
  • Float precision: 0.1 + 0.2 exactly 0.3 nahi hota. Paise ke liye round() ya decimal.Decimal.

Example

python
buy_in = 500          # int
rake_pct = 2.5        # float
player = "Rahul"      # str
is_vip = True         # bool

rake = buy_in * rake_pct / 100
print(f"{player} paid rake {rake}")     # f-string
print(type(rake), 7 // 2, 7 % 2, 2 ** 3)
print(0.1 + 0.2 == 0.3)
text
Rahul paid rake 12.5
<class 'float'> 3 1 8
False

Last line False isliye hai kyunki floats binary me approximate store hote hain.

Common mistakes

  • input() ka output number samajh ke add kar dena: "5" + "3" gives "53".
  • = (assign) aur == (compare) mix kar dena.
  • Float ko == se compare karna; math.isclose use karo.
  • Built-in naam (list, sum, id) variable naam bana dena, phir built-in toot jata hai.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. / aur // me kya farq hai?
    A. / true division hai, float deta hai (7/2 = 3.5). // floor division hai (7//2 = 3).
  • Q. Python dynamically typed ka matlab?
    A. Type variable ki nahi, value ki hoti hai. Type runtime pe decide hota hai, declare nahi karna padta.

Yaad rakho

Variable = label on a value; input() always string deta hai; float equality pe bharosa mat karo.

PY-02Control flow and loopsBasicMust Know

Decisions (if/else) aur repetition (for/while) ka tareeka, saath me comprehensions jo loops ko ek line me likhne dete hain.

Simple me samjho

Control flow matlab code ko raasta dikhana: "agar ye ho to ye karo, warna wo". Loop matlab same kaam bar bar karna. Jaise har row ke liye check karna ki player VIP hai ya nahi.

Key points

  • if / elif / else: upar se neeche check hota hai, pehli true condition chalti hai, baaki skip.
  • Indentation: Python me block indentation (4 spaces) se bante hain, braces nahi.
  • for loop: kisi bhi iterable pe chalta hai: for x in items:. range(n) 0 se n-1 deta hai.
  • enumerate / zip: enumerate(lst) index + value deta hai, zip(a, b) do lists ek saath chalata hai.
  • while loop: jab tak condition true ho. Exit condition khud update karni padti hai, warna infinite loop.
  • break: loop turant band. continue: current iteration skip, next pe jao.
  • for-else: else tab chalta hai jab loop bina break ke khatam ho.
  • Truthiness: empty list, 0, "", None False maane jaate hain. if items: se empty check.
  • List comprehension: [expr for x in data if cond]. Dict aur set comprehension bhi hoti hai.
  • Ternary: "VIP" if x > 1000 else "Regular".
  • Analyst tip: pandas me row-by-row loop avoid karo, vectorised operations use karo (PY-17).

Example

python
bets = [50, 0, 200, 1500, 20]

big = [b for b in bets if b >= 100]          # comprehension
labels = ["big" if b >= 100 else "small" for b in bets]
squares = {b: b * 2 for b in bets if b}      # dict comprehension

total = 0
for i, b in enumerate(bets):
    if b == 0:
        continue            # zero bet skip
    if total > 1500:
        break               # limit cross, stop
    total += b
print(big, total)
text
[200, 1500] 1750

Total 50, 250, phir 1750 hua. Last bet 20 pe total 1500 se bada tha, to break chala aur 20 add nahi hua. Zero bet continue se skip hui.

Common mistakes

  • while me counter update bhool jana, infinite loop.
  • List ko loop ke andar hi modify karna (items skip ho jaate hain). Copy ya comprehension use karo.
  • Comprehension me bahut zyada logic daalna, unreadable ho jata hai. Complex ho to normal loop likho.
  • if x == True likhna; seedha if x: likho.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. break aur continue me farq?
    A. break poora loop rok deta hai, continue sirf current iteration skip karke next pe jata hai.
  • Q. List comprehension loop se behtar kab?
    A. Jab simple transform ya filter ho; short aur thoda fast hota hai. Complex logic me normal loop readable hai.

Yaad rakho

Indentation hi block hai; comprehension simple cases ke liye, readability pehle.

PY-03Functions and scopeBasicMust Know

Functions reusable code blocks hain. def, args/kwargs, lambda, return, docstring aur variable scope samajhna zaroori hai.

Simple me samjho

Function ek mini machine hai: input do, output lo. Ek baar likho, bar bar chalao. Report ka rake calculation 10 jagah copy karne se behtar ek function.

Key points

  • def: def name(params): se function banta hai. Call: name(args).
  • return: value wapas deta hai. return na ho to function None return karta hai.
  • Positional vs keyword args: f(1, 2) position se, f(a=1, b=2) naam se.
  • Default values: def f(x, rate=0.05). Default mutable (list/dict) mat rakho.
  • Variable args (args): *args me extra positional args tuple ban ke aate hain.
  • Keyword args (kwargs): **kwargs me extra keyword args dict ban ke aate hain.
  • lambda: chhota anonymous function, ek expression: lambda x: x * 2. Sorting key ya apply me kaam aata hai.
  • Docstring: function ke pehle line me triple quotes, help(f) me dikhta hai.
  • Scope (LEGB): Local, Enclosing, Global, Built-in order me naam dhundha jata hai.
  • global / side effects: function ke andar global badalna avoid karo. Input lo, output return karo.
  • Multiple returns: return a, b actually tuple return karta hai.

Example

python
def rake(pot, pct=5, cap=None):
    """Return rake amount for a pot; optional cap."""
    r = pot * pct / 100
    return min(r, cap) if cap else r

def summary(*amounts, **opts):
    return sum(amounts), opts

print(rake(1000), rake(1000, cap=30))
print(summary(10, 20, 30, label="day1"))
players = [("a", 300), ("b", 100)]
print(sorted(players, key=lambda p: p[1]))
text
50.0 30
(60, {'label': 'day1'})
[('b', 100), ('a', 300)]

cap keyword se pass hua, *amounts tuple bana, lambda ne sort key di.

Common mistakes

  • Mutable default: def f(x, items=[]) me list calls ke beech share hoti hai. None default lo aur andar list banao.
  • return bhool jana, aur phir result None aana.
  • Function ke andar print karna jahan return chahiye; reuse nahi ho pata.
  • Bade logic ke liye lambda use karna; named def likho.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. *args aur **kwargs kya hain?
    A. *args extra positional arguments ko tuple me leta hai, **kwargs extra keyword arguments ko dict me.
  • Q. LEGB kya hai?
    A. Name lookup order: Local, Enclosing, Global, Built-in.

Yaad rakho

Function input leke output return kare, global state na chhede; mutable default kabhi nahi.

PY-04Core data structuresBasicMust Know

list, tuple, dict, set: Python ke chaar core containers, saath me slicing, sorting aur nested data.

Simple me samjho

List = ordered dabba jo badal sakta hai. Tuple = same par fixed. Dict = key se value dhundhna (phone book). Set = unique items ka bag. JSON data aksar dict aur list ka nested mix hota hai.

Key points

  • list: [1, 2, 3], ordered, mutable. append, extend, pop, remove.
  • tuple: (1, 2), ordered, immutable. Fixed records aur dict keys ke liye.
  • dict: {"id": 1}, key-value, insertion order preserved. d.get(k, default) safe access, d.items() loop ke liye.
  • set: {1, 2}, unique, unordered. a & b, a | b, a - b se intersection/union/difference. Membership check fast.
  • Slicing: lst[start:stop:step], stop exclude hota hai. lst[::-1] reverse, lst[-2:] last 2.
  • Sorting: sorted(x) naya list deta hai, lst.sort() in-place. key= aur reverse=True.
  • Nested structures: list of dicts (records), dict of lists. data["users"][0]["name"].
  • Copy: b = a sirf reference hai. a.copy() shallow copy, copy.deepcopy(a) nested ke liye.
  • Unpacking: a, b = (1, 2), first, *rest = lst.
  • Dedupe: list(set(x)) order kho deta hai; list(dict.fromkeys(x)) order rakhta hai.
  • Counting: collections.Counter(lst).

Example

python
players = [
    {"id": 1, "name": "Aman", "chips": 500},
    {"id": 2, "name": "Riya", "chips": 1200},
    {"id": 3, "name": "Kabir", "chips": 800},
]
top = sorted(players, key=lambda p: p["chips"], reverse=True)[:2]
names = [p["name"] for p in top]
by_id = {p["id"]: p for p in players}
print(names, by_id[3]["chips"])

a, b = {1, 2, 3}, {3, 4}
print(a & b, a - b, [1, 2, 3, 4, 5][1:4])
text
['Riya', 'Kabir'] 800
{3} {1, 2} [2, 3, 4]

List of dicts ko sort karke top 2 liye, aur dict se id se direct lookup kiya.

Common mistakes

  • b = a karke list copy samajhna; ek badlega to dusra bhi badlega.
  • d["missing"] se KeyError; .get() use karo.
  • Loop ke dauran dict ka size badalna, RuntimeError.
  • Set me order expect karna, ya list/dict ko set element banana (unhashable).

Interview Q&A

  • Q. list aur tuple me farq?
    A. List mutable hai, tuple immutable. Tuple hashable ho sakta hai, isliye dict key ban sakta hai.
  • Q. sort() vs sorted()?
    A. sort() list ko in-place badalta hai, None return. sorted() kisi bhi iterable se naya sorted list deta hai.

Yaad rakho

Order chahiye to list, lookup chahiye to dict, uniqueness chahiye to set; slice me stop exclusive.

PY-05Strings, f-strings and regexBasicMust Know

Text cleaning analyst ka roz ka kaam hai: string methods, f-string formatting aur re module se patterns nikalna.

Simple me samjho

String text ka sequence hai aur immutable hai. Methods naya string return karte hain. Regex ek pattern language hai, jaise "ye shape ka text dhundho" (email, phone, ID).

Key points

  • Basic methods: strip(), lower(), upper(), title(), replace(a, b), startswith(), endswith().
  • split / join: "a,b".split(",") list deta hai, ",".join(lst) wapas jodta hai.
  • Immutable: s.upper() original nahi badalta, result assign karo.
  • Indexing/slicing: s[0], s[-3:], strings pe bhi slicing chalti hai.
  • f-strings: f"{name}: {amt:,.2f}". :, thousand separator, .2f 2 decimals, :>10 right align, :.1% percent.
  • Debug f-string: f"{x=}" naam aur value dono print karta hai.
  • re.search / re.match: search kahin bhi dhundhta hai, match sirf shuru se.
  • re.findall / re.sub: findall saare matches list me, sub replace karta hai.
  • Groups: (...) se part capture, m.group(1).
  • Raw string: pattern r"\d+" raw string me likho, backslash issue nahi aata.
  • Common tokens: \d digit, \w word char, \s space, + one or more, * zero or more, ? optional, ^ $ start/end.
  • Pandas: same kaam column pe df["c"].str.extract(...), .str.contains(...).

Example

python
import re

msg = "Player P-1042 deposited Rs 2,500 on 2025-03-14"
pid = re.search(r"P-(\d+)", msg).group(1)
amt = re.search(r"Rs ([\d,]+)", msg).group(1).replace(",", "")
date = re.findall(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}", msg)
print(pid, int(amt), date)
print(re.sub(r"\s+", " ", "  too   many    spaces ").strip())
print(f"{int(amt):,} | {0.256:.1%}")
text
1042 2500 ['2025-03-14']
too many spaces
2,500 | 25.6%

Regex se ID, amount aur date nikale; sub se extra spaces hataye.

Common mistakes

  • re.search ka result None ho sakta hai; .group() se pehle check karo.
  • Raw string (r"") bhool jana.
  • Greedy match: .* zyada kha leta hai; .*? non-greedy use karo.
  • String method result assign na karna (s.strip() akela kuch nahi badalta).
  • Regex se complex HTML/JSON parse karna; proper parser use karo.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. re.match aur re.search me farq?
    A. match string ke start se match karta hai, search poori string me pehla match dhundhta hai.
  • Q. f-string ka fayda?
    A. Readable, fast, aur format spec (:,.2f) ke saath expression seedha embed hota hai.

Yaad rakho

Strings immutable hain; pattern hamesha raw string me; regex result None check karo.

PY-06File handlingBasicMust Know

Files padhna aur likhna: open, with, CSV/JSON/Excel, pathlib aur encoding ke jhanjhat.

Simple me samjho

File kholo, kaam karo, band karo. with ye band karna automatic kar deta hai, error aaye tab bhi. Analyst ke liye zyada tar CSV, Excel aur JSON files hoti hain.

Key points

  • open modes: "r" read, "w" write (purani file overwrite!), "a" append, "rb"/"wb" binary.
  • with: with open(p) as f: file auto close karta hai. Hamesha yahi use karo.
  • encoding: open(p, encoding="utf-8") explicitly do. Windows/Excel files me utf-8-sig ya cp1252 bhi milta hai.
  • CSV: pandas me pd.read_csv, df.to_csv(path, index=False). Built-in csv module bhi hai.
  • JSON: json.load(f), json.dump(obj, f, indent=2). Nested JSON ko pd.json_normalize se flat karo.
  • Excel: pd.read_excel(p, sheet_name="Sheet1"), df.to_excel(p, index=False). openpyxl engine chahiye (.xlsx).
  • pathlib: Path("data") / "file.csv", .exists(), .suffix, .stem, .glob("*.csv"), .mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True).
  • Relative paths: script kahan se chali us pe depend karte hain; Path(__file__).parent se anchor karo.
  • Multiple files: glob se saari CSV padho aur pd.concat karo.
  • UnicodeDecodeError: galat encoding ka sign. encoding="latin-1" ya errors="replace" try karo, par source ko samjho.

Example

python
import json
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

out = Path("exports")
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

df = pd.DataFrame({"user": ["a", "b"], "bet": [100, 250]})
df.to_csv(out / "bets.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8")

with open(out / "meta.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    json.dump({"rows": len(df)}, f, indent=2)

files = sorted(out.glob("*.csv"))
print([p.name for p in files], pd.read_csv(files[0]).shape)
text
['bets.csv'] (2, 2)

Folder banaya, CSV aur JSON likhe, phir glob se CSV files dhundh ke padhi.

Common mistakes

  • index=False bhool jana, CSV me extra index column aa jata hai.
  • "w" mode se important file overwrite kar dena.
  • Hardcoded absolute path (C:\Users\...); pathlib aur relative path use karo.
  • Encoding na batana, doosre machine pe UnicodeDecodeError.
  • Bahut badi file ek saath padhna (PY-17 dekho).

Interview Q&A

  • Q. with open() kyun?
    A. Ye file ko automatically close karta hai, exception ke case me bhi. Resource leak nahi hota.
  • Q. CSV padhte waqt UnicodeDecodeError aaye to?
    A. Encoding check karo: utf-8, utf-8-sig, cp1252/latin-1 try karo, aur source system se confirm karo.

Yaad rakho

Hamesha with, explicit encoding, aur pathlib paths; "w" overwrite karta hai.

PY-07Error handling and loggingIntermediateMust Know

try/except se errors sambhalna, khud errors raise karna aur logging module se samajhne layak failure messages likhna.

Simple me samjho

Error aana normal hai, script ka bina bataye toot jana nahi. try/except se hum plan banate hain ki galti pe kya karna hai. Logging print se behtar hai kyunki levels, time aur file output milte hain.

Key points

  • try/except: risky code try me, handler except me. Specific exception pakdo: except FileNotFoundError.
  • Bare except avoid: except: ya except Exception: pass bugs chhupa deta hai.
  • else / finally: else jab koi error na aaye, finally hamesha chalta hai (cleanup).
  • raise: raise ValueError("bet must be positive"). Bad input pe jaldi fail karo.
  • Re-raise: except X as e: log...; raise se error upar jaane do.
  • Common errors: KeyError, ValueError, TypeError, FileNotFoundError, ZeroDivisionError.
  • logging module: logging.getLogger(__name__). Levels: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL.
  • basicConfig: logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(message)s").
  • logger.exception: except ke andar use karo, traceback ke saath log hota hai.
  • Readable messages: kya fail hua, kis input pe, aur aage kya karna hai, ye likho.
  • Pipelines: ek row kharab ho to poori job na girao, bad row log karke skip karo (agar business allow kare).

Example

python
import logging

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO,
                    format="%(levelname)s %(message)s")
log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

def parse_amount(raw):
    try:
        value = float(raw)
    except ValueError:
        log.warning("Bad amount %r, skipping", raw)
        return None
    if value < 0:
        raise ValueError(f"Negative amount: {value}")
    return value

print([parse_amount(x) for x in ["100", "abc", "25.5"]])
text
WARNING Bad amount 'abc', skipping
[100.0, None, 25.5]

Bad string pe warning log hua aur script chalti rahi; negative value pe hum jaanbujh ke error raise karte.

Common mistakes

  • except Exception: pass, silent failure; kabhi pata nahi chalta data galat hai.
  • Bahut bada try block; sirf risky line wrap karo.
  • Production script me sirf print use karna.
  • Logs me passwords, tokens ya personal data likh dena.
  • Error message me context na dena ("failed" kis file pe?).

Interview Q&A

  • Q. try/except/else/finally ka flow?
    A. try chalta hai; error pe except; error na aaye to else; finally har haal me chalta hai.
  • Q. print ki jagah logging kyun?
    A. Levels, timestamps, file/console output aur easy on/off milta hai. Production me traceable hota hai.

Yaad rakho

Specific exceptions pakdo, silent fail mat karo, aur log me context likho.

PY-08Environments and packagesBasicMust Know

Virtual environment, pip, requirements.txt aur imports se project reproducible banta hai: "mere machine pe chal raha hai" wali problem khatam.

Simple me samjho

Har project ka apna alag toolbox (environment) hota hai, taaki ek project ke packages dusre ko na tode. requirements.txt us toolbox ki shopping list hai.

Key points

  • venv: python -m venv .venv environment banata hai. Activate: Linux/Mac source .venv/bin/activate, Windows .venv\Scripts\activate.
  • conda: conda create -n analytics python=3.11, conda activate analytics. Data science stack ke liye popular.
  • pip install: pip install pandas. Specific version: pip install pandas==2.2.2.
  • requirements.txt: pip freeze > requirements.txt se banao, pip install -r requirements.txt se install.
  • Pin versions: pandas==2.2.2 pin karne se result dobara bana sakte ho.
  • Imports: import pandas as pd, from pathlib import Path. Standard library, third-party, local, is order me.
  • pip list / pip show pkg: kya installed hai dekho.
  • .gitignore: .venv/ repo me commit mat karo.
  • Reproducibility: Python version, package versions aur random seed note karo.
  • Secrets: .env ya environment variables use karo, requirements ya code me nahi.
  • Jupyter kernel: environment ko kernel ke roop me register karna padta hai (ipykernel).

Example

bash
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install pandas==2.2.2 openpyxl
pip freeze > requirements.txt
# naye machine pe:
pip install -r requirements.txt
text
(.venv) $ pip list | grep pandas
pandas   2.2.2

Prompt me (.venv) dikhe to environment active hai. Ab installs sirf is project ke andar jaate hain.

Common mistakes

  • Global Python me sab install karna; version conflicts.
  • requirements.txt update na karna.
  • Environment activate kiye bina pip install, package galat jagah chala jata hai.
  • .venv folder git me daal dena.
  • Notebook ka kernel aur terminal ka environment alag hona.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Virtual environment kyun?
    A. Project-wise dependencies isolate hoti hain, conflicts nahi hote, aur setup dusre log reproduce kar sakte hain.
  • Q. pip aur conda me farq?
    A. pip Python packages install karta hai (PyPI). conda environment aur Python version bhi manage karta hai, non-Python libraries ke saath.

Yaad rakho

Ek project, ek environment, pinned requirements.txt.

PY-09NumPyIntermediateMust Know

NumPy fast numeric arrays deta hai. Vectorisation, broadcasting aur aggregations pandas ki neev hain.

Simple me samjho

NumPy array ek tarah ka Excel column hai jisme saare items same type ke hote hain. Poore column pe ek hi operation ek saath chalta hai, loop ke bina. Isliye Python loop se bahut tez hota hai.

Key points

  • Create: np.array([1, 2, 3]), np.zeros(3), np.ones((2, 3)), np.arange(0, 10, 2), np.linspace(0, 1, 5).
  • Attributes: a.shape, a.dtype, a.ndim, a.size.
  • Vectorisation: a * 2, a + b element-wise chalta hai, loop nahi likhna.
  • Broadcasting: chhota array bade ke shape me automatically phail jata hai (jaise (3,3) + (3,)). Shapes right se compatible honi chahiye.
  • Aggregations: sum, mean, std, min, max. axis=0 columns ke upar, axis=1 rows ke upar.
  • Boolean indexing: a[a > 10] filter karta hai. np.where(cond, x, y) if-else vectorised.
  • Indexing/slicing: a[1:3], 2D me a[0, 1], a[:, 0].
  • reshape: a.reshape(2, 3), -1 auto size.
  • NaN: np.nan, np.isnan(a), np.nanmean(a) NaN ignore karta hai.
  • Random: rng = np.random.default_rng(42), rng.integers(...), rng.normal(...). Seed se result repeatable.
  • dtype: ek array me ek hi dtype; mix hua to upcast hota hai.

Example

python
import numpy as np

bets = np.array([[100, 200, 300],
                 [50, 150, 250]])
print(bets.shape, bets.sum(), bets.mean(axis=0))
print(bets * 1.1)                       # vectorised
print(bets - np.array([10, 20, 30]))    # broadcasting
print(np.where(bets > 150, "high", "low"))

rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
print(rng.integers(1, 7, size=5).shape)
text
(2, 3) 1050 [ 75. 175. 275.]
[[110. 220. 330.]
 [ 55. 165. 275.]]
[[ 90 180 270]
 [ 40 130 220]]
[['low' 'high' 'high']
 ['low' 'low' 'high']]
(5,)

axis=0 ne har column ka mean diya. Broadcasting me [10,20,30] har row se subtract hua.

Common mistakes

  • Array pe Python loop chalana; vectorised form use karo.
  • axis confuse karna: axis=0 rows collapse karta hai (column-wise result).
  • == se NaN check karna; np.isnan use karo.
  • Seed set na karna aur result repeat na hona.
  • Integer array me float assign karna aur silent truncation.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Broadcasting kya hai?
    A. Alag shapes ke arrays pe operation, jahan chhota array bade ke shape me virtually phail jata hai bina copy ke.
  • Q. NumPy list se tez kyun?
    A. Contiguous memory, fixed dtype aur C-level vectorised operations.

Yaad rakho

Loop mat likho, array pe operate karo; axis aur shape hamesha check karo.

PY-10Pandas: load and inspectBasicMust Know

Data load karne ke baad pehle inspect karo: shape, info, describe, dtypes, head aur value_counts se data ka health pata chalta hai.

Simple me samjho

Naya dataset milte hi seedha analysis nahi karte. Pehle dekhte hain kitni rows, kaunse columns, kaunsa type, kitne nulls. Ye 2 minute ka check baad ke bahut bugs bacha deta hai.

Key points

  • read_csv: pd.read_csv(p, usecols=[...], dtype={...}, parse_dates=["created_at"], nrows=1000).
  • read_excel: pd.read_excel(p, sheet_name="Sheet1") (openpyxl chahiye).
  • read_sql: pd.read_sql(query, engine), SQLAlchemy engine ke saath (PY-20).
  • head / tail / sample: df.head(), df.tail(3), df.sample(5).
  • shape: (rows, cols) tuple.
  • info(): columns, non-null count, dtype, memory usage.
  • describe(): numeric columns ke count/mean/std/min/quartiles/max. include="object" text ke liye.
  • dtypes: har column ka type; dates aksar object aate hain, convert karo.
  • value_counts: df["col"].value_counts(dropna=False, normalize=True) frequency aur NaN dikhata hai.
  • Null summary: df.isna().sum().
  • Uniqueness: df["id"].nunique(), df.duplicated().sum().
  • Columns list: df.columns.tolist().

Example

python
import pandas as pd
from io import StringIO

csv = StringIO("""user_id,country,bet,created_at
1,IN,100,2025-01-01
2,IN,250,2025-01-02
3,US,,2025-01-02
""")
df = pd.read_csv(csv, parse_dates=["created_at"])
print(df.shape)
print(df.dtypes)
print(df["country"].value_counts())
print(df.isna().sum())
text
(3, 4)
user_id                int64
country               object
bet                  float64
created_at    datetime64[ns]
dtype: object
country
IN    2
US    1
Name: count, dtype: int64
user_id       0
country       0
bet           1
created_at    0
dtype: int64

bet me ek null hai, isliye wo int ki jagah float ban gaya. parse_dates se created_at datetime ban gayi.

Common mistakes

  • Bina info() ya dtypes dekhe analysis shuru karna.
  • Dates string rehna; sorting aur filtering galat.
  • IDs ya zip code number ban jaana (leading zeros jaate hain); dtype=str do.
  • Poori badi file read_csv se load kar lena; usecols/nrows/chunksize use karo.
  • describe() ko poora sach maan lena, outliers aur nulls alag dekho.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Naya dataset aaye to pehle kya karoge?
    A. shape, head, info, describe, null counts, duplicates aur key columns ke value_counts.
  • Q. info() aur describe() me farq?
    A. info() structure deta hai (dtype, non-null, memory); describe() statistics deta hai.

Yaad rakho

Analysis se pehle inspect: shape, dtypes, nulls, duplicates, value_counts.

PY-11Pandas: select and filterBasicMust Know

Columns aur rows chunna: loc, iloc, boolean masks, query, isin aur sorting. Roz ka sabse zyada use hone wala pandas kaam.

Simple me samjho

DataFrame ek table hai. Select matlab kuch columns uthana, filter matlab condition ke basis pe rows uthana. loc labels se, iloc position se.

Key points

  • Column select: df["bet"] Series deta hai, df[["user", "bet"]] DataFrame deta hai.
  • loc: label-based, df.loc[rows, cols]. Slice me end inclusive hota hai.
  • iloc: position-based, df.iloc[0:3, 0:2]. End exclusive.
  • Boolean mask: df[df["bet"] > 100]. Condition ek True/False Series banati hai.
  • Multiple conditions: &, |, ~ use karo, har condition bracket me: (a > 1) & (b == "IN"). and/or kaam nahi karte.
  • isin: df[df["country"].isin(["IN", "US"])]. Negate: ~df["country"].isin([...]).
  • between: df["bet"].between(100, 500) (inclusive by default).
  • query: df.query("bet > 100 and country == 'IN'"). Readable, variable ke liye @var.
  • Text filter: df["name"].str.contains("ab", na=False).
  • Sorting: df.sort_values(["country", "bet"], ascending=[True, False]), df.sort_index().
  • Top N: df.nlargest(3, "bet").
  • Assign safely: df.loc[mask, "col"] = value, chained indexing (df[mask]["col"] = ...) se bacho.

Example

python
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({
    "user": ["a", "b", "c", "d"],
    "country": ["IN", "US", "IN", "UK"],
    "bet": [100, 400, 250, 50],
})
mask = (df["bet"] >= 100) & df["country"].isin(["IN", "US"])
print(df.loc[mask, ["user", "bet"]])
print(df.query("bet > 90").sort_values("bet", ascending=False).iloc[0, 0])
df.loc[df["bet"] < 100, "bet"] = 100
text
  user  bet
0    a  100
1    b  400
2    c  250
b

Mask se 3 rows mili. query + sort ke baad iloc[0, 0] top row ka pehla column (b) deta hai.

Common mistakes

  • & ki jagah and likhna, ValueError: truth value of a Series is ambiguous.
  • Condition ke bracket bhool jana; operator precedence galat ho jata hai.
  • Chained assignment (df[df.a > 1]["b"] = 0), SettingWithCopyWarning aur update nahi hota.
  • loc aur iloc ka end behaviour confuse karna.
  • Filter ke baad index reset na karna jab iloc use ho raha ho.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. loc vs iloc?
    A. loc label se select karta hai (slice end inclusive), iloc integer position se (end exclusive).
  • Q. Multiple conditions kaise lagate ho?
    A. Har condition bracket me, &/|/~ se jodke. Ya query() use karo.

Yaad rakho

Bracket + &/|; assignment hamesha df.loc[mask, "col"] = v se.

PY-12Pandas: cleaningIntermediateMust Know

Real data gandha hota hai: missing values, duplicates, galat types, ajeeb naam. Cleaning ke standard pandas tools.

Simple me samjho

Cleaning matlab data ko analysis layak banana. Nulls handle karo, duplicates hatao, types theek karo, text normalise karo. Har decision document karo, kyunki ye numbers badalta hai.

Key points

  • Missing check: df.isna().sum(). df.isna().mean() percentage deta hai.
  • dropna: df.dropna(subset=["user_id"]) sirf zaroori columns ke nulls pe row hatata hai.
  • fillna: df["bet"].fillna(0), df["amt"].fillna(df["amt"].median()). Forward fill: df["x"].ffill().
  • Null ka matlab socho: 0, unknown ya sach me missing, teeno alag hain.
  • Duplicates: df.duplicated(subset=["txn_id"]).sum(), df.drop_duplicates(subset=["txn_id"], keep="last").
  • astype: df["id"].astype(str), astype("int64"). Kharab values ke liye pd.to_numeric(s, errors="coerce").
  • Dates: pd.to_datetime(s, errors="coerce").
  • rename: df.rename(columns={"Old Name": "old_name"}). Bulk: df.columns = df.columns.str.lower().str.strip().str.replace(" ", "_").
  • .str methods: .str.strip(), .str.lower(), .str.replace(), .str.extract().
  • apply: df["col"].apply(func) custom logic ke liye. Slow hai, pehle vectorised/.str/np.where try karo.
  • Outliers: hatane se pehle dekho ki valid hain ya nahi (whale player).
  • map: df["c"].map({"IN": "India"}) value mapping.

Example

python
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

df = pd.DataFrame({
    "Txn ID": [1, 1, 2, 3],
    "Country ": [" in", " in", "US ", None],
    "Amount": ["100", "100", "abc", "250"],
})
df.columns = df.columns.str.strip().str.lower().str.replace(" ", "_")
df["country"] = df["country"].str.strip().str.upper().fillna("UNKNOWN")
df["amount"] = pd.to_numeric(df["amount"], errors="coerce")
df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=["txn_id"])
print(df)
text
   txn_id  country  amount
0       1       IN   100.0
2       2       US     NaN
3       3  UNKNOWN   250.0

Column names normalise hue, "abc" NaN ban gaya, duplicate txn_id 1 hat gaya.

Common mistakes

  • Nulls ko bina soche 0 se fill karna; average aur counts badal jaate hain.
  • inplace=True pe depend karna; assignment style (df = df.drop...) behtar hai.
  • Duplicate hatate waqt galat subset dena, valid rows udd jaati hain.
  • Pehle hi astype(int) pe error aana; pehle to_numeric(errors="coerce") se bad values dekho.
  • Cleaning steps ka count log na karna (kitni rows hatayi).

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Missing values kaise handle karte ho?
    A. Pehle cause samjho. Phir drop, constant/median fill, ffill ya flag column. Business meaning ke hisaab se decide karte hain.
  • Q. apply kab avoid karoge?
    A. Jab vectorised option ho (.str, arithmetic, np.where), kyunki apply row-wise Python function chalata hai, slow.

Yaad rakho

Pehle null/duplicate/type check, phir clean; har step ka row count likho.

PY-13Pandas: groupby and aggregationIntermediateMust Know

groupby split-apply-combine hai: groups banao, har group pe aggregate lagao. SQL ke GROUP BY ka pandas version.

Simple me samjho

Poker table-wise ya country-wise summary chahiye? Rows ko group me baanto, har group ka sum/mean nikalo, phir result jodo. SQL GROUP BY jaisa hi concept hai.

Key points

  • Basic: df.groupby("country")["bet"].sum().
  • Multiple keys: df.groupby(["country", "game"])["bet"].mean() MultiIndex result deta hai.
  • agg: df.groupby("country")["bet"].agg(["sum", "mean", "count"]).
  • Named aggregation: .agg(total=("bet", "sum"), players=("user", "nunique")). Clean column names deta hai.
  • as_index=False / reset_index(): group keys ko normal columns banata hai.
  • Multi-level results: MultiIndex ko reset_index() ya unstack() se flat/wide karo.
  • transform: result original rows ke same shape me aata hai: df["share"] = df["bet"] / df.groupby("country")["bet"].transform("sum").
  • count vs size: size() NaN ko bhi ginta hai, count() sirf non-null.
  • filter: df.groupby("user").filter(lambda g: len(g) > 5) groups hatata/rakhta hai.
  • Custom function: agg(lambda s: s.quantile(0.9)).
  • NaN keys: default me NaN group drop hota hai; dropna=False se rakho.
  • Sort: sort_values(ascending=False) se top groups.

Example

python
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({
    "country": ["IN", "IN", "US", "US", "US"],
    "user": ["a", "b", "c", "c", "d"],
    "bet": [100, 200, 50, 150, 300],
})
out = (df.groupby("country")
         .agg(total=("bet", "sum"), players=("user", "nunique"))
         .reset_index())
df["pct"] = df["bet"] / df.groupby("country")["bet"].transform("sum")
print(out)
print(df["pct"].round(2).tolist())
text
  country  total  players
0      IN    300        2
1      US    500        2
[0.33, 0.67, 0.1, 0.3, 0.6]

agg ne country-wise 2 rows di. transform ne har original row ke liye country total diya, isliye percent share nikla.

Common mistakes

  • agg aur transform ka shape farq na samajhna: agg group-wise 1 row, transform original rows jitni.
  • count() aur size() mix karna.
  • NaN keys ka silently drop ho jana.
  • MultiIndex me phas jana; reset_index() karo.
  • Groupby ke andar apply ka overuse; built-in aggregations tez hain.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. agg vs transform?
    A. agg har group ko ek row me reduce karta hai. transform same-length result deta hai, original index ke saath, jise column ki tarah jod sakte ho.
  • Q. SQL window function ka pandas equivalent?
    A. groupby().transform(...), rank, cumsum, shift jaise methods.

Yaad rakho

Group, aggregate, combine; same-shape chahiye to transform, summary chahiye to agg.

PY-14Pandas: merge and joinIntermediateMust Know

Tables jodna: merge (SQL join), concat (stack karna) aur join. validate aur indicator se joins safe banao.

Simple me samjho

merge SQL ke JOIN jaisa hai: common key pe do tables jodta hai. concat tables ko upar-neeche ya side-by-side chipkata hai. Join galat ho to rows duplicate ya gayab ho jaati hain, isliye check zaroori hai.

Key points

  • merge: pd.merge(a, b, on="user_id", how="left"). how: inner, left, right, outer.
  • Different key names: left_on="uid", right_on="user_id".
  • Multiple keys: on=["user_id", "date"].
  • suffixes: same naam ke columns ke liye suffixes=("_a", "_b").
  • validate: validate="one_to_one", "one_to_many", "many_to_one" galat cardinality pe error deta hai.
  • indicator: indicator=True se _merge column aata hai: both, left_only, right_only.
  • join: a.join(b, on=...) index-based shortcut hai, default left join.
  • concat: pd.concat([df1, df2], ignore_index=True) rows stack; axis=1 columns side by side.
  • Key mismatch: dtype alag (int vs str), extra spaces, case ka farq, to match nahi hota. Pehle clean karo.
  • Row count check: join se pehle aur baad rows compare karo.
  • Anti-join: indicator=True se left_only filter karo.

Example

python
import pandas as pd

users = pd.DataFrame({"user_id": [1, 2, 3], "country": ["IN", "US", "UK"]})
txns = pd.DataFrame({"user_id": [1, 1, 2, 9], "amt": [10, 20, 30, 40]})

m = txns.merge(users, on="user_id", how="left",
               validate="many_to_one", indicator=True)
print(m)
print(m[m["_merge"] == "left_only"]["user_id"].tolist())
text
   user_id  amt country     _merge
0        1   10      IN       both
1        1   20      IN       both
2        2   30      US       both
3        9   40     NaN  left_only
[9]

user_id 9 users table me nahi hai, indicator ne use left_only dikha diya. validate ne ensure kiya ki users me key unique hai.

Common mistakes

  • Duplicate keys pe join karna, row explosion. validate lagao.
  • Key ka dtype mismatch (1 vs "1"); merge error ya zero matches.
  • inner join se silently rows kho dena.
  • Join ke baad NaN ko ignore karna.
  • concat me columns ka naam mismatch, extra NaN columns.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. merge aur concat me farq?
    A. merge key ke basis pe columns jodta hai (SQL join). concat bina key ke frames ko stack karta hai (axis ke along).
  • Q. Join ke baad rows badh gayi, kyun?
    A. Key duplicate hai (one-to-many ya many-to-many). validate aur drop_duplicates se check karo.

Yaad rakho

Join se pehle keys clean karo; validate aur indicator lagao; row count compare karo.

PY-15Pandas: reshapingIntermediateMust Know

Table ka shape badalna: long se wide (pivot) aur wide se long (melt). pivot_table, stack/unstack aur crosstab.

Simple me samjho

Long format me ek row = ek observation (date, game, bet). Wide format me games alag columns hote hain. Reports aksar wide mangte hain, charts aur groupby aksar long pasand karte hain.

Key points

  • pivot: df.pivot(index="date", columns="game", values="bet"). Duplicate (index, column) pairs pe error aata hai.
  • pivot_table: pivot + aggregation: pd.pivot_table(df, index="date", columns="game", values="bet", aggfunc="sum", fill_value=0).
  • margins: margins=True grand total row/column jodta hai.
  • melt: wide se long: df.melt(id_vars=["date"], var_name="game", value_name="bet").
  • stack / unstack: unstack() last index level ko columns bana deta hai, stack() ulta karta hai.
  • crosstab: do categorical columns ki frequency table: pd.crosstab(df["country"], df["game"]). normalize="index" se row percent.
  • Multiple aggfunc: aggfunc=["sum", "mean"] MultiIndex columns deta hai.
  • Flatten columns: df.columns = ["_".join(c) for c in df.columns] MultiIndex columns ke liye.
  • reset_index: pivot ke baad index ko column banane ke liye.
  • Missing combos: pivot me combination na ho to NaN aata hai, fill_value use karo.

Example

python
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({
    "date": ["d1", "d1", "d2", "d2"],
    "game": ["NLH", "PLO", "NLH", "PLO"],
    "bet": [100, 50, 80, 20],
})
wide = df.pivot_table(index="date", columns="game",
                      values="bet", aggfunc="sum")
print(wide)
long = wide.reset_index().melt(id_vars="date", value_name="bet")
print(long.shape)
print(pd.crosstab(df["date"], df["game"]))
text
game  NLH  PLO
date          
d1    100   50
d2     80   20
(4, 3)
game  NLH  PLO
date          
d1      1    1
d2      1    1

pivot_table ne wide banaya, melt ne wapas long (4 rows, 3 columns). crosstab ne counts diye.

Common mistakes

  • pivot pe duplicate keys; pivot_table with aggfunc use karo.
  • aggfunc default mean hai, sum chahiye to batao.
  • MultiIndex columns ko flatten na karna.
  • Pivot ke baad NaN ko 0 samajh lena bina sochay.
  • melt me id_vars na dena, saare columns melt ho jaate hain.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. pivot vs pivot_table?
    A. pivot sirf reshape karta hai, duplicates pe fail. pivot_table aggregate bhi karta hai (aggfunc), duplicates handle karta hai.
  • Q. melt kab use karte ho?
    A. Wide table ko long banane ke liye, jaise month columns ko month aur value columns me, plotting ya groupby se pehle.

Yaad rakho

Wide report ke liye pivot_table, long analysis ke liye melt; aggfunc explicitly likho.

PY-16Pandas: time seriesIntermediateMust Know

Dates ke saath kaam: datetime conversion, resample, rolling, shift, offsets aur time zones. Daily/weekly trends ka base.

Simple me samjho

Time series data ka index ya column time hota hai. Daily data ko weekly me badalna (resample), moving average (rolling), pichli row se compare (shift) common kaam hain. Time zone galat ho to daily numbers galat aa jaate hain.

Key points

  • to_datetime: pd.to_datetime(s, format="%Y-%m-%d", errors="coerce"). Format do, parsing fast aur safe hoti hai.
  • dt accessor: df["ts"].dt.year, .dt.month, .dt.dayofweek, .dt.date, .dt.floor("D").
  • DatetimeIndex: df.set_index("ts") ke baad slicing: df.loc["2025-01"].
  • resample: df.resample("D")["bet"].sum(). Frequencies: D day, W week, MS month start, ME month end (pandas 2.2+; purane me M), h hour.
  • rolling: s.rolling(7).mean() 7-period moving average. min_periods set kar sakte ho.
  • shift: s.shift(1) pichli value, s / s.shift(1) - 1 growth. pct_change() bhi hai.
  • diff: s.diff() consecutive difference.
  • Date offsets: pd.Timedelta(days=7), pd.DateOffset(months=1), pd.date_range("2025-01-01", periods=5, freq="D").
  • Time zones: tz_localize("UTC") naive ko tz deta hai, tz_convert("Asia/Kolkata") tz badalta hai.
  • Missing dates: resample ya reindex se gaps dikhte hain; fillna(0) socho-samjho ke.
  • Group + time: groupby(pd.Grouper(key="ts", freq="W")).

Example

python
import pandas as pd

ts = pd.to_datetime(["2025-01-01 23:30", "2025-01-02 01:00",
                     "2025-01-03 10:00"]).tz_localize("UTC")
df = pd.DataFrame({"bet": [100, 200, 50]}, index=ts)

ist = df.tz_convert("Asia/Kolkata")
daily = ist.resample("D")["bet"].sum()
print(daily)
print(daily.rolling(2).mean().tolist())
print(daily.shift(1).tolist())
text
2025-01-02 00:00:00+05:30    300
2025-01-03 00:00:00+05:30     50
Freq: D, Name: bet, dtype: int64
[nan, 175.0]
[nan, 300.0]

UTC me pehle 2 rows alag din ki thi, IST me dono 2 Jan me aa gayi. Ye time zone ka asar hai.

Common mistakes

  • Timezone convert kiye bina daily aggregate karna (UTC vs IST).
  • Date strings ko sort karna (text sort), datetime me convert karo.
  • resample ke liye index datetime na hona (ya on= na dena).
  • rolling ke pehle window-1 values NaN aati hain, ye normal hai.
  • dd/mm vs mm/dd confusion; format ya dayfirst=True do.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. resample aur groupby me farq?
    A. resample time-based groupby hai, DatetimeIndex pe regular frequency bins banata hai. Missing periods bhi dikhte hain.
  • Q. Day-over-day growth kaise nikaloge?
    A. s.pct_change() ya s / s.shift(1) - 1.

Yaad rakho

Pehle datetime + timezone theek karo, phir resample/rolling/shift lagao.

PY-17Pandas performance on large dataAdvancedGood to Have

Badi files pe pandas dheema ya memory-heavy ho sakta hai. Dtypes, categoricals, chunksize, Parquet aur Polars/DuckDB se kaam tez karo.

Simple me samjho

Pandas data RAM me rakhta hai. File RAM se badi ho to ya dheemi ho to trick lagani padti hai: chhote dtypes, chunk me padhna, ya alag tool. Pehle measure karo, phir optimise.

Key points

  • Memory check: df.info(memory_usage="deep"), df.memory_usage(deep=True).
  • Smaller dtypes: int32/float32, pd.to_numeric(s, downcast="integer").
  • category dtype: kam unique values wale text columns (country, game) ko astype("category") karo, memory bahut kam.
  • Load less: usecols=[...], dtype={...}, nrows.
  • chunksize: for chunk in pd.read_csv(p, chunksize=100_000): chunk-wise aggregate karke combine karo.
  • Vectorisation vs apply: df["a"] * 2 ya np.where row-wise apply se bahut tez hai. iterrows avoid karo.
  • Parquet: columnar binary format. df.to_parquet("f.parquet"), pd.read_parquet(p, columns=[...]). CSV se chhota aur tez (pyarrow ya fastparquet chahiye).
  • Filter early: jitna jaldi rows/columns kam karo, utna behtar. Heavy kaam database me (SQL) karo.
  • Polars: Rust-based DataFrame library, multi-threaded aur lazy execution. Badi files ke liye alternative.
  • DuckDB: in-process SQL engine, CSV/Parquet pe seedha SQL chala sakte ho.
  • Sampling: exploration ke liye df.sample(frac=0.1).

Example

python
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"country": ["IN", "US"] * 50000,
                   "bet": range(100000)})
before = df.memory_usage(deep=True).sum()
df["country"] = df["country"].astype("category")
df["bet"] = pd.to_numeric(df["bet"], downcast="integer")
after = df.memory_usage(deep=True).sum()
print(after < before)

totals = {}
# for chunk in pd.read_csv("big.csv", chunksize=100_000):
#     for k, v in chunk.groupby("country")["bet"].sum().items():
#         totals[k] = totals.get(k, 0) + v
text
True

category aur chhota int dtype se memory kam hui. Chunk loop me har chunk ka partial sum jodke poore file ka total banta hai, memory me ek chunk hi rehta hai.

Common mistakes

  • Bina measure kiye optimise karna.
  • iterrows ya apply(axis=1) pe lakhon rows chalana.
  • High-cardinality column (user_id) ko category banana, fayda nahi.
  • Chunk-wise mean ko seedha average karna; sum aur count alag rakho.
  • Poora raw data pandas me kheench ke filter karna jab SQL me filter ho sakta tha.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Bahut badi CSV (RAM se badi) kaise handle karoge?
    A. usecols aur dtype se load kam, chunksize se chunk-wise aggregate, ya Parquet/DuckDB/Polars use karke.
  • Q. Parquet CSV se behtar kyun?
    A. Columnar, compressed, dtypes saath me store, aur sirf zaroori columns padh sakte ho.

Yaad rakho

Kam load karo, chhote dtypes lo, vectorise karo; badi file ke liye Parquet, chunks, DuckDB ya Polars.

PY-18MatplotlibBasicMust Know

Matplotlib Python ki base plotting library hai. Figure, axes, line/bar/hist/scatter, labels aur chart save karna.

Simple me samjho

Figure ek canvas hai, Axes uske andar ek chart. Hum axes pe plot banate hain, labels lagate hain aur image save karte hain. Chart ka kaam ek baat saaf batana hai, sajawat nahi.

Key points

  • Import: import matplotlib.pyplot as plt.
  • Figure + Axes: fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4)). Yahi object-oriented style recommended hai.
  • Line: ax.plot(x, y, marker="o") trends ke liye.
  • Bar: ax.bar(categories, values) ya ax.barh horizontal. Categories compare karne ke liye.
  • Histogram: ax.hist(data, bins=20) distribution dekhne ke liye.
  • Scatter: ax.scatter(x, y) do variables ka relation.
  • Labels: ax.set_title(), ax.set_xlabel(), ax.set_ylabel(), ax.legend().
  • Ticks: ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=45), formatting ke liye.
  • Multiple charts: fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2), phir axes[0], axes[1].
  • Save: fig.savefig("chart.png", dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight"). plt.show() se pehle save karo.
  • pandas shortcut: df.plot(kind="bar", ax=ax).
  • Axis honesty: bar chart ka y-axis 0 se shuru karo.

Example

python
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")           # no display needed (scripts/servers)
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

days = ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu"]
bets = [120, 150, 90, 200]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 3))
ax.bar(days, bets, color="#4c78a8")
ax.set_title("Daily bets")
ax.set_xlabel("Day")
ax.set_ylabel("Bets (Rs)")
fig.savefig("daily_bets.png", dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
plt.close(fig)
text
daily_bets.png saved (bar chart with 4 bars, titled "Daily bets")

subplots se fig/ax mile, ax pe bar banaya, labels lagaye aur file save ki. close se memory free hoti hai.

Common mistakes

  • plt.plot (state-machine style) aur ax.plot mix karna, multi-chart me confusion.
  • Title ya axis labels na dena, chart ka matlab pata nahi chalta.
  • plt.show() ke baad savefig karna, blank image aati hai.
  • Bahut saare colors/series ek chart me.
  • Loop me chart banake plt.close na karna, memory badhti hai.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Figure aur Axes me farq?
    A. Figure poora canvas/window hai, Axes uske andar ek individual plot (axis, data, labels ke saath).
  • Q. Kaunsa chart kab?
    A. Trend ke liye line, categories compare karne ke liye bar, distribution ke liye histogram, do variables ke relation ke liye scatter.

Yaad rakho

fig, ax = plt.subplots(), labels lagao, savefig phir close.

PY-19Seaborn and PlotlyIntermediateGood to Have

Seaborn statistical plots aur heatmaps aasani se banata hai. Plotly interactive charts deta hai (hover, zoom).

Simple me samjho

Seaborn matplotlib ke upar bana hai, DataFrame ke saath kam code me sundar charts deta hai. Plotly ke charts browser me interactive hote hain, dashboards aur demos ke liye achhe.

Key points

  • Seaborn import: import seaborn as sns. Data data=df, x="col", y="col" style me deta hai.
  • Distribution: sns.histplot(df["bet"], kde=True), sns.boxplot(data=df, x="game", y="bet").
  • Relationship: sns.scatterplot(data=df, x="a", y="b", hue="country").
  • Categorical: sns.barplot(data=df, x="game", y="bet") (default me mean aur confidence interval).
  • Heatmap: sns.heatmap(corr, annot=True, cmap="Blues"). Correlation matrix: df.corr(numeric_only=True).
  • pairplot: sns.pairplot(df) sab numeric pairs ek saath.
  • Seaborn ax: return value matplotlib Axes hai, to title/save wahi matplotlib se.
  • Plotly Express: import plotly.express as px, px.line(df, x="date", y="bet", color="game").
  • Interactivity: hover tooltips, zoom, legend toggle. fig.show().
  • Export: fig.write_html("chart.html") share karne ke liye. Static image ke liye extra package (kaleido) chahiye.
  • When: report PDF/PPT me static (seaborn/matplotlib), exploration aur web dashboards me Plotly.

Example

python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import plotly.express as px

df = pd.DataFrame({
    "game": ["NLH", "NLH", "PLO", "PLO"],
    "bet": [100, 120, 80, 90],
    "win": [20, 30, -10, 5],
})
ax = sns.heatmap(df[["bet", "win"]].corr(), annot=True, cmap="Blues")
ax.figure.savefig("corr.png")

fig = px.bar(df, x="game", y="bet", color="game")
fig.write_html("bets.html")
text
corr.png (2x2 correlation heatmap), bets.html (interactive bar chart)

Seaborn heatmap me correlation values annotate hue. Plotly chart HTML file ke roop me save hua, browser me hover karke dekh sakte ho.

Common mistakes

  • Correlation ko causation samajhna.
  • df.corr() me text columns hona; numeric_only=True do.
  • Interactive chart PDF/PPT me bhejna; static image export karo.
  • Default colors par bharosa karna jab colour-blind users hon; clear palettes lo.
  • Bahut zyada points pe Plotly scatter (browser dheema).

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Matplotlib vs Seaborn?
    A. Matplotlib low-level aur flexible hai. Seaborn uske upar high-level, DataFrame-friendly statistical plots deta hai.
  • Q. Plotly kab choose karoge?
    A. Jab interactivity chahiye (hover, zoom) aur output web/dashboard ho.

Yaad rakho

Quick stats chart ke liye Seaborn, interactive ke liye Plotly; heatmap me numeric_only yaad rakho.

PY-20Connecting to databasesIntermediateMust Know

Python se database connect karna: SQLAlchemy, psycopg2, pymongo. Credentials hamesha environment variables se, queries parameterised.

Simple me samjho

Analyst ko data aksar database se laana padta hai. Connection string me password hota hai, isliye wo code me nahi, environment me rakhte hain. Query me user input seedha jodna khatarnak hai, parameters use karo.

Key points

  • Env variables: os.environ["DB_PASSWORD"] se padho. Naam se refer karo, value code ya git me nahi.
  • Missing var: os.environ[...] KeyError deta hai, jo achha hai (jaldi fail). os.getenv() None deta hai.
  • .env file: local dev ke liye, python-dotenv se load; .env ko .gitignore me rakho.
  • SQLAlchemy: create_engine(URL.create(...)) PostgreSQL/MySQL jaise DBs ke liye common layer. pd.read_sql ke saath best.
  • psycopg2: PostgreSQL ka direct driver. Placeholder %s, values alag tuple me.
  • pymongo: MongoDB ke liye MongoClient(os.environ["MONGO_URI"]), phir client[db][collection].find({...}).
  • Parameterised queries: values ko SQL string me f-string se mat jodo (SQL injection). Placeholders + params use karo.
  • SQLAlchemy text: text("... WHERE id = :id") aur params={"id": 5}.
  • Close connections: with engine.connect() as conn: ya with blocks; client.close().
  • Read-only user: analytics ke liye read-only DB account lo, production me write risk nahi.
  • Limit data: query me filter/aggregate DB me hi karo, SELECT * poori table mat kheencho.
  • MongoDB to DataFrame: pd.DataFrame(list(cursor)).

Example

python
import os
import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, text
from sqlalchemy.engine import URL
from pymongo import MongoClient

url = URL.create(
    "postgresql+psycopg2",
    username=os.environ["DB_USER"],
    password=os.environ["DB_PASSWORD"],
    host=os.environ["DB_HOST"],
    port=int(os.environ.get("DB_PORT", "5432")),
    database=os.environ["DB_NAME"],
)
engine = create_engine(url)

q = text("SELECT user_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM transactions "
         "WHERE created_at >= :start GROUP BY user_id")
df = pd.read_sql(q, engine, params={"start": "2025-01-01"})

client = MongoClient(os.environ["MONGO_URI"])
docs = list(client["app"]["users"].find({"country": "IN"}, {"_id": 0}))
text
df: DataFrame with columns user_id, total. docs: list of dicts.

Saari secrets environment se aayi, date value :start parameter se gayi, SQL string me jodi nahi gayi.

Common mistakes

  • Password ya connection string code/notebook me hardcode karke git me push karna. Agar chala gaya to password rotate karo.
  • Query me f-string se user input jodna, SQL injection.
  • Notebook outputs me connection string print ho jana.
  • Production DB pe heavy query chalana; replica ya read-only account use karo.
  • Connection close na karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Credentials code me kyun nahi?
    A. Code git me jaata hai aur share hota hai, secrets leak ho sakte hain. Environment variables ya secret manager se load karo.
  • Q. Parameterised query kya hai aur kyun?
    A. SQL aur values alag bheje jaate hain (%s, :name), driver escape karta hai, to SQL injection nahi hota.

Yaad rakho

Secrets env se, values parameters se, aur DB me jitna ho sake filter/aggregate karo.

PY-21APIs and web dataIntermediateGood to Have

requests library se APIs se JSON data laana: auth, pagination, rate limits aur retries sahi tareeke se.

Simple me samjho

API ek counter hai jahan HTTP request bhejte ho aur data (aksar JSON) milta hai. Bada data pages me aata hai (pagination). Server ki limit hoti hai, to tameez se, retry ke saath maango.

Key points

  • GET request: requests.get(url, params={...}, timeout=10). timeout hamesha do.
  • Status check: r.raise_for_status() 4xx/5xx pe exception deta hai.
  • JSON: r.json() dict/list deta hai. pd.json_normalize(data) flat DataFrame.
  • Auth: header me token: headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}. Token env variable se lo, hardcode nahi.
  • Pagination: page/limit ya next cursor; loop chalao jab tak data khatam na ho.
  • Rate limits: 429 Too Many Requests aaye to ruko. Retry-After header ho to use follow karo. Calls ke beech time.sleep.
  • Retries: temporary errors (5xx, timeout) pe backoff ke saath dobara try karo.
  • Session: requests.Session() connection reuse aur common headers ke liye.
  • POST: requests.post(url, json=payload).
  • Raw data save: response ko file me save karo taaki dobara API na maarni pade.
  • API docs: parameter names aur response fields documentation se lo, andaaza nahi.

Example

python
import os
import time
import requests
import pandas as pd

token = os.environ["API_TOKEN"]
base = "https://api.example.com/v1/orders"   # example URL
headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}

rows, page = [], 1
with requests.Session() as s:
    while True:
        for attempt in range(3):
            r = s.get(base, headers=headers, timeout=10,
                      params={"page": page, "limit": 100})
            if r.status_code in (429, 500, 502, 503):
                time.sleep(2 ** attempt)     # backoff
                continue
            break
        r.raise_for_status()
        data = r.json()
        if not data:
            break
        rows.extend(data)
        page += 1
df = pd.json_normalize(rows)
text
df: all pages combined into one flat DataFrame

Loop pages leta hai jab tak empty list na aaye. Temporary errors pe 1, 2, 4 second ruk ke retry hota hai.

Common mistakes

  • timeout na dena, script hamesha ke liye atak sakti hai.
  • raise_for_status na lagana, error response ko data samajh lena.
  • Token code me likhna ya logs me print karna.
  • Rate limit ignore karna, API block kar sakti hai.
  • Pagination bhool jana, sirf pehla page analyse karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Pagination kaise handle karte ho?
    A. Loop me page ya cursor badhate hain jab tak empty response ya next na ho, aur sab results combine karte hain.
  • Q. 429 error pe kya?
    A. Rate limit hit hua hai. Retry-After follow karo ya exponential backoff ke saath retry karo, request rate kam karo.

Yaad rakho

Timeout, status check, pagination, backoff, aur token env se.

PY-22Web scraping basicsIntermediateBonus

Webpage se data nikalna BeautifulSoup se. Pehle robots.txt aur site ke terms dekho: ethics zaroori hai.

Simple me samjho

Jab API na ho aur data sirf webpage pe ho, tab HTML download karke parse karte hain. Ye last option hai. Pehle check karo ki scraping allowed hai ya nahi.

Key points

  • requests + BeautifulSoup: r = requests.get(url, timeout=10), soup = BeautifulSoup(r.text, "html.parser") (package beautifulsoup4).
  • Find elements: soup.find("h1"), soup.find_all("a"), soup.select("div.price") (CSS selector).
  • Text/attrs: el.get_text(strip=True), el["href"].
  • Tables: simple HTML tables ke liye pd.read_html(url_or_html) DataFrames ki list deta hai (lxml ya bs4 + html5lib chahiye).
  • robots.txt: site.com/robots.txt me likha hota hai kya crawl karna allowed hai. Follow karo.
  • Terms of service: kai sites scraping mana karti hain. Pehle padho.
  • Be polite: requests ke beech delay (time.sleep), ek hi saath bahut requests nahi, apna User-Agent batao.
  • Personal data: personal/private data scrape mat karo, privacy rules (jaise GDPR) lag sakte hain.
  • JavaScript pages: agar content JS se load hota hai to requests ko kuch nahi milega; tab browser automation ya site ki hidden API dekhte hain.
  • Fragile: site ka layout badla to scraper toot jata hai.
  • Prefer API/dataset: official API ya downloadable data ho to wahi lo.

Example

python
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

html = """
<div class="item"><span class="name">Table 1</span>
  <span class="price">500</span></div>
<div class="item"><span class="name">Table 2</span>
  <span class="price">1000</span></div>
"""
soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")
rows = [
    (d.select_one(".name").get_text(strip=True),
     int(d.select_one(".price").get_text(strip=True)))
    for d in soup.select("div.item")
]
print(rows)
# real page: requests.get(url, headers={"User-Agent": "my-research-bot"}, timeout=10)
text
[('Table 1', 500), ('Table 2', 1000)]

select se har item mila, select_one se name aur price nikale. Real site pe pehle robots.txt check karo.

Common mistakes

  • robots.txt aur terms of service ignore karna.
  • Bina delay ke hazaron requests; server pe load ya IP ban.
  • Fragile selectors; zara layout badle aur script fail.
  • Element None hone pe .get_text() call karna, AttributeError.
  • Private ya personal data collect karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Scraping se pehle kya check karoge?
    A. Official API hai ya nahi, robots.txt, site ke terms, aur data personal to nahi. Phir polite rate se scrape karo.
  • Q. find_all aur select me farq?
    A. find_all tag/attribute se dhundhta hai, select CSS selectors use karta hai. Dono list return karte hain.

Yaad rakho

API pehle, scraping baad me; robots.txt, terms aur politeness follow karo.

PY-23Jupyter best practicesBasicMust Know

Jupyter notebook ko organised, reproducible aur share-karne layak rakhna: structure, markdown, restart and run all, nbconvert.

Simple me samjho

Notebook me cells kisi bhi order me chal sakte hain, isliye hidden state ka khatra rehta hai. Aaj chala, kal nahi chala, aisa hota hai. Best practice: upar se neeche chalne wala saaf notebook.

Key points

  • Structure: Title aur purpose, imports, config/parameters, data load, cleaning, analysis, conclusions. Is order me.
  • Markdown cells: headings, 2-3 line context aur insight likho. Code ke pehle "kya aur kyun" batao.
  • Restart and Run All: share karne se pehle Kernel > Restart & Run All karo. Error aaye to notebook reproducible nahi.
  • Cell order: neeche ke cell ka variable upar use mat karo (hidden state).
  • Imports ek jagah: pehle cell me saare imports.
  • Functions: repeated logic ko functions me daalo, bade logic ko .py module me nikalo aur import karo.
  • Keep outputs clean: df.head() rakho, poora DataFrame print mat karo. Long outputs hatao. Git me commit se pehle outputs clear karo (Clear All Outputs).
  • Secrets: notebook me password/token kabhi nahi; env variables use karo.
  • Naming: file ka naam meaningful (2025-03_retention_analysis.ipynb).
  • nbconvert: jupyter nbconvert --to html notebook.ipynb (ya --to pdf, --to script) share ya automate karne ke liye. --execute se pehle run bhi karta hai.
  • Parameters: file paths aur dates ek config cell me rakho.

Example

bash
# notebook ko fresh run karke HTML report banao
jupyter nbconvert --to html --execute retention.ipynb

# git commit se pehle outputs hatao
jupyter nbconvert --clear-output --inplace retention.ipynb
text
[NbConvertApp] Converting notebook retention.ipynb to html
[NbConvertApp] Writing ... bytes to retention.html

--execute notebook ko upar se neeche chalata hai, to ye test bhi hai ki notebook reproducible hai ya nahi.

Common mistakes

  • Cells out-of-order chala ke result lena, aur baad me reproduce na hona.
  • Poore notebook me markdown ek bhi nahi; sirf code ka dher.
  • Large outputs ya secrets ke saath notebook git me commit karna.
  • 500 line ka single cell.
  • Ek hi notebook me exploration aur final report ka mix.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Notebook reproducible kaise banate ho?
    A. Restart & Run All se test, upar se neeche order, config ek jagah, environment requirements.txt me pinned, aur secrets env me.
  • Q. nbconvert kis kaam aata hai?
    A. Notebook ko HTML/PDF/script me badalne ke liye, aur --execute se automated run ke liye.

Yaad rakho

Notebook = story: structured, upar se neeche chale, aur Restart & Run All pe pass ho.

PY-24Automating reportsIntermediateMust Know

Roz/weekly report haath se banane ki jagah script likho: schedule (cron), Excel output, email ya Slack bhejna.

Simple me samjho

Jo report har Monday banti hai, uska ek script bana do. Script data laye, Excel banaye aur bhej de. Cron us script ko time pe chalata hai.

Key points

  • Script structure: main() function me steps: data fetch, transform, file banao, bhejo. if __name__ == "__main__": main().
  • Excel with pandas: df.to_excel("r.xlsx", index=False). Multiple sheets: with pd.ExcelWriter("r.xlsx") as w: df.to_excel(w, sheet_name="Summary").
  • openpyxl: existing Excel padhne/edit karne ke liye, formatting (width, bold) ke liye bhi.
  • xlsxwriter: naye Excel files banane me strong, formats, charts aur conditional formatting. pd.ExcelWriter(..., engine="xlsxwriter").
  • cron: Linux scheduler. Line: min hour day month weekday command. 0 9 * * 1 matlab har Monday 9:00.
  • Absolute paths: cron me environment alag hota hai, to full path (python aur script ka) do.
  • Logs: output file me redirect karo: >> /var/log/report.log 2>&1, taaki failure pata chale.
  • Email: smtplib + email.message.EmailMessage, attachment ke saath. SMTP credentials env variables se.
  • Slack: incoming webhook URL pe requests.post(url, json={"text": "..."}). Webhook URL ek secret hai, env me rakho.
  • Idempotent: dobara chalane pe same result aaye, duplicate na bane.
  • Alternatives: Windows Task Scheduler, Airflow jaise orchestrators bade pipelines ke liye.
  • Failure alerts: script fail ho to khud notify kare.

Example

python
import os
import pandas as pd
import requests

def main():
    df = pd.DataFrame({"game": ["NLH", "PLO"], "revenue": [1200, 800]})
    with pd.ExcelWriter("daily.xlsx", engine="xlsxwriter") as w:
        df.to_excel(w, sheet_name="Summary", index=False)
        w.sheets["Summary"].set_column("A:B", 15)

    msg = f"Daily revenue: {df['revenue'].sum():,}"
    requests.post(os.environ["SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL"],
                  json={"text": msg}, timeout=10)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
text
# crontab -e
0 9 * * 1-5 /home/me/.venv/bin/python /home/me/report.py >> /home/me/report.log 2>&1

Script Excel banata hai aur Slack me message bhejta hai. Cron isse Mon-Fri subah 9 baje chalata hai, log file me output jaata hai.

Common mistakes

  • Cron me relative path ya system Python use karna, "command not found" ya wrong environment.
  • Failure ka alert na hona; report chupchap band ho jaati hai.
  • Webhook URL ya SMTP password code me hardcode karna.
  • Hardcoded dates; script today ke hisaab se chalni chahiye.
  • Report bhejne se pehle numbers ka sanity check na karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Report automation ka basic flow?
    A. Data query, pandas transform, Excel/chart output, email/Slack delivery, aur cron/scheduler se schedule, logging aur failure alert ke saath.
  • Q. openpyxl vs xlsxwriter?
    A. openpyxl existing files padh/edit kar sakta hai. xlsxwriter sirf naye files likhta hai, par formatting aur charts me strong hai.

Yaad rakho

Script + schedule + logs + alerts: sab kuch absolute paths aur env secrets ke saath.

PY-25Clean reusable codeIntermediateGood to Have

Code ko modules me baantna, PEP8 follow karna, type hints aur docstrings lagana aur pytest se test karna.

Simple me samjho

Aaj ka quick script kal ke liye reusable function ban sakta hai, agar saaf likha ho. Chhote functions, achhe naam, aur tests. Isse tumhara aur team ka time bachta hai.

Key points

  • Module: ek .py file; from utils import clean_names. Package ke liye folder me __init__.py.
  • PEP8: Python style guide: 4 spaces indent, snake_case functions/variables, CamelCase classes, line approx 79-88 chars.
  • Tools: black ya ruff format formatter, ruff/flake8 linter.
  • Type hints: def total(df: pd.DataFrame, col: str) -> float:. Runtime enforce nahi hota, par readability aur tools ke liye.
  • Docstring: function ka kaam, args aur return short me.
  • Small functions: ek function ek kaam. Side effects kam.
  • No magic numbers: constants upar naam ke saath (RAKE_PCT = 5).
  • if __name__ == "__main__": file import ho to code auto-run na ho.
  • pytest: test_*.py files me test_* functions, plain assert. Chalao: pytest.
  • Edge cases test: empty input, nulls, duplicates.
  • DRY: copy-paste ki jagah function.

Example

python
# utils.py
def rake_amount(pot: float, pct: float = 5.0) -> float:
    """Return rake for a pot. Raises ValueError for negative pot."""
    if pot < 0:
        raise ValueError("pot must be >= 0")
    return pot * pct / 100
