    A. Format identify karke explicitly parse karta hu, bad values coerce karke count karta hu, aur UTC me standardise karta hu.
  • Q. Join pe values match nahi ho rahi, kyu?
    A. Aksar whitespace ya casing. TRIM aur LOWER lagao.

Yaad rakho

Parse explicitly, units aur time zone pakke karo, aur whitespace/casing normalise karo.

EDA-06StandardisationBasicMust Know

Ek hi cheez ke alag spellings ko ek standard value me map karo, lookup table ke saath.

Simple me samjho

"Delhi", "New Delhi", "delhi " sab ek hi city hai. Agar alag count honge to report galat aayegi. Mapping table banake sab ko ek naam do.

Key points

  • Category mapping: CASE WHEN ya dictionary se values ko groups me daalo (jaise 'cc', 'credit card' to 'CARD').
  • Spelling variants: 'Bangalore', 'Bengaluru', 'bangaluru'. Ek canonical naam chuno.
  • Lookup table: raw_value to standard_value table. Maintain karna aasan, query me join karo.
  • Country names: 'IN', 'India', 'IND' ko ISO code me map karo.
  • City names: state ya pincode se cross-check karo.
  • Unmapped values: mapping me na milne wali values ko 'Other' ya review list me daalo, chupao mat.
  • Casing/trim: mapping se pehle LOWER+TRIM.
  • Ek jagah rakho: mapping logic code me scatter mat karo.

Example

sql
SELECT COALESCE(m.standard_city, 'UNMAPPED') AS city, COUNT(*) AS users
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN city_map m ON LOWER(TRIM(u.city)) = m.raw_city
GROUP BY 1;
python
city_map = {"bangalore": "Bengaluru", "bengaluru": "Bengaluru", "new delhi": "Delhi"}
df["city_std"] = df["city"].str.strip().str.lower().map(city_map).fillna("UNMAPPED")

Output me 'UNMAPPED' rows dikhengi jinhe mapping table me add karna hai. Isse silent errors nahi hote.

Common mistakes

  • Free-text city ko directly group by karna.
  • Mapping hard-code karke 5 queries me copy karna.
  • Unmapped values ko silently drop kar dena.
  • Alag 'Other' aur null ko mix kar dena.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Spelling variants ka best fix?
    A. Lookup/mapping table, jisme raw to standard value ho. Unmapped ki review list rakho.
  • Q. Free-text field me kaise karoge?
    A. Normalise karo, top values map karo, baaki fuzzy match ya manual review se.

Yaad rakho

Ek canonical value, ek mapping table, aur unmapped ko visible rakho.

EDA-07Outlier investigationIntermediateMust Know

Outlier ko hataane se pehle samjho: genuine hai ya error. Internal users, test accounts, bots aur one-off events check karo.

Simple me samjho

Ek user ne 10 lakh deposit kiya. Error hai, whale hai, ya test account? Delete karne se pehle sach pata karo. Outlier kabhi sabse important insight hota hai.

Key points

  • Detect: box plot, IQR rule (Q1 - 1.5*IQR, Q3 + 1.5*IQR), z-score, ya top-N sort.
  • Genuine: real high roller (VIP). Rakho, par alag segment me dikhao.
  • Error: unit mistake, extra zero, system bug. Fix ya hatao.
  • Internal users: employees, QA. Email domain ya flag se pehchano.
  • Test accounts: 'test', 'demo', dummy ids. Production metrics se exclude karo.
  • Bots: inhuman speed, 24x7 play, same pattern.
  • One-off events: tournament, promo, outage, festival spike. Date se explain hota hai.
  • Decision document karo: kya hataya aur kyu.

Example

sql
SELECT user_id, SUM(amount) AS total
FROM deposits
GROUP BY user_id
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT * FROM users
WHERE email LIKE '%@ourcompany.com' OR username ILIKE 'test%';
python
q1, q3 = df["amount"].quantile([.25, .75])
iqr = q3 - q1
out = df[(df["amount"] > q3 + 1.5*iqr) | (df["amount"] < q1 - 1.5*iqr)]

Top 10 me agar 3 users company email ke hain, to wo internal hain aur report se hatne chahiye.

Common mistakes

  • Har outlier ko automatically delete kar dena, genuine whales bhi chale jaate hain.
  • Mean pe depend karna, jabki outlier se mean khinch jaata hai. Median bhi dekho.
  • Test aur internal accounts filter na karna.
  • Spike ko bug samajhna jabki promo chal raha tha.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Outlier mile to kya karte ho?
    A. Pehle investigate: error, internal/test/bot ya genuine. Phir fix, exclude ya alag segment me rakhta hu aur document karta hu.
  • Q. IQR rule kya hai?
    A. Q1 - 1.5*IQR se neeche ya Q3 + 1.5*IQR se upar ki values outlier maani jaati hain.

Yaad rakho

Outlier ko pehle samjho, phir hatao. Internal, test aur bot accounts hamesha filter karo.

EDA-08Invalid values and business rulesIntermediateMust Know

Negatives, impossible dates, out-of-range values aur broken references pakdo, business rules ke against.

Simple me samjho

Data technically valid ho sakta hai par business me impossible. Jaise age 250 ya withdrawal date signup se pehle. Rules likho aur data ko un pe test karo.

Key points

  • Negatives: deposit amount negative nahi hona chahiye (refund/reversal alag hai).
  • Impossible dates: future signup date, 1900-01-01, withdrawal pehle deposit se.
  • Out-of-range: age 0-120, rake percent 0-100, seat number 1-9.
  • Referential integrity: transactions.user_id hamesha users.user_id me hona chahiye (orphan rows nahi).
  • Business rule: end_time >= start_time, win + loss consistency.
  • Allowed values: status sirf known list me (pending, success, failed).
  • Action: invalid ko fix, flag ya quarantine table me daalo.
  • Source feedback: owner ko batao taaki upstream fix ho.

Example

sql
SELECT t.*
FROM transactions t
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = t.user_id
WHERE u.user_id IS NULL;          -- orphan rows

SELECT * FROM transactions
WHERE amount <= 0 OR created_at > NOW() OR created_at < '2015-01-01';
python
bad = df[(df["age"] < 0) | (df["age"] > 120) | (df["end"] < df["start"])]
orphans = tx[~tx["user_id"].isin(users["user_id"])]

Orphans ka matlab user delete hua ya data late aaya. Count aur sample owner ko dikhao.

Common mistakes

  • Sab negatives ko error maan lena, jabki refunds valid ho sakte hain.
  • Orphan rows ko inner join me silently kho dena.
  • Rules ko sirf ek baar check karna, recurring check nahi banana.
  • Invalid rows ko delete karna bina log ke.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Referential integrity kaise check karte ho?
    A. LEFT JOIN child to parent aur parent.key IS NULL filter. Python me isin.
  • Q. Negative amount mila, kya karoge?
    A. Pehle dekhu refund/chargeback hai ya bug. Rule ke hisaab se flag ya fix.

Yaad rakho

Business rules likho, data ko un pe test karo, aur violations ko owner tak pahunchao.

EDA-09Univariate analysisBasicMust Know

Ek-ek variable ko akele dekhna: histogram, box plot aur value counts se distribution samjho.

Simple me samjho

Pehle har column ko alag se jaano. Kitne log kitna deposit karte hain, kaun si city zyada hai. Ye bivariate analysis ki neev hai.

Key points

  • Numeric: mean, median, std, min, max, percentiles. Mean >> median ka matlab right skew.
  • Histogram: value kitne bins me failti hai. Bin size ka asar dikhta hai.
  • Box plot: median, quartiles aur outliers ek nazar me.
  • Categorical: value_counts() aur percentage share.
  • Skew: deposit amounts aksar skewed hote hain, log scale try karo.
  • Spikes: ek value pe achanak bahut count (jaise 0 ya 100) matlab default ya promo value.
  • Missing/rare categories: rare categories ko 'Other' me group karo.
  • Time series ke liye: alag topic (time-based analysis).

Example

python
df["deposit"].describe(percentiles=[.5, .9, .99])
df["deposit"].plot.hist(bins=30)
df.boxplot(column="deposit")
df["device"].value_counts(normalize=True).round(3)
sql
SELECT device, COUNT(*) AS n,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct
FROM users GROUP BY device ORDER BY n DESC;

Agar mean 800 aur median 200 hai, to kuch bade deposits mean ko upar kheench rahe hain. Report me median bhi do.

Common mistakes

  • Sirf mean report karna skewed data me.
  • Histogram ke bins galat chun lena aur shape chhup jaana.
  • Rare categories ko alag-alag dikha kar chart cluttered banana.
  • Outlier ko dekhe bina scale fix kar dena.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Mean aur median me bada gap kya batata hai?
    A. Distribution skewed hai aur outliers hain. Median zyada robust hai.
  • Q. Box plot kya dikhata hai?
    A. Median, Q1/Q3, whiskers aur outliers.

Yaad rakho

Har column ko pehle akele dekho: shape, spread, spikes.

EDA-10Bivariate and multivariate analysisIntermediateMust Know

Do ya zyada variables ke beech relation dekho: scatter, heatmap, group comparison aur pair plots.

Simple me samjho

Ab dekhte hain ek cheez badhne pe doosri kya karti hai. Jaise sessions badhne pe deposit badhta hai? Correlation sirf hint deta hai, proof nahi.

Key points

  • Scatter plot: do numeric columns ka relation. Trend aur outliers dikhte hain.
  • Correlation: df.corr(). -1 se +1. Linear relation hi naapta hai.
  • Heatmap: correlation matrix ya hour x weekday counts ko colour se dikhana.
  • Group comparison: category ke hisaab se metric (device ke hisaab se avg deposit). GROUP BY ya groupby.
  • Pair plot: sab numeric columns ke pairs ek saath (sns.pairplot).
  • Multivariate: 3+ variables, jaise device x channel x new/returning.
  • Correlation is not causation: lurking third variable ho sakta hai.
  • Simpson's paradox: aggregate me trend ulta, segment me alag. Segments me bhi dekho.

Example

python
df[["sessions", "deposit", "tenure_days"]].corr()
df.groupby("device")["deposit"].agg(["mean", "median", "count"])
df.pivot_table(index="channel", columns="device",
               values="deposit", aggfunc="mean")
sql
SELECT device, channel, AVG(deposit) AS avg_dep, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM users GROUP BY device, channel;

Pivot se dikhega ki kaun sa channel-device combo best hai. Count bhi dekho, chhota sample misleading hota hai.

Common mistakes

  • Correlation ko causation samajhna.
  • Chhote group ke average pe conclusion nikalna.
  • Non-linear relation me correlation 0 dekh kar relation nahi hai bol dena.
  • Segment me split kiye bina aggregate trust karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Correlation aur causation me farak?
    A. Correlation sirf saath move hona hai. Causation ke liye experiment ya strong reasoning chahiye.
  • Q. Simpson's paradox kya hai?
    A. Aggregate me ek trend, par har subgroup me ulta. Confounding variable ki wajah se.

Yaad rakho

Pehle plot, phir group comparison, aur har finding ko segment me re-check karo.

EDA-11Segmentation and slicingIntermediateMust Know

Metric ko geography, device, cohort, channel, tier aur new vs returning ke hisaab se todke dekho.

Simple me samjho

Overall number acchha dikhe to bhi koi ek segment kharab ho sakta hai. Slice karke dekhna padta hai. Average sab kuch chhupa deta hai.

Key points

  • Geography: country, state, city. Region-wise performance alag hoti hai.
  • Device: Android, iOS, web. App version bhi.
  • Cohort: signup month ke hisaab se users. Retention ke liye important.
  • Channel: organic, paid, referral, affiliate.
  • Customer tier: VIP, regular, casual. Revenue concentration dikhta hai.
  • New vs returning: naye users ka behaviour purane se alag hota hai.
  • Sample size: har segment me kitne users hain, hamesha dikhao.
  • Mix shift: overall metric badla kyuki segment mix badla, performance nahi.
  • Meaningful segments: itne mat banao ki har segment chhota ho jaye.

Example

sql
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', signup_date) AS cohort,
       channel,
       COUNT(*) AS users,
       AVG(first_deposit) AS avg_first_dep
FROM users
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;
python
df["is_new"] = df["signup_date"] >= "2026-10-01"
df.groupby(["is_new", "device"])["revenue"].agg(["sum", "mean", "count"])

Paid channel ke naye iOS users ka revenue alag nikla to marketing ko targeted action mil sakta hai.

Common mistakes

  • Sirf overall average report karna.
  • Bahut zyada slices banake false patterns dhundhna.
  • Segment ka size na batana.
  • Mix shift ko performance change samajh lena.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Revenue gira, kaise investigate karoge?
    A. Segment me todunga: geography, device, channel, tier, new vs returning. Dekhunga kaun sa segment gira ya mix badla.
  • Q. Cohort analysis kyu?
    A. Same time pe aaye users ko track karke retention aur behaviour compare karne ke liye.

Yaad rakho

Overall number pe bharosa mat karo, slice karo aur sample size dikhao.

EDA-12Time-based analysisIntermediateMust Know

Trends, seasonality, day-of-week, holidays, YoY compare karo aur partial-period traps se bacho.

Simple me samjho

Time ke saath metric kaise badalta hai, ye dekhna hai. Weekend pe poker traffic zyada hota hai, ye normal hai. Galat period compare karoge to galat story banegi.

Key points

  • Trend: long-term upar ya neeche. Moving average se noise kam hota hai.
  • Seasonality: repeat hone wala pattern (weekly, monthly, festival).
  • Day-of-week: Monday ko Sunday se compare mat karo. Same weekday compare karo.
  • Holidays: Diwali, IPL jaise events ka effect alag note karo.
  • YoY: pichle saal ke same period se compare, seasonality hat jaati hai.
  • Partial-period trap: aadha month vs poora month compare karna. Month-to-date ko MTD se compare karo.
  • Time zone: din ka boundary IST me ya UTC me?
  • Late-arriving data: recent days ke numbers baad me badal sakte hain.

Example

sql
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', created_at) AS wk,
       SUM(amount) AS dep
FROM deposits
WHERE created_at < DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)  -- incomplete week hatao
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
python
s = df.set_index("date")["revenue"].resample("D").sum()
s.rolling(7).mean()
df["dow"] = df["date"].dt.day_name()

7-day rolling average weekly seasonality hata deta hai. Chalu hafte ko report se hatao, warna dip jaisa dikhega.

Common mistakes

  • Incomplete current week/month ko full period se compare karna.
  • Holiday spike ko growth samajhna.
  • Missing dates (zero days) ko fill na karna, trend toot jaata hai.
  • Time zone ke wajah se raat ka data galat din me jaana.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Aaj ka revenue kal se kam hai, panic?
    A. Pehle partial day, day-of-week aur late data check karunga. Same weekday se compare.
  • Q. YoY kyu use karte hain?
    A. Seasonality hataane ke liye, kyuki same period compare hota hai.

Yaad rakho

Same period, same weekday, complete period compare karo.

EDA-13Feature creationIntermediateGood to Have

Raw columns se nayi useful columns banao: ratios, flags, buckets, rolling windows aur lags.

Simple me samjho

Raw data se seedha insight nahi milta. Chhote derived columns banane se pattern saaf dikhta hai. Jaise "deposit" se "deposit per session".

Key points

  • Ratios: win_rate = wins / hands, ARPU = revenue / users. Zero division se bacho.
  • Flags: 0/1 columns. is_depositor, is_weekend, is_new.
  • Buckets: continuous ko groups me. Jaise deposit 0-500, 500-2000, 2000+. CASE WHEN ya pd.cut.
  • Rolling windows: pichle 7 din ka average ya sum. ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW.
  • Lags: pichli value. LAG(col, 1) se day-over-day change.
  • Date parts: day of week, hour, month.
  • Leakage se bacho: future ka data feature me mat lao.
  • Naming: clear naming aur document karo.

Example

sql
SELECT user_id, day, deposit,
       LAG(deposit) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY day) AS prev_dep,
       AVG(deposit) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY day
                          ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_7d,
       CASE WHEN deposit >= 2000 THEN 'high' ELSE 'low' END AS bucket,
       deposit * 1.0 / NULLIF(sessions, 0) AS dep_per_session
FROM player_daily;
python
df["prev"] = df.groupby("user_id")["deposit"].shift(1)
df["avg_7d"] = df.groupby("user_id")["deposit"].transform(lambda s: s.rolling(7).mean())
df["bucket"] = pd.cut(df["deposit"], [0, 500, 2000, float("inf")], labels=["low", "mid", "high"])

NULLIF(sessions, 0) divide-by-zero rokta hai. Rolling aur lag me PARTITION BY user_id zaroori hai.

Common mistakes

  • PARTITION BY ke bina lag/rolling, jisse users mix ho jaate hain.
  • Zero se divide.
  • Bucket edges kabhi overlap ya gap chhod dena.
  • Future data wala feature banana (leakage).

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Rolling 7-day average SQL me?
    A. AVG(x) OVER (PARTITION BY u ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW).
  • Q. Divide-by-zero kaise avoid?
    A. NULLIF(den, 0) ya pandas me mask.

Yaad rakho

Ratio, flag, bucket, lag: chhote derived columns bade insights dete hain.

EDA-14Joining and reconciliationIntermediateMust Know

Joins ke baad totals source se match karo, systems ke beech reconcile karo aur gaps explain karo.

Simple me samjho

Join ke baad total badal jaaye to kuch galat hai. Jaise bank statement aur passbook ka match. Source total ko anchor maano.

Key points

  • Source totals: join se pehle aur baad me row count aur SUM compare karo.
  • Join type: INNER rows khota hai, LEFT rows rakhta hai, many-to-many rows badhata hai.
  • Fan-out: ek-se-kai join pe parent ki value repeat hoti hai, SUM inflate.
  • Reconcile across systems: game DB vs payment gateway vs finance report.
  • Explain gaps: gap ko buckets me todo: timing, missing rows, duplicates, currency, test data.
  • Anti-join: ek side me hai, doosri me nahi, unhe list karo.
  • Tolerance: chhota rounding difference accept karo, threshold decide karo.
  • Document: reconciliation result likho.

Example

sql
-- gateway me hai, warehouse me nahi
SELECT g.txn_id, g.amount
FROM gateway_txns g
LEFT JOIN wh_txns w ON w.txn_id = g.txn_id
WHERE w.txn_id IS NULL;

SELECT (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM gateway_txns) AS gateway_total,
       (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM wh_txns)      AS wh_total;
python
m = g.merge(w, on="txn_id", how="outer", indicator=True, suffixes=("_g", "_w"))
m["_merge"].value_counts()
m["diff"] = m["amount_g"] - m["amount_w"]

indicator=True se left_only, right_only, both milta hai. Mismatched total ko in teen groups me todke explain karo.

Common mistakes

  • Join ke baad total check na karna.
  • Many-to-many join se unknown duplicates.
  • INNER JOIN se missing rows silently gir jaana.
  • Difference bol dena bina breakdown ke.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Join ke baad revenue double ho gaya, kyu?
    A. Fan-out. Join key unique nahi hai, to rows repeat hui. Pehle aggregate ya dedupe karo.
  • Q. Do systems ka total alag hai, kaise explain?
    A. Anti-join se missing rows, timing, duplicates, currency aur test data ke buckets me todta hu.

Yaad rakho

Join ke baad row count aur total source se match karo.

EDA-15Documenting assumptionsBasicMust Know

Cleaning log, assumptions, caveats aur versioned queries likho, taaki koi bhi tumhara kaam reproduce kar sake.

Simple me samjho

Kaam ke 3 mahine baad tumhe khud yaad nahi rahega kya hataya tha. Likh ke rakho. Doosra analyst ya manager bhi samajh sake.

Key points

  • Cleaning log: kya kiya, kitni rows affected, kyu. Jaise "removed 214 test accounts".
  • Assumptions: "amount INR me hai", "timestamps UTC hain".
  • Caveats: kya limitations hain. "Pichle 2 din ka data incomplete".
  • Versioned queries: SQL ko Git me rakho, v1, v2 changes ke saath.
  • Metric definition: active user ka matlab likho.
  • Data source aur date: kab pull kiya, kaun si table.
  • Open questions: jo owner se confirm karna hai.
  • Report me summary: top 3 caveats report me daalo.

Example

text
Cleaning log (deposits_analysis, v2, 2026-11-20)
1. Source: wh.deposits, pulled 2026-11-20 10:00 IST
2. Removed 214 rows: test accounts (email like '%@ourcompany.com')
3. Dropped 37 rows: amount <= 0 (sent to owner)
4. Assumption: amounts are INR, timestamps UTC
5. Caveat: last 24h data may be incomplete (late arrival)

Is log se reviewer ko exact numbers mil jaate hain aur result reproducible rehta hai.

Common mistakes

  • Notebook me bina comment ke steps chalana.
  • Queries ko email/chat me bhej dena, version control nahi.
  • Caveats chhupana.
  • Filter ka reason na likhna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Documentation kyu zaroori?
    A. Reproducibility, trust aur handover ke liye. Reviewer samajh sake ki number kaise bana.
  • Q. Kya document karte ho?
    A. Source, filters, cleaning steps with counts, assumptions, caveats aur query version.

Yaad rakho

Jo hataya, jo maana, jo nahi pata: sab likho.

EDA-16Sanity-checking numbersBasicMust Know

Report bhejne se pehle poocho: kya ye number make sense karta hai? Last week, benchmark aur order of magnitude se compare karo.

Simple me samjho

Galat number bhejne se credibility jaati hai. Calculator ki tarah, answer ka rough andaza pehle laga lo. 5 minute ka check bada nuksaan bachata hai.

Key points

  • Does it make sense?: DAU total registered users se zyada nahi ho sakta.
  • Compare with last week: 5% ka change normal, 80% ka change investigate.
  • Known benchmarks: finance report, pichla quarter, company dashboard.
  • Order of magnitude: 1 crore chahiye tha, 10 crore aaya to 0 extra lag gaya.
  • Back-of-envelope: users x ARPU se rough revenue nikalo.
  • Parts vs whole: segments ka sum total se match karna chahiye. Percentages 100% hone chahiye.
  • Edge dates: aaj ka partial data, month end.
  • Doosre se verify: kisi aur table ya person se cross-check.

Example

text
Daily active users = 52,000
Total registered = 40,000  -> impossible, kuch galat hai

Revenue/day = 1.2 cr, last week same day = 1.1 cr  -> reasonable (+9%)
Segments: iOS 40% + Android 55% + Web 8% = 103% -> overlap ya bug
sql
SELECT SUM(amount) FROM deposits WHERE dt = CURRENT_DATE - 1;
-- compare: same weekday, last week

Pehle example me logic hi tut raha hai. Teesre me segments overlap ho rahe hain, to double counting check karo.

Common mistakes

  • Number ko bina compare kiye bhej dena.
  • Percentages ka sum check na karna.
  • Partial day ko full day se compare karna.
  • Rounding ya units (lakh vs crore) me galti.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Bhejne se pehle kya check karte ho?
    A. Last week se compare, benchmark, order of magnitude, parts ka sum total se match, aur logic constraints.
  • Q. Number bahut zyada aaya, pehla step?
    A. Duplicates aur join fan-out, test accounts, aur time range check.

Yaad rakho

Number bhejne se pehle 5 minute: compare, estimate, aur parts ka sum.

Visualization & BI 21 topics

BI-01Choosing the right chartBasicMust Know

Sawal ke hisaab se chart chuno: comparison, trend, distribution, composition ya relationship. Galat chart se sahi data bhi confuse karta hai.

Simple me samjho

Chart ek vehicle jaisa hai. Shehar me cycle chalti hai, highway pe car. Pehle sawal poocho: "main kya dikhana chahta hoon?" Phir chart chuno.

Key points

  • Comparison: categories ko compare karna ho (game type wise revenue) to bar chart. Labels lambe hon to horizontal bar.
  • Trend: time ke saath change ho to line chart. X-axis pe time, points ordered.
  • Distribution: values kaise phaili hain (bet size, session length) to histogram ya box plot.
  • Composition: part-of-whole (revenue share by game) to stacked bar ya 100% stacked bar. Time ke saath composition ho to stacked area.
  • Relationship: do numeric measures ka link (deposit vs withdrawal) to scatter plot. Teesra measure ho to bubble size.
  • Single number: KPI card (DAU, GGR) bada number + chhota delta.
  • When not to use a pie: 5 se zyada slices, ya slices ki size close ho, ya time trend dikhana ho. Angle se compare karna mushkil hai, bar easy hai.
  • Dual axis / table: exact values chahiye to table. Dual axis tabhi jab dono axis clearly labelled ho.
  • Sort karo: bar chart ko value se sort karo, alphabetical nahi (jab tak natural order na ho, jaise months).

Example

Sawal aur chart ka mapping:

SawalChart
Kaunsa game top revenue deta hai?Sorted horizontal bar
Last 12 months DAU trend?Line chart
Bet size kaise distribute hai?Histogram
Revenue me game-wise share?100% stacked bar
Deposit aur play-time ka link?Scatter

Pie sirf tab theek hai jab 2-3 slices ho aur total 100% ka point clear ho.

Common mistakes

  • Trend ke liye bar/pie use karna. Line use karo.
  • 10+ slices wala pie ya donut. Bar me badlo.
  • Chart pehle chun lena, sawal baad me. Pehle question likho.
  • Sab kuch ek chart me thoons dena (too many series). Small multiples try karo.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Pie chart kab avoid karte ho?
    A. Jab categories 5 se zyada ho ya values close ho, kyunki angle compare karna mushkil hai. Sorted bar better hai.
  • Q. Distribution dikhane ke liye kaunsa chart?
    A. Histogram ya box plot. Outliers aur spread dono dikhte hain.
  • Q. Do measures ka relationship kaise dikhaoge?
    A. Scatter plot, aur zaroorat ho to trend line ya correlation value.

Yaad rakho

Pehle sawal, phir chart: compare = bar, trend = line, spread = histogram, share = stacked bar, link = scatter.

BI-02Design principlesBasicMust Know

Chart saaf, contrast wala, colour-blind safe aur honest ho. Truncated axis aur 3D effects se bachna.

Simple me samjho

Achha dashboard road sign jaisa hota hai: ek nazar me samajh aa jaye. Jo cheez insight me help nahi karti, wo noise hai. Use hata do.

Key points

  • Declutter: heavy gridlines, borders, background colours, extra legends hatao. "Data-ink" zyada, decoration kam.
  • Contrast: important cheez ko strong colour, baaki ko grey. Text aur background ka contrast readable ho.
  • Colour-blind safe palette: red-green combination avoid karo. Blue-orange jaisi palette use karo, aur colour ke saath label/shape bhi do.
  • Limited colours: ek chart me 5-6 se zyada colours nahi. Zyada categories ho to filter ya group karo.
  • Consistent scales: same measure ke charts me same axis range aur same colour. Ek jagah "Revenue" blue, doosri jagah blue = "Cost" na ho.
  • No truncated bar axis: bar chart ka axis 0 se shuru hona chahiye. Warna chhota difference bada dikhta hai.
  • No 3D: 3D pie/bar se height aur angle distort hote hain. 2D use karo.
  • Direct labels: legend se bar tak aankh na ghumani pade, label seedha lagao.
  • Number format: 1,250,000 ki jagah 1.25M, units saaf likho (INR, USD).
  • Alignment aur spacing: elements grid me align, fonts 1-2 se zyada nahi.

Example

Before: 3D pie, 9 colours, gridlines, y-axis 95 se 100. After: sorted bar, ek highlight colour baaki grey, axis 0 se, direct labels.

text
Bar A = 96, Bar B = 98
Axis 95-100: B ka bar A se 3x bada dikhta hai
Axis 0-100: difference sirf ~2%, jo sach hai

Truncated axis difference ko exaggerate karta hai. Line chart me truncation chalta hai, bar me nahi.

Common mistakes

  • Default tool colours chhod dena aur rainbow palette use karna.
  • Bar chart axis 0 se na shuru karna.
  • Alag dashboards me same KPI ka alag colour ya format.
  • Decoration (logos, shadows, 3D) ko "professional look" samajhna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Bar chart ka axis 0 se kyun?
    A. Bar ki length value ko represent karti hai. Truncate karne se ratio galat dikhta hai, misleading hota hai.
  • Q. Colour-blind safe design kaise karoge?
    A. Red-green avoid, blue-orange palette, plus labels ya shapes. Grayscale me bhi check karo.
  • Q. Declutter ka matlab?
    A. Jo element insight nahi badhata (gridlines, borders, extra legend) use hatana.

Yaad rakho

Kam colour, zero-based bars, no 3D, consistent scales: design ka kaam samajh banana hai, sajana nahi.

BI-03Dashboard design and layoutIntermediateMust Know

Ek dashboard ek audience aur ek purpose ke liye. Upar KPI row, neeche detail, filters aur drill-down saaf.

Simple me samjho

Dashboard newspaper ki front page jaisa hai. Headline pehle, detail neeche. Jo reader jaldi me hai, usko 5 second me answer mil jana chahiye.

Key points

  • One purpose per audience: CEO ko summary, ops team ko detail. Ek dashboard me sab ko khush karne ki koshish mat karo.
  • KPI row first: sabse upar 4-6 KPI cards (Revenue, DAU, Retention, Churn) with delta vs last period.
  • F-pattern: log upar-left se padhna shuru karte hain, phir left side neeche. Sabse important cheez top-left.
  • Top to bottom flow: summary, phir trend, phir breakdown, phir detail table.
  • Filters: date, region, game type jaise 3-5 useful filters. Ek hi jagah (top ya left) rakho. Default selection sensible rakho (last 30 days).
  • Drill-down: summary se detail tak jaane ka rasta (country se state se city). Ya drill-through detail page pe.
  • Mobile view: phone layout alag banao (Power BI me Mobile layout, Tableau me Device Layouts). Kam visuals, bade cards.
  • Whitespace aur grouping: related visuals ek saath, alignment grid pe.
  • Limit visuals: 5-8 visuals per page. Zyada ho to naya page.
  • Title aur context: har visual ka title, unit, date range clearly likho.

Example

Poker "Daily Health" dashboard layout:

RowContent
1KPI cards: DAU, Deposits, GGR, Rake, with vs last week
2Line: DAU trend (left), Bar: revenue by game type (right)
3Table: top 10 tables by rake, drill-through to table detail
Top barFilters: date range, platform, country

Executive ko row 1 se answer milta hai, analyst row 3 se drill karta hai.

Common mistakes

  • 20 visuals ek page pe, koi hierarchy nahi.
  • Filters bikhre hue, ya default me "All time" jo slow bhi hai.
  • Mobile ke liye alag layout na banana.
  • Ek dashboard me exec aur analyst dono ke questions mix karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Dashboard banate waqt sabse pehle kya poochte ho?
    A. Audience kaun hai aur kaunsa decision lena hai. Uske baad KPI aur layout decide hote hain.
  • Q. F-pattern ka kya use?
    A. Aankh upar-left se padhti hai, isliye top-left me sabse important KPI rakho.
  • Q. Drill-down aur drill-through me fark?
    A. Drill-down same visual me hierarchy me neeche jaata hai. Drill-through filter context ke saath doosre detail page pe le jaata hai.

Yaad rakho

Ek audience, ek purpose: upar KPI, beech me trend, neeche detail, side me filters.

BI-04Visual storytellingIntermediateMust Know

Chart sirf data nahi dikhata, ek kahani batata hai. Title me insight likho, ek cheez highlight karo, baaki noise hatao.

Simple me samjho

Stakeholder ke paas time kam hota hai. Tum usko batao "kya hua aur kyun", sirf "ye raha chart" nahi. Story ka format: context, insight, action.

Key points

  • Insight wala title: "Revenue by month" ki jagah "Revenue 12% gira after rake change in March". Title me hi conclusion.
  • Annotations: chart pe seedha note lagao (event, launch, outage, promo). Spike ya dip ka reason pata chale.
  • Highlight colour: ek series ya bar ko strong colour, baaki grey. Aankh wahin jaati hai.
  • Remove noise: gridlines, legend, extra labels, decoration hatao. Sirf jo story support kare.
  • Context do: benchmark, target line, ya previous period comparison. Akela number meaning nahi rakhta.
  • Story structure: situation, problem, finding, recommendation. Ek slide ya page = ek message.
  • Order of visuals: pehle bada picture, phir zoom. Logical flow.
  • Action line: end me "next step" likho (e.g. "test bonus change on mobile").
  • Know the audience: exec ko ek line aur ek chart, analyst ko method aur numbers.

Example

Before title: "DAU by platform". After title: "Mobile DAU up 18% since Oct, Desktop flat". Mobile line orange, Desktop grey, Oct launch pe ek annotation "New app release".

text
Chart: line, 2 series
Highlight: Mobile = orange, Desktop = grey
Annotation at 2026-10-05: "App v3 launch"
Takeaway line: "Push mobile onboarding campaign next"

Reader ko 5 second me message mil jaata hai bina legend dhundhe.

Common mistakes

  • Generic title ("Sales Dashboard") jo kuch nahi batata.
  • Har series ko alag colour dena, koi highlight nahi.
  • Sirf dikhana, "so what" na batana.
  • Annotation me galat ya unverified reason likhna. Pehle verify karo.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Data storytelling ka matlab?
    A. Data ko context, insight aur recommendation ke saath present karna taaki audience action le sake.
  • Q. Highlight colour kyun?
    A. Attention guide karta hai. Ek cheez coloured, baaki grey, to message turant dikhta hai.
  • Q. Ek achha chart title kaisa hota hai?
    A. Jo insight state kare, jaise "Churn doubled after bonus removal", sirf metric ka naam nahi.

Yaad rakho

Title me insight, ek highlight, thodi annotation, baaki noise saaf.

BI-05Power BI: Power QueryIntermediateMust Know

Power Query me data connect, clean, merge, append aur unpivot hota hai. Steps M language me save hote hain aur har refresh pe chalte hain.

Simple me samjho

Power Query data ka kitchen hai. Kachcha data aata hai, safai hoti hai, phir model me jaata hai. Har step record hota hai (Applied Steps), isliye refresh pe wahi process dubara chalta hai.

Key points

  • Connect: Get Data se SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Excel, CSV, web, folder jaise sources. Credentials aur privacy level set hote hain.
  • Clean: data types set karo, nulls handle, duplicates hatao, trim/clean text, rename columns, unused columns hatao.
  • Merge: do tables ka join (Merge Queries). Join kinds: Left Outer, Inner, Full Outer, Anti jaise. Key column ka type dono taraf same ho.
  • Append: tables ko upar-neeche jodna (UNION jaisa). Same structure ke monthly files combine karne ke liye.
  • Unpivot: wide table (Jan, Feb, Mar columns) ko long table (Month, Value) me badalna. Reporting ke liye long format better hai.
  • Query folding: Power Query steps ko source ke native query (SQL) me translate karta hai, to kaam database me hota hai. Fast hota hai.
  • Folding check: step pe right-click, "View Native Query" enabled hai to fold ho raha hai. Greyed out ho to folding toot gayi.
  • Folding todne wale steps: kuch custom functions ya Table.Buffer jaise steps. Foldable steps (filter, select columns) pehle rakho.
  • Reduce early: rows aur columns jaldi filter karo, taaki kam data load ho.
  • Staging queries: base query ko "Enable load" off karke reference se use karo.

Example

M code ka basic pattern (server aur table names generic hain):

text
let
    Source = Sql.Database("server_name", "db_name"),
    Orders = Source{[Schema="public", Item="orders"]}[Data],
    Filtered = Table.SelectRows(Orders, each [status] = "paid"),
    Typed = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Filtered, {{"amount", type number}}),
    Merged = Table.NestedJoin(Typed, {"user_id"}, Users, {"user_id"}, "u", JoinKind.LeftOuter),
    Unpiv = Table.UnpivotOtherColumns(Wide, {"user_id"}, "Month", "Value"),
    Appended = Table.Combine({Jan_Table, Feb_Table})
in
    Merged

let ... in me har line ek step hai, aur last in wala step final output hai. Unpiv aur Appended alag queries ke examples hain.

Common mistakes

  • Foldable steps (filter, column select) ko non-foldable step ke baad rakhna. Ek baar folding tooti to aage ke steps bhi memory me chalte hain, isliye foldable steps pehle rakho.
  • Merge me key ke data types alag hona, to match fail hota hai.
  • Sab kuch Power Query me karna jo database me SQL view se easy hota. Heavy logic source me rakho.
  • Unpivot ke jagah 12 month columns model me chhod dena.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Query folding kya hai?
    A. Power Query ke steps ka source ke native query me convert hona, jisse processing database me hoti hai aur refresh fast hota hai.
  • Q. Merge aur Append me fark?
    A. Merge columns ke basis pe join (side by side), Append rows ko stack karta hai (UNION jaisa).
  • Q. Unpivot kab karte ho?
    A. Jab months/categories alag columns me hon. Unpivot se attribute-value long format banta hai, jo DAX aur charts ke liye achha hai.

Yaad rakho

Filter aur reduce jaldi, folding bachao, Merge = join, Append = union, Unpivot = wide to long.

BI-06Power BI: data modellingIntermediateMust Know

Power BI me star schema banao: beech me fact table, charon taraf dimension tables, one-to-many relationships aur ek proper date table.

Simple me samjho

Model ek wheel jaisa hai. Beech me fact (events, transactions), spokes me dimensions (users, games, dates). Filter dimension se fact ki taraf behta hai.

Key points

  • Star schema: ek fact table (numbers, FKs) aur kai dimension tables (descriptive attributes). Snowflake se simple aur fast.
  • Fact table: bahut rows, measures (amount, rake), foreign keys. Dimension: kam rows, unique key.
  • Relationship: do tables ko key column se jodna. Dimension key unique hoti hai.
  • Cardinality: One-to-many (sabse common, dim to fact), many-to-one, one-to-one, many-to-many. Many-to-many se jitna ho sake bachna.
  • Cross-filter direction: Single (dim se fact) default aur best. Both direction sirf zaroori hone par, kyunki ambiguity aur slow performance hoti hai.
  • Active vs inactive: ek do tables ke beech ek hi active relationship. Doosri inactive, DAX me USERELATIONSHIP se use hoti hai.
  • Date table: alag calendar table banao aur Mark as date table karo. Time intelligence ke liye zaroori.
  • Hide FK columns: fact me keys hide karo, users sirf dimension ke fields use karein.
  • Flat table avoid: ek bada flat table repeat data aur size badhata hai.
  • Naming: Dim_ aur Fact_ prefix, clear column names.

Example

Poker model:

TableTypeKey
Fact_HandsFactuser_id, table_id, date
Dim_UserDimensionuser_id
Dim_TableDimensiontable_id
Dim_DateDimension (date table)date
text
Dim_User[user_id]  1 ---> *  Fact_Hands[user_id]
Dim_Table[table_id] 1 ---> * Fact_Hands[table_id]
Dim_Date[date]     1 ---> *  Fact_Hands[date]
Cross-filter: Single (dimension to fact)

Country slicer Dim_User pe lagao to Fact_Hands automatic filter ho jaata hai.

Common mistakes

  • Bi-directional filter har jagah laga dena, jisse circular ya ambiguous paths bante hain.
  • Date table na banana aur auto date/time pe depend karna.
  • Many-to-many relationship bina soche banana, galat totals aate hain.
  • Dimension key me duplicates hona, jisse one-to-many ban hi nahi pata.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Star schema kyun?
    A. Simple, fast, aur DAX filter propagation clean hota hai. Fact beech me, dimensions charon taraf.
  • Q. Both direction filter kab?
    A. Kam hi, jaise bridge table me. Default Single rakhte hain performance aur ambiguity ki wajah se.
  • Q. Date table kyun zaroori?
    A. Time intelligence functions ko continuous dates wala marked date table chahiye.

Yaad rakho

Star schema, one-to-many, single direction, aur ek marked date table.

BI-07Power BI: DAX basicsIntermediateMust Know

DAX Power BI ki formula language hai. Measures dynamic hote hain aur filter/row context ke hisaab se value badalte hain.

Simple me samjho

Calculated column row-by-row ek baar banta hai aur memory me store hota hai. Measure report me click/filter ke time calculate hota hai. Context samajh gaye to DAX samajh gaya.

Key points

  • Measure vs column: Column table me store hoti hai (row context). Measure aggregate hota hai, filter context se change hota hai. Totals ke liye measure use karo.
  • SUM: ek column ko add karta hai. Total Sales = SUM(Sales[Amount]).
  • CALCULATE: filter context badalta hai. CALCULATE(expression, filter1, filter2). DAX ka sabse important function.
  • FILTER: table return karta hai jahan condition true ho. Row by row evaluate karta hai, CALCULATE me use hota hai.
  • ALL: filters hata deta hai. Percent of total me denominator ke liye. ALL(Table) ya ALL(Table[Column]).
  • SUMX: iterator. Har row pe expression chalata hai phir sum karta hai. Jaise Qty * Price.
  • DIVIDE: safe division, zero ya blank par error nahi deta. DIVIDE(num, den, alt), alternate optional.
  • Filter context: slicers, rows/columns, filters se aane wale filters.
  • Row context: calculated column ya iterator (SUMX) me current row. Measure me default me row context nahi hota.
  • Context transition: row context me measure/CALCULATE call hone par row context filter context ban jaata hai.
  • Variables: VAR ... RETURN se readable aur fast code.

Example

text
Total Sales = SUM(Sales[Amount])

Revenue (SUMX) = SUMX(Sales, Sales[Qty] * Sales[Price])

Cash Game Sales =
CALCULATE([Total Sales], Dim_Game[Type] = "Cash")

All Sales = CALCULATE([Total Sales], ALL(Dim_Game))

% of Total = DIVIDE([Total Sales], [All Sales])

High Value Sales =
CALCULATE([Total Sales], FILTER(Sales, Sales[Amount] > 1000))

Avg Ticket =
VAR Total = [Total Sales]
VAR Orders = COUNTROWS(Sales)
RETURN DIVIDE(Total, Orders)

% of Total har game ka share deta hai kyunki denominator me ALL(Dim_Game) ne game filter hata diya. Total row 100% aati hai.

Common mistakes

  • Calculated column se aggregate banana jo measure hona chahiye. Model bhaari hota hai.
  • / use karna, jisse divide by zero error. DIVIDE use karo.
  • FILTER(ALL(...)) aur filter context ka fark na samajhna, galat results aate hain.
  • Context na samajh ke totals galat hone par debug na kar paana. Measure ko matrix me test karo.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Measure aur calculated column me fark?
    A. Column row-level pe refresh pe compute hoke store hota hai. Measure query time pe filter context ke hisaab se compute hota hai, storage nahi leta.
  • Q. CALCULATE kya karta hai?
    A. Expression ko modified filter context me evaluate karta hai. Filters add, replace ya remove kar sakta hai (ALL).
  • Q. SUM aur SUMX me fark?
    A. SUM ek column add karta hai. SUMX row-by-row expression evaluate karke sum karta hai, jaise Qty * Price.

Yaad rakho

Measure for totals, CALCULATE changes context, ALL removes filters, DIVIDE for safety.

BI-08Power BI: DAX time intelligenceAdvancedGood to Have

Time intelligence functions se YTD, last year aur growth nikalte hain. Iske liye continuous, marked calendar table zaroori hai.

Simple me samjho

Tum poochte ho "is saal ab tak kitna aur pichle saal usi time pe kitna?" Time intelligence ye same-period comparison automatic karti hai. Ye sab date table ke upar chalta hai, fact table ke date column pe nahi.

Key points

  • Calendar table: har din ek row, koi gap nahi, poore years cover. DAX me CALENDAR ya CALENDARAUTO se bana sakte ho, ya Power Query/SQL me.
  • Mark as date table: Power BI me table ko date table mark karo aur date column choose karo.
  • Relationship: Dim_Date[Date] se Fact[Date] one-to-many. Fact ke date ke saath bhi date part (time nahi) match ho.
  • TOTALYTD: year-to-date total. TOTALYTD(expression, dates).
  • SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR: pichle saal ki same dates ka table. CALCULATE ke andar filter ki tarah use hota hai.
  • DATEADD: dates ko interval se shift karta hai. DATEADD(dates, -1, MONTH); intervals DAY, MONTH, QUARTER, YEAR.
  • Other functions: DATESYTD, DATESMTD, PARALLELPERIOD, PREVIOUSMONTH bhi hote hain.
  • Growth %: current aur last year ko DIVIDE se compare karo.
  • Date column from calendar use karo: slicer aur visuals me Dim_Date ka column, fact ka nahi. Nahi to time intelligence kaam nahi karti.
  • Fiscal year: TOTALYTD me optional year-end date argument hota hai, fiscal year ke liye docs me format check karo.

Example

text
Total Sales = SUM(Sales[Amount])

Sales YTD = TOTALYTD([Total Sales], 'Date'[Date])

Sales LY =
CALCULATE([Total Sales], SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR('Date'[Date]))

Sales Prev Month =
CALCULATE([Total Sales], DATEADD('Date'[Date], -1, MONTH))

YoY % =
VAR Cur = [Total Sales]
VAR LY = [Sales LY]
RETURN DIVIDE(Cur - LY, LY)

Date =
ADDCOLUMNS(
    CALENDAR(DATE(2024,1,1), DATE(2026,12,31)),
    "Year", YEAR([Date]),
    "Month", FORMAT([Date], "MMM"),
    "MonthNo", MONTH([Date])
)

Matrix me month rows pe rakho: Sales LY har month ke saamne pichle saal ki value dikhayega. Pichle saal ka data na ho to blank aata hai.

Common mistakes

  • Fact table ka date column use karna ya date table mark na karna. Results galat ya blank aate hain.
  • Calendar table me gaps ya incomplete years. Poore saal cover karo.
  • Month name sort by month number set na karna, to Apr, Aug, Dec alphabetical aate hain.
  • Date column me time part hona jisse relationship match nahi hota.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Time intelligence ke liye kya zaroori hai?
    A. Continuous date table jisme har din ho, relationship fact se, aur table date table mark ki gayi ho.
  • Q. SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR aur DATEADD me fark?
    A. SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR fixed pichla saal. DATEADD flexible, kisi bhi interval se (months, quarters, days) shift karta hai.
  • Q. YoY growth kaise nikaloge?
    A. (Current - LY) / LY, DIVIDE ke saath taaki LY blank ya zero hone pe error na aaye.

Yaad rakho

Marked calendar table pehle, phir TOTALYTD, SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR, DATEADD, aur growth me DIVIDE.

BI-09Power BI: visuals and interactivityIntermediateMust Know

Slicers, bookmarks, drill-through, tooltips aur parameters se report interactive banti hai aur user khud explore kar paata hai.

Simple me samjho

Report ek static PDF nahi, ek app jaisi honi chahiye. User click kare aur jawab mile. Har interactive feature ka ek kaam hai: filter, view save, detail page, hover info.

Key points

  • Slicers: on-page filters (date, country, game type). Date range slicer, dropdown, list style options hote hain. Sync slicers se multiple pages pe same filter.
  • Cross-filtering: ek visual pe click karo to baaki visuals filter/highlight hote hain. Edit interactions se control karo.
  • Bookmarks: report ka current state (filters, visibility) save karta hai. Buttons ke saath navigation ya view toggle (chart vs table) banate hain.
  • Drill-through: kisi item (jaise user ya table) pe right-click karke detail page pe jaana, filter context ke saath. Pehle drill-through field set karni padti hai.
  • Drill-down: hierarchy me neeche jaana (Year, Quarter, Month) usi visual me.
  • Tooltips: hover pe chhota info. Report page tooltip bana sakte ho, jisme mini chart dikhe.
  • Parameters: What-if parameter se slider bana kar user se value (jaise discount %) lete hain, aur DAX me use karte hain. Field parameters se user measure ya axis badal sakta hai.
  • Conditional formatting: rules ya measure se colour (red/green), data bars, icons.
  • KPI aur card visuals: single-number display ke liye.
  • Buttons aur navigation: page navigator, back button se app jaisa feel.

Example

Scenario: "Player Overview" page pe table me users ki list hai.

  • Page 2 "Player Detail" pe user_id ko drill-through field banao.
  • Overview me user pe right-click, Drill through, Player Detail. Page 2 us user ke hands aur deposits dikhata hai.
  • Tooltip page se hover pe last 7 days ka mini sparkline aata hai.
  • What-if parameter "Rake %" slider se projected revenue measure badalta hai.
  • Bookmark "Table view" aur "Chart view" button se toggle.

Isse ek hi report me summary aur detail dono mil jaate hain.

Common mistakes

  • Bahut zyada slicers, jisse screen bhar jaati hai. 3-5 rakho.
  • Bookmarks me filter state capture hona ya na hona (Data option) check na karna, unexpected results aate hain.
  • Drill-through ka field set kiye bina option dikhne ki ummeed.
  • Interactions control na karna, jisse ek click se kuch visuals ka kaam bigad jaata hai.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Drill-down aur drill-through me fark?
    A. Drill-down same visual me hierarchy level badalta hai. Drill-through filter ke saath doosre detail page pe le jaata hai.
  • Q. Bookmark kya store karta hai?
    A. Page ka state: filters, slicer selection, visual visibility. Buttons se toggle views banate hain.
  • Q. What-if parameter kya hai?
    A. Slider se number input leke DAX measure me use karna, jaise scenario analysis.

Yaad rakho

Slicer filters, bookmark views save, drill-through detail page, tooltip hover info, parameter what-if.

BI-10Power BI ServiceIntermediateMust Know

Desktop me banao, Service me publish karo. Workspace, refresh, gateway, app aur sharing se report users tak pahunchti hai.

Simple me samjho

Desktop workshop hai jahan report banti hai. Service dukaan hai jahan sab log use dekhte hain. Publish karne ke baad data fresh rakhna refresh ka kaam hai.

Key points

  • Workspaces: reports, semantic models aur dashboards ka shared folder. Roles: Admin, Member, Contributor, Viewer.
  • Publish: Desktop se Publish karke workspace me report aur semantic model upload hote hain.
  • Scheduled refresh: Import mode ka data schedule pe refresh hota hai. Refresh ki frequency license/capacity pe depend karti hai.
  • Gateway: on-premises ya private network ke data source ke liye On-premises data gateway chahiye. Cloud sources ko aam taur par gateway nahi chahiye.
  • Credentials: dataset settings me data source credentials set karne padte hain, warna refresh fail hota hai.
  • Apps: workspace content ko polished bundle ki tarah audience ko publish karna. Viewers ko workspace access nahi dena padta.
  • Sharing: report ka link share, ya workspace/app access. Sharing ke liye license (Pro, PPU ya Premium/Fabric capacity) ki rules hoti hain.
  • Dashboards: Service me pinned tiles ka single-page view, alag se reports se.
  • Usage metrics: report ke views, viewers aur trends dikhate hain. Adoption track karne ke liye.
  • Deployment pipelines: dev, test, prod stages (Premium/Fabric feature, availability check karo).

Example

Workflow: 1. Desktop me report banao aur data source se connect. 2. Publish to workspace "Poker Analytics". 3. On-prem Postgres hai to gateway install karke dataset ko map karo. 4. Dataset settings me credentials, Scheduled refresh: daily 6:00 AM. 5. Workspace se "Poker KPI App" publish karo aur audience ko access do. 6. Usage metrics se dekho kitne log report khol rahe hain.

Refresh fail ho to Refresh history me error dekho (credentials ya gateway offline sabse common).

Common mistakes

  • Gateway offline ya credentials expire hone se refresh fail hona, alert na lagana.
  • Saare users ko workspace Member bana dena, jabki App ya Viewer enough hai.
  • Dev aur prod ek hi workspace me rakhna.
  • Viewers ke liye RLS lagana bhool jaana, jabki data sensitive hai.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Gateway kab chahiye?
    A. Jab data source on-premises ya private network me ho aur Service ko refresh ke liye us tak pahunchna ho.
  • Q. App aur workspace share me fark?
    A. App curated, read-only package hota hai audience ke liye. Workspace access team members ke liye hota hai jo content edit karte hain.
  • Q. Refresh fail ho to kya dekhoge?
    A. Refresh history ka error, credentials, gateway status, aur source query timeout.

Yaad rakho

Publish to workspace, set credentials, gateway for on-prem, schedule refresh, share via app, track via usage metrics.

BI-11Tableau: fundamentalsIntermediateGood to Have

Tableau me fields dimensions ya measures hote hain, discrete ya continuous. Marks card aur calculated fields se visual banta hai.

Simple me samjho

Tableau me tum fields ko shelves pe drag karte ho aur chart ban jaata hai. Dimension se data slice hota hai, measure se number aata hai.

Key points

  • Dimensions: qualitative fields (country, game, user_id). Group aur slice karne ke liye.
  • Measures: quantitative fields (revenue, bet). Aggregate hote hain: SUM, AVG, COUNTD.
  • Discrete vs continuous: discrete (blue pill) alag headers/labels banata hai. Continuous (green pill) ek axis banata hai. Date discrete (Month name) ya continuous (timeline) dono ho sakti hai.
  • Rows aur Columns shelves: chart ka structure. Columns = x, Rows = y.
  • Marks card: Color, Size, Label, Detail, Tooltip, Shape aur mark type (bar, line, circle). Detail se granularity badhti hai bina visual change.
  • Filters shelf: fields se filter. Dimension filter, measure filter, date filter.
  • Calculated fields: custom formula, jaise [Revenue] - [Cost]. Row-level (har row pe) ya aggregate (SUM ke saath).
  • Show Me: chart type suggestion.
  • Data source: Connection, Live ya Extract, joins/relationships.
  • Sheet aur workbook: sheet = ek chart, workbook = sheets + dashboards.

Example

Calculated fields (Tableau syntax):

text
Profit = [Revenue] - [Cost]

Margin % = SUM([Profit]) / SUM([Revenue])

Player Type =
IF [Deposits] >= 1000 THEN "High"
ELSEIF [Deposits] >= 100 THEN "Mid"
ELSE "Low"
END

Days Active = DATEDIFF('day', [First Play], [Last Play])

Pehla row-level calc hai (har row pe). Doosra aggregate calc hai kyunki SUM ke saath hai, isliye ratio of sums sahi aata hai. Average of row-level margin se alag hota hai.

Common mistakes

  • Dimension ko measure samajhna (ID ko SUM karna). Aggregation check karo.
  • Discrete aur continuous ka fark na jaanna, jisse date chart ajeeb dikhta hai.
  • Aggregate aur row-level calc mix karna, error "cannot mix aggregate and non-aggregate" aata hai.
  • Ratio ko average of ratios se nikalna. Ratio of sums use karo.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Discrete aur continuous me fark?
    A. Discrete separate buckets/headers banata hai (blue). Continuous unbroken axis banata hai (green), jaise timeline.
  • Q. Marks card ka kya kaam?
    A. Visual ke properties control karta hai: color, size, label, detail, tooltip, shape.
  • Q. Row-level aur aggregate calculation me fark?
    A. Row-level har record pe chalta hai. Aggregate SUM/AVG jaise function ke saath group level pe chalta hai.

Yaad rakho

Blue = discrete, green = continuous; dimension slices, measure aggregates; Marks card se look control.

BI-12Tableau: LOD and table calcsAdvancedGood to Have

LOD expressions (FIXED, INCLUDE, EXCLUDE) granularity control karte hain. Table calcs visual ke result pe chalte hain, jaise running total aur rank.

Simple me samjho

Normally Tableau visual ki granularity pe aggregate karta hai. LOD se tum bolte ho "is dimension pe aggregate karo, visual kuch bhi ho." Table calc visual ke displayed numbers pe aage kaam karta hai.

Key points

  • FIXED: sirf diye dimensions pe compute, visual ki dimensions ignore. {FIXED [Region] : SUM([Sales])}.
  • INCLUDE: visual ki dimensions ke saath ek aur dimension add karke compute. {INCLUDE [Customer] : SUM([Sales])}.
  • EXCLUDE: visual ki dimensions me se ek hatakar compute. {EXCLUDE [Region] : SUM([Sales])}.
  • Table-scoped FIXED: {FIXED : SUM([Sales])} poore data ka ek total deta hai.
  • Order of operations: Extract filters, data source filters, context filters, FIXED LOD, dimension filters, INCLUDE/EXCLUDE, measure filters, table calcs. Isliye FIXED normal dimension filter se affect nahi hota (context filter se hota hai).
  • Running total: RUNNING_SUM(SUM([Sales])). Direction "Compute using" se set hoti hai.
  • Rank: RANK(SUM([Sales])). Variants: RANK_DENSE, RANK_UNIQUE.
  • Other table calcs: WINDOW_AVG, LOOKUP, INDEX, TOTAL, percent difference from.
  • Compute using / addressing: table calc kis dimension ke across chalega (Table down, Region, etc.).
  • LOD vs table calc: LOD database level pe granular, table calc sirf visible marks pe.

Example

text
Region Sales =
{FIXED [Region] : SUM([Sales])}

Share of Region =
SUM([Sales]) / SUM({FIXED [Region] : SUM([Sales])})

Customer First Order =
{FIXED [Customer ID] : MIN([Order Date])}

Cumulative Sales =
RUNNING_SUM(SUM([Sales]))

Sales Rank =
RANK(SUM([Sales]))

Avg Per Customer =
AVG({INCLUDE [Customer ID] : SUM([Sales])})

Customer First Order cohort analysis me use hota hai: har customer ki first order date, phir usi se month-wise group.

Common mistakes

  • Dimension filter lagake FIXED ka total badalne ki ummeed. Filter ko context me add karo.
  • Table calc ka "Compute using" galat rehna, to running total ya rank galat dimension pe chalta hai.
  • LOD aur table calc ko same samajhna. LOD pehle chalta hai, table calc baad me.
  • Zyada LODs se performance slow. Sirf zaroorat pe use karo.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. FIXED, INCLUDE, EXCLUDE me fark?
    A. FIXED sirf listed dimensions pe, INCLUDE visual me dimension add karta hai, EXCLUDE visual se hatata hai.
  • Q. FIXED dimension filter se kyun affect nahi hota?
    A. Order of operations me FIXED dimension filters se pehle chalta hai. Context filter lagana padta hai.
  • Q. Running total kaise banate ho?
    A. RUNNING_SUM(SUM([Sales])) ya Quick Table Calculation, aur Compute using sahi set karo.

Yaad rakho

LOD granularity badalta hai (FIXED pehle), table calc visible numbers pe aage chalta hai.

BI-13Tableau: dashboards and publishingIntermediateGood to Have

Tableau dashboard me actions aur parameters interactivity dete hain. Extract ya live connection chuno aur Server/Cloud pe publish karo.

Simple me samjho

Sheets jodke dashboard banta hai. Actions se sheets ek doosre se baat karti hain. Publish karne se team browser me use dekh sakti hai.

Key points

  • Dashboard: kai sheets, text, images ek layout me. Layout containers (horizontal/vertical), Fixed ya Automatic size.
  • Filter action: ek sheet pe click karo, doosri filter ho. Dashboard menu se Actions me banao.
  • Highlight action: related marks ko highlight karta hai, baaki dim.
  • Go to Sheet / URL actions: doosre sheet ya web link pe jaana.
  • Set aur Parameter actions: click se set ya parameter value badalna.
  • Parameters: user-input value (number, string, date) jo calculation ya filter me use hoti hai. Jaise Top N selector.
  • Live vs extract: live seedha database ko query karta hai (fresh, par DB load). Extract (.hyper) snapshot hai, fast, schedule se refresh.
  • Tableau Server aur Tableau Cloud: publish karne ki jagah. Server self-hosted, Cloud Tableau ka hosted version. Dono me permissions, schedules, subscriptions.
  • Tableau Desktop: authoring tool. Publish: Server menu, Publish Workbook ya Data Source.
  • Projects aur permissions: content folders me, user/group-wise access.
  • Device layouts: phone/tablet ke liye alag layout.

Example

Dashboard "Revenue by Region":

  • Left: map of regions, Right: bar of games by revenue.
  • Filter action: map pe region click karo to bar chart us region ka dikhata hai.
  • Parameter "Top N" (integer) se games ki list ka size user chuna.
  • Data source: Extract, refresh daily 5:00 AM schedule.
  • Publish to Tableau Cloud, project "Poker BI", group "Ops" ko view permission.

Extract refresh fail ho to Server/Cloud ke background tasks me dekho. Live connection chuno jab real-time chahiye aur DB handle kar sake.

Common mistakes

  • Live connection pe heavy dashboard chalana, jisse production DB slow hota hai.
  • Actions ko galat source/target sheets pe set karna.
  • Extract schedule na lagana, to stale data.
  • Publish karte waqt permissions na dekhna, galat log data dekh lete hain.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Extract aur live me fark?
    A. Live har baar DB query karta hai. Extract ek snapshot (.hyper) hai jo fast hai par schedule pe refresh hota hai.
  • Q. Dashboard action kya hai?
    A. Click ya select par doosri sheets ko filter, highlight ya navigate karna.
  • Q. Parameter aur filter me fark?
    A. Filter data ko subset karta hai. Parameter ek input value hai jo calculation ya filter me use hoti hai.

Yaad rakho

Actions se interactivity, parameters se user input, extract for speed, publish to Server/Cloud with permissions.

BI-14Looker, Looker Studio, Metabase, SupersetIntermediateGood to Have

Self-serve BI tools ke basics: Looker me LookML model, Looker Studio free dashboards, Metabase saved questions aur Superset open-source dashboards.

Simple me samjho

Har tool ka goal same hai: non-technical user bina SQL ke data dekh sake. Fark ye hai ki metrics kaun define karta hai aur kitna code chahiye.

Key points

  • Self-serve BI: business users khud filter, group aur chart banate hain. Analysts data model ek baar set karte hain.
  • Looker: Google Cloud ka BI platform. Data model LookML me define hota hai, jisse sabko same metrics milte hain.
  • LookML awareness: code-based modelling language. Mukhya cheezen: views (table ya dimension/measure), explores (jahan se users query karte hain), models. Version control (Git) ke saath.
  • Looker Studio: Google ka free dashboard tool (pehle Data Studio). Google Sheets, BigQuery, connectors se simple report. Light modelling.
  • Metabase: open-source (aur paid) BI. Questions (query builder ya SQL), dashboards, collections. Easy for non-SQL users.
  • Saved questions (Metabase): ek saved query/chart jo dashboards me use hota hai aur reuse hota hai.
  • Superset: Apache Superset, open-source. SQL Lab se queries, datasets, charts, dashboards. Zyada customisation, thoda setup.
  • Choose karna: governance chahiye to Looker, free aur quick to Looker Studio, simple self-serve to Metabase, open-source flexibility to Superset.
  • Common limit: sab me metric definitions ek jagah rakhna zaroori hai warna numbers alag aate hain.

Example

Same KPI "Active users" 4 tools me:

ToolKahan define hota hai
LookerLookML measure (count of distinct user_id)
Looker StudioReport me calculated field
MetabaseSaved question / metric ya model
SupersetDataset me saved metric

Looker me ek baar LookML me measure likhne se sab dashboards same definition use karte hain. Doosre tools me discipline chahiye.

Common mistakes

  • Har analyst ka apni query me metric alag define karna.
  • Tool chunne me sirf cost dekhna, governance ignore karna.
  • LookML ya data model ke bina Looker ka fayda nahi, model pehle banao.
  • Saved questions ka naam/owner na rakhna, purane ki bheed lag jaati hai.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. LookML kya hai?
    A. Looker ki modelling language jisme dimensions, measures aur joins (explores) code me define hote hain. Isse metrics consistent rehte hain.
  • Q. Looker Studio aur Looker me fark?
    A. Looker Studio free, simple dashboards ke liye. Looker enterprise platform hai jisme governed LookML model hota hai.
  • Q. Metabase me saved question kya?
    A. Ek saved query (GUI ya SQL) jo chart/table banti hai aur dashboard me reuse hoti hai.

Yaad rakho

Self-serve ka matlab ek governed model: Looker = LookML, Metabase = questions, Superset = SQL Lab + datasets, Studio = free quick dashboards.

BI-15Dashboard performance tuningAdvancedGood to Have

Slow dashboard ko extracts, aggregate tables, kam visuals aur incremental refresh se fast banao. Pehle measure karo, phir optimise.

Simple me samjho

Dashboard 20 second me khule to koi use nahi karega. Slowness ke 3 reason hote hain: zyada data, bhaari queries, zyada visuals. Pehle bottleneck dhundho, phir fix.

Key points

  • Measure first: Power BI me Performance Analyzer, Tableau me Performance Recorder. Pata chale kaunsa visual ya query slow hai.
  • Extracts / Import mode: data ko tool ke fast engine me load karo (Tableau extract, Power BI Import). Live/DirectQuery se tez hota hai, par data fresh nahi.
  • Aggregate tables: pre-summarised table (daily level) banao, row-level nahi. Dashboard chhoti table se query karta hai. Power BI me aggregations feature bhi hai, ya SQL/dbt me summary table.
  • Fewer visuals: har visual ek query hai. Page pe visuals kam rakho, zarurat ho to alag page.
  • Incremental refresh: sirf naya/recent data refresh, poora nahi. Power BI me RangeStart aur RangeEnd parameters se set hota hai. Tableau me extract incremental refresh hota hai.
  • Reduce columns aur rows: jo use nahi ho wo load mat karo. High-cardinality columns (user_id, timestamp) model bhaari karte hain.
  • Star schema aur simple DAX: achha model aur measures me iterators ka kam use.
  • Filters: default date range chhoti rakho. Apply button wale filters se baar baar query nahi chalti.
  • Query folding: source pe heavy kaam, Power Query me nahi.
  • Calculated columns kam: source ya SQL view me banao.

Example

Problem: "Hands" dashboard 30 sec, 200M rows, live DirectQuery.

text
Step 1: Performance Analyzer: top 2 visuals 80% time lete hain
Step 2: SQL me daily summary table:
        date, game_type, country, hands, rake, active_users
Step 3: Dashboard summary table se, detail sirf drill-through pe
Step 4: Import mode + incremental refresh (last 7 days refresh)
Result: load time 30 sec se kuch second tak

Detail data tabhi query hota hai jab user drill kare, to default view hamesha fast rehta hai. (Numbers sirf illustration hain.)

Common mistakes

  • Bina measure kiye guess se optimise karna.
  • Row-level fact table seedha dashboard se chalana jab daily level kaafi hai.
  • Ek page pe 25 visuals aur 10 slicers.
  • Incremental refresh me date column galat ya late-arriving data ignore karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Slow dashboard kaise debug karte ho?
    A. Pehle Performance Analyzer/Recorder se slow visual ya query dhundhta hoon. Phir data size, model, DAX aur visuals count dekhta hoon.
  • Q. Aggregate table kyun?
    A. Chhoti summary table se query fast hoti hai. Detail tabhi hit hota hai jab zaroori ho.
  • Q. Incremental refresh kya hai?
    A. Sirf recent partitions refresh hote hain, poora data nahi. Refresh time aur load kam hota hai.

Yaad rakho

Measure, phir shrink: kam data, kam visuals, pre-aggregate, incremental refresh.

BI-16Row-level security and accessAdvancedGood to Have

RLS se tay hota hai kaun user kaunsi rows dekhe. Roles banao, filter rules lagao aur user ban ke test karo.

Simple me samjho

Ek hi report, par Delhi ka manager sirf Delhi ka data dekhe aur CEO sab dekhe. Ye RLS hai. Security data level pe lagti hai, report hide karke nahi.

Key points

  • Role: access rule ka naam (jaise "Region Manager"). Users ko role me assign karte hain.
  • Filter rule: role pe table filter (DAX expression). Jaise [Region] = "North".
  • Static RLS: har role ke liye fixed value. Simple par roles zyada ho jaate hain.
  • Dynamic RLS: logged-in user se rule. Power BI me USERPRINCIPALNAME() ko mapping table ke email se match karte hain.
  • Mapping table: user_email aur allowed region ki table. Naya user = ek row add, role change nahi.
  • Power BI: Desktop me Manage roles, Service me semantic model security me members add. Workspace Admin/Member/Contributor ko RLS apply nahi hota, sirf Viewer jaise access par hota hai.
  • Tableau: user filters, data source filter me USERNAME() ya FULLNAME(), aur ISMEMBEROF() group check.
  • Testing: Power BI me "View as role" (aur specific user). Tableau me "View as user" option (permissions ke hisaab se available).
  • Object-level aur column: sensitive columns ke liye alag mechanism ya hide.
  • Principle: least privilege, sirf jo zaroori ho wo dikhao.

Example

text
Role "Region Manager" filter on Dim_Region:
[ManagerEmail] = USERPRINCIPALNAME()

Mapping table Dim_Region:
Region | ManagerEmail
North  | a@example.com
South  | b@example.com

a@example.com login kare to sirf North ki rows dikhegi. Relationship Dim_Region se Fact tak filter propagate karti hai, isliye fact table pe alag filter nahi lagana padta.

Test: Desktop me Modeling, View as, role chuno aur "Other user" me email daalo. Total numbers us region ke match hone chahiye.

Common mistakes

  • Sirf report me filter hide karna, jabki data model me security nahi.
  • Sab ko workspace Member banana, to RLS bypass ho jaata hai.
  • RLS ko user ban ke test na karna.
  • Real emails ya sensitive values test data me hardcode karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Static aur dynamic RLS me fark?
    A. Static me har role ka fixed filter hota hai. Dynamic me logged-in user (USERPRINCIPALNAME) se mapping table ke through rows decide hoti hain.
  • Q. RLS test kaise karte ho?
    A. "View as" role ya user se report kholke totals aur rows verify karta hoon.
  • Q. Kise RLS apply nahi hota Power BI me?
    A. Jinke paas workspace me edit rights hain (Admin, Member, Contributor). Viewers par hota hai.

Yaad rakho

Role + filter rule + mapping table, aur hamesha "view as user" se test karo.

BI-17Dashboard testing and validationIntermediateMust Know

Dashboard ke numbers SQL se reconcile karo, filters aur edge cases test karo, aur UAT me stakeholders se confirm karao.

Simple me samjho

Galat number wala dashboard bina dashboard se bura hai, kyunki log us pe bharosa karke decision lete hain. Release se pehle checklist chalao.

Key points

  • Reconcile with SQL: dashboard ke KPI ko independent SQL query se match karo (same filters, same date range). Difference ka reason dhundho.
  • Source of truth: jo finance/ops report maanti hai, usse bhi compare karo.
  • Totals vs details: grand total aur sum of rows match ho. Double counting (join fan-out) check karo.
  • Filter testing: har slicer alone aur combination me test karo. "All" selection aur single select dono.
  • Edge cases: empty data, ek hi row, nulls, naye users, month boundaries, timezone cutoffs, leap days, negative values.
  • Date logic: last 7 days kya include karta hai (aaj ya nahi), timezone UTC vs local.
  • Cross-filter aur drill: drill-through aur cross-filtering se numbers sahi rehte hain.
  • Performance aur refresh: load time, scheduled refresh chalta hai ya nahi.
  • Access: RLS users ke role me test.
  • UAT: stakeholders real use-cases pe chalate hain aur sign-off dete hain. Feedback aur issues log.
  • Document: test cases aur results rakho.

Example

KPI "Deposits last 7 days" check:

sql
SELECT SUM(amount) AS deposits_7d
FROM transactions
WHERE type = 'deposit'
  AND status = 'success'
  AND created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND created_at <  CURRENT_DATE;

Dashboard ke card se compare karo. Mismatch aaye to check: status filter, timezone, refunds, duplicates, refresh time. PostgreSQL syntax hai, doosre DB me interval alag ho sakta hai.

Checklist table:

CheckResult
KPI vs SQLMatch
Country filter = IndiaMatch
Empty date range"No data" message

Common mistakes

  • Sirf visual dekhke "theek lag raha hai" kehna.
  • Dashboard aur SQL me alag filter/definition par compare karna.
  • Edge cases (timezone, nulls) ko test na karna.
  • Stakeholder sign-off ke bina production me daalna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Dashboard validate kaise karte ho?
    A. Independent SQL se KPIs reconcile, filters aur edge cases test, phir stakeholders ke saath UAT.
  • Q. Numbers match na ho to?
    A. Definition, filters, timezone, joins se duplicates, refresh time aur data freshness check karta hoon.
  • Q. UAT kya hai?
    A. User Acceptance Testing: end users real scenarios pe dashboard check karke sign-off dete hain.

Yaad rakho

Reconcile with SQL, test filters aur edge cases, UAT sign-off, phir release.

BI-18Dashboard documentation and adoptionIntermediateMust Know

Dashboard ke saath definitions, owner aur refresh time likho. Training do, usage track karo aur unused dashboards retire karo.

Simple me samjho

Banana aadha kaam hai. Log use na karein ya samajh na paayein to dashboard bekaar hai. Documentation aur adoption ek ongoing kaam hai.

Key points

  • Definitions on the page: har KPI ki definition page pe (info icon ya footnote). Jaise "Active user = kam se kam ek hand in 24h".
  • Owner: dashboard ka naam, owner/contact, aur team likho. Sawal kisse poochna hai pata ho.
  • Refresh time: "Last refreshed: date time" dikhao. Data kab tak ka hai clear ho.
  • Data source aur lineage: kaunsa table/query use hota hai.
  • Change log: kya badla, kab, kisne. Version history.
  • Training: chhoti walkthrough session, 1-page guide, ya short video. Naye users ke liye.
  • Usage tracking: Power BI usage metrics, Tableau admin views jaise tools se views, unique users, last opened.
  • Feedback loop: channel ya form jahan users issue ya request bhejein.
  • Retire unused dashboards: 90 din se koi view nahi to owner ko poochke archive/delete. Clutter se trust ghatta hai.
  • Naming aur folders: consistent naming, certified vs experimental alag.

Example

Dashboard "Cash Game KPI" ke page ka footer:

text
Owner: Analytics team (analytics@example.com)
Last refreshed: daily 06:00 IST
Source: warehouse.cash_game_daily
Definitions:
- DAU: unique users with >= 1 hand in the day (IST)
- Rake: house commission from cash hands
Change log: v1.2 - added country filter

Quarterly review me usage dekho: agar "Old Promo Report" ko 90 din me 0 views mile, owner ko mail karke archive kar do.

Common mistakes

  • Definitions kisi doc me rakhna jo koi nahi padhta, dashboard me nahi.
  • Owner ka naam na hona, to issue ka koi jawab nahi deta.
  • Usage track na karna aur purane dashboards jama hona.
  • Training sirf launch pe dena, naye users ke liye nahi.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Dashboard adoption kaise badhate ho?
    A. Clear definitions, training, achha design, regular feedback aur usage metrics dekhke improve karna.
  • Q. Unused dashboards ka kya?
    A. Usage dekhke owner se confirm karke archive ya retire karte hain, taaki clutter aur confusion na ho.
  • Q. Page pe kya info honi chahiye?
    A. KPI definitions, owner, last refresh time, aur data source.

Yaad rakho

Definitions, owner, refresh time page pe; training do, usage dekho, unused ko retire karo.

BI-19Alerts and subscriptionsIntermediateGood to Have

Email subscriptions, threshold alerts aur scheduled snapshots se insight user tak khud pahunchta hai, dashboard kholne ki zaroorat nahi.

Simple me samjho

Roz dashboard kholna sab ko yaad nahi rehta. Isliye number ya snapshot seedha inbox me aa jaye. Alert tab bajta hai jab metric limit cross kare.

Key points

  • Email subscription: report ya dashboard ka snapshot schedule pe email (daily 8 AM). Link ke saath.
  • Threshold alerts: jab KPI limit cross kare (DAU 20% se kam ho, deposits zero) to notification. Power BI me data alerts dashboard tiles (card, gauge, KPI) pe lagte hain, Service me.
  • Scheduled snapshots: fixed time ka PDF/image/data. Reports ka record aur offline sharing.
  • Tableau: Server/Cloud me subscriptions aur data-driven alerts (numeric axis wale view pe).
  • Looker aur Metabase: scheduled deliveries (Looker), aur Metabase me dashboard subscriptions aur alerts available hain.
  • Power Automate: Power BI alerts se workflows (Teams message, email) trigger karne ke liye.
  • Audience: sahi log, sahi frequency. Weekly exec, daily ops.
  • Alert fatigue: bahut zyada alerts ignore ho jaate hain. Sirf actionable thresholds.
  • Threshold choice: static value ya historical baseline (average ya percentage change) se.
  • Data freshness: alert refresh ke baad hi chalta hai. Refresh nahi hua to alert nahi aayega.
  • RLS aur snapshot: subscription me user ke access ke hisaab se data hota hai, check karo.

Example

Poker ops alerts:

AlertRuleKisko
Deposits lowDeposits < 50% of last 7-day avgOps team
Payment fail spikeFailure rate > 5%Payments + on-call
Daily KPI mailDaily 8 AM snapshotLeadership

Setup (Power BI jaisa): dashboard tile pe "Manage alerts", condition above/below, frequency chuno. Alert sirf tab check hota hai jab data refresh ho.

Common mistakes

  • Har chhoti dip pe alert, alert fatigue.
  • Snapshot me stale data bhejna, refresh ke pehle schedule karna.
  • Alert ka owner ya action tay na hona.
  • Sensitive snapshot galat log ko bhejna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Subscription aur alert me fark?
    A. Subscription schedule pe aata hai (daily mail). Alert condition (threshold) pe trigger hota hai.
  • Q. Alert fatigue se kaise bachoge?
    A. Sirf actionable thresholds, sahi audience, aur noise kam karne ke liye baseline-based rules.
  • Q. Snapshot ka use?
    A. Fixed time ki copy, jaise daily PDF, record ya offline sharing ke liye.

Yaad rakho

Subscription = schedule, alert = threshold, aur alert tab jab actionable ho.

BI-20Semantic layer and certified datasetsAdvancedGood to Have

Semantic layer me metrics ek hi jagah define hote hain aur kai dashboards wahi use karte hain. Isse numbers sab jagah same rehte hain.

Simple me samjho

Agar 5 analysts "Active user" 5 tarah se calculate karein, to 5 alag numbers. Semantic layer me ek definition, sab use karte hain. Ye "single source of truth" ka BI wala roop hai.

Key points

  • Semantic layer: raw tables aur dashboards ke beech ka business layer. Isme metrics, dimensions, joins aur naam define hote hain.
  • One definition, many dashboards: "Revenue" ya "DAU" ek baar define, har report me reuse. Number change ho to ek jagah fix.
  • Power BI: shared semantic model (pehle "dataset" kehte the). Alag reports usse connect hoti hain. Endorsement: Promoted aur Certified.
  • Certified dataset: reviewed aur trusted marked data. Users ko pata chale kaunsa safe hai.
  • Tableau: published data sources, certified bhi ho sakte hain. Workbooks inhe use karte hain.
  • Looker: LookML model semantic layer ka kaam karta hai.
  • dbt aur others: dbt me metrics/semantic layer features hain (version aur edition check karo). Warehouse side par bhi ban sakta hai.
  • Governance: owner, definitions, change process, certification criteria.
  • Benefits: consistency, kam duplicate kaam, self-serve, kam reconciliation arguments.
  • Trade-off: central team ka bottleneck ho sakta hai. Naye metric ka process fast rakho.

Example

Problem: Finance dashboard "Net Revenue" = 1.2M, Marketing dashboard = 1.35M.

text
Fix:
1. Ek shared semantic model "Poker Core" banao.
2. Measure: Net Revenue = SUM(Fact[Gross]) - SUM(Fact[Bonus])
3. Certify the model, owner = Analytics.
4. Finance aur Marketing reports isi model se connect karein.

Ab dono dashboards same measure use karte hain, to numbers same aate hain. Naye measure ke liye model owner ko request jaati hai.

Common mistakes

  • Har report apna dataset aur apni calculation banata hai (metric sprawl).
  • Certified label bina review ke dena.
  • Definitions document na karna, to model hone par bhi confusion.
  • Central model me har request ko wait karwana, log shadow datasets bana lete hain.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Semantic layer kya hai?
    A. Business-friendly layer jahan metrics aur dimensions ek hi jagah define hote hain, aur sab dashboards unhe reuse karte hain.
  • Q. Certified dataset kyun?
    A. Trusted, reviewed source ka signal. Users galat ya duplicate data se bachte hain.
  • Q. Do dashboards ke numbers alag aayein to?
    A. Definition aur source compare karta hoon. Fix: dono ko ek shared semantic model/measure pe laana.

Yaad rakho

Define once, use everywhere: shared model + certification = same number sab jagah.

BI-21Maps and geospatialIntermediateBonus

Choropleth, point maps aur geocoding ke basics. Location data ko map pe sahi tarah dikhane ke liye naam ya coordinates clean hone chahiye.

Simple me samjho

Jab sawal "kahan" ka ho, tab map kaam aata hai (state-wise players). Warna bar chart kaafi hai. Map sunder dikhta hai par exact compare karna mushkil hota hai.

Key points

  • Choropleth (filled map): regions (state, country) ko value ke hisaab se shade karna. Rate ya ratio ke liye achha.
  • Normalise karo: raw count se bade regions hamesha dark dikhte hain. Per-capita ya rate use karo (players per 100k).
  • Point map (symbol map): har location ek point/bubble. Size = measure, colour = category. Cities ya individual events ke liye.
  • Geocoding: address ya place name ko latitude/longitude me badalna. Tools: Tableau me built-in geographic roles, Power BI me map visuals location fields (data category set karna).
  • Coordinates: latitude aur longitude numeric columns, direct plot ho jaate hain.
  • Clean location names: "Delhi" vs "New Delhi" vs "NCT of Delhi". Standard names ya codes (ISO country codes) use karo.
  • Ambiguity: ek naam ke kai places (Paris, TX vs Paris, France). Country/state column saath do.
  • Unmatched locations: unknown ya mismatch rows alag se dikhte hain. Count check karo.
  • Privacy: precise location (user ke ghar ke coordinates) sensitive hai. Aggregate level (state/city) pe dikhao.
  • Kab map nahi: agar sirf ranking chahiye to sorted bar chart better.
  • Boundaries: custom regions ke liye shapefile/GeoJSON support tool pe depend karta hai.

Example

India state-wise deposits per player:

StatePlayersDepositsPer player
Maharashtra50002,500,000500
Goa400300,000750

Raw deposits se Maharashtra sabse dark hota. Per player se Goa zyada dikhta hai, jo ek sachha insight hai. Tool me state field ka geographic role set karo (Tableau) ya data category State/Province (Power BI), phir color me ye measure daalo. (Numbers illustration ke liye hain.)

Common mistakes

  • Raw counts se choropleth banana, jisse sirf bade states chamakte hain.
  • Location names ka spelling mismatch, jisse points map pe nahi aate.
  • Map par zyada categories ya colours daalna.
  • Exact precise user locations dikhana, privacy risk.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Choropleth kab use karte ho?
    A. Jab region-level rate ya density dikhani ho. Raw count ki jagah normalised measure.
  • Q. Geocoding kya hai?
    A. Address ya place name ko latitude/longitude me convert karna taaki map pe plot ho sake.
  • Q. Map kab avoid karoge?
    A. Jab sirf ranking ya exact comparison chahiye, tab bar chart zyada clear hai.

Yaad rakho

Map tabhi jab "kahan" matter kare; choropleth me rate dikhao, aur location names clean rakho.

Data Modeling & Warehousing 14 topics

DW-01OLTP vs OLAPBasicMust Know
