  • Baseline ke bina model ki tareef.
  • Maintenance aur monitoring ka cost ignore karna.
  • Chhote improvement ke liye complexity badhana.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. ML kab nahi use karoge?
    A. Jab simple rule kaafi ho, data/labels kam ho, ya explainability aur maintenance cost zyada ho.
  • Q. Baseline kya hota hai?
    A. Sabse simple reference method (average, rule). Naya model isse behtar hona chahiye, tab hi worth hai.

Yaad rakho

Rules aur baseline pehle. ML tab jab fayda maintenance cost se bada ho.

ML-12Working with data scientistsIntermediateGood to Have

Data scientists ke saath kaam: feature tables, clear definitions aur handoffs. Analyst ka kaam data ko ML-ready aur trustworthy banana hai.

Simple me samjho

Data scientist ko chef samjho, analyst ko wo jo saaf, kata hua saman (data) deta hai. Saman galat ya unclear ho to best chef bhi achha khana nahi bana sakta.

Key points

  • Feature table: Ek row = ek entity (player) per snapshot date, columns = features + label.
  • Snapshot date: Features sirf us date se pehle ke data se. Label us date ke baad ke window se.
  • Point-in-time correctness: Future data feature me na aaye (leakage).
  • Definitions: Churn, active, deposit, session: sab ki exact definition likho (data dictionary).
  • Grain check: Row count aur unique player count match karo. Duplicates nahi.
  • Fan-out: Do fact tables ko seedha join karne se rows multiply hote hain. Pehle aggregate karo, phir join.
  • Data quality: Nulls, outliers, test accounts, bots, timezone.
  • Handoff: SQL code, table schema, refresh schedule, owner, known issues share karo.
  • Communication: Business sawal, success metric, aur kaise use hoga, pehle clear karo.

Example

sql
-- one row per user for snapshot 2026-10-01 (PostgreSQL)
WITH s AS (
  SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS sessions_30d
  FROM sessions
  WHERE started_at >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND started_at < DATE '2026-10-01'
  GROUP BY user_id
), t AS (
  SELECT user_id, SUM(amount) AS deposit_30d
  FROM transactions
  WHERE type = 'deposit'
    AND created_at >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND created_at < DATE '2026-10-01'
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT u.user_id, DATE '2026-10-01' AS snapshot_date,
       COALESCE(s.sessions_30d, 0) AS sessions_30d,
       COALESCE(t.deposit_30d, 0)  AS deposit_30d
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN s ON s.user_id = u.user_id
LEFT JOIN t ON t.user_id = u.user_id;

Dono tables alag CTE me aggregate hue, to join me fan-out nahi hua. Window 1 Oct se pehle ki hai, to leakage nahi.

Common mistakes

  • Churn ya active ki alag alag definition use karna.
  • Feature window me snapshot ke baad ka data aa jana.
  • Duplicate rows ya fan-out join.
  • Handoff me documentation aur owner na dena.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Feature table me kya check karoge?
    A. Grain (ek row per player/date), point-in-time correctness, null handling, aur row count reconcile.
  • Q. Data scientist ko handoff kaise doge?
    A. SQL, data dictionary, refresh schedule, known issues aur owner ke saath.

Yaad rakho

Clear definitions, point-in-time features, one row per entity, documented handoff.

ML-13GenAI and LLM tools for analystsBasicGood to Have

LLM tools SQL/Python me madad karte hain, par output hamesha validate karo. Sensitive ya player data public tools me kabhi mat paste karo.

Simple me samjho

LLM ek tez junior assistant hai: jaldi draft deta hai, par kabhi confidently galat bhi hota hai. Draft use karo, par zimmedari tumhari hai.

Key points

  • Use cases: SQL/Python draft, query explain, error debug, regex, doc/comment likhna, ideas.
  • Hallucination: LLM galat column, function ya statistic bana sakta hai. Sab check karo.
  • Validate SQL: Chhote sample pe chalao, row count, join fan-out, NULL handling aur date filters check karo.
  • Validate numbers: Known total ya purane report se reconcile karo. LLM ke "insights" ko data se verify karo.
  • Statistics: AI ki test ya p-value ki explanation khud verify karo (assumptions, formula).
  • Data privacy: Player PII (name, email, phone), real transactions, KYC, credentials, connection strings, API keys public tools me nahi.
  • Safe way: Sirf schema aur dummy/synthetic rows share karo. Table/column names bhi sensitive ho sakte hain, to anonymise karo.
  • Company policy: Sirf approved tools use karo. Data retention aur training policy samjho.
  • Accountability: Final answer ka owner tum ho. "AI ne bola" excuse nahi.
  • Good prompt: Schema, goal, SQL dialect, sample dummy rows aur expected output batao.

Example

text
Prompt (safe, no real data):
"PostgreSQL. Tables: users(user_id, signup_date),
transactions(txn_id, user_id, amount, type, created_at).
Write a query: deposit total per user for last 30 days.
Return user_id, total_deposit. Use dummy table names only."

Output aaye to checklist: (1) sample pe run, (2) total ko known report se match, (3) join/filter review, (4) NULLs aur timezone check. Real player emails ya amounts prompt me kabhi nahi.

Common mistakes

  • Real player data ya credentials chat me paste karna.
  • AI ka SQL bina run kiye production report me daalna.
  • AI ke stats claims ko bina verify maan lena.
  • Unapproved personal AI account pe company data use karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. AI generated SQL pe bharosa kaise karte ho?
    A. Sample data pe run karta hun, row counts aur totals reconcile karta hun, joins/filters review karta hun, aur edge cases test karta hun.
  • Q. Data privacy ke liye kya dhyan rakhte ho?
    A. PII, real data aur secrets share nahi karta. Schema ya dummy data use karta hun aur company ke approved tools hi chalata hun.

Yaad rakho

AI draft deta hai, tum validate karte ho. Sensitive data kabhi paste nahi.

Cloud & Tools 14 topics

CT-01Git basicsBasicMust Know

Git code aur queries ka version control hai: clone, branch, commit, push, pull, merge request aur conflict resolve karna.

Simple me samjho

Git ek time machine jaisa hai. Har change ka snapshot (commit) save hota hai, aur team ke log alag branches me kaam karke baad me merge karte hain. Analyst ke liye SQL scripts, notebooks aur dbt models yahin rehte hain.

Key points

  • Repository (repo): Project folder jisme history track hoti hai.
  • clone: Remote repo ki local copy lena.
  • branch: Alag line of work. main ko direct touch nahi karte.
  • commit: Changes ka snapshot with message.
  • push / pull: Local commits remote par bhejna / remote ke naye changes laana.
  • Merge Request (MR): GitLab me review ke liye request. GitHub me ise Pull Request (PR) kehte hain.
  • merge conflict: Same lines ko do logon ne badla. Manually decide karna padta hai.
  • status / diff / log: git status, git diff, git log --oneline se haalat dekho.
  • Stage: git add se files commit ke liye select hoti hain.

Example

bash
git clone git@gitlab.com:team/analytics-sql.git
cd analytics-sql
git switch -c feature/retention-query      # new branch
# ... edit retention.sql ...
git status
git add retention.sql
git commit -m "Add D30 retention query for new cohorts"
git push -u origin feature/retention-query
# GitLab par Merge Request open karo
git pull origin main                        # main ke latest changes

Conflict aaye to file me markers dikhte hain:

text
  <<<<<<< HEAD
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users;
  =======
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM users;
  >>>>>>> feature/retention-query

Sahi version rakho, markers hatao, phir git add file aur git commit.

Common mistakes

  • main par direct commit karna.
  • Bina git pull kiye kaam shuru karna, to conflicts badhte hain.
  • Ek hi commit me unrelated changes daal dena.
  • Conflict markers (<<<<<<<) file me chhod ke commit karna.
  • git reset --hard ya force push bina samjhe chalana. Ye destructive hain.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. git fetch aur git pull me farak?
    A. fetch sirf remote ke changes laata hai. pull fetch ke saath merge bhi karta hai.
  • Q. Merge conflict kaise resolve karte ho?
    A. Conflict wali file kholta hoon, dono versions dekh ke sahi code rakhta hoon, markers hatata hoon, phir add aur commit karta hoon.

Yaad rakho

Branch banao, chhote commits karo, push karo, MR se merge karo.

CT-02Git workflow in teamsBasicMust Know

Team me feature branches, code review, clear commit messages, .gitignore, aur secrets kabhi commit na karna.

Simple me samjho

Team me sab ek hi repo par kaam karte hain. Isliye rules chahiye: har kaam ki alag branch, review ke baad merge, aur sensitive cheezein repo se bahar.

Key points

  • Feature branch: Har task ke liye alag branch, naam jaise feature/dau-dashboard, fix/null-revenue.
  • Base branch: Team ka main branch (e.g. main, staging). Project ke hisaab se check karo.
  • Code review: MR par teammate SQL logic, joins, filters review karta hai. Comments ka reply do aur fix push karo.
  • Small MRs: Chhote changes jaldi review hote hain.
  • Commit message: Clear aur specific. Kya aur kyun likho.
  • .gitignore: Un files ki list jo track nahi honi chahiye (data dumps, .env, notebooks outputs).
  • Never commit secrets: Passwords, API keys, tokens, connection strings. Environment variables ya secret manager use karo.
  • Agar secret commit ho gaya: Turant security team ko batao aur secret rotate karo. Sirf delete karna kaafi nahi, history me rehta hai.
  • Large data files repo me nahi rakhte.

Example

Acchi vs buri commit message:

text
Bad : "changes"
Good: "Fix double counting in daily revenue query by joining on order_id"

.gitignore example:

text
.env
*.csv
*.parquet
.ipynb_checkpoints/
__pycache__/

Typical flow:

bash
git switch -c fix/null-revenue
git add queries/daily_revenue.sql
git commit -m "Handle NULL amount in daily revenue query"
git push -u origin fix/null-revenue
# MR banao, reviewer assign karo, approval ke baad merge

.env.example me sirf variable ke naam rakho, values nahi.

Common mistakes

  • .env ya credentials commit karna. Real credentials kabhi code ya chat me paste mat karo.
  • Vague commit messages ("update", "fix").
  • Review ke bina merge karna.
  • Customer data ya CSV exports repo me daal dena.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Galti se password commit ho gaya, kya karoge?
    A. Turant team ya security ko batata hoon, password rotate karta hoon, aur history cleanup unki guidance se karta hoon. Sirf agle commit me hatana kaafi nahi.
  • Q. Code review me kya dekhte ho?
    A. Logic, joins ka duplication, filters, performance, naming, aur ki koi secret ya PII to nahi hai.

Yaad rakho

Feature branch, review, clear message, aur secrets kabhi repo me nahi.

CT-03Command line basicsBasicMust Know

Terminal ke basic commands: cd, ls, grep, curl, cron, ssh aur environment variables.

Simple me samjho

Command line me mouse ki jagah text commands se kaam hota hai. Servers, logs, aur automation ke liye ye zaroori hai. Shuru me kuch hi commands kaafi hain.

Key points

  • pwd, cd, ls: Kahan ho, folder badlo, files dekho. ls -la details aur hidden files dikhata hai.
  • cat, head, tail: File ka content ya start/end dekho.
  • grep: Text search. grep -i case-insensitive, -r recursive, -n line number.
  • Pipe |: Ek command ka output doosre ko do. cat file | grep error | wc -l.
  • curl: URL se request bhejna (API test).
  • cron: Scheduled jobs. Format: minute hour day month weekday command.
  • ssh: Remote server par login: ssh user@host.
  • Environment variables: export NAME=value, padho echo $NAME. Secrets code me nahi, env me rakho.
  • chmod, mkdir, cp, mv: Permissions, folder, copy, move. rm destructive hai, dhyan se.

Example

bash
cd ~/reports && ls -la
grep -rn "deposit" queries/ | head
grep -i "error" app.log | wc -l          # error lines count
export API_TOKEN="set-in-your-shell"      # placeholder, real token yahan paste mat karo
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_TOKEN" https://api.example.com/v1/stats
ssh analyst@reports-server

Cron: har weekday subah 9 baje script chalao.

text
0 9 * * 1-5 /home/analyst/run_report.sh >> /home/analyst/report.log 2>&1

Crontab edit karne ke liye crontab -e, list ke liye crontab -l. Cron ka timezone server ka hota hai.

Common mistakes

  • rm -rf bina path check kiye chalana.
  • Token ya password ko command me seedha likhna (shell history me save hota hai).
  • Cron job me full paths na dena, to job fail hota hai.
  • Cron ka timezone ignore karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. grep ka use kab karte ho?
    A. Logs ya code me pattern dhoondne ke liye, e.g. grep -i error app.log.
  • Q. Cron me 0 9 * * 1-5 ka matlab?
    A. Monday se Friday, subah 9:00 baje.

Yaad rakho

Chhote commands ko pipe se jodo, secrets env variables me rakho, delete se pehle path dekho.

CT-04SQL clients and IDEsBasicMust Know

Database se connect karne ke tools: DBeaver, DataGrip, pgAdmin, VS Code, aur saved connections ka sahi use.

Simple me samjho

SQL likhne aur chalane ke liye ek client chahiye. Ye tools database se connect hote hain aur results table me dikhate hain. Sahi tool aur safe connection setup se kaam fast aur secure hota hai.

Key points

  • DBeaver: Free universal client. Kai databases support karta hai (PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.).
  • DataGrip: JetBrains ka paid IDE. Strong autocomplete aur refactoring.
  • pgAdmin: PostgreSQL ke liye specific tool. Admin tasks aur query tool.
  • VS Code: Editor, extensions se SQL clients bhi mil jaate hain. Git integration achha hai.
  • Saved connections: Host, port, database, user save karo. Naam clear rakho (prod-readonly, staging).
  • Read-only user: Analysis ke liye read-only credentials use karo, taaki galti se data na badle.
  • SSH tunnel: Agar DB direct accessible nahi to tool ke SSH tab se tunnel set karo.
  • Result export: CSV export karte time PII dhyan se handle karo.
  • Query history aur scripts: Important queries Git me rakho.

Example

Typical connection settings (PostgreSQL):

text
Name     : analytics-prod-readonly
Host     : db.example.internal
Port     : 5432
Database : analytics
User     : analyst_ro        (read-only role)
Password : keep in the tool's secure store / password manager

Safe query habit:

sql
SELECT user_id, created_at
FROM users
WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
LIMIT 100;

LIMIT se pehle chhota result check karo, phir full run karo.

Common mistakes

  • Production DB par write access ke saath kaam karna.
  • Passwords ko plain-text scripts ya shared files me save karna.
  • Bina LIMIT ya date filter ke heavy query prod par chalana.
  • Autocommit on rakh ke UPDATE ya DELETE chalana.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Tum kaunsa SQL tool use karte ho aur kyun?
    A. Apna actual tool batao (e.g. DBeaver). Reason: multi-database support, saved connections, export features.
  • Q. Production DB se safely kaise connect karte ho?
    A. Read-only user, VPN ya SSH tunnel, aur credentials secure store me.

Yaad rakho

Read-only connection, LIMIT ke saath chhota test, aur credentials secure store me.

CT-05Cloud basicsIntermediateMust Know

AWS, GCP, Azure ke basics: storage, compute, IAM, regions aur cost awareness.

Simple me samjho

Cloud matlab kirae ke servers aur storage. Aap use ke hisaab se paise dete ho. Analyst ko pata hona chahiye data kahan rakha hai, kaun access kar sakta hai, aur query ka kharcha kya hai.

Key points

  • Storage: AWS S3, GCP Cloud Storage, Azure Blob Storage. Files (CSV, Parquet, logs) yahan rehti hain.
  • Compute: AWS EC2, GCP Compute Engine, Azure Virtual Machines. Servers jo code chalate hain.
  • Warehouses: AWS Redshift, GCP BigQuery, Azure Synapse (aur Snowflake teeno clouds par).
  • IAM: Identity and Access Management. Kaun kya kar sakta hai. Least privilege: sirf utna access jitna zaroori.
  • Region: Data center ki geography. Data residency aur latency par asar.
  • Cost awareness: Storage, compute time, data scanned, aur data egress (cloud se bahar data bhejna) ka charge lagta hai.
  • Budgets/alerts: Billing alerts set karo.
  • Cleanup: Unused resources (VMs, big tables, old exports) band ya delete karo (permission ke saath).
  • Pricing: Exact rates change hote hain, official pricing page dekho.

Example

AWS CLI se S3 dekhna aur download karna:

bash
aws s3 ls s3://my-analytics-bucket/exports/
aws s3 cp s3://my-analytics-bucket/exports/users.parquet ./users.parquet

Service mapping:

NeedAWSGCPAzure
File storageS3Cloud StorageBlob Storage
VMEC2Compute EngineVirtual Machines
WarehouseRedshiftBigQuerySynapse
Access controlIAMIAMEntra ID / RBAC

Common mistakes

  • Bucket ko publicly accessible chhod dena.
  • Broad admin access le lena jabki read access kaafi hai.
  • Data transfer ya scan cost ignore karna.
  • Alag region me data rakh ke compliance ya latency issue banana.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. IAM kya hai?
    A. Wo system jo decide karta hai kaun user ya service kis resource par kya action kar sakta hai. Least privilege follow karte hain.
  • Q. Cloud cost kaise kam karoge?
    A. Queries me kam data scan, unused resources band, storage lifecycle rules, aur budget alerts.

Yaad rakho

Storage, compute, access, region aur cost: ye paanchon cloud me hamesha yaad rakho.

CT-06Warehouse hands-onIntermediateMust Know

BigQuery, Redshift ya Snowflake me data load karna, query chalana aur query cost padhna.

Simple me samjho

Warehouse bada analytical database hai jo bahut data par fast aggregate karta hai. Data pehle load hota hai, phir SQL se query. Cost kaise lagta hai ye samajhna zaroori hai warna bill surprise deta hai.

Key points

  • BigQuery: Serverless. Default me query cost bytes scanned par depend karta hai. Capacity-based pricing bhi hota hai.
  • Redshift: Cluster-based (ya Serverless). Data S3 se COPY command se load hota hai.
  • Snowflake: Compute (virtual warehouse) aur storage alag. Cost credits me, warehouse size aur chalne ke time se.
  • Load data: BigQuery me bq load ya UI. Redshift me COPY. Snowflake me stage + COPY INTO.
  • File format: Parquet ya CSV. Parquet columnar aur efficient hota hai.
  • Read cost: BigQuery me query se pehle "bytes processed" dekho ya dry run karo.
  • Reduce cost: Sirf zaroori columns select karo (SELECT * avoid), partition filter lagao, LIMIT scan kam nahi karta (BigQuery me).
  • Partition/cluster: Date par partition karke scan kam karo.
  • Snowflake: Query ke baad warehouse auto-suspend rakho.

Example

bash
# BigQuery: file load aur dry run
bq load --autodetect --source_format=PARQUET mydataset.users gs://my-bucket/users.parquet
bq query --use_legacy_sql=false --dry_run \
  'SELECT user_id, SUM(amount) FROM mydataset.transactions
   WHERE dt >= "2026-11-01" GROUP BY user_id'

Dry run output bytes batata hai jo query process karegi, bina chalaye.

sql
-- Redshift: S3 se load
COPY transactions FROM 's3://my-bucket/transactions/'
IAM_ROLE 'arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redshift-copy' FORMAT AS PARQUET;

Common mistakes

  • SELECT * par bade table scan karna.
  • Partition filter na lagana.
  • Snowflake warehouse ko bina suspend ke chalte chhod dena.
  • Bina dry run ya EXPLAIN ke heavy query prod warehouse par chalana.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. BigQuery me cost kaise control karoge?
    A. Partition filter, sirf zaroori columns, dry run se bytes check, aur results ko intermediate table me save karna.
  • Q. Snowflake me cost kis par depend karta hai?
    A. Warehouse size aur uske chalne ke time par (credits), plus storage.

Yaad rakho

Query chalane se pehle dekho kitna data scan hoga: columns kam, partition filter zaroor.

CT-07Docker basicsIntermediateBonus

Docker se app ya database container me chalate hain. Images, containers aur local PostgreSQL chalane ka tareeka.

Simple me samjho

Container ek chhota packed dabba hai jisme app aur uske saare dependencies hote hain. Har machine par same chalta hai. Analyst ke liye sabse useful: ek command me local database chalana.

Key points

  • Image: Read-only template (e.g. postgres:16). Recipe jaisa.
  • Container: Image ka running instance.
  • docker pull / docker run: Image lana / container start karna.
  • Port mapping: -p 5432:5432 host port ko container port se jodta hai.
  • Environment variables: -e se settings dete hain (e.g. POSTGRES_PASSWORD).
  • Volume: Data container delete hone par bhi bacha rahe, iske liye -v.
  • docker ps, logs, stop, rm: Status, logs, band, delete.
  • docker exec: Running container ke andar command chalana (e.g. psql).
  • Docker Compose: docker-compose.yml me multiple services ek file se (docker compose up -d).

Example

bash
docker run -d --name pg-local \
  -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=localdev_only \
  -p 5432:5432 \
  -v pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data \
  postgres:16

docker ps
docker exec -it pg-local psql -U postgres
docker logs pg-local
docker stop pg-local

Ab localhost:5432 par DBeaver se connect kar sakte ho. Ye password sirf local practice ke liye hai, real credentials kabhi aise mat likho.

Common mistakes

  • Volume ke bina data rakhna, container delete hote hi data gaya.
  • Real ya production credentials local containers me use karna.
  • Port already in use hone par container fail hona (port badlo).
  • docker rm ya volume delete karna bina soche. Data jaa sakta hai.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Image aur container me farak?
    A. Image template hai, container uska chalta hua instance.
  • Q. Analyst Docker kyun seekhe?
    A. Local database ya tools jaldi setup karne ke liye aur environment same rakhne ke liye.

Yaad rakho

Image = recipe, container = dish: data ke liye volume lagao.

CT-08APIs and JSONBasicGood to Have

REST APIs se data kaise lete hain: methods, auth, status codes, JSON aur Postman.

Simple me samjho

API ek counter hai jahan se aap request bhejte ho aur server data wapas deta hai, aksar JSON format me. Analyst ko APIs se data pulling, aur logs/dashboards ke JSON padhna aana chahiye.

Key points

  • REST: HTTP methods: GET (read), POST (create), PUT/PATCH (update), DELETE.
  • JSON: Key-value text format. Objects {} aur arrays [].
  • Auth: API key, Bearer token, ya OAuth. Token header me bhejte hain: Authorization: Bearer <token>.
  • Status codes: 200 OK, 201 Created, 400 Bad Request, 401 Unauthorized, 403 Forbidden, 404 Not Found, 429 Too Many Requests, 500 Server Error.
  • Query params: URL me filters, e.g. ?from=2026-11-01&limit=100.
  • Pagination: Bada data pages me aata hai. Loop me saare pages lao.
  • Rate limits: Zyada requests par 429. Retry with delay.
  • Postman: GUI tool jisme requests banate, save aur test karte ho.
  • Secrets: Token env variable ya Postman environment me, code me nahi.

Example

bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_TOKEN" \
  "https://api.example.com/v1/users?limit=2"

Response JSON:

json
{"data": [{"id": 1, "country": "IN"}, {"id": 2, "country": "US"}], "next_page": 2}

Python me:

python
import os, requests, pandas as pd
r = requests.get("https://api.example.com/v1/users",
                 headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['API_TOKEN']}"},
                 params={"limit": 100}, timeout=30)
r.raise_for_status()
df = pd.json_normalize(r.json()["data"])

raise_for_status() 4xx ya 5xx par error deta hai.

Common mistakes

  • Token ko code ya Git me hardcode karna.
  • Status code check na karna aur error response ko data samajh lena.
  • Pagination ignore karke sirf pehla page lena.
  • Rate limit hit karna bina retry ya delay ke.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. 401 aur 403 me farak?
    A. 401 = authentication fail (login ya token galat). 403 = authenticated hai, par permission nahi.
  • Q. json_normalize kyun?
    A. Nested JSON ko flat table me convert karne ke liye.

Yaad rakho

Request bhejo, status code check karo, pagination handle karo, token secret rakho.

CT-09Jira, Confluence, NotionBasicMust Know

Tickets, sprint boards aur documentation ki aadat: kaam track karna aur knowledge likh ke rakhna.

Simple me samjho

Jira kaam ka tracker hai, Confluence aur Notion documentation ke liye. Agar kaam ya logic sirf aapke dimaag me hai to team ke liye wo exist nahi karta.

Key points

  • Ticket (issue): Ek kaam ka record: title, description, assignee, priority, status.
  • Status flow: To Do, In Progress, In Review, Done.
  • Sprint board: Fixed time (jaise 2 hafte) ke tickets ek board par. Standup me board dekhte hain.
  • Good ticket: Clear goal, acceptance criteria, deadline, stakeholder, data source.
  • Update tickets: Progress, blockers aur final answer ticket me comment karo.
  • Confluence/Notion pages: Metric definitions, data dictionary, analysis writeups, runbooks.
  • Documentation habit: Query ya analysis ke saath assumptions, filters aur date likho.
  • Naming aur linking: Ticket ID commit ya MR me likho, doc ko ticket se jodo.
  • Keep updated: Purana doc misleading hota hai, owner aur last-updated date rakho.

Example

Ek achha analytics ticket:

text
Title: Why did D7 retention drop in November?
Goal: Identify cause of D7 retention drop (Oct 38% -> Nov 33%)
Stakeholder: Product lead
Acceptance: Segment breakdown, top 2 causes, recommendation
Data: events, users tables
Due: 2026-11-27

Metric doc ka structure: Definition, SQL logic, owner, known caveats, last updated.

Common mistakes

  • Vague ticket ("check data") aur phir bar-bar requirement badalna.
  • Work complete karke ticket update na karna.
  • Docs likhna hi nahi ya purane docs par bharosa karna.
  • Metric definitions alag-alag jagah alag likhna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Tum documentation kaise karte ho?
    A. Har analysis ke saath question, data source, assumptions, query link aur conclusion ek page par likhta hoon, taaki koi bhi reproduce kar sake.
  • Q. Sprint me kaam estimate kaise karte ho?
    A. Task ko chhote parts me todta hoon, data availability dekhta hoon, aur buffer rakhta hoon.

Yaad rakho

Jo likha nahi, wo hua hi nahi: ticket aur doc dono update rakho.

CT-10Collaboration toolsBasicMust Know

Slack ya Teams etiquette, shared drives, calendar aur meeting notes: team ke saath smooth kaam karne ki aadatein.

Simple me samjho

Achha analysis bhi bekaar hai agar sahi log tak sahi tarah se na pahunche. Communication tools ka sahi use time bachata hai aur confusion kam karta hai.

Key points

  • Slack/Teams channels: Topic ke hisaab se channel use karo. Bahut zaroori na ho to DM ki jagah channel me poochho, taaki sabko dikhe.
  • Clear message: Ek message me context, question, deadline. "Hi" likh ke ruk jana avoid karo.
  • Threads: Reply thread me do, channel clutter kam hota hai.
  • Urgency: Mention (@) sirf zaroori hone par. Urgent aur normal me farak rakho.
  • Sensitive data: Chat me PII ya credentials mat bhejo.
  • Shared drives: Folder structure aur naming convention (date, version). Access sirf zaroori logon ko.
  • Calendar: Meeting invite me agenda likho. Working hours aur time zone respect karo.
  • Meeting notes: Decisions, action items, owner, deadline likho aur meeting ke baad share karo.
  • Follow-up: Commit kiya hua kaam time par ya update ke saath.

Example

Achha Slack message:

text
Hi Riya, for the retention analysis I need the Nov signup list by Thu 3 PM.
Source: users table, signup_at >= 2026-11-01. Any filters I should exclude (bots, test)?

Meeting notes ka format:

Decision / ActionOwnerDue
Share D7 retention breakdownAnalystFri
Confirm bot filterProductThu

Common mistakes

  • Bina context ke "urgent" message bhejna.
  • Customer data ya screenshots me PII chat me share karna.
  • Meeting ke baad notes ya action items na bhejna.
  • Shared drive me "final_v3_final.xlsx" jaise confusing names.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Stakeholder se unclear request aaye to?
    A. Chhote clarifying sawaal poochta hoon (goal, deadline, definition), aur written me confirm karta hoon.
  • Q. Delay ho raha ho to kya karoge?
    A. Jaldi batata hoon, reason aur naya ETA deta hoon, aur partial output share karta hoon.

Yaad rakho

Clear message, likhit decisions, aur sensitive data chat me nahi.

CT-11Product analytics toolsIntermediateGood to Have

GA4, Mixpanel, Amplitude, CleverTap, Firebase jaise tools app ya website ke user events track karte hain.

Simple me samjho

Ye tools batate hain ki user app me kya karta hai: kahan click kiya, kaunsa screen dekha, deposit kiya ya nahi. Analyst inke events aur funnels se product ki behaviour samajhta hai.

Key points

  • Event: User action (e.g. signup, deposit_success) with properties (amount, game type).
  • User properties: User ke attributes (country, plan, device).
  • GA4 (Google Analytics 4): Web aur app tracking, event-based model. BigQuery export milta hai.
  • Mixpanel: Product analytics, funnels, retention, flows.
  • Amplitude: Product analytics, cohorts, behavioural analysis.
  • CleverTap: Engagement aur retention platform: segmentation, push, in-app messages, campaigns.
  • Firebase: Google ka mobile app platform; Analytics, crashes, remote config, push. Firebase Analytics events BigQuery me export ho sakte hain.
  • Tracking plan: Events ke naam, properties, aur definitions ka document. Consistent naming zaroori.
  • Limitations: Sampling ya thresholding, event limits, aur tool ke numbers backend/DB se match na hona.

Example

GA4 BigQuery export par event counts (events_YYYYMMDD tables):

sql
SELECT event_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM `my_project.analytics_123456.events_*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20261101' AND '20261107'
GROUP BY event_name
ORDER BY cnt DESC;

Isse tool UI ke bahar raw events par custom analysis ho sakta hai.

Reconciliation habit: Mixpanel ke deposits ka count backend transactions table se match karo. Fark ho to tracking bugs ya duplicate events check karo.

Common mistakes

  • Tool ke numbers ko backend ka final truth maan lena.
  • Event names inconsistent rakhna (Deposit, deposit, deposit_done).
  • Tracking plan ke bina events add karna.
  • Privacy ignore karna: PII ko event properties me bhejna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. GA4 aur Mixpanel me kya farak?
    A. GA4 marketing aur web/app traffic par strong hai, Mixpanel/Amplitude deep product behaviour (funnels, retention, cohorts) ke liye. Dono event-based hain.
  • Q. Tool aur DB ke numbers match na ho to?
    A. Definitions, timezone, duplicate ya dropped events, bots filter aur sampling check karta hoon.

Yaad rakho

Events ka naam aur definition fix rakho, aur tool ko backend se reconcile karo.

CT-12Data catalog and observability toolsIntermediateBonus

Data catalog (DataHub, Atlan) data dhoondne me madad karta hai, aur observability tools (Monte Carlo jaise) data quality issues pakadte hain.

Simple me samjho

Catalog data ki library hai: kaunsa table kahan hai, kisne banaya, kya matlab hai. Observability data ka smoke alarm hai: kuch toot jaye to turant pata chale.

Key points

  • Data catalog: Tables, columns, owners, descriptions ka searchable inventory. Examples: DataHub, Atlan (aur Alation, Collibra jaise).
  • Lineage: Table ya dashboard kis source se bana. Upstream/downstream impact dikhata hai.
  • Metadata: Table ka description, owner, tags, PII flags, freshness.
  • Observability: Data pipelines ki health monitor karna. Example: Monte Carlo.
  • Common checks: Freshness (data time par aaya?), volume (rows achanak kam?), schema change, null ya duplicate spikes.
  • Data quality tests: dbt tests, Great Expectations jaise tools se rules likhe jaate hain.
  • Analyst ka use: Table dhoondna, definition samajhna, issue ka source lineage se trace karna.
  • Contribute: Descriptions aur owners update karo, to catalog useful rehta hai.

Example

Scenario: Dashboard me DAU achanak 30% gira.

text
1. Observability alert: events table volume low since 02:00
2. Catalog lineage: events -> daily_users -> DAU dashboard
3. Root cause: upstream ingestion job failed (not a real drop)
4. Action: tell stakeholders, wait for backfill, re-check dashboard

Bina lineage ke analyst ghanton real "business reason" dhoondta rehta.

Common mistakes

  • Catalog ke descriptions outdated rehne dena.
  • Observability alert ko ignore karna ya alert fatigue.
  • Dashboard ka source table pata hi na hona.
  • Tool ko bina team process ke lagana.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Data lineage kya hai aur kyun?
    A. Data ka source se dashboard tak ka rasta. Issue ka root cause aur change ka impact pata karne me kaam aata hai.
  • Q. Observability me kya monitor hota hai?
    A. Freshness, volume, schema changes, aur quality anomalies (nulls, duplicates).

Yaad rakho

Catalog batata hai data kya hai, observability batata hai data theek hai ya nahi.

CT-13Linux server and logsIntermediateBonus

Linux server par logs padhna, disk space check karna aur basic troubleshooting.

Simple me samjho

Jab koi job ya app fail ho, pehla jawab logs me milta hai. Aur kai baar problem sirf disk full ya memory kam hone ki hoti hai. Kuch commands se ye jaldi pata chal jata hai.

Key points

  • Logs padhna: tail -n 100 file.log last lines, tail -f live follow, less scroll karke padhne ke liye.
  • Search: grep -i "error" file.log, grep -C 3 ke saath context lines.
  • Time-based: Log me timestamp dekho aur incident ke time ke aas-paas dhoondo.
  • Disk space: df -h (filesystem usage), du -sh * (folder sizes).
  • Memory aur CPU: free -h, top ya htop.
  • Services: systemctl status name, aur journalctl -u name -n 100 (systemd systems par).
  • Processes: ps aux | grep name.
  • Permissions: Permission denied par ls -l se owner dekho.
  • Cron job fail: Cron log ya redirect kiya hua output file dekho.
  • Caution: Production par changes ya kill/rm bina permission na karo.

Example

bash
df -h                                  # disk usage per filesystem
du -sh /var/log/* | sort -h | tail -5  # sabse bade 5 log folders
tail -n 50 /var/log/app/etl.log
grep -i -C 2 "error" /var/log/app/etl.log | tail -20
free -h
systemctl status etl-scheduler

Agar df -h me / ka Use% 100% hai, to job isliye fail hua ho sakta hai ki disk full hai.

Common mistakes

  • Sirf last error line dekhna, uske pehle ka context miss karna.
  • Disk full hone par seedha files delete kar dena bina check kiye.
  • Log time zone aur apne time zone me confusion.
  • Production server par bina owner se pooche restart ya kill karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Job fail ho gaya, pehle kya dekhoge?
    A. Job ka log (tail/grep error), phir disk space aur memory (df -h, free -h), aur recent changes.
  • Q. df aur du me farak?
    A. df poore filesystem ka usage batata hai, du kisi folder ya files ka size.

Yaad rakho

Pehle log padho, phir disk aur memory dekho, aur production par change ke liye permission lo.

CT-14Security basics for analystsBasicMust Know

Data aur accounts safe rakhne ki aadatein: VPN, SSO, MFA, password manager, aur data personal email ya chat par nahi.

Simple me samjho

Analyst ke paas customer data hota hai, jo bahut sensitive hai. Ek galti (galat email, weak password) se data leak ho sakta hai. Kuch simple aadatein bada risk kam kar deti hain.

Key points

  • VPN: Office ya internal systems ke liye secure encrypted connection. Prod ya internal DB se pehle VPN on.
  • SSO (Single Sign-On): Ek company login se kai tools. Access control centrally manage hota hai.
  • MFA (multi-factor authentication): Password ke saath doosra factor (app code, hardware key). Hamesha on rakho.
  • Password manager: Strong, unique passwords. Reuse mat karo.
  • Least privilege: Sirf utna data access maango jitna kaam ke liye chahiye.
  • No data on personal email/chat: Company data personal Gmail, WhatsApp ya personal cloud me mat bhejo.
  • PII handling: Name, phone, email, KYC jaise data ko mask ya aggregate karo. Zaroorat ho tab hi export.
  • Phishing: Suspicious link ya attachment par click mat karo, report karo.
  • Secrets: Passwords, tokens, API keys code ya chat me share nahi. Secret manager ya env variables.
  • Report incidents: Laptop kho gaya ya galat bhej diya to turant security team ko batao.

Example

Scenario: Stakeholder ne bola "player list WhatsApp par bhej do".

text
Wrong : Export CSV with phone and email, send on WhatsApp
Right : Share aggregated counts, or put the file in the approved shared drive
        with restricted access, only needed columns, PII masked

Masking ka tareeka (PostgreSQL):

sql
SELECT user_id, LEFT(email, 2) || '***' AS email_masked
FROM users LIMIT 10;

Common mistakes

  • Same password kai jagah use karna.
  • MFA band karna ya codes share karna.
  • Laptop unlock chhod dena ya public WiFi par bina VPN ke kaam karna.
  • Screenshot ya CSV me PII bhej dena.
  • Credentials ko chat ya docs me paste karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Customer data share karna ho to kaise karoge?
    A. Pehle poochta hoon kya zaroori hai, aggregated ya masked data deta hoon, aur approved channel aur restricted access se share karta hoon.
  • Q. MFA kyun zaroori?
    A. Password leak ho jaye tab bhi doosra factor account ko bachata hai.

Yaad rakho

VPN, SSO, MFA, password manager: aur customer data kabhi personal email ya chat me nahi.

Data Quality & Governance 12 topics

DQ-01Dimensions of data qualityBasicMust Know

Data quality ke 6 dimensions: accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness aur validity. Har ek ka alag check hota hai.

Simple me samjho

"Data kharab hai" bolna vague hai. Quality ko 6 angles se naapte hain. Isse pata chalta hai problem kahan hai aur kaun sa check lagana hai.

Key points

  • Accuracy: data real world se match karta hai? Player ka balance actual wallet se same hai?
  • Completeness: zaroori fields bhare hain? Email 30% null hai to incomplete.
  • Consistency: alag systems me same value? Users table me country 'IN' aur payments me 'India'.
  • Timeliness: data time pe available hai? Daily report 9 baje ready hona chahiye par 2 baje aaya.
  • Uniqueness: ek entity ek hi baar? Duplicate users nahi.
  • Validity: format aur rules ke andar? Date valid, status allowed list me.
  • Check examples: accuracy ke liye source se compare, completeness ke liye null %, uniqueness ke liye duplicate key count.
  • Trade-off: sab dimension 100% nahi hote, business impact ke hisaab se priority.

Example

DimensionMessy exampleCheck
AccuracyWallet 500 par ledger 450Source se compare
Completeness30% email nullCOUNT(email)/COUNT(*)
Consistency'IN' vs 'India'Distinct values
TimelinessTable 6 ghante puraniMAX(updated_at)
UniquenessSame email 2 usersGROUP BY ... HAVING COUNT(*)>1
ValidityAge = -5Range check
sql
SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS dup_rows,
       100.0 * COUNT(email) / COUNT(*)    AS email_complete_pct
FROM users;

Ek query se uniqueness aur completeness dono ka score mil gaya.

Common mistakes

  • Sab problems ko "accuracy" bol dena.
  • Valid format ko correct data samajhna (valid date par galat date bhi ho sakti hai).
  • Timeliness ko ignore karna.
  • Quality ko ek baar ka kaam samajhna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Data quality ke dimensions batao.
    A. Accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness, validity.
  • Q. Valid aur accurate me farak?
    A. Valid matlab format/rule follow karta hai. Accurate matlab real value sahi hai. 31-12-1900 valid ho sakti hai par accurate nahi.

Yaad rakho

Quality ko 6 angle se naapo: A-C-C-T-U-V.

DQ-02Validation checksIntermediateMust Know

Automatic checks: row count, null, range, freshness, schema. Tools: dbt tests aur Great Expectations.

Simple me samjho

Har baar manually data dekhna possible nahi. Checks likh do jo pipeline ke saath chalen aur fail hone pe alert den. Jaise airport security: har bag ka scan.

Key points

  • Row count check: table me expected rows aaye? Kal se bahut kam to alert.
  • Null check: key columns null nahi hone chahiye.
  • Range check: amount 0 se bada, age 0-120.
  • Freshness check: MAX(updated_at) kitna purana hai. SLA ke andar hona chahiye.
  • Schema check: columns aur types wahi hain? Kisi ne column rename/drop to nahi kiya.
  • Uniqueness aur accepted values: key unique, status known list me.
  • dbt tests: YAML me unique, not_null, accepted_values, relationships tests. Custom SQL tests bhi.
  • Great Expectations: Python library, "expectations" jaise expect_column_values_to_not_be_null.
  • Severity: warn vs error. Har fail pe pipeline rokna zaroori nahi.

Example

yaml
# dbt schema.yml
models:
  - name: deposits
    columns:
      - name: txn_id
        tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: status
        tests:
          - accepted_values:
              values: ['pending', 'success', 'failed']
sql
-- freshness + range check
SELECT MAX(created_at) < NOW() - INTERVAL '2 hours' AS is_stale,
       SUM(CASE WHEN amount <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)   AS bad_amount
FROM deposits;

dbt test fail ho to wo rows dikhata hai jinhone rule toda. SQL check me is_stale = true matlab data purana hai.

Common mistakes

  • Sirf pipeline success dekhna, data content nahi.
  • Itne checks ki alert fatigue ho jaye.
  • Threshold fix rakhna jabki data naturally weekdays pe badalta hai.
  • Failed check ka owner tay na hona.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Kaun se basic checks lagaoge?
    A. Row count, null, uniqueness, range, freshness aur schema checks. dbt tests ya Great Expectations me.
  • Q. dbt tests kaun se hote hain?
    A. Built-in unique, not_null, accepted_values, relationships, aur custom SQL tests.

Yaad rakho

Checks code me likho aur pipeline ke saath chalao, tabhi quality maintain hoti hai.

DQ-03ReconciliationIntermediateMust Know

Source, warehouse aur dashboard ke numbers match karna: har layer pe total compare karo.

Simple me samjho

Data teen jagah se guzarta hai: source DB, warehouse, dashboard. Har step pe kuch gir sakta hai. Reconciliation matlab har layer ka total match karna.

Key points

  • Source vs warehouse: row count aur SUM compare karo. ETL me rows gire to nahi?
  • Warehouse vs dashboard: BI filters, joins ya cached data ki wajah se difference aata hai.
  • Same cut-off: dono taraf same date range aur time zone.
  • Control totals: count, sum, min, max (checksum jaisa).
  • Daily recon table: roz ka match status store karo.
  • Tolerance: rounding ya pending txns ke liye chhota threshold.
  • Gap explain: missing rows, late data, duplicates, filters.
  • Automate: manual nahi, scheduled query.

Example

sql
SELECT 'source' AS layer, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(amount) AS total
FROM prod_replica.deposits WHERE created_at >= '2026-11-19' AND created_at < '2026-11-20'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'warehouse', COUNT(*), SUM(amount)
FROM wh.fact_deposits WHERE dep_date = '2026-11-19';
python
src = pd.read_sql(q_src, conn_src); wh = pd.read_sql(q_wh, conn_wh)
diff = src["total"].iloc[0] - wh["total"].iloc[0]
print(round(diff, 2))   # 0 ya tolerance ke andar

Agar count same par SUM alag hai to amount ya currency conversion me issue hai. Count alag hai to rows gir rahi hain.

Common mistakes

  • Alag time zone ya cut-off se compare karna.
  • Sirf SUM compare karna, count nahi.
  • Ek baar recon karke chhod dena.
  • Dashboard ke filters bhool jaana.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Reconciliation kaise karte ho?
    A. Source, warehouse aur dashboard ka same period me count aur SUM compare. Phir difference ko causes me todta hu.
  • Q. Count match par SUM nahi, kya hua?
    A. Amount transformation, currency conversion ya rounding issue.

Yaad rakho

Har layer pe same cut-off se count aur SUM match karo.

DQ-04When the numbers do not matchIntermediateMust Know

Do reports ke numbers alag hon to systematic debug karo: definition, time zone, filters, late data, duplicates, currency, test data. Phir stakeholders ko samjhao.

Simple me samjho

Finance bolta hai 10 lakh, dashboard bolta hai 9.4 lakh. Ghabrao mat. Ek checklist se gap ko todo. Aksar 2-3 chhote reasons milke gap banate hain.

Key points

  • Definitions: "revenue" gross hai ya net of bonus? "Active user" ka matlab alag to nahi?
  • Time zones: UTC vs IST se din ki boundary badalti hai.
  • Filters: country, status, product, date filter alag.
  • Late-arriving data: purani date ka data baad me aaya, ek report refresh pehle hua.
  • Duplicates: join fan-out ya ETL retry.
  • Currency: INR vs USD, rate date alag.
  • Test data: internal aur test accounts ek me included, doosre me nahi.
  • Explain to stakeholders: simple bridge: "A = 10.0, B = 9.4. Gap 0.6: timezone 0.4, test accounts 0.2."
  • Next step: ek official definition tay karo.

Example

sql
SELECT DATE(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')           AS d_utc,
       DATE(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AS d_ist,
       SUM(amount) AS amt
FROM deposits
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1;

Bridge table:

StepAmount
Finance report10.0L
Time zone shift-0.4L
Test accounts-0.2L
Dashboard9.4L

Gap ko reasons me todne se stakeholders ko clear explanation milta hai.

Common mistakes

  • Pehle hi bol dena "dashboard galat hai".
  • Ek reason milte hi ruk jaana, jabki kai reasons stack hote hain.
  • Definition poochna bhool jaana.
  • Bridge ke bina sirf "approx same hai" bol dena.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Do dashboards alag number dikha rahe hain, kya karoge?
    A. Definition, time zone, filters, late data, duplicates, currency, test data ek-ek check. Phir bridge se gap explain.
  • Q. Stakeholder ko kaise batate ho?
    A. Simple bridge table, kitna gap kis wajah se, aur kaun sa number official hai.

Yaad rakho

Checklist se debug karo, gap ko bridge me todo, aur ek official definition tay karo.

DQ-05PII and sensitive dataBasicMust Know

PII ko masking, anonymisation, hashing aur need-to-know access se protect karo.

Simple me samjho

PII wo data hai jisse kisi insaan ko pehchana ja sake: name, phone, email, PAN, bank details. Analysis me aksar asli identity ki zaroorat nahi hoti, to usse chhupa do.

Key points

  • PII examples: name, phone, email, address, government ID, bank/card number, IP address.
  • Masking: kuch part chhupana. 98****3210, r***@gmail.com.
  • Hashing: one-way function (SHA-256). Same input, same hash, join kar sakte ho. Salt use karo, kyuki phone numbers guess karke reverse ho sakte hain.
  • Anonymisation: identity hamesha ke liye hata do. Re-identification possible nahi honi chahiye.
  • Pseudonymisation: ID ko token se replace, mapping alag secure jagah. Anonymisation se alag hai.
  • Need-to-know: sirf wahi access jise kaam ke liye chahiye.
  • Minimise: sirf zaroori columns pull karo, SELECT * avoid.
  • Sharing: PII email, chat ya screenshot me mat bhejo.

Example

sql
SELECT user_id,
       CONCAT(LEFT(phone, 2), '****', RIGHT(phone, 2)) AS phone_masked,
       MD5(LOWER(email) || :salt) AS email_hash   -- ya SHA-256, dialect ke hisaab se
FROM users;
python
import hashlib
df["email_hash"] = df["email"].str.lower().apply(
    lambda e: hashlib.sha256((e + salt).encode()).hexdigest())
df = df.drop(columns=["email", "phone"])

Analysis table me ab user_id aur hash hai, asli email/phone nahi. Hash se join possible hai par identity directly nahi dikhti.

Common mistakes

  • Hashing ko anonymisation maan lena. Salt ke bina reverse ho sakta hai.
  • Sheets ya Excel me PII download karke local rakhna.
  • Zaroorat se zyada columns export karna.
  • Dashboard me phone/email raw dikhana.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Masking aur hashing me farak?
    A. Masking data ka part chhupata hai. Hashing one-way transformation hai jo join ke liye same value deti hai.
  • Q. Anonymisation aur pseudonymisation?
    A. Anonymisation me re-identify nahi ho sakta. Pseudonymisation me token mapping alag rakhi hoti hai, to reversible hai.

Yaad rakho

PII chhupao ya hatao, minimum data lo, aur need-to-know pe access do.

DQ-06Compliance basicsIntermediateGood to Have

Data compliance ki basic samajh: GDPR, India DPDP Act, PCI-DSS, SOC 2, retention policies aur audit trails.

Simple me samjho

Compliance matlab data ke rules jo law ya industry standard set karte hain. Analyst ko lawyer nahi banna, par basic rules pata hone chahiye.

Key points

  • GDPR: EU ka privacy law. Consent, right to access/delete, data minimisation. EU users ka data ho to lagu.
  • India DPDP Act: India ka Digital Personal Data Protection Act (2023). Personal data processing ke liye consent aur data principal ke rights.
  • PCI-DSS: card data ke liye industry standard. Card numbers raw analytics me nahi rakhte.
  • SOC 2: service organisation ke security aur controls ka audit report (security, availability, confidentiality jaise criteria).
  • Retention policies: data kitne time tak rakhna hai, uske baad delete ya archive.
  • Audit trails: kisne, kab, kya access ya change kiya, uska record.
  • Analyst ka role: PII minimise, sahi access, retention follow, doubt ho to legal/compliance team se poocho.
  • Details: exact legal requirements ke liye company ki compliance team ya official text dekho.

Example

text
Scenario: Marketing 3 saal purane users ki phone list maangta hai.
Check 1: Retention policy kya hai? (jaise 2 saal inactive ke baad delete)
Check 2: Consent hai us purpose ke liye?
Check 3: Kisne maanga, kyu? Audit log me note.
Action: Compliance team se approval ke baad hi, minimal columns.
sql
-- retention check: inactive users jinka data policy se zyada purana hai
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE last_active < NOW() - INTERVAL '2 years';

Is query se pata chalta hai kitne records retention limit cross kar gaye. Delete ka decision owner/compliance ka hota hai.

Common mistakes

  • Purane user data ko hamesha ke liye rakhna.
  • Card ya KYC data analytics table me copy karna.
  • Consent ke bina marketing use karna.
  • Audit log disable ya ignore karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. GDPR aur DPDP me common kya hai?
    A. Dono personal data protect karte hain: consent, purpose limitation aur individuals ke rights.
  • Q. PCI-DSS kab relevant?
    A. Jab card payment data store, process ya transmit hota hai.

Yaad rakho

Consent, minimum data, retention aur audit trail: compliance ke 4 basics.

DQ-07Access controlBasicMust Know

Least privilege follow karo, sahi tareeke se access maango, aur production ki jagah read replica use karo.

Simple me samjho

Ghar ki chabi sirf unhe jinhe zaroorat hai. Wahi principle database pe. Zyada access ka matlab zyada risk.

Key points

  • Least privilege: kaam ke liye jitna chahiye utna hi access. Analyst ko read-only.
  • Role-based access: user ko role (analyst_read) do, har table ka grant alag nahi.
  • Requesting access: ticket/manager approval, reason, kitne time ke liye, kaun si tables.
  • Production DB: live game ya payment DB pe heavy queries mat chalao, system slow ho sakta hai.
  • Read replica: production ki copy, analytics ke liye. Thoda lag ho sakta hai.
  • Warehouse: reporting ke liye best jagah.
  • Credentials: password share mat karo, code me mat daalo. Environment variable ya secret manager.
  • Review: jo access ab nahi chahiye, hatwao.
  • No writes: analyst ko aksar INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE nahi chahiye.

Example

sql
-- DBA ye grant karta hai (analyst nahi)
CREATE ROLE analyst_ro;
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reporting TO analyst_ro;
GRANT SELECT ON reporting.fact_deposits TO analyst_ro;
text
Access request:
Who: Priya (Data Analyst)
What: SELECT on reporting.fact_deposits (read replica)
Why: Weekly deposit trend analysis
Duration: 3 months, manager approved

Role me sirf SELECT hai, to galti se data change nahi hoga. Request me reason aur duration likhne se approval jaldi aur audit-friendly hoti hai.

Common mistakes

  • Production DB pe long-running query chalana.
  • Shared credentials use karna.
  • Zaroorat se zyada schemas ka access maangna.
  • Access mil gaya to kabhi review na karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Production ki jagah read replica kyu?
    A. Heavy analytics queries live users ko slow na karein. Replica me thoda lag ho sakta hai.
  • Q. Least privilege kya hai?
    A. User ko sirf wahi permission jo kaam ke liye zaroori hai, aur zyada nahi.

Yaad rakho

Minimum access, read replica pe query, aur credentials kabhi share nahi.

DQ-08Data ownership and stewardshipBasicGood to Have

Table ya metric ka owner kaun hai, steward kya karta hai, aur issue aaye to escalation path kya hai.

Simple me samjho

Har table ka koi zimmedaar hona chahiye. Warna issue aaye to sab ek doosre ko point karte hain. Owner decide karta hai, steward din-ba-din dekhbhaal karta hai.

Key points

  • Data owner: business ya team jo data ke liye accountable hai. Access aur definition approve karta hai.
  • Data steward: roz ki quality, documentation aur definition maintain karta hai.
  • Table owner: engineering team jo pipeline chalati hai. Source system ka owner alag ho sakta hai.
  • Metric owner: ek metric (jaise "Net Revenue") ka final definition kaun tay karta hai, jaise Finance.
  • Escalation path: pehle table owner, phir team lead, phir data/engineering head.
  • Owner kaise pata kare: table ka description, catalog, ya team se poocho.
  • Issue report: table, query, expected vs actual, impact likho.
  • Ownerless data: risk hai, usko flag karo.

Example

text
Issue: fact_deposits me 2 din se yesterday ka data nahi.
1. Table owner: Data Engineering (pipeline: deposits_etl)
2. Message: "fact_deposits missing 19 Nov rows. Source count 12,400,
   warehouse 0. Dashboard affected: Finance daily."
3. 2 ghante me reply nahi: team lead ko escalate
4. Metric owner (Finance) ko impact batao

Issue message me table, numbers aur impact hone se owner jaldi action le pata hai.

Common mistakes

  • Owner pata kiye bina khud pipeline "fix" karna.
  • Vague message: "data galat hai".
  • Metric definition ka owner na hona, har team apni banati hai.
  • Escalation me seedha top management ko ping karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Owner aur steward me farak?
    A. Owner accountable hota hai aur decisions leta hai. Steward roz quality aur documentation maintain karta hai.
  • Q. Data issue mile to kise batate ho?
    A. Table owner ko evidence ke saath. Reply na mile to team lead tak escalate.

Yaad rakho

Har table aur metric ka owner pata rakho, aur issue evidence ke saath escalate karo.

DQ-09Single source of truthIntermediateMust Know

Har metric ki ek hi definition aur ek hi jagah ho, taaki teams ke numbers match karein aur shadow reports na bane.

Simple me samjho

Agar Marketing aur Finance "revenue" alag tarah se nikaalein, to meeting me sirf number pe jhagda hota hai. Ek official jagah aur ek definition rakho.

Key points

  • One metric definition: "Active user = kam se kam 1 real-money hand in last 30 days." Sab same use karein.
  • Single source of truth (SSOT): ek curated table ya semantic layer jisse sab dashboards bante hain.
  • Shadow reports: Excel ya personal SQL jo official se alag number dete hain.
  • Kyu bante hain: official dashboard slow ya incomplete, ya definition unclear.
  • Metric catalog: metrics ki list, definition, owner, SQL logic.
  • Reuse: same SQL/model reuse, copy-paste nahi.
  • Change control: definition badle to announce, version aur effective date.
  • Reconcile: shadow report ko official se compare karke gap ka reason dhundo.

Example

sql
-- official metric view, sab yahin se padhen
CREATE VIEW metrics.active_users_30d AS
SELECT DATE '2026-11-20' AS as_of, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS active_users
FROM fact_hands
WHERE hand_time >= DATE '2026-11-20' - INTERVAL '30 days'
  AND is_real_money = TRUE
  AND is_test_account = FALSE;

Is view me real-money aur test-account filters definition ka hissa hain. Har team yahi view use kare, to numbers match honge.

Common mistakes

  • Har dashboard me apni copy of logic.
  • Definition badalna bina batayen.
  • Shadow report ko ignore karna, jabki wo official ki kami batata hai.
  • Metric ka owner na hona.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. SSOT kyu zaroori?
    A. Taaki sab teams same definition aur same number use karein. Trust badhta hai aur reconciliation ka time bachta hai.
  • Q. Shadow reports kaise kam karoge?
    A. Official dashboard ko fast aur clear banao, metric catalog rakho, aur gaps ko owner ke saath fix karo.

Yaad rakho

Ek metric, ek definition, ek jagah.

DQ-10Handling data incidentsIntermediateMust Know

Data incident me 5 steps: detect, communicate, fix, post-mortem, prevent.

Simple me samjho

Kabhi galat data dashboard pe chala jaata hai. Panic nahi, process follow karo. Jaldi batao, theek karo, aur sikho.

Key points

  • Detect: automated checks, alerts ya kisi user ki complaint se. Severity aur impact check karo.
  • Communicate: affected stakeholders ko jaldi batao: kya galat hai, kab se, kaun se reports. Update dete raho.
  • Contain: galat dashboard pe note lagao ya temporary pause.
  • Fix: root cause dhundo, data backfill ya correct karo, aur result verify karo.
  • Post-mortem: blameless review. Timeline, root cause, impact, learnings.
  • Prevent: nayi validation checks, alerts, documentation, owner assign.
  • Impact sizing: kitni rows, kitne din, kaun se numbers galat the.
  • Correction notice: sahi number bhejo aur batao kya badla.

Example

text
Incident: Duplicate deposits in fact_deposits (ETL retried)
Detect  : row count +18% vs last week alert
Impact  : 16-17 Nov, revenue overstated by 2.1L
Comm    : Finance + BI ko message, dashboard par banner
Fix     : dedupe by txn_id, backfill, recon vs gateway = 0 diff
Prevent : unique test on txn_id, ETL idempotent
sql
SELECT txn_id, COUNT(*) FROM fact_deposits
GROUP BY txn_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

Fix ke baad wahi query 0 rows deni chahiye. Preventive unique test se dobara issue turant pakda jaayega.

Common mistakes

  • Chup rehna jab tak fix na ho jaye.
  • Sirf symptom fix karna, root cause nahi.
  • Post-mortem me kisi ko blame karna.
  • Prevent step skip karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Galat number stakeholders ko chala gaya, kya karoge?
    A. Turant batata hu, impact size karta hu, fix karke sahi number bhejta hu, aur prevention check add karta hu.
  • Q. Blameless post-mortem kya hai?
    A. Process ki kami dhundhna, kisi insaan ko blame nahi.

Yaad rakho

Detect, communicate, fix, post-mortem, prevent: jaldi batao, sahi fix karo.

DQ-11Documentation standardsBasicMust Know

Table descriptions, change logs aur metric definitions likhne ke standards, taaki data samajhna aur use karna aasan ho.

Simple me samjho

Undocumented table ek aisi machine hai jiska manual nahi. Naya banda use galat chalayega. Short aur updated documentation sabka time bachata hai.

Key points

  • Table description: grain, source, refresh frequency, owner, primary key, known issues.
  • Column description: meaning, unit (INR/paise), allowed values, nulls ka matlab.
  • Metric definitions: formula, filters, inclusions/exclusions, owner, example.
  • Change log: kya badla, kab, kyu, kisne. Breaking changes highlight.
  • Data dictionary/catalog: ek central jagah jahan sab docs mile.
  • Query comments: complex SQL me assumptions likho.
  • Keep updated: outdated doc, doc nahi hone se bhi bura hai.
  • Examples: sample query aur sample output.

Example

text
Table: fact_deposits
Grain      : 1 row = 1 successful deposit transaction
Key        : txn_id (unique)
Source     : payments DB via deposits_etl
Refresh    : hourly, UTC
Owner      : Data Engineering (de-team)
Columns    : amount (INR, 2 decimals), status ('success' only)
Known issue: Test accounts included (flag is_test_account)

Change log
2026-11-10  Added column is_test_account  (ticket DATA-482)
sql
COMMENT ON TABLE fact_deposits IS '1 row = 1 successful deposit; key txn_id; UTC; hourly';

COMMENT ON PostgreSQL ka syntax hai. Description table ke saath hi rehti hai, to alag file kho nahi jaati.

Common mistakes

  • Grain aur unit na likhna.
  • Metric ka formula sirf kisi ke dimag me hona.
  • Change log update na karna.
  • Docs ko alag jagah rakhna jahan koi dekhta nahi.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Ek achhe table doc me kya hona chahiye?
    A. Grain, key, source, refresh, owner, column meanings aur units, known issues.
  • Q. Change log kyu?
    A. Pata chale ki number kab aur kyu badla, to historical comparison aur debugging aasan hoti hai.

Yaad rakho

Grain, definition, owner aur change log likho, aur updated rakho.

DQ-12Ethical data use and biasIntermediateGood to Have

Consent, fairness aur misleading charts se bachna: data ko responsibly use karna.

Simple me samjho

Data se bade decisions hote hain, jaise kisi user pe limit lagana. Galat ya biased analysis se real logon ko nuksaan hota hai. Analyst ki zimmedari hai ki sahi aur fair dikhaye.

Key points

  • Consent: user ne jis purpose ke liye data diya, usi me use karo.
  • Purpose limitation: data ko naye, unrelated kaam me bina permission mat use karo.
  • Fairness: model ya rule kisi group (city, device, gender) ke saath unfair to nahi? Group-wise results dekho.
  • Sampling bias: data sirf ek type ke users ka hai (jaise sirf app users), to conclusion sab pe lagu nahi.
  • Responsible gaming: poker/gaming me vulnerable players ko exploit karne wale targeting se bacho.
  • Misleading charts: truncated y-axis, cherry-picked dates, dual axes, pie me bahut slices.
  • Honest caveats: sample size, uncertainty aur limitations batao.
  • Privacy: analysis me individuals ko identify mat karo.

Example

text
Chart A: bar chart, y-axis 95 se start -> 96 aur 98 ka farak bahut bada dikhta hai
Fix    : y-axis 0 se, ya line chart; difference ko % me likho

Targeting: "high-spend users ko extra bonus offer"
Check  : kya ye kam-aay ya addiction-risk wale logon ko bhi push kar raha hai?
python
df.groupby("device")["approved"].mean()   # group-wise approval rate

Group-wise rate se dikhta hai ki kisi device/segment ko systematically kam approval to nahi mil raha.

Common mistakes

  • Y-axis kaat kar chhota farak bada dikhana.
  • Sirf wahi data dikhana jo story support kare.
  • Group-wise impact na dekhna.
  • Consent ke bahar data use karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Misleading chart ke examples?
    A. Truncated y-axis, cherry-picked time range, dual axes, aur 3D charts jo size distort karte hain.
  • Q. Data bias kaise check karte ho?
    A. Sample kaun hai, kaun missing hai dekhta hu, aur results ko groups me todke compare karta hu.

Yaad rakho

Consent lo, fair raho, aur chart se sach dikhao.

Communication & Storytelling 15 topics

CS-01Story structureBasicMust Know

Data ko kahani ki tarah present karo: Context, Insight, Implication, Recommendation. Isse audience ko samajh bhi aata hai aur action bhi milta hai.

Simple me samjho

Doctor ki tarah socho: pehle problem bataata hai, phir report ka matlab, phir dawai. Sirf "BP 150 hai" bolna kaafi nahi hai. Analyst ka kaam bhi yahi hai: number ko kahani me badalna jisse decision ho sake.

Key points

  • Context: Kyun dekh rahe the? Ek line me background. Example: "Last month cash game rake girta dikha."
  • Insight: Data ne kya bataya? Ek clear finding, number ke saath. Example: "Rake 12% gira, sirf mobile users me."
  • Implication: Is finding ka business pe kya asar hai? Example: "Isse monthly revenue ~Rs 8 lakh kam hoga."
  • Recommendation: Ab kya karna chahiye? Specific action, owner aur timeline ke saath.
  • Ek kahani, ek message: Ek presentation me 5 insights mat ghusao. Top 1-3 chuno.
  • Order flexible hai: Leadership ko Recommendation pehle chahiye ho sakti hai, phir baaki.
  • Supporting data baad me: Method aur extra charts appendix me rakho.

Example

text
Context:        Mobile app v4.2 7 Nov ko release hua.
Insight:        Mobile pe table-join success rate 94% se 81% hua. Desktop flat hai.
Implication:    ~3,000 players/day join nahi kar paa rahe, ~Rs 1.2 lakh/week rake loss.
Recommendation: v4.2 ka join-flow hotfix is week; tab tak v4.1 pe rollback ka option dekho.

Chaar line me poori kahani ho gayi. Reader ko query ya SQL ki zaroorat nahi padi.

Common mistakes

  • Sirf Insight bata dena, Implication aur Recommendation chhod dena.
  • Context itna lamba ki asli finding dub jaye.
  • Ek hi deck me 8 alag kahaniyan.
  • Recommendation vague rakhna, jaise "isko improve karna chahiye".

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Tum data se story kaise banate ho?
    A. Context, Insight, Implication, Recommendation follow karta hoon. Pehle business question, phir ek clear finding, phir uska impact, last me specific action.
  • Q. Kaunsa part sabse important hai?
    A. Recommendation, kyunki uske bina insight se koi decision nahi hota. Lekin wo insight aur implication pe based honi chahiye.

Yaad rakho

Context, Insight, Implication, Recommendation: har analysis in chaar lines me bol sakni chahiye.

CS-02Executive summary firstBasicMust Know

Jawab pehli do lines me do, detail baad me. Busy reader ko pehle conclusion chahiye, process nahi.

Simple me samjho

Newspaper headline jaisa socho. Headline me poori baat aa jaati hai, neeche detail hoti hai. Analyst aksar pehle method batate hain aur answer last me. Ulta karo.

Key points

  • Answer first: Pehli do lines me conclusion aur ask likho.
  • BLUF: Bottom Line Up Front. Ye military/corporate writing ka common naam hai.
  • Number ke saath: "Revenue badha" ki jagah "Revenue 8% badha (Rs 42L se Rs 45L)".
  • Detail baad me: Method, caveats, charts neeche ya appendix me.
  • Reader decide kare: Reader chahe to sirf summary padhe aur decision le sake.
  • Caveat ek line me: Agar data incomplete hai to summary me hi ek line me bolo.
  • Test: Agar reader sirf 2 line padhe, kya wo sahi decision le lega?

Example

Kharab version:

text
Maine last 90 days ka data pull kiya, bots filter kiye, cohorts banaye aur phir retention nikala...

Achha version:

text
Summary: New-player D7 retention 22% se 17% gira, mainly referral channel se (-9 pts).
Ask: Referral campaign ka bonus rule is week review karo (owner: Marketing).
Detail neeche. Caveat: Last 3 din ka data incomplete hai.

Pehle version me reader ko answer dhundhna padta hai. Dusre me 10 second me baat clear.

Common mistakes

  • Pehle poora background likhna, answer last me.
  • Summary me bhi jargon bharna.
  • Caveats chhupana ya bahut lambe likhna.
  • Ask bhoolna: summary me action nahi to reader ko kya karna hai pata nahi.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Executive summary me kya hona chahiye?
    A. Conclusion, uska size (number), aur next step ya ask. Do-teen lines me.
  • Q. Agar leadership ko sirf 1 minute mile?
    A. Headline insight, impact, aur recommendation bolunga. Method poochhne par hi bataunga.

Yaad rakho

Answer pehle, kahani baad me: pehli do lines hi asli message hain.

CS-03Writing insight emails and reportsBasicMust Know

Email chhoti, scannable ho, next step clear ho, aur ek message me sirf ek ask.

Simple me samjho

Log email skim karte hain, padhte nahi. Isliye subject se hi baat clear honi chahiye. Ek email, ek kaam. Zyada asks diye to koi bhi poora nahi hota.

Key points

  • Subject line: Finding likho, topic nahi. "D7 retention -5 pts in referral" better hai "Retention report" se.
  • Short: 5-8 lines. Lambi detail attachment ya doc me.
  • Scannable: Bullets, bold number, chhote paragraphs.
  • Clear next steps: Kaun, kya, kab. Owner aur date ke saath.
  • One ask per message: Do alag decisions chahiye to do alag emails.
  • Chart ek hi: Ek key chart inline, baaki link ya attachment me.
  • Reports me bhi same: Summary upar, details neeche, definitions aur caveats end me.

Example

text
Subject: Referral D7 retention -9 pts after Nov 1 bonus change

Hi Priya,

Referral-joined players ka D7 retention 24% se 15% gira (Nov 1 ke baad, n = 4,100).
Other channels flat hain, isliye bonus rule change likely cause hai.

Ask: Kya hum bonus rule ko 1 week ke liye purane version pe A/B test kar sakte hain?
Reply by Thursday, taaki Monday se test chalu ho.

Chart aur query neeche link me. Caveat: last 2 din ka data incomplete hai.

Thanks, Rahul

Ek ask, ek date, ek finding. Reader sirf "yes" reply kar sakta hai.

Common mistakes

  • Subject me sirf "Report" ya "Update" likhna.
  • Ek email me 4 alag questions.
  • Next step ya deadline na dena.
  • 10 charts attach kar dena bina batae kaunsa important hai.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Achhi insight email kaisi hoti hai?
    A. Subject me finding, upar summary, ek ask, owner aur deadline, aur detail link me.
  • Q. Agar do cheezein poochni hain?
    A. Do alag emails ya clear numbered asks, lekin priority ek hi rakhta hoon.

Yaad rakho

Subject me insight, body me ek ask, end me date.

CS-04Presenting to non-technical stakeholdersIntermediateMust Know

Non-technical logon ko jargon nahi, analogy chahiye. Decision dikhao, method nahi.

Simple me samjho

Ops ya marketing wale ko "logistic regression" nahi chahiye. Unhe chahiye "kaunse players churn honge aur hum kya karein". Tum translator ho: data ki bhasha se business ki bhasha me.

Key points

  • No jargon: "Cohort" ki jagah "same week join karne wale players". "Variance" ki jagah "kitna upar-neeche hota hai".
  • Analogies: Complex idea ko roz ki cheez se jodo. Example: A/B test = do dukaan me alag offer try karna.
  • Decision dikhao: Slide ka title decision ho, jaise "Bonus X ko 10% karo".
  • Method appendix me: Bas ek line: "Humne 30 din ka data compare kiya."
  • Unka metric use karo: Finance ko Rs, support ko tickets, product ko conversion.
  • Pause aur check: "Yahan tak clear hai?" poochho, silent confusion se bacho.
  • Simple visuals: Ek chart, ek message.

Example

text
Technical: "Churn model ka AUC 0.82 hai, top-decile lift 3.1x."
Plain:     "Jo 10% players sabse zyada jaane wale hain, unme hum 3 guna zyada sahi pakadte hain.
            Agar un 10% ko bonus dein, to har mahine ~400 players bach sakte hain."

Doosri line me model ki detail nahi hai, par action aur impact dono hain.

Common mistakes

  • Apna method explain karne me 10 minute lagana.
  • Abbreviations (AUC, CTR, ARPU) bina explain kiye use karna.
  • Slide pe table of numbers daalna.
  • Audience ka level na jaanna, kisi se pehle poochh lo.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Non-tech audience ko model kaise samjhaoge?
    A. Analogy se, aur result pe focus: kya decision lena hai aur kitna fayda. Method ek line me, baaki appendix.
  • Q. Agar koi technical sawaal kare?
    A. Seedha simple jawab, aur detail follow-up me ya appendix se.

Yaad rakho

Decision dikhao, method nahi; unki bhasha bolo, apni nahi.

CS-05Presenting to leadershipIntermediateMust Know

Leadership ko impact se shuru karo, kathin sawaalon ke liye tayyar raho, aur time ke andar khatam karo.

Simple me samjho

Leadership ke paas 10 minute hote hain aur 20 items. Unhe jaldi batao: kitna paisa ya player ka asar, aur kya chahiye. Detail wo maangenge to do.

Key points

  • Lead with impact: Pehli slide: "Rs 1.5 crore/year ka opportunity" ya "retention 5 pts gira".
  • Time-box: 10 minute mile to 6 minute me present karo, 4 minute discussion ke liye.
  • Ask clear: Approval, budget, ya decision, kya chahiye ye pehle bolo.
  • Hard questions expect karo: "Number sahi hai?", "Bots filter kiye?", "Aur kya option hai?" Pehle se tayyari rakho.
  • Backup slides: Method, segments, assumptions appendix me ready.
  • Pata na ho to bolo: "Verify karke aaj hi bhejta hoon", andaza mat lagao.
  • Ek-do options do: Recommendation ke saath alternative bhi.

Example

text
Slide 1 (30 sec): Mobile join failure se ~Rs 5 lakh/month rake loss.
Slide 2 (1 min):  Kab se, kis device pe, kitne players.
Slide 3 (1 min):  Option A hotfix (2 din, Rs 0 extra), Option B rollback (1 din, feature delay).
Slide 4 (30 sec): Ask: Option A approve karein.
Backup:           Segment tables, query logic, data caveats.

Total 3-4 minute, baaki time sawaalon ke liye.

Common mistakes

  • Background se shuru karna, impact last me.
  • 25 slides ek 10 minute slot me.
  • Hard sawaal ka bachav karna ya andaza lagana.
  • Ask bhool jana, leadership ko pata nahi kya decide karna hai.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Leadership presentation ki tayyari kaise karte ho?
    A. Impact aur ask pehle, hard questions ki list banata hoon, backup slides rakhta hoon, aur time rehearse karta hoon.
  • Q. Agar koi number challenge kare?
    A. Calmly method batata hoon, aur pakka na ho to "verify karke aaj hi confirm karta hoon" bolta hoon.

Yaad rakho

Impact pehle, ask clear, time ke andar, aur hard sawal ke liye backup ready.

CS-06Slide designBasicGood to Have

Ek slide, ek message. Chart padhne layak ho, text kam ho.

Simple me samjho

Slide tumhari baat ka support hai, script nahi. Agar log slide padhne lage, to tumhari baat nahi sunenge. Ek slide ko 5 second me samajh aana chahiye.

Key points

  • One message per slide: Title me poora message likho, jaise "Mobile join rate 13 pts gira".
  • Action title: Topic nahi, conclusion. "Join rate" ki jagah "Join rate Nov 7 ke baad gira".
  • Readable charts: Bade fonts, axis labels, units. Pichli row se bhi dikhna chahiye.
  • Minimal text: Max 3-4 bullets, ek line each.
  • Right chart type: Trend ke liye line, comparison ke liye bar. Pie sirf 2-3 parts ke liye.
  • Highlight karo: Important bar ya point ko color do, baaki grey.
  • Consistent: Same colors, fonts, aur number format poore deck me.

Example

text
Kharab slide:  Title "Retention analysis"; 12 lines text; table 8x10.
Achha slide:   Title "Referral D7 retention 24% se 15% gira"
               Chart: line, referral red, baaki grey, 1 annotation "Nov 1 bonus change"
               Footer: Source: events table, n=4,100

Achhe slide pe reader ko turant dikh jata hai kya hua aur kab.

Common mistakes

  • Slide pe poora paragraph ya table daalna.
  • Rainbow colors, 3D charts, chhote fonts.
  • Y-axis truncate karke difference bada dikhana (misleading).
  • Ek slide me 3 alag messages.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Achha slide kaisa hota hai?
    A. Ek message, action title, simple chart jisme important cheez highlighted ho, aur kam text.
  • Q. Pie chart kab use karte ho?
    A. Bahut kam: sirf 2-3 categories ke share ke liye. Warna bar chart.

Yaad rakho

Ek slide, ek message, title me conclusion.

CS-07Explaining statistics simplyIntermediateMust Know

p-value, confidence, correlation ko roz ki bhasha me samjhao, formula ke bina.

Simple me samjho

Stats ko "kitna pakka?" aur "kitna asli?" ke sawaal ki tarah samjhao. Tumhara goal audience ko sahi decision tak pahunchana hai, definition ratwana nahi.

Key points

  • p-value: "Agar asal me koi farak nahi hota, to ye result sirf chance se kitni baar aata?" Chhota p (jaise 0.03) = chance se aana mushkil.
  • p-value ye NAHI hai: Ye "hum 97% sahi hain" nahi hai. Ye effect ka size bhi nahi batata.
  • Confidence interval: "Asli value shayad is range me hai", jaise 4% se 8% ke beech.
  • Confidence level (95%): Same method baar-baar chalayein to ~95% baar range asli value ko pakdegi.
  • Correlation: Do cheezein saath saath chalti hain. Isse cause pakka nahi hota.
  • Causation example: Ice cream aur drowning dono garmi me badhte hain, par ice cream cause nahi.
  • Sample size: Chhota sample = zyada shor. "Sirf 20 players pe" wali baat par savdhaan raho.
  • Practical significance: Stat significant ho par fayda chhota ho to business ke liye bekaar ho sakta hai.

Example

text
Result: Naya bonus conversion +2.1 pts, 95% CI [0.4, 3.8], p = 0.02.
Plain:  "Naya bonus se zyada log convert hue, lagbhag 2 pts. Asli fayda shayad 0.4 se 3.8 pts ke beech.
         Ye sirf chance se hone ki sambhavna kam hai (2%). Hum isko roll-out karne ki salah dete hain."
Corr:   "Jo players chat use karte hain wo zyada khelte hain, par pakka nahi ki chat ki wajah se."

Plain version me number, range aur decision teeno hain.

Common mistakes

  • p-value ko "result sahi hone ki probability" bolna.
  • Correlation ko causation bata dena.
  • Sirf p-value batana, effect size ya range nahi.
  • Bahut chhote sample pe confident claim karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. p-value kisi non-technical ko kaise samjhaoge?
    A. "Agar koi asli farak nahi hota to itna bada difference sirf chance se kitni baar dikhta. Jitna chhota p, utna kam chance."
  • Q. Correlation aur causation me farak?
    A. Correlation = saath chalna; causation = ek cheez doosri ko karti hai. Iske liye experiment ya A/B test chahiye.

Yaad rakho

Number ke saath range aur "kitna pakka" bolo, aur correlation ko cause mat bolo.

CS-08Handling pushbackIntermediateMust Know

Jab koi number ya method pe sawaal kare, calm raho, method defend karo, aur pata na ho to "verify karke batata hoon" bolo.

Simple me samjho

Pushback personal attack nahi hai, ye aksar number ko sahi karne ka mauka hai. Tumhara kaam hai shant rehke logic dikhana, aur galti ho to jaldi maan lena.

Key points

  • Pehle sunno: Poora sawaal samjho, interrupt mat karo. "Aap kehna chahte ho ki ..., sahi?"
  • Calmly defend: Definition, filter, aur date range batao. Emotion nahi, logic.
  • Data se jawab: "Maine bots exclude kiye the, ye query hai."
  • Pata na ho to: "Let me verify and come back." Andaza mat lagao.
  • Time do: "Aaj EOD tak confirm karta hoon." Aur wapas jao.
  • Galti ho to: Seedha bolo, fix karo, aur sabko update do.
  • Alternate view welcome: "Aap alag filter ke saath dekhna chahte ho? Chalo dono dikha deta hoon."

Example

text
Stakeholder: "Ye retention number bahut kam lag raha hai."
Reply:       "Fair point. Ye D7 retention hai, sirf Nov 1-7 ke naye players, bots excluded.
              Kya aap D1 ya alag cohort ki baat kar rahe ho?"

Stakeholder: "Finance ke number se match nahi karta."
Reply:       "Sahi observation. Abhi pakka nahi bata sakta ki difference definition ka hai ya data ka.
              Let me verify and come back to you by 5 PM today with the reconciliation."

Dusre reply me guess nahi hai, commitment hai.

Common mistakes

  • Defensive hona ya number ko zabardasti sahi batana.
  • Andaza lagana jab data verify nahi kiya.
  • "Verify karunga" bolke wapas na jana.
  • Sabke saamne kisi ko galat sabit karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Agar stakeholder tumhare number pe doubt kare?
    A. Pehle sunta hoon, phir definition aur method batata hoon. Agar pakka nahi hoon to "verify karke wapas aata hoon" bolke time pe confirm karta hoon.
  • Q. Agar tumhari galti nikli?
    A. Turant maan leta hoon, fix karta hoon, aur affected logon ko corrected number bhejta hoon.

Yaad rakho

Shant raho, method dikhao, aur "let me verify and come back" bolke wapas zaroor aao.

CS-09Saying no and managing scopeIntermediateMust Know

Na bolna sikho: priorities clarify karo, alternatives do, aur deep-work time protect karo.

Simple me samjho

Sab ko "haan" bolne se koi kaam time pe nahi hota. Na bolna matlab rude hona nahi, kaam ko sahi order me rakhna hai. Seedha "na" ki jagah "abhi nahi, ye karein ya wo" bolo.

Key points

  • Priorities clarify karo: "Mere paas A aur B pending hain. Kaunsa pehle?"
  • Tradeoff dikhao: "Ye le lunga to wo Friday se Tuesday ho jayega."
  • Alternatives do: Chhota version, rough estimate, ya self-serve dashboard.
  • Scope likho: Kya shamil hai, kya nahi, likh ke confirm karo.
  • Scope creep roko: "Ye naya ask hai, alag ticket banate hain."
  • Deep-work time: Calendar pe 2-3 ghante ka focus block lagao, notifications band.
  • Escalate: Agar do stakeholders me conflict ho, manager se priority tay karwao.

Example

text
Ask:    "Kal tak full player LTV model chahiye."
Reply:  "Abhi mere paas Monday ke KPI review ka kaam hai. LTV model me ~3 din lagenge.
         Options:
         1) Kal tak simple avg revenue/player (rough, 2 ghante)
         2) Full model Thursday tak
         Kaunsa chalega? Ya manager se priority confirm kar lein?"

Seedha na nahi, options diye gaye, aur decision unke haath me hai.

Common mistakes

  • Sab ko haan bolke sab me late hona.
  • Bina explain kiye "busy hoon" bolna.
  • Scope likhit me na lena, baad me "ye bhi chahiye tha".
  • Deep-work time ko meetings se bhar dena.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Agar do stakeholders ek saath urgent bolein?
    A. Dono ko impact aur deadline poochta hoon, tradeoff dikhata hoon, aur zarurat ho to manager se priority tay karwata hoon.
  • Q. Scope creep kaise handle karte ho?
    A. Naya ask alag ticket me, ETA aur effort ke saath. Original delivery protect karta hoon.

Yaad rakho

"Na" ke saath option do, aur tradeoff saaf bolo.

CS-10Asking clarifying questionsBasicMust Know

Kaam shuru karne se pehle teen sawaal: kaunsa decision, kab tak, aur achha result kaisa dikhta hai.

Simple me samjho

Galat sawaal ka sahi jawab bekaar hota hai. 5 minute ke sawaal 2 din ki mehnat bacha dete hain. Request ke peeche ka asli maqsad samjho.

Key points

  • What decision will this support? Ye data se kya decide hoga? Isse metric aur depth tay hoti hai.
