  • By when? Asli deadline kab hai, aur kya rough answer pehle chalega?
  • What does good look like? Success ka number ya format kya hai? Example: "retention >20% matlab theek."
  • Definition poochho: "Active player" ka matlab kya? Last 7 din me kam se kam 1 hand?
  • Audience: Ye kis ko dikhana hai, team ko ya CEO ko?
  • Pehle kya dekha: Koi purana report ya number already hai?
  • Confirm back: Jo samjha wo 2 lines me wapas likho.

Example

text
Ask: "Mujhe churn dikha do."

Questions:
1) Is data se kya decide karna hai? (Bonus campaign ya product fix?)
2) Churn ki definition: 14 din inactive? 30 din?
3) Kis segment ke liye: sab players ya sirf cash game?
4) Kab tak chahiye, aur format (ek number ya detail table)?

Confirm: "To main last 90 din ke cash game players ka 14-day churn, weekly trend me, Thursday tak bhejta hoon. Theek?"

Teen-chaar sawaal aur ek confirmation line.

Common mistakes

  • Bina poochhe seedha query likhna.
  • 15 sawaal ek saath poochhna. 3-4 important rakho.
  • Sawaal jinka jawab pehle se doc me hai.
  • Confirm na karna, baad me "ye wo nahi tha".

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Vague request aaye to pehla kadam?
    A. Poochta hoon: kaunsa decision, kab tak, aur good result kaisa dikhta hai. Phir apni samajh likh ke confirm karta hoon.
  • Q. Ye sawaal kyun zaroori hain?
    A. Isse sahi metric, sahi depth, aur sahi deadline tay hoti hai aur rework bachta hai.

Yaad rakho

Decision, deadline, definition of good: teen sawaal pehle.

CS-11Recommendations, not just numbersIntermediateMust Know

Har number ke saath "so what?" ka jawab do: kya karna chahiye.

Simple me samjho

"Retention 18% hai" sunke kya karein? Number akela adhoora hai. Tumhara kaam hai number ko action me badalna.

Key points

  • So what? Har finding ke baad khud se poochho: isse kya badlega?
  • Number + meaning + action: Teeno saath do.
  • Benchmark do: Number kisse compare hai? Last month, target, ya peers.
  • Impact size: Rupees ya players me batao, sirf percentage nahi.
  • Specific action: Owner, kya, kab. "Marketing bonus rule 15 Nov tak revert kare."
  • Confidence batao: Kitna pakka hai aur kya uncertain hai.
  • Options do: Ek recommended option aur ek fallback.

Example

text
Sirf number:   "Referral D7 retention 15% hai."
Recommendation: "Referral D7 retention 15% hai, jo target 22% se 7 pts kam hai
                 (~Rs 3 lakh/month ka loss). Bonus rule Nov 1 ko badla tha.
                 Salah: 1 hafte ke liye purana bonus A/B test karo (owner: Marketing).
                 Confidence: medium, sirf 2 hafte ka data."

Doosra version bina poochhe bata deta hai kya hua, kitna bada hai, aur kya karna hai.

Common mistakes

  • Dashboard bhej dena aur kuch na kehna.
  • Sirf percentage dena, rupees ya players me nahi.
  • Aisi recommendation jo data se nahi nikalti.
  • Uncertainty chhupana.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. "So what?" kya hai?
    A. Har finding ke baad ye batana ki business ke liye uska matlab kya hai aur kya action lena chahiye.
  • Q. Agar data se clear recommendation na nikle?
    A. Honestly bolta hoon, options aur unke risks deta hoon, aur next data ya test ka plan batata hoon.

Yaad rakho

Number + meaning + action: tabhi analysis poora hai.

CS-12Writing documentationBasicMust Know

Analysis docs, runbooks, README aur handover notes likho, taaki kaam doosre bhi samajh aur repeat kar sakein.

Simple me samjho

Aaj ka tumhara kaam 6 mahine baad tumhe khud yaad nahi rahega. Documentation future-tum aur team ke liye hai. Short, saaf, aur updated rakho.

Key points

  • Analysis doc: Question, data source, definitions, method, result, caveats, aur next steps.
  • Runbook: Step-by-step: kaise chalana hai, kab, kya galat ho sakta hai, aur fix.
  • README: Repo me: ye kya hai, kaise run karein, folder structure, owner.
  • Handover note: Kya chal raha hai, kya pending hai, kahan kya milega, kis se poochna hai.
  • Definitions likho: "Active player" jaise terms ek jagah.
  • Ek jagah, updated: Wiki ya repo me rakho, chat me mat chhodo. Date aur owner likho.
  • Likho jab yaad ho: Kaam ke dauran notes lo, last me nahi.

Example

text
README.md
- Purpose:   Weekly retention report (cash game)
- Run:       python run_retention.py --week 2026-11-16
- Source:    analytics.events, analytics.users (read replica)
- Output:    Dashboard "Weekly Retention" + CSV in shared drive
- Owner:     Rahul (backup: Priya)
- Gotchas:   Bots excluded via users.is_bot = false; data lags by 1 day

Naya banda 5 minute me samajh jayega ki kaam kaise chalta hai.

Common mistakes

  • Docs likhna hi nahi ("code khud samajh aa jayega").
  • Likh ke update na karna, purani doc bhrama deti hai.
  • Definitions aur caveats chhod dena.
  • Bahut lamba doc jo koi padhta nahi.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Analysis document me kya hota hai?
    A. Question, data source, definitions, method, results, caveats, aur next steps.
  • Q. Runbook kya hota hai?
    A. Kaam chalane aur fail hone par fix karne ke step-by-step instructions, taaki koi bhi kar sake.

Yaad rakho

Jo doc nahi hai wo tribal knowledge hai: chhota likho, par likho.

CS-13Meetings and stand-upsBasicMust Know

Stand-up me do minute me update do, blockers jaldi batao, aur meeting ke baad notes aur follow-ups bhejo.

Simple me samjho

Meeting ka matlab sabka time hai. Chhoti, tayyar, aur action ke saath khatam honi chahiye. Stand-up status report nahi, coordination hai.

Key points

  • Two-minute update: Kal kya kiya, aaj kya karoge, blocker kya hai.
  • Blockers early: Atke ho to stand-up me hi bolo, 3 din baad nahi.
  • Specific bolo: "Dashboard ka data validation khatam, aaj review ke liye bhejunga."
  • Tayyari: Agenda aur goal pehle se. Bina agenda ki meeting skip karne layak.
  • Notes: Decisions aur action items likho, owner aur date ke saath.
  • Follow-up: Meeting ke 24 ghante ke andar notes bhejo.
  • Time respect: Time pe shuru, time pe khatam, off-topic parking lot me.

Example

text
Stand-up update:
Kal:      Retention query validate ki, bots filter fix kiya.
Aaj:      Dashboard refresh aur Priya se review.
Blocker:  events table me Nov 10-12 ka data missing. Data-eng se ticket DATA-482 banaya hai.

Meeting notes:
Decision: Bonus A/B test Monday se.
Actions:  1) Rahul: test design doc, Fri.  2) Priya: bonus config, Mon.

Update chhota hai, blocker saaf hai, aur notes me owner aur date hain.

Common mistakes

  • Stand-up me 5 minute ki kahani.
  • Blocker chhupana jab tak deadline na aa jaye.
  • Meeting ke baad koi notes ya owner nahi.
  • Bina agenda ki lambi meetings.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Stand-up me kya bolte ho?
    A. Kal kya kiya, aaj kya karunga, aur blockers. Do minute, specific.
  • Q. Blocker kab batate hain?
    A. Jaise hi pata chale, same din stand-up ya chat me, taaki time rehte help mile.

Yaad rakho

Chhota update, blocker pehle din, aur har meeting ke baad owner ke saath notes.

CS-14Cross-team collaborationIntermediateMust Know

Engineers, product, design, finance, ops aur support ke saath kaam karo: unki bhasha aur zaroorat samjho.

Simple me samjho

Har team ka alag goal aur bhasha hai. Analyst beech ka pul hai. Unse kya chahiye aur unhe kya chahiye, dono saaf rakho.

Key points

  • Engineers: Event tracking, data quality, schema changes. Clear ticket aur example ke saath poochho.
  • Product: Feature impact, funnels, experiments. Unke goals aur release dates jaano.
  • Design: UX changes ke data insights. Heatmap, drop-off points.
  • Finance: Numbers ka reconciliation. Definitions match karo, month-end ka dhyan rakho.
  • Ops: Daily metrics, anomalies. Unhe simple dashboards aur alerts chahiye.
  • Support: Complaint patterns, ticket volumes. Wo player ki awaaz hain.
  • Shared definitions: Ek metric glossary, taaki sab ek hi number baat karein.
  • Close the loop: Kaam ke baad unhe result batao.

Example

text
To Engineering (ticket):
Title: Add 'table_join_failed' event with reason code (mobile v4.2)
Why:   Join failures dikh rahe hain par reason nahi pata. Decision: hotfix vs rollback.
Need:  Event fields: user_id, table_id, reason, app_version. By: 20 Nov.

To Finance (message):
"Rake definition: gross rake before bonuses. Aapke numbers me net hai?
 Reconcile karne ke liye 10 min ka sync kar lein?"

Dono messages me kaam, wajah, aur deadline ya next step hai.

Common mistakes

  • Sirf apni bhasha me baat karna (jargon).
  • Alag teams me alag metric definitions.
  • Last moment pe data maangna ya dena.
  • Kaam khatam hone par feedback na dena.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Engineering se kaam kaise karwate ho?
    A. Clear ticket: kya chahiye, kyun, example aur deadline. Aur unki priorities ka respect.
  • Q. Finance aur analytics ke numbers match na ho to?
    A. Definitions aur filters compare karta hoon, reconciliation table banata hoon, aur ek agreed definition document karta hoon.

Yaad rakho

Har team ki zaroorat samjho, definitions common rakho, aur loop close karo.

CS-15Giving and receiving feedbackIntermediateGood to Have

Review comments, 1:1s aur criticism ko growth ke liye use karo: specific, respectful, aur action wale.

Simple me samjho

Feedback ek gift hai, hamla nahi. Dena aur lena dono skill hain. Specific bolo, behavior pe bolo, insaan pe nahi.

Key points

  • Review comments: Code/query pe specific, kyun aur suggestion ke saath. "Is join se duplicates ban sakte hain, DISTINCT ya pre-aggregate try karo."
  • Pehle achha batao: Sachchi taareef bhi do, sirf galtiyan nahi.
  • Behavior pe, insaan pe nahi: "Ye query slow hai" na ki "tum slow query likhte ho".
  • 1:1s: Regular, tayyari ke saath: wins, blockers, growth goals, manager se feedback.
  • Criticism lena: Beech me mat toko, pura suno, sawaal pucho, "thanks" bolo.
  • Act on it: Feedback pe kaam karo aur follow-up me bata do kya badla.
  • Alag feel ho to: Defensive mat ho, example maango.
  • Tone: Sawaal ke form me bhi suggestion de sakte ho: "Kya yahan CTE better rahega?"

Example

text
Review comment (given):
"Nice use of CTEs, readable. Ek suggestion: line 42 pe users join se rows duplicate ho sakti hain
 (ek user ke multiple devices). Kya pehle device-level dedupe kar sakte hain? Count check dekh lena."

1:1 (received):
Manager: "Tumhare reports accurate hain par late hote hain."
Reply:   "Thanks. Kya aap ek example de sakte ho? Main estimate better karunga aur delay jaldi bataunga."

Pehla comment specific aur helpful hai. Dusra reply defensive nahi hai aur action pe ja raha hai.

Common mistakes

  • Vague feedback: "achha nahi hai".
  • Feedback ko personal le lena.
  • Public me criticize karna.
  • Feedback sunke kuch na badalna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Tumhe critical feedback mile to?
    A. Pura sunta hoon, example poochta hoon, thanks bolta hoon, aur ek action plan banake follow-up me dikhata hoon.
  • Q. Junior ki query me galti mile to?
    A. Private ya review comment me, specific issue aur suggestion ke saath, aur kuch achha bhi batata hoon.

Yaad rakho

Specific aur kind feedback do, shant hoke lo, aur uspe action karo.

Corporate Workflow 22 topics

CW-01Team structure and reporting lineBasicMust Know

Pata rakho kaun kaam maangta hai, kaun approve karta hai, aur kisko escalate karna hai.

Simple me samjho

Office me map jaisa hota hai: kaam kahan se aata hai, kaun priority tay karta hai, aur atakne par kiske paas jaana hai. Ye pata ho to time nahi barbaad hota.

Key points

  • Requesters: Product, marketing, finance, ops, support, leadership: inse kaam aata hai.
  • Approvers: Manager ya team lead priority aur scope approve karta hai. Sensitive data ke liye data owner ya security approve karta hai.
  • Reporting line: Tum kisko report karte ho aur wo kisko. Ye jaano.
  • Escalation path: Pehle requester, phir apna manager, phir stakeholder ka manager. Seedha upar jump mat karo.
  • Kab escalate karein: Deadline risk, conflicting priorities, access ya data blocked, ya galti jo business ko affect kare.
  • Backup: Chhutti me kaun tumhara kaam dekhta hai, ye clear rakho.
  • Ek-do point of contact: Har team se ek bhaasha-samajhne wala insaan jaano.

Example

text
Request flow (cash game dashboard):
Requester:  Product Manager (Priya)  -> ticket DATA-510
Approver:   Analytics Lead (Amit)    -> priority & scope
Executor:   Analyst (Rahul)
Data owner: Data Engineering (Karan) -> schema/pipeline issues
Escalation: Rahul -> Amit -> Head of Analytics

Escalation message (to Amit):
"DATA-510 ka deadline Fri hai, par events table ka fix Data-Eng me atka hai (since Mon).
 Kya aap Karan ke manager se priority bol sakte ho?"

Escalation me problem, impact, aur specific help likhi hai.

Common mistakes

  • Sabko seedha CEO tak escalate karna.
  • Bina manager ko bataye alag team ka kaam lena.
  • Escalate karne me bahut der karna.
  • Escalation emotional ya blame wali bhasha me.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Do alag logon se conflicting priority aaye to?
    A. Dono ko batata hoon, aur apne manager ko escalate karta hoon taaki wo priority tay kare.
  • Q. Kab escalate karna chahiye?
    A. Jab deadline ya data issue mere control ke bahar ho aur business pe asar pad sakta ho, aur pehle ek baar seedha try kar chuka hoon.

Yaad rakho

Jaano request kahan se, approval kahan se, aur escalation kiske paas jaati hai.

CW-02Ad-hoc vs planned workBasicMust Know

Urgent asks ko intake form ya ticket se handle karo aur expectations pehle se set karo.

Simple me samjho

Planned work roadmap ka hota hai. Ad-hoc achanak aata hai, jaise "ek number chahiye abhi". Dono ko ek system (ticket) me laao taaki kuch gum na ho.

Key points

  • Planned work: Sprint ya quarterly plan ka kaam, jaise dashboards aur weekly reports.
  • Ad-hoc: Chhote one-off sawaal. Roz kuch kaam isme jaayega, uske liye buffer rakho.
  • Intake form ya ticket: Har request ek jagah: question, deadline, audience, definition.
  • Urgent ka matlab: Poochho ki "urgent" ke peeche kya deadline ya decision hai.
  • Triage: 5 minute me tay karo: abhi, aaj, is hafte, ya backlog.
  • Expectations set karo: ETA aur effort batao, "10 minute ka hai" ya "2 din ka".
  • Capacity: Roz ~20% time ad-hoc ke liye rakho, baaki planned ke liye.
  • Repeat asks: Agar ek sawaal baar baar aata hai to dashboard ya self-serve banao.

Example

text
Chat: "Ek quick number chahiye: kal ke new players."
Reply: "Bilkul. Ye 10 min ka hai, 3 PM tak bhejta hoon. Ticket bana dena (link), taaki track ho."

Chat: "Urgent! Poore quarter ka churn by cohort."
Reply: "Ye ~1 din ka kaam hai. Deadline kya hai aur kis meeting ke liye chahiye?
        Aaj rough 30-day churn de sakta hoon, full cohort Thursday tak."

Pehla chhota hai to turant ETA, doosra bada hai to sawaal aur option.

Common mistakes

  • Har chhote ask pe chat me kaam karna, koi record nahi.
  • "Urgent" sunte hi sab chhodke bhaag jaana.
  • Ad-hoc ke liye time hi na rakhna aur planned late.
  • Baar baar ke asks ko manual karte rehna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Urgent ad-hoc request kaise handle karte ho?
    A. Deadline aur decision poochta hoon, effort estimate batata hoon, ticket banata hoon, aur zarurat ho to planned kaam ki priority manager se confirm karta hoon.
  • Q. Ticket kyun zaroori hai?
    A. Track, priority, aur record ke liye, aur baad me "kisne kya maanga" ka saboot.

Yaad rakho

Har ask ticket me, ETA sach me, aur ad-hoc ke liye buffer.

CW-03PrioritisationIntermediateMust Know

Impact vs effort se kaam chuno, stakeholders ki umeedein samjho, aur ETA clearly batao.

Simple me samjho

Sab kaam ek saath nahi ho sakta. Jo kaam kam mehnat me zyada fayda de wo pehle. Aur dusron ko batao ki unka kaam kab milega.

Key points

  • Impact vs effort: High impact, low effort pehle (quick wins). Low impact, high effort last ya mat karo.
  • Impact ka matlab: Revenue, players, decision ya risk pe asar.
  • Effort: Kitne ghante ya din lagenge, aur kya dependencies hain.
  • Stakeholder expectations: Kaun kitna ummeed rakhe baitha hai aur kya deadline hai, ye jaano.
  • Prioritisation matrix: 2x2: Do now, Plan, Quick fill, Skip.
  • Communicate ETA: Har requester ko batao kab milega, ya kyun nahi.
  • Manager se align: Conflict ho to manager se priority confirm karo.
  • Regularly review: Priorities badalti hain, hafte me ek baar list dekho.

Example

TaskImpactEffortDecision
Fix wrong rake in CEO dashboardHighLowDo now
Churn modelHighHighPlan (next sprint)
Rename dashboard colorsLowLowQuick fill
30-slide player atlasLowHighSkip
text
ETA message: "Rake fix aaj 4 PM tak. Churn model next sprint me, Monday ko design share karunga.
              Color change Friday ko free time me."

Table se logic dikhta hai aur ETA message se sabki umeed set hoti hai.

Common mistakes

  • Jo sabse zor se bole uska kaam pehle karna.
  • Effort ko underestimate karna.
  • ETA na batana, log baar baar poochte hain.
  • Priority list ko update na karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Tum prioritise kaise karte ho?
    A. Impact vs effort, deadline aur dependency dekhta hoon, aur manager aur stakeholders ke saath align karke ETA sabko batata hoon.
  • Q. Agar do high impact kaam hain?
    A. Jo deadline ya dependency ke saath bandha hai pehle, aur doosre ka ETA clearly bata deta hoon.

Yaad rakho

Pehle high impact low effort, aur har kisi ko ETA bolo.

CW-04Estimating and communicating delaysIntermediateMust Know

Task todo, honestly buffer rakho, aur delay ho to jaldi batao.

Simple me samjho

Estimate andaza hota hai, vaada nahi. Bade kaam ko tukdon me todne se andaza behtar hota hai. Aur deri ho rahi ho to pehle batao, deadline ke din nahi.

Key points

  • Break down: Kaam ko 2-4 ghante ke tukdon me todo: data pull, clean, analysis, review, doc.
  • Hidden work yaad rakho: Data quality check, review, aur stakeholder feedback me time lagta hai.
  • Pad honestly: Buffer 20-30% rakho aur batao ki buffer kyun hai. Bina wajah inflate mat karo.
  • Range do: "2-3 din" better hai "2 din" se jab uncertain ho.
  • Assumptions likho: "Agar data Monday tak mila to Wednesday".
  • Tell early: Risk dikhte hi batao, aur naya ETA aur wajah saath do.
  • Option do: Rough result abhi, full baad me.
  • Track karo: Actual vs estimate dekho, agli baar behtar estimate.

Example

text
Task: Monthly retention dashboard
Break-down:  Data pull 3h | Cleaning & bot filter 3h | Metrics & checks 4h | Dashboard 4h | Review 2h
Total 16h = ~2 din; with 25% buffer = ~2.5 din. Estimate: "Wednesday EOD".

Delay message (Tuesday):
"Update: events table me Nov 10-12 ka data missing mila. Naya ETA Thursday EOD (data-eng fix pe depend).
 Rough dashboard Wed ko share kar sakta hoon, final Thursday. Chalega?"

Delay Tuesday ko bataya, wajah, naya ETA aur option ke saath.

Common mistakes

  • Bina breakdown ke "2 din lagenge" bol dena.
  • Delay ko deadline ke din tak chhupana.
  • Bina wajah ke bahut bada buffer.
  • Delay batate hue naya ETA na dena.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Estimate kaise karte ho?
    A. Task todta hoon, har part ka time likhta hoon, review aur data issues ka buffer jodta hoon, aur assumptions bata deta hoon.
  • Q. Deadline miss hone wali ho to?
    A. Jaise hi pata chale stakeholder ko wajah, naya ETA aur partial option ke saath batata hoon.

Yaad rakho

Tukdon me estimate, honest buffer, aur delay ki khabar jaldi.

CW-05Agile / Scrum / KanbanBasicMust Know

Agile me chhote cycles me kaam hota hai: sprint, backlog, story points, retro aur stand-up. Kanban me flow board hota hai.

Simple me samjho

Bada kaam ek baar me nahi, chhote hisson me, har 2 hafte me kuch deliver karna. Analytics team bhi aksar isi tarah kaam karti hai.

Key points

  • Backlog: Saare pending kaamon ki priority list.
  • Sprint: Fixed time box (aksar 1-2 hafte) jisme team kuch kaam commit karti hai.
  • Story points: Kaam ki relative size ka andaza (effort + complexity), ghanton me nahi.
  • Stand-up: Daily 15 min: kya kiya, kya karna hai, blockers.
  • Sprint planning: Backlog se kaam chun ke sprint me daalna.
  • Retro: Sprint ke baad: kya achha gaya, kya nahi, kya badlein.
  • Scrum: Roles aur ceremonies wala framework (sprints, planning, review, retro).
  • Kanban: Board (To Do, In Progress, Done), WIP limit, continuous flow. Ad-hoc heavy teams ke liye achha.
  • Analytics me: Reports/dashboards ko stories ki tarah likho, ad-hoc ke liye buffer ya Kanban lane.

Example

text
Kanban board:   To Do | In Progress (WIP limit 3) | In Review | Done
Sprint story:   "As a Product Manager, I want a weekly retention dashboard so that I can track onboarding."
                Points: 5  | Acceptance: 3 cohorts, bots excluded, refresh daily.
Retro:          Achha: tickets clear the.  Sudhaar: data-eng dependency late pata chali -> pehle hi flag karenge.

Story ka format aur retro ka outcome (ek action) dikhaya gaya hai.

Common mistakes

  • Story points ko ghanton ke barabar maan lena.
  • Retro me sirf shikayat, koi action nahi.
  • Sprint me ad-hoc ke liye jagah na rakhna.
  • Board ko update na karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Scrum aur Kanban me farak?
    A. Scrum me fixed sprints, roles aur ceremonies hote hain. Kanban me continuous flow, WIP limit, aur sprint nahi hota.
  • Q. Story points kya hain?
    A. Kaam ki relative size ka andaza (complexity aur effort), jisse team capacity plan karti hai.

Yaad rakho

Backlog se sprint, stand-up se sync, retro se sudhaar.

CW-06Ticket hygieneBasicMust Know

Achha ticket: clear title, queries ya dashboards ke links, status update, aur kaam khatam hone par loop close.

Simple me samjho

Ticket tumhare kaam ka record hai. Ganda ticket baad me kisi ko samajh nahi aata, tumhe bhi nahi. Chhoti si aadat hai jo bahut time bachati hai.

Key points

  • Clear title: Kaam aur scope ek line me. "Weekly D7 retention by channel (cash game)" na ki "Retention".
  • Description: Question, deadline, audience, definition, expected output.
  • Link queries/dashboards: Query repo ka link, dashboard URL, source tables.
  • Status update: In Progress, Blocked, In Review, Done: sach me update karo.
  • Comments me progress: Blocker aur decision likho, chat me nahi.
  • Close the loop: Result requester ko bhejo, confirm karwao, phir ticket close karo.
  • Labels/priority: Type, priority, aur owner lagao.
  • Related tickets: Duplicate ya follow-up ko link karo.

Example

text
Title:       Weekly D7 retention by acquisition channel (cash game) - Nov
Requester:   Priya (Product)   Priority: P2   Due: 22 Nov
Description: Question: kya referral channel ka retention gira? Audience: Product weekly.
             Definition: D7 = players jo join ke 7th din active; bots excluded.
Output:      Dashboard + 3-line summary.
Links:       Query: analytics-queries/retention/d7_by_channel.sql | Dashboard: <link>
Update:      Nov 19 - First draft ready, waiting for Priya's review.
Close:       Nov 20 - Priya confirmed numbers; closed.

Naya banda sirf ticket padh ke poora kaam samajh sakta hai.

Common mistakes

  • Vague title jaise "Data request".
  • Status update na karna, ticket "In Progress" me atka rehta hai.
  • Result chat me bhej dena aur ticket me nahi.
  • Close karne se pehle requester se confirm na karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Achha ticket kaisa hota hai?
    A. Clear title, question aur deadline, definitions, links to queries/dashboards, up-to-date status, aur closing note.
  • Q. "Close the loop" ka matlab?
    A. Result requester ko dena, unse confirm karwana, aur tab ticket close karna.

Yaad rakho

Clear title, links, sahi status, aur confirm karke close.

CW-07Version control for analysisIntermediateMust Know

Queries aur notebooks ko git me rakho: naming convention, change logs, aur clean history ke saath.

Simple me samjho

SQL file ke 10 versions email me ghoomna "final_v2_FINAL.sql" jaisa chaos hai. Git me har badlav ka record rehta hai. Kisne kya aur kyun badla, sab dikhta hai.

Key points

  • Query repo: Saari reusable SQL ek git repo me, folders me (retention/, revenue/, ...).
  • Naming conventions: topic_metric_grain.sql jaise retention_d7_by_channel.sql. Lowercase, underscores.
  • Commit messages: Chhote aur clear: "Fix: exclude bots in D7 retention".
  • Branch + review: Naya kaam branch me, merge se pehle review (merge request).
  • Notebooks in git: Output clear karke commit karo (ya nbstripout jaisa tool), warna diff gande aur data leak ho sakta hai.
  • Change log: Metric definition badli to CHANGELOG me date, kya, kyun likho.
  • No secrets/PII: Password, tokens ya player data repo me mat daalo; .gitignore use karo.
  • Tag/version: Important report logic ko version do (v1, v2).

Example

text
analytics-queries/
  retention/
    retention_d7_by_channel.sql
    retention_d30_by_cohort.sql
  revenue/
    rake_daily_by_game.sql
  notebooks/
    churn_exploration.ipynb   (outputs cleared)
  CHANGELOG.md

git commit -m "Fix: exclude bots in D7 retention (users.is_bot = false)"

CHANGELOG.md:
2026-11-18  retention_d7: bots excluded. Old values ~3% higher. Requested by Priya.

Naam se file ka kaam pata chalta hai, aur changelog se numbers ka farak samajh aata hai.

Common mistakes

  • Final_v3_new.sql jaise file names.
  • Notebook outputs (player data) commit kar dena.
  • Metric logic badal ke changelog na likhna.
  • Direct main branch me bina review ke push.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Analysis ko version control kyun?
    A. History, review, rollback, aur reproducibility ke liye: kisne kab kya badla, aur purana number kaise bana tha.
  • Q. Notebook ko git me kaise rakhte ho?
    A. Outputs clear karke commit karta hoon, taaki diff saaf rahe aur data leak na ho.

Yaad rakho

Queries git me, naam saaf, metric badle to changelog likho.

CW-08Peer review and QAIntermediateMust Know

Queries review karwao, doosron ki review karo, aur numbers share karne se pehle checklist chalao.

Simple me samjho

Ek galat number poore decision ko bigad sakta hai. Doosri nazar galti pakad leti hai. Share karne se pehle 10 minute ka checklist bahut bachata hai.

Key points

  • Apni query review karwao: Merge request ya doosre analyst ko dikhao, specially naye metrics ke liye.
  • Doosron ki review karo: Logic, joins, filters, aur edge cases dekho. Naya kuch seekhne ka tareeka.
  • Review me kya dekhein: Join duplicates, NULL handling, date range, time zone, bots/test users.
  • Sanity checks: Total apne aap se match karta hai? Doosre source (finance) se reconcile?
  • Row counts: Join se pehle aur baad me count compare karo.
  • Reasonableness: Number bahut achha ya bura dikhe to pehle shaq karo.
  • Pre-share checklist: Definition, date, filters, source, caveats likhe hue?
  • Poochho, hamla mat karo: Review comments sawaal ya suggestion ke form me.

Example

text
Pre-share checklist:
[ ] Question aur definition ticket se match karti hai
[ ] Date range aur time zone sahi (IST vs UTC)
[ ] Bots/test users excluded
[ ] Joins ke baad row count/dups check
[ ] Total ek independent source se match (finance / dashboard)
[ ] Number reasonable (last week se compare)
[ ] Peer ne review kiya: ______
[ ] Caveats summary me likhe

Sanity query: SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM result;

Agar COUNT(*) aur COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) alag hain to join duplicates ho sakte hain (agar grain user-level hona chahiye).

Common mistakes

  • "Query chal gayi, to sahi hoga" maan lena.
  • Review ko time ki barbaadi samajhna.
  • Number ko kisi se compare na karna.
  • Deadline ke dabav me checklist skip karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Numbers share karne se pehle kya check karte ho?
    A. Definition, filters, date/time zone, duplicates after joins, independent source se reconciliation, reasonableness, aur peer review.
  • Q. Query review me kya dhoondhte ho?
    A. Join type aur duplicates, NULL, filters, date logic, aur edge cases.

Yaad rakho

Share se pehle checklist aur doosri nazar.

CW-09Production vs analytics databaseBasicMust Know

Prod database pe heavy queries nahi: read replica ya warehouse use karo, timeouts aur query cost ka dhyan rakho.

Simple me samjho

Prod DB me live game chal raha hai. Wahan bhaari query chalana restaurant ki kitchen me bhaari kaam karna jaisa hai: customers ka khana late ho jayega. Analysis ke liye alag copy (replica ya warehouse) hoti hai.

Key points

  • Production DB: Live app (players, transactions) serve karta hai. Slow query = players ko dikkat.
  • Read replica: Prod ki read-only copy, thodi delay (replication lag) ke saath. Analytics ke liye safer.
  • Analytics DB / warehouse: Alag system jahan data load hota hai aur heavy analysis ke liye bana hai.
  • Never heavy on prod: Bade joins, full scans, bina filter ke SELECT * prod pe mat chalao.
  • Timeouts: Query timeout set karo (jaise statement_timeout PostgreSQL me), taaki query atak ke resource na khaye.
  • Query cost: EXPLAIN dekho, kitne rows scan honge. Warehouse me scanned data ka paisa lagta hai.
  • Limit aur filter: Date filter aur LIMIT se test karo, phir full chalao.
  • Access: Analytics ko aksar read-only role milta hai. Zaroorat ho to prod ka access seedha nahi, DBA se poocho.

Example

sql
-- PostgreSQL: session level timeout, replica pe chalao
SET statement_timeout = '60s';

EXPLAIN
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS d, COUNT(*) AS txns
FROM transactions
WHERE created_at >= '2026-11-01'
  AND created_at <  '2026-11-08'
GROUP BY 1;

Date filter se kam rows scan honge, EXPLAIN se plan dikhta hai, aur timeout se query atak nahi sakti. Ye query replica ya analytics DB pe chalao.

Common mistakes

  • Prod pe "bas ek chhoti query" chalana jo table scan kar de.
  • Replication lag bhool jana, numbers thode purane ho sakte hain.
  • Bina date filter ke warehouse pe query (bada bill).
  • Bina WHERE ke UPDATE/DELETE: analyst ke role me write access hi nahi hona chahiye.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Prod pe heavy query kyun nahi?
    A. Isse live users ki queries slow ya fail ho sakti hain. Analysis replica ya warehouse pe karte hain.
  • Q. Read replica ki limitation?
    A. Replication lag ho sakta hai, to latest data thoda peeche ho sakta hai, aur ye read-only hota hai.

Yaad rakho

Prod sirf players ke liye: analysis replica ya warehouse pe, filter aur timeout ke saath.

CW-10Knowledge transfer and handoverIntermediateMust Know

Runbooks likho, tribal knowledge mat rakho, aur kaam saaf tareeke se hand over karo.

Simple me samjho

Agar sirf tumhe pata hai ki report kaise chalti hai, to tum chhutti pe nahi ja sakte aur team risk me hai. Kaam ko aise likho ki koi bhi sambhal sake.

Key points

  • Tribal knowledge: Jo sirf kisi ke dimaag me hai. Ye risk hai: use doc me laao.
  • Runbook: Step-by-step: kaise chalana, schedule, output kahan, fail hone par kya.
  • Handover doc: Kya chal raha hai, pending kya hai, access kahan, kisse poochna hai.
  • Walkthrough session: 30-60 min live demo, recording rakho.
  • Shadow phase: Naya owner tumhare saath ek-do cycle chalaye, phir tum observe karo.
  • Access aur ownership: Dashboards, scheduled jobs, aur credentials (secure tarike se) transfer karo.
  • Known issues: Gotchas aur workarounds likho.
  • Sign-off: Naya owner confirm kare ki wo comfortable hai.

Example

text
HANDOVER: Weekly Retention Report (Rahul -> Sneha), effective 1 Dec
What:        Runs every Mon 8 AM, emails Product + posts to dashboard
Where:       Repo analytics-queries/retention, job "weekly_retention" in scheduler
Steps:       1) Check data freshness (events max date = yesterday)  2) Run job  3) Verify totals vs last week (+/-10%)
Known:       Nov 10-12 data missing (ticket DATA-482); bots excluded via users.is_bot
Pending:     Add D30 view (DATA-501, 50% done)
Contacts:    Data-Eng: Karan | Product owner: Priya
Plan:        Nov 24-28 shadow run; Sneha runs, Rahul reviews

Naya owner bina poochhe hi 80% kaam samajh sakta hai.

Common mistakes

  • Last week me hadbadi me handover.
  • Sirf code dena, context aur gotchas nahi.
  • Access ya ownership transfer bhool jana.
  • Naye owner se confirm na lena.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Clean handover kaise karte ho?
    A. Runbook aur handover doc, live walkthrough, shadow cycle, known issues aur contacts, aur naye owner ka sign-off.
  • Q. Tribal knowledge se kya dikkat?
    A. Wo insaan na ho to kaam ruk jaata hai. Documentation se risk kam hota hai.

Yaad rakho

Jo tumhare dimaag me hai wo doc me laao, aur handover me shadow cycle rakho.

CW-11Stakeholder managementIntermediateMust Know

Regular syncs rakho, samjho unhe asli me kya chahiye, aur expectations manage karo.

Simple me samjho

Stakeholder customer jaisa hai. Jo wo maangte hain aur jo unhe chahiye, wo alag ho sakta hai. Regular baat se surprises kam hote hain.

Key points

  • Map karo: Kaun kaun stakeholder hai, unka goal aur kitna influence.
  • Regular syncs: Weekly ya bi-weekly 15-30 min: status, naye asks, blockers.
  • Asli need samjho: Request ke peeche ka decision poochho ("kyun chahiye?").
  • Expectations manage: Kya milega, kab, aur kya nahi: shuru me hi saaf bolo.
  • No surprises: Bad news jaldi batao, saath me plan.
  • Proactive updates: Poochne se pehle update do.
  • Unki bhasha: Unke KPIs me baat karo.
  • Feedback loop: Deliver ke baad poochho kaam aaya ya nahi.

Example

text
Weekly sync agenda (Priya, Product) - 20 min
1) Last week delivered: Retention dashboard v1
2) This week: D30 view (ETA Thu), referral A/B test design
3) Risks: events data gap Nov 10-12 (Data-Eng fixing)
4) New asks / priorities from your side?

Surprise-free message:
"Heads-up: D30 view Thursday ki jagah Friday ho sakta hai, data-eng fix pe depend karta hai.
 Wednesday ko final confirm karunga."

Agenda me delivered, planned, risks aur naye asks hain, aur heads-up proactive hai.

Common mistakes

  • Sirf tab baat karna jab deadline aaye.
  • Request ko word-to-word lena, asli need na samajhna.
  • Over-promise karna.
  • Bad news chhupana.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Stakeholder ki asli need kaise pata lagate ho?
    A. "Is data se kya decide hoga?" poochta hoon, aur ek rough version dikha ke feedback leta hoon.
  • Q. Expectations kaise manage karte ho?
    A. Scope, ETA aur limitations shuru me batata hoon, aur badlav hone par turant update deta hoon.

Yaad rakho

Regular baat, asli need, aur koi surprise nahi.

CW-12Reporting cadenceIntermediateMust Know

Daily, weekly, monthly reports aur MBR/QBR ka rhythm rakho, aur recurring reports ko automate karo.

Simple me samjho

Alag audience ko alag frequency chahiye: ops ko daily, product ko weekly, leadership ko monthly ya quarterly. Jo report baar baar banti hai usko automate karo, taaki time analysis me lage.

Key points

  • Daily: Ops aur monitoring: DAU, deposits, rake, errors. Short aur alert-style.
  • Weekly: Product aur marketing: trends, funnels, experiments, week-over-week change.
  • Monthly: Leadership aur finance: MBR (Monthly Business Review), targets vs actual.
  • Quarterly: QBR (Quarterly Business Review): bade trends, strategy, next quarter plan.
  • Audience-first: Report ka goal aur decision pehle tay karo, phir frequency.
  • Automate: Scheduled query, dashboard refresh, ya auto email: manual copy-paste kam karo.
  • Consistent format: Same metrics, same definitions, taaki trend compare ho sake.
  • Kabhi band bhi karo: Jo report koi nahi padhta use retire karo.

Example

ReportAudienceFrequencyContent
Daily pulseOpsDaily 9 AMDAU, deposits, rake, failed txns
Weekly growthProduct, MarketingMondayNew players, D7 retention, funnel
MBRLeadership, FinanceMonthlyRevenue vs target, KPIs, variance
QBRLeadershipQuarterlyTrends, wins, next-quarter plan
text
Automation note: weekly_growth job (scheduler) -> runs Mon 7 AM -> updates dashboard -> emails Product list.
                 Failure alert to analytics channel.

Table se audience aur frequency match hoti hai, automation se manual kaam khatam.

Common mistakes

  • Har kisi ko har cheez daily bhejna.
  • Report manual banate rehna jabki automation possible hai.
  • Alag reports me alag definitions.
  • Report chalu rakhna jabki koi use nahi karta.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. MBR aur QBR kya hain?
    A. Monthly aur Quarterly Business Review: leadership ke saath performance, targets, variance aur aage ke plan ki meeting.
  • Q. Recurring report automate kyun?
    A. Time bachta hai, human error kam hota hai, aur report consistent aur time pe aati hai.

Yaad rakho

Audience ke hisaab se cadence, aur jo baar baar ho use automate karo.

CW-13Working with legacy dashboards and undocumented tablesIntermediateMust Know

Purane dashboards aur bina doc ke tables ki lineage dhoondo, owners se poochho, aur seekhte hue document karo.

Simple me samjho

Naye job me aksar purane dashboards milte hain jinka koi doc nahi. Detective ki tarah source tak trace karo. Jo seekho use likhte jao taaki agle ko aasaani ho.

Key points

  • Lineage: Number kahan se aata hai: dashboard -> query -> table -> source system/pipeline.
  • Dashboard se shuru: Chart ki query kholo, tables aur filters note karo.
  • Table explore: Columns, row count, date range, NULLs, sample rows dekho.
  • Owners se poochho: Query ya table ka last editor, data-eng, ya purana analyst. Chhote specific sawaal.
  • Validate: Purane number ko ek independent source se match karo, tabhi bharosa karo.
  • Usage check: Dashboard ko abhi kaun dekhta hai? Agar koi nahi to retire ho sakta hai.
  • Document as you learn: Column meanings, gotchas, owner, last verified date likho.
  • Mat badlo bina samjhe: Pehle impact samjho, phir change karo.

Example

sql
-- Undocumented table explore (PostgreSQL)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows, MIN(created_at) AS first_row, MAX(created_at) AS last_row
FROM legacy_player_stats;

SELECT column_name, data_type
FROM information_schema.columns
WHERE table_name = 'legacy_player_stats';
text
Note added to wiki:
legacy_player_stats - updated nightly by job X (owner: Karan). 'wins' = hands won, NOT tournaments won.
Last verified: 2026-11-20. Known issue: duplicates for players with 2 accounts.

Query se range aur columns dikhte hain, aur wiki note agle analyst ke kaam aata hai.

Common mistakes

  • Purane dashboard ke number pe seedha bharosa.
  • Bina owner se poochhe table ke columns ka matlab guess karna.
  • Seekha hua kahin likhna nahi.
  • Legacy query badal dena bina dekhe ki kaun use karta hai.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Undocumented table mile to?
    A. Columns, row count, date range aur sample dekhta hoon, lineage trace karta hoon, owner se confirm karta hoon, aur jo seekha doc me likhta hoon.
  • Q. Legacy dashboard ka number kaise verify karte ho?
    A. Query tak trace karke ek independent source se reconcile karta hoon.

Yaad rakho

Lineage trace karo, owner se poochho, aur seekhte hue likhte jao.

CW-14Sharing data securelyBasicMust Know

Permissions ka dhyan rakho, email ya chat me PII nahi, aur sirf approved storage use karo.

Simple me samjho

Player data real logon ka hai. Galat jagah share karna privacy breach ban sakta hai. Sirf jitna zaroori ho utna, aur sirf unhe jinhe chahiye.

Key points

  • PII: Naam, email, phone, ID, payment details, IP. Ye personal data hai.
  • No PII in email/chat: Email, Slack ya WhatsApp me raw player data mat bhejo.
  • Approved storage: Company ke approved drive, BI tool ya data platform ka use. Personal laptop ya personal cloud nahi.
  • Permissions: Dashboard aur files ko sirf zaroori logon tak share karo (least privilege).
  • Minimum data: Zaroorat ho to aggregated ya anonymised (user_id hash) data do.
  • Need-to-know: Share karne se pehle poochho: kya ye person ye data dekh sakta hai?
  • Access review: Purane shares aur links time-time pe hatao.
  • Galti ho jaye to: Turant apne manager aur security team ko batao.

Example

text
Request: "Top 100 depositors ka naam, email aur amount bhej do."
Reply:   "Raw naam/email main email pe nahi bhej sakta (PII policy). Options:
          1) User ID + amount, aggregated tier-wise, shared drive pe restricted link.
          2) Agar contact karna hai to CRM team ko list ID se bhejta hoon.
          Kya inme se kuch chalega?"

Safe share checklist:
[ ] PII removed / hashed   [ ] Approved location   [ ] Access limited to named people   [ ] Expiry set

Reply me na bhi hai, option bhi, aur checklist se safe sharing yaad rehti hai.

Common mistakes

  • Excel with emails ko Slack/email me attach kar dena.
  • "Anyone with link" access dena.
  • Zyada columns share karna jo zaroori nahi.
  • Personal drive ya screenshot me player data.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Sensitive data share karna ho to?
    A. Approved storage, restricted access, minimum aur anonymised data, aur policy ke hisaab se approval.
  • Q. PII kya hai?
    A. Kisi insaan ko identify karne wala data: naam, email, phone, ID, payment info, kabhi kabhi IP bhi.

Yaad rakho

Minimum data, approved jagah, sahi log: PII kabhi chat ya email me nahi.

CW-15Working with vague requirementsIntermediateMust Know

Vague ask pe jaldi prototype banao aur full version se pehle confirm karo.

Simple me samjho

"Hume player behaviour samajhna hai" jaise ask pe poora kaam shuru karna risky hai. Chhota draft dikhao, feedback lo, phir bada banao.

Key points

  • Pehle poochho: Decision, deadline, aur definition (CS-10 wale sawaal).
  • Prototype early: Ek chhota chart, sample table ya mockup 1-2 din me.
  • Wireframe/mockup: Dashboard ka paper ya slide sketch pehle dikhao.
  • Small slice: Ek segment ya ek hafte ka data pe pehle draft.
  • Confirm before full build: "Ye sahi direction hai?" jab tak haan na ho, full version mat banao.
  • Assumptions likho: "Maine active = last 7 din me 1 hand maana hai."
  • Iterate: Feedback ke baad version 2. Changes track karo.
  • Time-box exploration: Vague kaam ko limit do, jaise "2 din exploration".

Example

text
Ask:     "Player engagement dashboard chahiye."
Step 1:  Poochha: kaunsa decision? Product ko feature priority tay karni hai. Audience: Product team.
Step 2:  Prototype (1 din): 3 charts: DAU, hands/player/day, session length. Last 4 weeks, cash game only.
Message: "Draft attached. Assumption: engaged = 3+ sessions/week. Kya ye direction sahi hai?
          Haan to Thursday tak full dashboard (segments, mobile vs desktop)."

Pehle chhota draft + assumptions, phir confirmation, phir full build.

Common mistakes

  • Bina poochhe 1 hafta lagake bada dashboard banana.
  • Assumptions na likhna.
  • Feedback na lena prototype ke baad.
  • Exploration ko time-box na karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Vague requirement aaye to?
    A. Decision aur definition poochta hoon, chhota prototype banata hoon, assumptions likhta hoon, aur confirm hone par full version banata hoon.
  • Q. Prototype kyun?
    A. Jaldi feedback milta hai aur galat direction me bada kaam nahi hota.

Yaad rakho

Chhota draft pehle, confirm karo, phir full build.

CW-16Time zones, currencies, fiscal calendarsIntermediateMust Know

Fiscal year, week start, time zone aur FX rates sahi handle karo, warna numbers match nahi honge.

Simple me samjho

Ek hi data alag time zone, currency ya week definition me alag dikhta hai. Shuru me hi rules tay karo aur likh do.

Key points

  • Time zone: DB aksar UTC me store karta hai. Report IST ya local me chahiye to convert karo. Din ki boundary badal jaati hai.
  • Ek standard: Poori report me ek hi time zone rakho aur label karo ("IST").
  • DST: Kuch regions me daylight saving hota hai, din 23 ya 25 ghante ka ho sakta hai. India me DST nahi hota.
  • Week start: Kuch jagah Monday, kuch jagah Sunday se. ISO week Monday se shuru hota hai.
  • Fiscal year: Company ka saal Jan se nahi bhi ho sakta, jaise April-March (India me common). Q1 ka matlab company ke FY se.
  • Currency: Players alag currencies me khelte hain. Reporting currency tay karo.
  • FX rates: Kaunsa rate: transaction date ka, month-end ka, ya fixed budget rate? Finance se confirm karo, aur rate ka source likho.
  • Document: Report me time zone, week start, FY, currency aur FX rule footer me likho.

Example

sql
-- PostgreSQL: UTC timestamp ko IST me convert karke daily count
SELECT (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AS ist_day,
       COUNT(*) AS txns
FROM transactions
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
text
Footer: Time zone IST | Week = Mon-Sun (ISO) | FY = Apr-Mar | Currency = INR (daily FX, source: Treasury)

Agar created_at UTC me hai to ye query din ki boundary IST me sahi karti hai. Late-night transactions agle din me ginti hongi.

Common mistakes

  • UTC me group karke report IST ke din se compare karna.
  • Calendar quarter aur fiscal quarter mix karna.
  • FX rate ka rule na batana.
  • Week start alag tools me alag hona.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Time zone ki wajah se numbers kyun mismatch ho sakte hain?
    A. Din ki boundary badalti hai: UTC ka ek din IST me do dino me baat jaata hai. Isliye ek standard tay karke label karna zaroori hai.
  • Q. FX rate ka kaunsa use karein?
    A. Business rule pe depend: transaction date ka, month-end, ya budget rate. Finance se confirm karke document karta hoon.

Yaad rakho

Time zone, week start, FY aur FX ka rule pehle tay karo aur report me likho.

CW-17SLAs and support rotationIntermediateGood to Have

SLA me response aur resolution time tay hota hai. On-call analyst rotation me urgent data issues sambhalta hai.

Simple me samjho

SLA ek vaada hai: "request ka jawab itne time me denge". Support rotation me baari baari se ek analyst urgent asks dekhta hai. Isse baaki team deep work kar paati hai.

Key points

  • SLA: Service Level Agreement: response time (pehla reply) aur resolution time (kaam khatam).
  • Priority levels: P1 (live issue/CEO number), P2 (is hafte), P3 (backlog), har ek ka alag SLA.
  • Response vs resolution: Response = "mila, dekh raha hoon". Resolution = poora jawab.
  • Support rotation: Roz ya haftawar ek analyst support/on-call: ad-hoc asks, data issues, alerts.
  • On-call duties: Queue dekhna, triage, chhote asks resolve karna, bade asks ticket me, incident me escalate.
  • Handoff: Rotation badalte waqt open items ka note.
  • Out-of-hours: Agar company ke rules me hai to alag SLA, compensation aur escalation path.
  • Report SLA: Kitne tickets SLA ke andar hue, trend dekho.

Example

PriorityExampleFirst responseResolution
P1Dashboard wrong, leadership meeting aaj30 minSame day
P2Ad-hoc metric for campaign4 working hours2 days
P3New dashboard request2 daysPlanned sprint
text
On-call handoff (Fri): Open: DATA-530 waiting on Data-Eng; DATA-535 draft sent to Priya. Alerts: none firing.
Ack message: "Mil gaya, dekh raha hoon. 3 PM tak update dunga. - on-call analyst"

Table se expectations clear hain, aur ack message response SLA poora karta hai.

Common mistakes

  • Ticket ka response hi nahi dena, bas silent.
  • Har request ko P1 bana dena.
  • Handoff notes na likhna.
  • On-call ko apna sab kaam karne ka mauka samajhna: pehle queue dekho.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. SLA me response aur resolution ka farak?
    A. Response pehla acknowledge hota hai, resolution poora jawab ya fix.
  • Q. On-call analyst kya karta hai?
    A. Support queue dekhta hai, triage karta hai, chhote asks resolve karta hai, bade ko ticket me daalta hai, aur incident me escalate karta hai.

Yaad rakho

Jaldi acknowledge karo, priority ke hisaab se resolve karo, handoff likho.

CW-18Business and KPI reviewsIntermediateMust Know

Talking points banao, variance explain karo, aur sawaalon ke liye pehle se tayyar raho.

Simple me samjho

KPI review me log pooch-te hain: "number badla kyun?" Tumhe pehle se pata hona chahiye. Number ke peeche ki wajah, size aur action ready rakho.

Key points

  • Talking points: 3-5 bullets: kya hua, kyun, kya karenge.
  • Variance: Actual vs target ya vs last period. Absolute (Rs) aur % dono.
  • Explain variance: Driver breakdown: volume, price/mix, segment, channel, ek-baar ka event.
  • Anticipate questions: "Kya bots ka asar hai?", "Seasonality?", "Is mahine ka data poora hai?"
  • Backup data: Segment table aur drill-down ready.
  • Pehle number verify: Review se pehle reconcile karo, meeting me surprise nahi.
  • Ownership: Kaun action lega, kab tak.
  • Honest rahao: Jo nahi pata, wo "verify karke bhejta hoon".

Example

text
KPI: Net rake Oct = Rs 46L vs target Rs 50L (-Rs 4L, -8%); vs Sep +3%.
Variance drivers:
  - Mobile join issue (v4.2): -Rs 2.5L
  - Fewer weekend tournaments (holiday week): -Rs 1.0L
  - Other / noise: -Rs 0.5L
Action: Hotfix v4.2 (Eng, 20 Nov). Recovery estimate: +Rs 2.5L next month.

Anticipated Q&A:
Q: Seasonality? A: Oct last year bhi -4% vs target; so ~half normal.
Q: Bots? A: Bots excluded in this metric.

Variance ko drivers me toda hai, aur sawaal pehle se tayyar hain.

Common mistakes

  • Sirf number batana, wajah nahi.
  • Review me hi pata chalna ki number galat hai.
  • Variance ke drivers ka sum total se match na karna.
  • Excuses dena, action na dena.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Variance kaise explain karte ho?
    A. Actual vs target ya last period compare karta hoon, drivers me todta hoon (segment, channel, volume, one-off), aur har driver ka size aur action batata hoon.
  • Q. KPI review ki tayyari?
    A. Number verify, talking points, backup tables, aur anticipated questions ki list.

Yaad rakho

Number, wajah, size, action: aur sawaal pehle se soch ke aao.

CW-19Learning from wrong numbersIntermediateMust Know

Galat number ho jaye to post-mortem karo, checklist banao, aur wahi galti dobara mat dohrao.

Simple me samjho

Galti sabse hoti hai. Fark ye hai ki hum us se seekhte hain ya nahi. Blame nahi, process sudhaar.

Key points

  • Turant batao: Galti pata chalte hi affected logon ko corrected number aur sorry ke saath.
  • Impact samjho: Kaunsa report, kitna farak, kis decision pe asar?
  • Root cause: "Kyun hua?" baar baar poochho (5 whys): duplicate join, galat filter, time zone, stale data.
  • Post-mortem: Short doc: kya hua, timeline, root cause, impact, fix, prevention. Blameless tone.
  • Checklist update: Jo check chhoot gaya tha use pre-share checklist me jodo (CW-08).
  • Prevent: Automated tests (row count, total match), peer review, alerts.
  • Share learning: Team ko batao, taaki sab seekhein.
  • Trust rebuild: Agle kuch reports extra check ke saath.

Example

text
POST-MORTEM: Rake report overstated by 6% (Nov 14-17)
What:      Weekly rake report showed Rs 53L instead of Rs 50L.
Impact:    Shared with Finance; budget discussion used wrong number. Corrected Nov 18.
Root cause: Join with promo table (many-to-one per user) duplicated rows.
Fix:       Pre-aggregate promo table to user level; re-ran report.
Prevention: Added check "SUM(rake) matches ledger within 0.5%" + row-count check; peer review mandatory for new joins.
Owner/Date: Rahul, 20 Nov

Isme blame nahi hai, root cause, fix aur prevention saaf hain.

Common mistakes

  • Galti chhupana ya der se batana.
  • Sirf number fix karna, root cause nahi.
  • Blame game: "kisne kiya".
  • Post-mortem likh ke checklist na badalna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Aapka report galat nikla to?
    A. Turant batata hoon, corrected number deta hoon, root cause nikalta hoon, aur checklist ya automated check jodta hoon taaki dobara na ho.
  • Q. Post-mortem me kya hota hai?
    A. Kya hua, impact, root cause, fix, prevention, owner: blameless tone me.

Yaad rakho

Jaldi batao, root cause dhoondo, aur process me prevention daalo.

CW-20Visibility and impactIntermediateGood to Have

Apni wins share karo, impact quantify karo, aur contributions document karo.

Simple me samjho

Achha kaam bina dikhaye adrishya reh jaata hai. Ye self-promotion nahi, team ko value dikhana hai. Number ke saath batao ki tumhare kaam se kya badla.

Key points

  • Share wins: Chhoti update team channel ya weekly note me: "Dashboard se Ops ka 3 ghante/week bacha."
  • Quantify impact: Rupees, time saved, ya conversion: "Rake loss 3L/month pakda."
  • Before vs after: Kaam se pehle aur baad ka farak.
  • Credit share karo: Team ko credit do, trust badhta hai.
  • Document contributions: Ek running "brag doc": date, kaam, impact, link.
  • Appraisal me kaam aata hai: Performance review me proof ke saath baat karo.
  • Showcase: Team demo, lunch-and-learn, ya internal blog.
  • Honest raho: Impact inflate mat karo, assumptions batao.

Example

text
Brag doc entry:
2026-11-12  Found mobile join failure (v4.2).  Impact: ~Rs 1.2L/week rake loss; hotfix shipped in 3 days.
                                                 Link: DATA-482, dashboard "Join Funnel".
2026-10-28  Automated weekly report.             Impact: saves ~4 hrs/week for 2 analysts (~Rs 0 extra cost).

Win post (team channel):
"Join funnel dashboard live. Isse v4.2 ka drop 1 din me pakda gaya; Eng ne hotfix kiya, ~Rs 1.2L/week loss bacha. Thanks Karan for the event fix!"

Win post me number, kaam, aur credit teeno hain.

Common mistakes

  • Kaam karke chup rehna, phir appraisal me yaad na aana.
  • Impact me vague words: "bahut improve hua".
  • Sab credit khud lena.
  • Numbers inflate karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Apne impact ko kaise dikhate ho?
    A. Quantify karta hoon: Rs, time saved ya conversion, before/after, aur ek running doc me link ke saath rakhta hoon.
  • Q. Ek example do jahan tumhare analysis se farak pada.
    A. Problem, kya kiya, number me impact, aur result batata hoon (STAR style).

Yaad rakho

Kaam karo, number me likho, aur sahi logon tak pahunchao.

CW-21Cost awarenessIntermediateGood to Have

Cloud query cost, licences aur bekaar refreshes ka dhyan rakho.

Simple me samjho

Warehouse aur BI tools ka paisa lagta hai. Har query aur refresh ka chhota kharcha hota hai, jo jodke bada ho jaata hai. Samajhdari se queries aur schedules rakho.

Key points

  • Cloud query cost: Kai warehouses scanned data ya compute time ke hisaab se charge karte hain (tool pe depend). Bina filter ki query mehngi.
  • Reduce scan: Sirf zaroori columns (SELECT * se bacho), date filter, aur partitions use karo.
  • Pre-aggregate: Bar bar chalne wali heavy query ka daily summary table banao.
  • Wasteful refreshes: Har 5 min refresh jab data din me ek baar badalta hai: schedule kam karo.
  • Unused dashboards: Jinhe koi nahi dekhta unhe band karo, refresh aur storage bachti hai.
  • Licences: BI tool ya seats ka kharcha: unused licences review karo.
  • Test chhote sample pe: LIMIT ya chhote date range se test, phir full.
  • Cost dikhao: Dashboard ya query ka monthly cost estimate team ke saath share karo.

Example

sql
-- Mehnga: saare columns, saari history
SELECT * FROM events;

-- Sasta: zaroori columns, date filter
SELECT user_id, event_type, event_time
FROM events
WHERE event_time >= '2026-11-01' AND event_time < '2026-11-08';
text
Schedule review: dashboard "Live Tables" refresh 5 min -> 1 hour (data hourly hi aata hai). ~90% kam queries.

Dusri query kam data scan karegi, aur schedule kam karne se refresh cost bachti hai.

Common mistakes

  • Warehouse pe SELECT * aur bina date filter.
  • Dashboard ka refresh unnecessarily frequent.
  • Unused dashboards aur licences ko chalu rakhna.
  • Cost ko apna problem na samajhna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Query cost kaise kam karte ho?
    A. Zaroori columns aur date filter, partitions, pre-aggregated tables, aur refresh frequency ko data ke update rate ke hisaab se rakhta hoon.
  • Q. Cost awareness kyun?
    A. Chhote-chhote wasteful queries jodke bada bill banate hain; team ke budget ke liye zimmedari hai.

Yaad rakho

Kam data scan karo, refresh zaroorat ke hisaab se, aur unused cheezein band karo.

CW-22Writing a good data requestBasicGood to Have

Achhi data request me ye hota hai: question, deadline, audience, definition aur expected output.

Simple me samjho

Request jitni clear, utna jaldi aur sahi jawab. Ek template se har baar wahi sawaal bar bar poochne ki zaroorat nahi padti. Ye analyst aur requester dono ke liye helpful hai.

Key points

  • Question: Business question ya decision jo data se tay hoga.
  • Deadline: Kab tak chahiye aur kyun (meeting, launch).
  • Audience: Kis ko dikhana hai (team, leadership, external).
  • Definition: Metrics ki definition: active player, period, segment, time zone.
  • Expected output: Number, table, chart, ya dashboard; format (CSV, slide).
  • Context/priority: Impact aur priority batao, taaki sahi order me ho.
  • Data sensitivity: PII chahiye? Approval ki zaroorat?
  • Single ticket: Request ticket me daalo (CW-06), chat me nahi.

Example

text
Data request template

Question:        Kya naye bonus ke baad referral players ka D7 retention gira?
Decision:        Bonus rule rollback karein ya nahi.
Deadline:        Thu 26 Nov, 3 PM (Product weekly meeting)
Audience:        Product team + Head of Growth
Definition:      D7 retention = players jo join ke 7th din active (>=1 hand). Bots excluded. IST.
Scope:           Referral channel, joined Oct 1 - Nov 15, cash game.
Expected output: 1 chart (weekly cohort) + 3-line summary.
PII needed?:     No (aggregated only).
Priority:        P2.

Isse analyst ko 10 clarifying sawaal nahi poochhne padte, aur kaam ek hi baar me sahi hota hai.

Common mistakes

  • "Retention data de do" jaisi vague request.
  • Deadline na batana ya last moment pe dena.
  • Definition ke bina alag logon ke alag numbers.
  • Chat me maangna aur ticket na banana.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Achhi data request me kya hota hai?
    A. Question aur decision, deadline, audience, metric definition, scope, aur expected output.
  • Q. Requester vague request bheje to?
    A. Template bhejta hoon aur 3 sawaal poochta hoon: decision, deadline, aur definition.

Yaad rakho

Question, deadline, audience, definition, output: ye paanch saath me do.

Interview Prep 13 topics

IP-01Resume and LinkedInBasicMust Know

Resume ka goal hai 6-10 second me impress karna. Quantified impact bullets, relevant tools, projects aur keywords use karo.

Simple me samjho

Recruiter ek resume par bahut kam time deta hai. Isliye har bullet me "maine kya kiya aur uska result kya tha" hona chahiye. Responsibilities nahi, achievements likho.

Key points

  • Bullet formula: Action verb + what you did + tool + measurable result. Example: "Built X using Y, which reduced Z by N%."
  • Quantify karo: %, time saved, revenue, users, rows. Exact number na ho to range ya estimate (approx) likho, par jhooth nahi.
  • Tools section: SQL (PostgreSQL), Python (pandas), Excel, Power BI/Tableau, Git. Sirf wo likho jo interview me explain kar sako.
  • Projects: 2-3 projects, har ek me problem, data, approach aur result. GitHub ya portfolio link do.
  • Keywords: job description se match karo (ATS ke liye): "cohort analysis", "A/B testing", "dashboard", "stakeholder", "ETL".
  • One page, clean format: ek page (2 yrs experience ke liye), simple font, no photos/graphics.
  • LinkedIn: headline me role + domain ("Data Analyst | SQL, Power BI | Online Gaming"), About me 3-4 lines, skills aur projects update rakho.
  • Consistency: resume aur LinkedIn ke dates aur titles same hone chahiye.

Example

Kamzor bullet: "Responsible for making dashboards and reports."

Strong bullets:

text
- Built a retention dashboard in Power BI (SQL + DAX) for 5 stakeholder teams,
  cutting weekly manual reporting from 6 hours to 30 minutes.
- Identified a 12% deposit drop on Android via funnel segmentation; payments
  team fixed a gateway timeout, recovering ~Rs 8L monthly deposits.
- Wrote SQL cohort queries (D1/D7/D30) on 20M+ event rows, used to tune
  welcome-bonus rules.

Har bullet me tool aur measurable outcome hai. Confidential numbers ko approx ya % me likho.

Common mistakes

  • "Responsible for..." jaise duties list karna.
  • Bahut saare tools likhna jo aate nahi.
  • Confidential company data ya exact revenue publish kar dena.
  • 3 page resume ya typos.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Resume me ye bullet kaise bana?
    A. (Ready raho) Context, tumhara role, tool, aur result 30 second me samjha sako.
  • Q. Resume me koi skill likhi hai jo kam aati hai, to?
    A. Honest raho. "Working knowledge" bolo aur concrete example do. Wo skills hi likho jo defend kar sako.

Yaad rakho

Har bullet me ek number aur ek tool hona chahiye.

IP-02SQL interview practiceIntermediateMust Know

SQL rounds me joins, window functions, aggregation aur dedupe ke sawal aate hain. Roz practice karo, easy se hard tak.

Simple me samjho

SQL interview ek gym jaisa hai: rozana thoda practice se pattern yaad ho jate hain. Patterns pehchano, naya sawal bhi purane jaisa lagega.

Key points

  • Platforms: LeetCode (database section), StrataScratch (real company-style questions), DataLemur (SQL-focused). Teeno me easy, medium, hard levels hote hain.
  • Plan: pehle 2 hafte easy (SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY, JOIN), phir medium (window functions, CTEs), phir hard (gaps and islands, recursive).
  • Window functions: ROW_NUMBER, RANK, DENSE_RANK, LAG/LEAD, running totals, top-N per group.
  • Joins: INNER vs LEFT, anti-join (LEFT JOIN ... WHERE b.id IS NULL), self join.
  • Dedupe: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ... ORDER BY ...) aur rn = 1.
  • Common patterns: second highest, consecutive days, cohort retention, year-over-year, running average.
  • Interview me bolke socho: pehle table grain aur expected output clarify karo, phir approach batao, phir code likho.
  • Edge cases: NULLs, ties, duplicates, empty groups. Interviewer yahi dekhta hai.
  • Dialect: pucho kaunsa database hai (PostgreSQL, MySQL). Functions thode alag ho sakte hain.
  • Track karo: ek sheet me problem, pattern aur mistakes likho.

Example

Top 2 highest-rake players per stake (PostgreSQL):

sql
SELECT *
FROM (
  SELECT stake, user_id, SUM(rake) AS total_rake,
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY stake ORDER BY SUM(rake) DESC) AS rnk
  FROM hands
  GROUP BY stake, user_id
) t
WHERE rnk <= 2;

DENSE_RANK ties ko handle karta hai. Interview me bolo ki ROW_NUMBER use karne par ties me ek hi row aati.

Common mistakes

  • Bina clarify kiye seedha code likhna.
  • NULL aur duplicates ke edge cases ignore karna.
  • RANK aur DENSE_RANK ka difference yaad na hona.
  • Sirf solutions padhna, khud likhna nahi. Timer lagake khud likho.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Duplicate rows kaise hataoge?
    A. ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY updated_at DESC) aur rn = 1 filter. Ya SELECT DISTINCT agar poori row duplicate hai.
  • Q. Nth highest salary kaise nikaloge?
    A. DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY salary DESC) aur rank = N. Ties handle ho jate hain.

Yaad rakho

Pattern pehchano, edge cases bolo, aur timer ke saath practice karo.

IP-03Python and pandas practiceIntermediateMust Know

Python rounds me pandas se data manipulation aur kuch basic algorithm sawal aate hain. Hands-on practice sabse zaroori hai.

Simple me samjho

Interview me Python ka matlab mostly data ko clean, filter, group aur merge karna hai. Heavy algorithms kam, par strings aur lists ke basic sawal aate hain.

Key points

  • Core pandas: read_csv, head, info, describe, isna, fillna, dropna, drop_duplicates.
  • Selection: loc, iloc, boolean filter, query.
  • Groupby: groupby().agg(), transform, size, nunique.
  • Merge: merge(how='left'), concat, key duplicates check.
  • Datetime: pd.to_datetime, .dt.date, .dt.dayofweek, resample.
  • Reshape: pivot_table, melt, sort_values, rank.
  • Window-like: shift, diff, cumsum, rolling.
  • Basic algorithms: reverse string, palindrome, two-sum with dict, count frequency (Counter), FizzBuzz, dedupe list preserving order.
  • Interview habit: pehle data shape aur dtypes dekho, assumptions bolo, chhote steps me code likho.
  • Practice: StrataScratch aur DataLemur me Python/pandas questions, aur kisi real CSV par khud analysis.

Example

Per-user latest deposit aur total deposit:

python
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv("deposits.csv", parse_dates=["created_at"])
df = df.drop_duplicates(subset="txn_id")

out = (
    df.sort_values("created_at")
      .groupby("user_id")
      .agg(total=("amount", "sum"),
           last_deposit=("created_at", "max"))
      .reset_index()
)
print(out.head())

Duplicates hata ke per user total aur last date mil gaya. Same cheez SQL me bhi bol sakte ho.

Common mistakes

  • Loop se rows iterate karna jab vectorized operation possible hai.
  • Merge ke baad row count check na karna (duplicate keys se rows badh jati hain).
  • SettingWithCopyWarning ignore karna aur chained assignment karna.
  • Dtypes (string date, numeric as object) check na karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. merge ke baad rows kyun badh gayi?
    A. Key duplicate thi, many-to-many join hua. Merge se pehle duplicated() check aur validate argument use karo.
  • Q. apply vs vectorized operation?
    A. Vectorized (built-in pandas/NumPy ops) tez hote hain. apply row-wise hai aur slow, jab zaroori ho tabhi use karo.

Yaad rakho

Shape dekho, vectorize karo, merge ke baad rows verify karo.

IP-04Statistics questionsIntermediateMust Know

Interview me hypothesis testing, A/B tests, distributions aur chhote probability puzzles puche jate hain. Concepts simple words me samjhana seekho.

Simple me samjho

Statistics ka sawal aksar "kya ye difference real hai ya luck?" hota hai. Tumhe test, p-value aur assumptions simple tareeke se explain karne aate hone chahiye.

Key points

  • Hypothesis testing: H0 (no effect) vs H1 (effect). Data se H0 ko reject karte hain ya nahi.
  • p-value: agar H0 sach ho to itna extreme result aane ki probability. Chhota p-value = H0 par shak.
  • Significance level (alpha): usually 0.05. Ye Type I error ki limit hai.
  • Type I vs Type II: Type I = false positive. Type II = false negative. Power = 1 - Type II.
  • Confidence interval: estimate ki range. 95% CI ka matlab procedure 95% baar sahi range pakadta hai.
  • A/B testing: random split, ek metric, pehle se sample size aur duration decide, peeking se bacho.
  • Tests: two proportions z-test/chi-square (conversion), t-test (means), Mann-Whitney (non-normal).
  • Distributions: Normal, Binomial (success/fail), Poisson (events per time), skewed (revenue per player, long tail).
  • Central Limit Theorem: sample mean approximately normal hota hai, sample bada ho to.
  • Probability puzzles: 2 dice sum = 7 ki probability 6/36 = 1/6. Conditional probability aur Bayes basic aate hain.
  • Correlation vs causation aur multiple testing ka issue.

Example

Scenario: control conversion 10% (n=10,000), new welcome offer 11% (n=10,000).

text
H0: conversion same. H1: different.
Test: two-proportion z-test.
Result: p-value approx 0.02 (< 0.05).
Answer: difference statistically significant.
Par check karo: practical uplift +1pp worth hai? cost kitna? guardrails?

Statistical significance aur business significance dono bolo.

Common mistakes

  • p-value ko "H1 sach hone ki probability" bolna. Ye galat hai.
  • Test beech me dekh ke jaldi rok dena (peeking).
  • Revenue jaise skewed data par normal assumption lagana.
  • Sample size aur power plan na karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. p-value kya hai?
    A. Agar H0 sach ho to observed ya usse extreme result milne ki probability. Ye effect ki size nahi batata.
  • Q. Do dice ka sum 7 hone ki probability?
    A. 6 combinations / 36 = 1/6.

Yaad rakho

Statistical significance dikhao, phir business significance bhi.

IP-05Case studies and product senseIntermediateMust Know

Case rounds me metric drop investigation, success metrics define karna aur experiment design puchhe jate hain. Structure se bolo.

Simple me samjho

Interviewer dekhta hai tum kaise sochte ho, final answer se zyada. Clarify karo, structure banao, aur data se test karo.

Key points

  • Clarify first: product kya hai, goal kya hai, metric kya define hai, time period kya hai.
  • Metric drop framework: data check -> decompose -> segment -> internal causes -> external causes -> action.
  • Success metrics: ek primary metric, 2-3 supporting, aur guardrails. Example (new feature): adoption, retention, revenue per user, guardrail: fraud/support tickets.
  • Experiment design: hypothesis, randomization unit (user), metric, sample size, duration, guardrails, decision rule.
  • Product sense: user pain, feature ka goal, trade-offs, prioritisation (impact vs effort).
  • Structure bolo: "Main 3 parts me answer karunga..." ye clarity deta hai.
  • Hypotheses prioritise karo aur batao pehle kya check karoge aur kyu.
  • End with recommendation aur next steps, apni confidence ke saath.
  • Poker-style cases: "cash game rake 10% gira", "new tournament format ki success kaise measure karoge".

Example

Case: "Daily deposits 20% gire. Kya karoge?"

text
1. Clarify: kab se, kaunsa region/platform, absolute ya per-user?
2. Data check: pipeline, tracking, payment logs.
3. Decompose: deposits = depositors x avg deposit. Kaunsa gira?
4. Segment: gateway, device, country, new vs old.
5. Causes: release, gateway outage, promo end, festival, regulation.
6. Action: payments team se confirm, fix, monitor guardrails.

Ye structure har metric drop case par chalta hai.

Common mistakes

  • Bina clarify kiye solutions batana.
  • Sirf ek metric choose karna aur guardrails bhool jana.
  • Random ideas dena, structure nahi.
  • Final recommendation na dena.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Naye feature ki success kaise measure karoge?
    A. Goal clarify karunga, primary metric (adoption/retention) aur guardrails choose karunga, A/B test design karunga.
  • Q. Experiment me sample size kaise decide karoge?
    A. Baseline rate, minimum detectable effect, alpha aur power se calculate karunga.

Yaad rakho

Clarify, structure, data, recommendation. Is order me bolo.

IP-06Excel and BI tool testsIntermediateGood to Have

Excel ya BI tool test me pivot, lookups, DAX/LOD basics aur dashboard critique aate hain. Tools par hands-on speed zaroori hai.

Simple me samjho

Ye tests dekhte hain ki tum data ko jaldi table se insight tak la sakte ho ya nahi. Formula yaad karne se zyada flow aana chahiye.

Key points

  • Pivot table: rows, columns, values, filters. Group by date/month, calculated fields, percentage of total.
  • Lookups: VLOOKUP (left-to-right only), XLOOKUP (newer Excel versions), INDEX-MATCH (flexible). IFERROR se errors handle.
  • Core formulas: SUMIFS, COUNTIFS, AVERAGEIFS, IF, TEXT, date functions.
  • Excel hygiene: clean data (trim, duplicates, data types), tables, named ranges, charts.
  • DAX basics (Power BI): CALCULATE, SUM, DIVIDE, FILTER, time intelligence (SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR). Measure vs calculated column ka farak.
  • LOD (Tableau): FIXED, INCLUDE, EXCLUDE expressions. Different grain par aggregate karne ke liye.
  • Dashboard critique: purpose clear? kya sawal answer karta hai? kam charts, sahi chart type, labels, consistent colors, filters, number formatting, drill-down.
  • Common test tasks: dataset do, pivot + chart banao, KPI cards, top-N, YoY comparison.
  • Time-box: pehle basic version complete karo, phir polish.

Example

Dashboard critique ke liye bolo:

text
Purpose: Finance team ke liye daily rake monitoring.
Good: KPI cards upar, trend line, filter by stake.
Fix: 12 charts bahut zyada, pie chart me 15 slices,
     rake aur revenue ki definition missing,
     red/green colorblind-unfriendly.
Suggest: 4-5 charts, bar for categories, tooltip definitions.

Strong critique me purpose, issues aur concrete suggestion tino hote hain.

Common mistakes

  • Pivot banane se pehle data clean na karna.
  • VLOOKUP me exact match (FALSE) bhool jana.
  • Dashboard me bahut saare charts aur colors.
  • DAX measure aur calculated column ka farak na pata hona.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. VLOOKUP ki limitation?
    A. Sirf right side columns return karta hai aur column index hardcoded hota hai. XLOOKUP ya INDEX-MATCH zyada flexible hain.
  • Q. Measure aur calculated column me farak?
    A. Measure query time par filter context ke hisab se calculate hota hai. Calculated column row-wise refresh par calculate hoke store hota hai.

Yaad rakho

Pehle clean, phir pivot, aur dashboard ko purpose se judge karo.

IP-07Take-home assignmentsIntermediateGood to Have

Take-home me scope, assumptions, clear write-up aur time-box important hain. Insight aur communication code se zyada count karte hain.

Simple me samjho

Take-home ek mini real project hai. Company dekhti hai tum kaise sochte ho, kaise communicate karte ho, aur apna kaam kitna clean rakhte ho.

Key points

  • Scope samjho: question dobara padho. Kya poocha hai, kya nahi. Zarurat ho to clarifying email bhejo.
  • Assumptions likho: missing data, definitions, filters. Har assumption ek line me document karo.
  • Time-box: jitna time bola gaya (jaise 3-4 hours), usi me raho. Zyada polish se zyada clear answer behtar.
  • Pehle data check: nulls, duplicates, outliers, date ranges. Findings likho.
  • Structure: Executive summary (3 insights + recommendation) -> approach -> analysis -> limitations -> next steps.
  • Clear write-up: charts labelled, simple words, "so what" har chart ke neeche.
  • Reproducible: SQL/Python/notebook clean aur runnable, comments ke saath.
  • Recommendation: actionable aur prioritised. Impact ka estimate do.
  • Presentation round: apne choices aur trade-offs defend karne ke liye ready raho.

Example

Task: "Player churn ka analysis karo aur recommendations do."

text
Summary: 30-day churn 38%; high in players who never played a
tournament in first week (52% vs 28%).
Approach: churn = inactive 30d; cohort by signup week; segmented by
first-week behaviour.
Assumptions: test accounts removed; bonus-only players kept.
Recommendation: tournament onboarding nudge; test via A/B.
Limits: observational data, no causality.

Last me limitation likhna maturity dikhata hai.

Common mistakes

  • Time-box se bahut zyada samay lagana aur over-engineer karna.
  • Bina summary ke code ya raw tables bhej dena.
  • Assumptions ya data issues chhupana.
  • Insight ke bina sirf charts dena.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Take-home me data incomplete ho to?
    A. Assumptions clearly likhunga, ya clarification maangunga, aur analysis me limitations batunga.
  • Q. Aap kis cheez ko priority dete ho?
    A. Correct, clear insight pehle. Polish baad me, agar time bache.

Yaad rakho

Summary upar, assumptions saaf, aur time-box ka respect.

IP-08Behavioural stories (STAR)BasicMust Know

Behavioural sawalon ka jawab STAR format me do: Situation, Task, Action, Result. Conflict, failure, impact, prioritisation aur ambiguity ke stories ready rakho.

Simple me samjho

Interviewer past behaviour se future guess karta hai. Isliye 5-6 solid stories pehle se tayar rakho, aur wahi alag-alag sawalon par fit karo.

Key points

  • STAR: Situation (context, 1-2 lines), Task (tumhari zimmedari), Action (tumne kya kiya, "I" bolo), Result (number ke saath).
  • Time: 1.5 se 2 minute. Action sabse lamba part hona chahiye.
  • Story bank: conflict, failure, impact, prioritisation, ambiguity, aur ek leadership/ownership story ready rakho.
  • Conflict: stakeholder se disagreement. Dikhao ki tumne data aur empathy se resolve kiya.
  • Failure: asli galti batao, jisse seekha. Blame mat karo. End me kya badla wo batao.
  • Impact: measurable result (time saved, revenue, accuracy).
  • Prioritisation: bahut requests me impact vs effort aur deadline se kaise chuna.
  • Ambiguity: vague ask me kaise questions poochhe aur assumptions confirm kiye.
  • Result me numbers aur lesson dono do.

Example

Q: "Ek baar ambiguity me kaam kiya ho."

text
S: Product head ne bola "VIP players ka behaviour samjho", bina definition ke.
T: 1 week me insights dene the, definition tay karni thi.
A: Maine 3 questions poochhe (decision, time range, VIP kaun), 90-day rake ke
   top 5% se VIP define kiya, aur 2 stakeholders se confirm kiya. Phir cohort
   aur game-type analysis chalaya.
R: Insight mila ki VIPs tournaments me 3x zyada khelte hain. Isse rakeback
   offer redesign hua, jisse VIP retention 6 pp badha.

Ye story ambiguity aur impact dono sawalon me kaam aati hai.

Common mistakes

  • "We" bolna aur apna role na batana.
  • Result me number na dena.
  • Failure story me excuses ya jhooth ki perfect-sounding story.
  • Bahut lambi background aur Action chhota.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Ek failure batao.
    A. Real galti (jaise untested metric publish ki), uska impact, maine kya fix kiya, aur ab process me kya check add kiya (jaise reconciliation before publish).
  • Q. Stakeholder se disagreement hua to?
    A. Unka goal samjha, data dikhaya, options aur trade-offs rakhe, aur agreed decision document kiya.

Yaad rakho

Story bank banao, Action pe "I" bolo, Result me number do.

IP-09Explaining your projectsBasicMust Know

Apne project ko Problem, Approach, Result aur "kya badalta" ke structure me 2-3 minute me explain karna seekho.

Simple me samjho

Project explain karna ek chhoti kahani sunana hai. Interviewer ko jaldi samajh aana chahiye: kya problem thi, tumne kya kiya, aur kya farak pada.

Key points

  • Problem: business context aur kyun important tha. 2 lines.
  • Approach: data source, tools, steps, aur key decisions. Kyun ye method choose kiya.
  • Result: measurable outcome aur business decision jo isse hua.
  • What you would change: kya behtar kar sakte the (more data, better tests, automation). Ye maturity dikhata hai.
  • Your role: team project me tumhara hissa clear batao.
  • Challenges: ek-do real problems (dirty data, definition mismatch) aur solution.
  • Depth ke liye ready raho: "Ye number kaise calculate hua?", "Data kahan se aaya?" jaise follow-ups.
  • Simple words: non-technical interviewer ko bhi samajh aaye.
  • Practice: 30-second, 2-minute aur 5-minute versions ready rakho.

Example

Project: Poker churn dashboard.

text
Problem: Retention gir rahi thi par team ko pata nahi tha kis segment me.
Approach: SQL se signup cohorts banaye (D1/D7/D30), Power BI me channel aur
          stake-wise retention curves; data dictionary banayi.
Result: Ek affiliate channel ka D7 retention 9% nikla (avg 22%). Marketing ne
        spend 30% reduce karke high-retention channels me move kiya.
Change: Ab A/B test karke onboarding fix validate karta, aur pipeline
        automate karta.

Ye 2 minute me bolne layak hai.

Common mistakes

  • Tool-by-tool explanation, business problem skip karna.
  • Result ya impact na batana.
  • Project ki limitations ya galtiyan chhupana.
  • Bahut zyada technical detail se shuru karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Apna sabse bada project explain karo.
    A. Problem (1-2 lines), approach (tools aur steps), result (number), aur kya badalta. 2-3 minute me.
  • Q. Is project me sabse mushkil kya tha?
    A. Ek real challenge (jaise definitions mismatch), kaise resolve kiya, aur seekh.

Yaad rakho

Problem, Approach, Result, Change. Har project ke liye ye 4 lines ready rakho.

IP-10GuesstimatesIntermediateGood to Have

Guesstimate me exact answer nahi, structure, assumptions aur sanity check dekhe jate hain. Problem ko chhote parts me todo.

Simple me samjho

Aisa sawal jaise "India me roz kitne log online poker khelte hain?" Tumhe sahi number nahi pata, par logical steps se reasonable estimate nikalna hai.

Key points

  • Clarify: kya count karna hai, kaunsa region, time period, definition.
  • Structure: top-down (population se filter karke) ya bottom-up (unit economics se multiply karke). Pehle approach batao.
  • Segments: population ko logical groups me todo (age, urban/rural, income).
  • Assumptions: har assumption ek number ke saath bolo, aur round numbers use karo (easy math).
  • Calculation: step by step bolo, 10, 100, 1000 jaise round figures.
  • Sanity check: answer ko known benchmark se compare karo (population, GDP, known user counts).
  • Sensitivity: batao kaunsa assumption sabse zyada asar karta hai.
  • Time-box: 5-8 minute. Aaram se, loudly sochte hue.

Example

"India me roz kitne log online poker khelte hain?"

text
Population 1.4B. Internet users ~ 50% = 700M.
Age 18-45 = 50% -> 350M.
Real-money gaming interest 10% -> 35M.
Poker share of that 5% -> ~1.75M.
Daily active (20% of them) -> ~350K.
Sanity: poker platforms ke publicly claimed users ke range me?
Biggest sensitivity: 5% poker share aur 20% daily.

Numbers approximate hain aur laws/market ke hisab se badal sakte hain. Interview me assumptions clear bolna hi point hai.

Common mistakes

  • Bina structure ke seedha number bolna.
  • Assumptions bolna bhool jana.
