  • Hard math me atak jana (round numbers lo).
  • Sanity check skip karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Guesstimate me kya evaluate hota hai?
    A. Structured thinking, reasonable assumptions, comfort with numbers aur sanity check. Exact answer nahi.
  • Q. Top-down aur bottom-up me farak?
    A. Top-down badi population se filters lagake chhota karta hai. Bottom-up chhote unit (ek table, ek player) se multiply karke upar jata hai.

Yaad rakho

Structure, round assumptions, sanity check. Ye teen cheezein.

IP-11Salary research and negotiationBasicGood to Have

Market range pata karo, apni expectation clear rakho, aur offer ko politely negotiate karo. Preparation se confidence aata hai.

Simple me samjho

Salary ek business conversation hai, personal nahi. Data se tayari karo, aur poori package (fixed, bonus, benefits) ko dekho.

Key points

  • Market range research: job portals, Glassdoor-type salary sites, LinkedIn, peers aur recruiters se. Role, city, experience aur company size ke hisab se range nikalo.
  • Apna number: current CTC, target range, aur minimum acceptable pata hona chahiye.
  • Range do: expectation bolte waqt range do jiska lower end tumhe accept ho.
  • Current CTC: kuch jagah salary history poochi jati hai. Politely expectation par focus karo; local law aur practice alag hoti hai.
  • Total package: fixed, variable, joining bonus, ESOP, insurance, WFH, learning budget, notice-period buyout.
  • Offer milne par: thank karo, details likhit me maango, aur 1-2 din socho.
  • Negotiate: data aur value ke base par ("market range aur mere skills ko dekhte hue X ki umeed thi"). Ultimatum mat do.
  • Competing offers (agar hain) honestly use karo.
  • Written offer: final terms, joining date aur designation likhit me confirm karo.

Example

Recruiter: "Expectation kya hai?"

text
Tumhara jawab: "Mujhe role aur responsibilities ki achhi samajh hai.
Market research ke hisab se is role ke liye X se Y ki range lagti hai.
Main total package par flexible hu, agar role aur growth strong hai."
Offer aaya: Z (kam). Reply: "Offer ke liye thanks. Meri umeed
X-Y thi. Kya hum Z se thoda upar, X ke paas, discuss kar sakte hain?"

Polite, data-based aur specific range.

Common mistakes

  • Bina research ke number bolna.
  • Sirf fixed salary par focus, baaki package ignore karna.
  • Pehli baar me hi offer accept ya reject kar dena.
  • Negotiate karte waqt aggressive ya ultimatum wala tone.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Expected salary kya hai?
    A. Role aur market research ke hisab se ek range (X-Y) bolunga, aur total package par discuss karunga.
  • Q. Offer kam laga to?
    A. Thanks bolunga, market data aur apni value dikhake politely upar request karunga, aur written me confirm karunga.

Yaad rakho

Research karo, range bolo, total package dekho.

IP-12Mock interviewsBasicGood to Have

Mock interviews me ucchi awaaz me practice karo, feedback lo aur khud ko record karo. Isse real interview ka darr kam hota hai.

Simple me samjho

Cricket ki tarah net practice. Padhna aur bolna alag skills hain. Jo cheez dimaag me clear lagti hai wo bolne me atakti hai.

Key points

  • Practice out loud: answer zor se bolo, chup-chap padhna kaafi nahi.
  • Kisse karo: dost, colleague, senior, ya mock-interview platforms. Aise logo se jo honest feedback dein.
  • Real conditions: timer, camera on, shared doc/SQL editor, aur actual interview jaisi setting.
  • Feedback lo: clarity, structure, speed, confidence, technical mistakes. Specific points maango.
  • Record yourself: video ya audio, phir dekho: filler words ("um", "basically"), pace, eye contact, rambling.
  • Types: SQL live coding, case study, behavioural, project walkthrough. Har type alag practice.
  • Track mistakes: ek list banao, har mock ke baad improvement dekho.
  • Frequency: interview se pehle 4-6 mocks, aur repeat karo weak areas par.

Example

Weekly plan:

text
Mon: SQL timed (2 problems, 40 min), bol ke solve
Wed: Case study mock with friend (metric drop)
Fri: STAR stories record, 2 min each, review
Sun: Full mock (SQL + case + behavioural), feedback sheet update

Feedback sheet me: kya achha tha, kya fix karna hai, next action.

Common mistakes

  • Sirf padhna, bolna nahi.
  • Feedback ko defend karna ya ignore karna.
  • Recording dekhne se bachna (sabse zyada seekh wahin hai).
  • Last moment par mock shuru karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Aap interview ki tayari kaise karte ho?
    A. SQL timed practice, case frameworks, STAR stories, aur friends ke saath mocks. Recording se improve karta hu.
  • Q. Feedback me kya sabse common hota hai?
    A. Rambling, structure ki kami aur edge cases miss. Isliye main pehle structure bolta hu.

Yaad rakho

Bolo, record karo, feedback lo, repeat.

IP-13Company researchBasicGood to Have

Interview se pehle company ka product, metrics, recent news samjho aur achhe sawal taiyar rakho. Isse interest aur seriousness dikhti hai.

Simple me samjho

Date par jaane se pehle samne wale ke bare me jaante ho. Company research se tum relevant examples de pate ho aur sahi sawal poochte ho.

Key points

  • Product: company kya banati hai, kaun use karta hai, revenue kaise aata hai. App/website khud use karke dekho.
  • Metrics: unke likely KPIs socho. Poker/gaming me: DAU, rake, retention, deposit conversion, churn. Ye apne examples me use karo.
  • Recent news: funding, new features, launches, leadership changes, regulation news, competitors.
  • Competitors: 2-3 competitors aur unse difference.
  • Team aur role: job description dhyan se padho. Kaunsi tools, kaunsa team (product, marketing, finance).
  • Interviewers: LinkedIn par background dekho (respectfully), common ground dhundo.
  • Questions to ask: "Team ka top KPI kya hai?", "Data stack kya hai?", "Analysts decisions me kaise involved hain?", "Pehle 90 din me success kaisa dikhega?"
  • Avoid: salary ya leave jaisi cheezein first round me, jab tak recruiter na poochhe.
  • Notes: ek one-page sheet banao: company, metrics, 3 sawal, apne relevant project.

Example

Interview ke end me:

text
Interviewer: "Aapke koi sawal?"
Tum: "Maine dekha ki aapne recently tournament format launch kiya.
Is launch ki success kaise measure kar rahe hain, aur analytics team
us decision me kitna involved thi?"

Ye sawal research aur analytical thinking dono dikhata hai.

Common mistakes

  • Sirf website ka "About us" padhna.
  • Koi sawal na poochna (low interest dikhta hai).
  • Research ki hui cheez ko galat batana ya exaggerate karna.
  • Confidential ya unverified news par bolna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Humari company ke bare me kya jaante ho?
    A. Product ka short summary, unka business model, ek recent news ya launch, aur ye ki kyun role mere skills se match karta hai.
  • Q. Aap kya sawal poochoge?
    A. Team ke KPIs, data stack, analyst ka decision me role, aur pehle 90 din ki expectation.

Yaad rakho

Product dekho, metrics socho, sawal taiyar rakho.

Career & Growth 10 topics

CG-012-year goals and specialisationBasicMust Know

Agle 2 saal ke liye ek direction chuno: product, marketing, finance, BI, analytics engineering ya data science. Sab ek saath nahi.

Simple me samjho

Analyst ke kai raaste hain. Saare ek saath sikhoge to kisi me deep nahi ho paoge. Ek primary direction chuno, baaki ko support skill banao.

Key points

  • Product analytics: funnels, retention, experiments, user behaviour. Gaming me bahut common.
  • Marketing analytics: campaigns, attribution, CAC, LTV, channel ROI.
  • Finance analytics: P&L, forecasting, budgeting, unit economics.
  • BI / reporting: dashboards, data modelling, stakeholder reporting (Power BI, Tableau).
  • Analytics engineering: dbt, SQL modelling, data quality, pipelines.
  • Data science: statistics, ML, prediction. Math aur Python zyada.
  • Goal format: "24 mahine me X role, Y skills, Z projects". Measurable rakho.
  • Reality check: job descriptions padho aur apne interest aur strengths se match karo.

Example

text
Current: Data analyst (2 yrs), SQL + Excel strong, poker domain.
Option chosen: Product analytics (retention, funnels, A/B tests)
6 months : SQL window functions, cohort retention, 1 A/B test analysis
12 months: Python + statistics, experiment design, 2 portfolio projects
24 months: Senior analyst / product analyst role, owns one metric area
Review: har 3 mahine me plan dekho aur adjust karo.

Common mistakes

  • Trend ke peeche bhaagna (har naya tool). Pehle fundamentals aur ek domain.
  • Goal ko vague rakhna ("better analyst banna").
  • Apne current kaam se jodna bhool jaana. Kaam me hi practice sabse tez hai.
  • Ek baar chun ke kabhi review na karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Aap 2 saal me khud ko kahan dekhte ho?
    A. Ek clear direction batao (jaise product analytics), skills aur ek example project ke saath, aur role me ownership.
  • Q. Analyst vs data scientist me kaise chunoge?
    A. Business insight aur reporting pasand hai to analyst/BI. Modelling aur math pasand hai to data science.

Yaad rakho

Ek primary direction, ek measurable 24-month plan, quarterly review.

CG-02Portfolio projectsIntermediateMust Know

3 se 5 achhe projects GitHub ya portfolio site par, clear write-up ke saath. Kaam dikhao, sirf skills ki list nahi.

Simple me samjho

Resume claim karta hai, portfolio prove karta hai. Recruiter 2 minute me dekhta hai. Isliye problem, approach aur result saaf likho.

Key points

  • Count: 3 se 5 projects. Quality quantity se zyada.
  • Variety: SQL analysis, dashboard (Power BI/Tableau), Python/EDA, ek A/B test ya experiment.
  • Real problem: business question se shuru karo, jaise "player churn kyun badh raha hai".
  • Data source: public datasets (Kaggle, open data) ya synthetic data. Company ka real/private data kabhi mat daalo.
  • Write-up structure: Problem, Data, Method, Findings, Recommendation, Next steps.
  • GitHub hygiene: README, clean folders, requirements, notebooks me output aur short comments.
  • Visuals: ek-do screenshots ya live dashboard link.
  • Impact line: "Retention 12% badhane ka suggestion" jaise outcome.
  • Update: purane weak projects hatao ya improve karo.

Example

text
Project: Poker player churn analysis (synthetic data)
Problem : 30-day churn 35% hai, kaun se segments chhod rahe hain?
Data    : 50k synthetic players, sessions, deposits
Method  : SQL cohorts + Python survival-style retention curve
Finding : Pehle 3 din me <2 sessions wale 3x zyada churn karte hain
Action  : Day-1 onboarding bonus ka A/B test suggest kiya
Repo    : README + notebook + 2 charts + 1-page summary

Common mistakes

  • Titanic/iris jaise common datasets par basic project, jisme koi business angle nahi.
  • README ke bina code dump.
  • Employer ka confidential data ya credentials push kar dena.
  • Bahut saare half-done projects.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Apna best project batao.
    A. Problem, tumhara role, method, aur measurable result 1-2 minute me. Phir trade-offs bhi batao.
  • Q. Agar office data share nahi kar sakte to?
    A. Public ya synthetic data par same problem recreate karo.

Yaad rakho

Kam projects, saaf story: problem, method, result.

CG-03CertificationsBasicGood to Have

PL-300, Tableau, Google Data Analytics ya cloud data certs: help karte hain, par skills aur projects se bade nahi.

Simple me samjho

Certificate ek structured learning aur resume signal hai. Ye experience ka replacement nahi. Wahi cert lo jo tumhare target role se match kare.

Key points

  • PL-300 (Power BI Data Analyst): Microsoft cert. Power BI, DAX, modelling. BI roles me valued.
  • Tableau certs: Tableau Desktop Specialist/Certified Data Analyst. Tableau use karne wali companies ke liye.
  • Google Data Analytics Certificate: beginner level, Coursera par. Basics ke liye theek, advanced nahi.
  • Cloud data certs: AWS, Azure, GCP data/analytics certs. Data engineering ya cloud-heavy roles ke liye.
  • Cost aur time: exam fee aur prep time plan karo. Details official site par check karo, kyunki badalti rehti hain.
  • Selection rule: job descriptions me jo baar baar aaye wahi cert.
  • Use: cert ke saath ek project bhi banao taaki practical proof ho.
  • Expiry: kuch certs renew karne padte hain.

Example

text
Target: BI / Power BI analyst roles
Plan  : PL-300 prep 8 hafte, 5 hrs/week
Week 1-3 : data modelling + relationships
Week 4-6 : DAX, CALCULATE, time intelligence
Week 7   : practice tests
Week 8   : exam, phir ek dashboard project portfolio me
Result: LinkedIn par cert + project link

Common mistakes

  • Bahut saare certs jama karna bina practice ke.
  • Cert ko hi skill samajh lena. Interview me tools ka real use poochha jaata hai.
  • Outdated prep material. Exam objectives official page se dekho.
  • Aisa cert lena jo industry me recognised nahi hai.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Kya certs zaroori hain?
    A. Zaroori nahi. Projects aur experience zyada matter karte hain, par cert profile ko support karta hai, khaaskar career switch me.
  • Q. Pehla cert kaunsa?
    A. Jo tumhare tool stack se match kare. Power BI use ho to PL-300.

Yaad rakho

Cert goal-aligned ho aur project ke saath ho. Collection mat banao.

CG-04Weekly learning routineBasicMust Know

Har hafte fixed hours seekhne ko do, plan banao aur review karo. Consistency intensity se jeet-ti hai.

Simple me samjho

Gym ki tarah, hafte me 5 ghante regular > ek din 20 ghante. Time calendar me block karo. Plan aur review se pata chalta hai kya seekha.

Key points

  • Fixed hours: hafte me 4-6 ghante realistic rakho (jaise 1 hr x 5 din, ya weekend 3 hr).
  • Calendar block: time ko meeting ki tarah block karo.
  • Weekly plan: Sunday ko 10 minute: is hafte ka ek topic aur ek output.
  • Ek focus: ek hafte me ek topic (jaise window functions), kai nahi.
  • Practice 70%: padhna 30%, exercises aur projects 70%.
  • Weekly review: Friday/Sunday ko: kya seekha, kya atka, agla kya.
  • Tracking: simple sheet ya notes: date, topic, hours, output.
  • Buffer: busy hafte me minimum 2 ghante rakho, streak toote nahi.

Example

text
Hafte ka plan (5 hrs):
Mon 1h : SQL window functions theory
Tue 1h : 5 practice queries
Thu 1h : poker data par retention query
Sat 2h : mini project + notes

Sunday review (10 min):
Seekha  : ROW_NUMBER, LAG
Atka    : frame clause (ROWS BETWEEN)
Next    : frame clause + running total

Common mistakes

  • Bahut zyada plan jo ek hafte me poora na ho.
  • Sirf videos dekhna, practice nahi.
  • Review skip karna, to seekha hua bhool jaata hai.
  • Ek miss ho gaya to poora routine chhod dena.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Aap naye skills kaise seekhte ho?
    A. Fixed weekly hours, topic ke saath hands-on exercise, aur weekly review. Jaise recently SQL window functions ek project me use kiye.
  • Q. Busy schedule me kaise manage karte ho?
    A. Chhote blocks aur minimum commitment, consistency maintain karne ke liye.

Yaad rakho

Plan, practice, review. Chhota par regular.

CG-05Networking and communityBasicGood to Have

LinkedIn, meetups, Kaggle aur blogs se logon se juro aur apna kaam dikhao. Opportunities aksar logon se aati hain.

Simple me samjho

Achhe jobs aur learning aksar referrals aur community se milte hain. Networking ka matlab dikhawa nahi, kaam share karna hai. Chhote, regular steps lo.

Key points

  • LinkedIn: profile saaf rakho, hafte me 1 post (ek learning ya project), analysts ko follow karo.
  • Meetups: local ya online data meetups, conferences. Ek-do logon se baat karna goal rakho.
  • Kaggle: datasets, notebooks, competitions. Practice aur public profile.
  • Blogs: Medium, Substack, ya personal site par seekhi hui cheezein likho.
  • Give first: help karo, resources share karo, sirf maangne mat jao.
  • Communities: Slack/Discord/Reddit data groups me sawaal poochho aur jawab bhi do.
  • Referral: relationships pehle banao, job ki zaroorat pad jaane par nahi.
  • Boundaries: confidential company data kabhi share mat karo.

Example

text
Monthly target:
- LinkedIn par 4 posts (1 per week): e.g. "Retention cohort in SQL: 5 lines"
- 1 meetup ya webinar attend, 2 naye logon se connect
- 1 Kaggle notebook ya 1 blog post
Message template (connect request):
"Hi Asha, aapka cohort analysis post pasand aaya. Main bhi gaming analytics par kaam karta hoon, connect karna chahunga."

Common mistakes

  • Sirf job maangne ke liye message karna.
  • Generic copy-paste connection requests.
  • Company ki internal numbers public post me daal dena.
  • Perfect post ke chakkar me kabhi post hi na karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Community me kaise active ho?
    A. Learnings share karta hoon, Kaggle/LinkedIn par posts, aur meetups me discussions. Isse feedback aur opportunities milti hain.
  • Q. Networking ke bina kya hoga?
    A. Seekhna aur job options limited rehte hain, kyunki kai roles referrals se bharte hain.

Yaad rakho

Pehle value do, phir maango. Chhota aur regular.

CG-06Mentorship and feedbackBasicGood to Have

Ek mentor dhundo aur regular feedback maango. Ye seekhne ki speed sabse zyada badhata hai.

Simple me samjho

Mentor ek shortcut hai: unhone wahi galtiyan pehle ki hain. Feedback aaina hai jo tum khud nahi dekh paate. Maangne se dar mat.

Key points

  • Mentor kaun: senior analyst, manager, ya doosri team ka koi. Zaroori nahi ki same company ho.
  • Kaise dhundo: kaam ke logon se, LinkedIn, community. Specific ask rakho.
  • Specific ask: "mujhe SQL optimization me help chahiye", "meri dashboard par 20 min feedback dijiye".
  • Meeting rhythm: mahine me ek, 30 minute, agenda ke saath.
  • Prepare: sawaal aur pichle action items likh ke jao.
  • Regular feedback: har project ke baad stakeholder aur manager se poochho.
  • Feedback sawaal: "Ek cheez jo achhi thi, ek jo behtar ho sakti hai?"
  • Act on it: feedback par action lo aur batao kya badla.
  • Return value: mentor ka shukriya, update aur khud bhi juniors ko mentor karo.

Example

text
Monthly mentor call (30 min) agenda:
1. Pichle mahine: maine dashboard banaya, manager ne bola "too many charts"
2. Mera sawaal: Kaise 3 KPIs choose karun?
3. Mentor ka advice: decision se start karo, KPI baad me
4. Action: dashboard 5 charts se 3 par laya, agli call me dikhaunga

Common mistakes

  • Vague ask ("mentor banoge?"). Pehle ek chhota specific sawaal poochho.
  • Feedback ko personal le kar defensive hona.
  • Mentor se baat karke follow-up na karna.
  • Sirf ek source se feedback. Alag log alag angle dete hain.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Aapko feedback kaise handle karte ho?
    A. Sunta hoon, clarify karta hoon, action plan banata hoon aur follow-up karta hoon. Ek example: manager ke feedback par dashboard simplify kiya.
  • Q. Mentor kaise dhundoge?
    A. Specific skill gap pehchanta hoon, phir us area ke senior se chhota ask karta hoon.

Yaad rakho

Specific ask, regular meeting, feedback par action.

CG-07Brag documentBasicMust Know

Apni jeet (wins) numbers ke saath turant likho. Review, promotion aur interview ke time sabse kaam aata hai.

Simple me samjho

Brag document ek diary hai jisme tum apni uplabdhiyan likhte ho. 6 mahine baad yaad nahi rehta kya kiya. Isliye hota hai jab hota hai, tab likho.

Key points

  • Kya likho: kaam, impact (number), date, kaun involved, link ya evidence.
  • Numbers ke saath: "report banayi" nahi, "weekly report 3 ghante se 20 minute me automate ki".
  • Turant likho: win hote hi 2 minute. Hafte ka reminder lagao.
  • Format: simple doc ya sheet: date | what | impact | evidence.
  • Sab cheezein: projects, mentoring, process improvements, tough bugs, positive feedback, learning.
  • Feedback quotes: stakeholder ke achhe messages screenshot ya copy karke rakho.
  • Use: self-review, promotion case, resume bullets, interview stories.
  • Private rakho: company confidential details apne personal doc me copy mat karo, summary hi likho.

Example

text
Date    | What                          | Impact                        | Evidence
12 Mar  | Automated daily rake report   | 45 min/day saved, 0 manual err| Script link, manager msg
03 Jun  | Churn cohort analysis         | Led to onboarding bonus test  | Slide deck
21 Aug  | Fixed duplicate txn bug       | Revenue overcount 2.3% removed| Ticket #123
Resume bullet: "Automated daily rake reporting, saving ~15 hrs/month"

Common mistakes

  • Review se ek hafte pehle yaad karke likhna. Details aur numbers bhool jaate hain.
  • Impact ke bina sirf task list.
  • Chhoti wins ignore karna. Saath me jud kar bade stories ban jaati hain.
  • Doc ko kisi ek jagah na rakhna, ya company laptop par hi chhod dena.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Apni sabse badi achievement batao.
    A. Brag document se: problem, action, measurable impact. Jaise ek report automate karke 15 ghante/mahina bachaye.
  • Q. Numbers na ho to?
    A. Estimate karo (time saved, users affected) aur batao ki estimate hai.

Yaad rakho

Win hote hi likho, number ke saath.

CG-08Performance review preparationIntermediateMust Know

Review ke liye goals, KPIs, self-review aur evidence taiyaar rakho, taaki apna impact saaf dikha sako.

Simple me samjho

Review me wahi dikhta hai jo tum evidence ke saath bata sako. Manager ko sab yaad nahi rehta. Saal bhar thoda-thoda tayyari karo, last minute nahi.

Key points

  • Goals: saal ke shuru me manager ke saath clear goals set karo. Measurable aur time-bound.
  • KPIs: apne kaam ke metrics jaise dashboard adoption, report turnaround time, accuracy, stakeholder satisfaction.
  • Self-review: apne goals ke against likho: kya poora hua, kya nahi, kyun.
  • Evidence: brag document, emails, dashboards, project links, numbers.
  • Structure: Goal, Action, Result (number), Learning.
  • Gaps honestly: kamzori maano aur improvement plan do.
  • Next goals: agle saal ke liye apne proposals lekar jao.
  • Manager ke saath: review se pehle 1:1 me expectations aur feedback pooch lo, surprise nahi.
  • Promotion case: agle level ke kaam (ownership, influence) ke examples.

Example

text
Goal    : Reduce reporting time
Action  : Built automated pipeline for weekly KPI pack
Result  : 6 hrs/week -> 30 min, used by 4 teams
Evidence: Dashboard link, manager's Slack note, brag doc entry
Gap     : A/B test analysis me confidence kam; plan = ek course + 2 tests Q1 me
Next    : Own retention metric area

Common mistakes

  • Self-review me sirf tasks likhna, result nahi.
  • Last week me yaad karke likhna.
  • Credit team ko ya khud ko poora dena. Apna role saaf batao.
  • Feedback sunne ki jagah argue karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Aap review ke liye kaise prepare karte ho?
    A. Goals ke against brag document se evidence nikalta hoon, results numbers me likhta hoon, aur gaps ke saath plan leke jaata hoon.
  • Q. Weak area kaise batate ho?
    A. Honestly, ek example ke saath aur improvement action ke saath.

Yaad rakho

Goal, action, result, evidence. Surprise nahi, taiyaari.

CG-09Path to senior analystAdvancedGood to Have

Senior banne ke liye ownership, mentoring, strategy, bina authority ke influence aur ambiguity handle karna seekho. Sirf tools nahi.

Simple me samjho

Junior ko sawaal diya jaata hai. Senior khud sahi sawaal dhundhta hai aur business ko direction deta hai. Technical skills base hain, par behaviour se farak padta hai.

Key points

  • Ownership: ek metric ya area ka end-to-end zimmedaar bano, data quality se decision tak.
  • Mentoring: juniors ko review do, SQL aur analysis seekhao. Team ki speed badhti hai.
  • Strategy: sirf "kya hua" nahi, "kyun aur ab kya karein". Business goals se jodo.
  • Influencing without authority: data, saaf story aur trust se logon ko convince karo, manager na hone par bhi.
  • Handling ambiguity: vague sawaal ko tod ke clear question, assumptions aur plan banao.
  • Prioritisation: high impact kaam chuno, "no" bolna seekho.
  • Communication: bina technical logon ke liye simple summary aur recommendation.
  • Impact: output (reports) se outcome (decisions, revenue) tak.
  • Judgement: kab accuracy chahiye aur kab fast estimate kaafi hai.

Example

text
Vague ask: "Retention improve karna hai."
Senior approach:
1. Define: Day-7 retention by new vs old players
2. Diagnose: kahan drop (onboarding, first deposit)
3. Hypothesis: first-game bonus se retention badhegi
4. Plan: A/B test, success metric, 2 hafte
5. Align: product aur marketing ko 1-page summary
6. Own: result track karke next steps recommend

Common mistakes

  • Sirf tools aur code par focus, business context ignore.
  • Sab kuch khud karna, delegate ya mentor na karna.
  • Data dena par recommendation na dena.
  • Ambiguity se ghabra ke clarify kiye bina kaam shuru karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Senior analyst aur analyst me kya fark?
    A. Scope aur ownership, ambiguity handle karna, business recommendations aur doosron ko influence aur mentor karna.
  • Q. Bina authority ke kaise influence karoge?
    A. Data-backed story, stakeholders ki problem samajh kar aur trust bana kar.

Yaad rakho

Senior = ownership + judgement + influence, sirf SQL nahi.

CG-10Staying updatedBasicGood to Have

Newsletters, release notes, naye tools aur AI developments ko dhyan se follow karo, bina overwhelm hue.

Simple me samjho

Data field tez badalti hai. Sab padhna possible nahi, isliye kuch trusted sources chuno. Hafte me thoda time fix karo aur seekhe hue ko kaam me try karo.

Key points

  • Newsletters: 2-3 achhe newsletters chuno (data, analytics, tool-specific). Zyada subscribe mat karo.
  • Release notes: apne tools (Power BI, Tableau, Excel, Postgres, dbt) ke monthly release notes dekho.
  • New tools: ek naya tool ya feature ek baar chhote project par try karo.
  • AI developments: AI assistants SQL, Python aur analysis me help karte hain. Seekho kab use karna hai aur outputs verify karna.
  • Verify AI: AI ka code ya number hamesha check karo, data privacy ka dhyan rakho.
  • Time-box: hafte me 1 ghanta, ya roz 15 minute.
  • Notes: ek chhota doc: kya naya, kaam me kaise use ho sakta hai.
  • Filter: sirf wahi seekho jo tumhare role aur goals se jude.

Example

text
Weekly routine (60 min):
Mon 15 min : 2 newsletters skim
Wed 15 min : Power BI / Excel release notes ek naya feature
Fri 30 min : ek naya feature chhote dataset par try, note likho
Month end  : 3 baatein jo team ko share karni hain
Rule       : AI se code liya to test data par verify, company data bina permission ke daalna nahi

Common mistakes

  • Har naye tool ke peeche bhaagna aur fundamentals bhool jaana.
  • 20 newsletters subscribe karke kuch na padhna.
  • AI output ko bina check kiye use karna.
  • Confidential data ko public AI tools me paste karna.

Interview Q&A

  • Q. Aap updated kaise rehte ho?
    A. Kuch fixed newsletters, tool release notes, aur naye features ko chhote projects par try karta hoon.
  • Q. AI tools ko kaise use karte ho?
    A. Draft code ya idea ke liye, par results hamesha verify karta hoon aur sensitive data share nahi karta.

Yaad rakho

Kam sources, fixed time, try karke seekho. AI ko verify karke use karo.
